Adestan bids you speak with Maxinne, the guard watching over Amdapor Keep, that you might behold the terrors within for yourself.
TEXT_SUBCTS109_00430_SEQ_03:
Maxinne grants you entry to the castle, but not without a warning. The darkness inside has made the forest life turn savage and feral. It will pose a deadly challenge to you until the voidsent lord lurking at the castle's heart is defeated.

※Amdapor Keep (Hard) can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_SUBCTS109_00430_SEQ_04: You have felled the voidsent lord, a nightmarish being seemingly garbed in harlequin's attire. Return to Camp Tranquil and tell Brother Adestan that you have had the last laugh.
TEXT_SUBCTS109_00430_SEQ_05: After hearing of your adventure, Adestan realizes the voidsent were summoned forth not by the living, but rather by the dead. The Lambs of Dalamud's dark rites had been complete but for blood. When you purged them, their vitality ran forth over the ground, and brought their foul rituals to fruition. Adestan wonders if the voidsent drew the Lambs to Amdapor in the first place, before dismissing such theories as improbable. He nevertheless thanks you for restoring peace to the Shroud.
TEXT_SUBCTS110_00431_SEQ_00: Bloezoeng seems to have eyes only for you.
TEXT_SUBCTS110_00431_SEQ_01: Bloezoeng is overjoyed to hear that you are the very adventurer who survived the Wanderer's Palace. He explains that a fellow in his acquaintance─a treasure hunter of sorts─has been searching for you. Go and discover why at Camp Bronze Lake in upper La Noscea.
TEXT_SUBCTS110_00431_SEQ_02: You speak with the blundering treasure hunter and his companion. The two tell a harrowing tale, of how close they came to death within the Wanderer's Palace themselves, only to be saved by the tonberries. Their respite was short-lived, however, as a bloodthirsty band of Mamool Ja sellswords invaded not long after, slaughtering many tonberries and locking the remainder away. The treasure-hunting duo barely escaped the attack with their lives. Now, they ask that you give the mercenaries the boot, and so aid their tonberry comrades. Speak with the ferryman Abazi Charazi to gain entrance to the Wanderer's Palace.
TEXT_SUBCTS110_00431_SEQ_03:
Deciding to overlook his hatred of the tonberries, Abazi Charazi grants you passage to the Wanderer's Palace to save the beleaguered creatures from the Silverscales.

※The Wanderer's Palace (Hard) can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_SUBCTS110_00431_SEQ_04: The Silverscales are now sleeping with faerie bass, so to speak, and the tonberries are rescued. Return to Camp Bronze Lake, and tell the treasure hunters of your triumph.
TEXT_SUBCTS110_00431_SEQ_05: The treasure-hunting pair are overjoyed to hear of your success. They thank you profusely, vowing that they will do all in their power to ensure the tonberries' safety. With smiles on their lips, the two depart to live happy lives amongst their green friends.
TEXT_SUBCTS822_00432_SEQ_00: The wandering minstrel of Revenant's Toll would like you to wet his whistle.
TEXT_SUBCTS822_00432_SEQ_01: Much has the wandering minstrel heard of your legendary deeds, but he is more interested in your knowledge of legendary steeds. Upon discovering that you have a full stable of magicked mounts at your beck and call, a revelation dawns on him: could you be the one of whom the ancient hermit spoke, all those years ago? The one who can sound the mystic whistle he has carried with him ever since, and call forth the beast of legend? Convinced that this hero is you, he bids you take the pipe to a suitable stage─the crystal cliffs of Rathefrost─and blow with all your might.
TEXT_SUBCTS822_00432_SEQ_02: You climb the glowing pathway to the Rathefrost cliffs, and blow the magicked dizi beneath the crystal branches. As its piercing note echoes in the air, a mythical Kirin appears before your very eyes. The minstrel emerges from his hiding place, full awed by the sight of the legendary beast, and declares that his word was true: you are indeed the hero to whom the Kirin has pledged its fealty. Whensoever you call upon it with a blast from the whistle, the immortal beast will return to you from its otherworldly kingdom, and whisk you wheresoever you please. And so a new chapter in your epic saga begins...
TEXT_SUBGSC001_00434_SEQ_00: A well-heeled youth on Emerald Avenue appears to have been the beneficiary of some good fortune, and may not be averse to sharing it...
TEXT_SUBGSC001_00434_SEQ_01: As his manservant gamely struggles to maintain his grip on a towering stack of prizes, the well-heeled youth regales you with tales of his exploits at the Gold Saucer, the entertainment venue to which all of Ul'dah seems irresistibly drawn. Still basking in the glow of victory, he magnanimously furnishes you with a golden airship ticket. Present it at the airship landing and see for yourself what all the fuss is about.
TEXT_SUBGSC001_00434_SEQ_02: You emerge from the airship into the garishly illuminated halls of the Gold Saucer. Set forth into a glittering world of delights and diversions...and may fortune smile upon you.
TEXT_SUBGSC002_00435_SEQ_00: The attendant at the airship landing seems eager to welcome you to the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_SUBGSC002_00435_SEQ_01: You have been invited to participate in an introductory tour of the Gold Saucer, at the conclusion of which you will apparently be entitled to some manner of complimentary gift. The economics of complimentary gifts aside, there seems little reason not to take part. Proceed to the main counter and inform the receptionist of your readiness to begin.
TEXT_SUBGSC002_00435_SEQ_02: Having enthusiastically welcomed you to the Gold Saucer, the receptionist points out the gates leading to one of its main attractions: the chocobo races. He then explains that most transactions within the establishment are conducted in Manderville Gold Saucer points (MGP), and directs you to his colleague to learn more about the currency and how to acquire it.
TEXT_SUBGSC002_00435_SEQ_03: You step away from the front desk with a newfound understanding of MGP. To continue your tour, proceed to Card Square, where the Triple Triad trader is waiting to teach you more about Eorzea's favorite new card game.
TEXT_SUBGSC002_00435_SEQ_04: The Triple Triad trader introduces you to the realm's most popular new card game, encouraging you to return at any time to learn the rules and begin building a deck of your own. The next stop on your tour will be Wonder Square─make your way there and listen to what the resident GATE Keeper has to say.
TEXT_SUBGSC002_00435_SEQ_05: You learn that Wonder Square is home to an assortment of games─as well as a giant revolving cactuar named “El Coloso,” which features prominently in a number of events. Continue on to the second floor of Event Square, where an attendant named Veleda awaits you by the Cactpot Board.
TEXT_SUBGSC002_00435_SEQ_06: Veleda cheerfully welcomes you to Event Square, home to the Gold Saucer's center stage and the lucrative lottery known as the Jumbo Cactpot. Apparently conscious of the time, she soon blows you a kiss and sends you on your way to the final place of interest on your tour: the incongruously named Round Square. Speak with the GATE Keeper there to continue your tour.
TEXT_SUBGSC002_00435_SEQ_07: Though your visit to Round Square notably fails to shed any light on its oxymoronic name, it does alert you to the presence of a massive boulder dubbed Mt. Corel─the scene of a rousing mountaineering challenge in which you are heartily encouraged to participate. The GATE Keeper informs you that your tour is complete, and encourages you to return to the main counter to receive your complimentary gift. Whatever could it be?
TEXT_SUBGSC002_00435_SEQ_08: Even as you receive your long-anticipated gift, you are greeted by Master Roland, the overseer entrusted with managing daily operations at the Gold Saucer. Observing that you are an adventurer, he shares with you the story behind the birth of the establishment, and the ambitious goals of his esteemed employer, the singular Godbert Manderville. Trusting that you share a common understanding, he takes his leave, encouraging you to enjoy all that the Gold Saucer has to offer.
TEXT_SUBGSC101_00436_SEQ_00: For those with a need for speed and a yearning for competition, the Manderville Gold Saucer provides the perfect solution.
TEXT_SUBGSC101_00436_SEQ_01: You have been invited to participate in sanctioned chocobo races held by the Manderville Gold Saucer. However, in order to do so, you must first secure a trained race chocobo. Journey to Moogle's Gift Mounts in Gridania's Bentbranch Meadows and speak with Katering to learn more.
TEXT_SUBGSC101_00436_SEQ_02: With Katering's assistance, you select a suitable fledgling to serve as your race chocobo. The trainer then furnishes you with the documentation needed to register your chocobo with the Gold Saucer, bringing you one step closer to your debut...
TEXT_SUBFST100_00443_SEQ_00: Nyell, the levemete at Quarrymill, is recruiting adventurers to undertake his stack of local levequests.
TEXT_SUBFST100_00443_SEQ_01: Convince Nyell to allow you to undertake further levequests by completing a trial leve. Though the decidedly risk-averse levemete portrays the test as a means for him to measure the likelihood of your death, you may choose instead to consider it an assessment of your skills as an adventurer.
TEXT_SUBFST100_00443_SEQ_02: You have successfully completed the trial leve. Return to Quarrymill and report to Nyell.
TEXT_SUBFST100_00443_SEQ_03: Having been forced to concede that you seem capable of completing such tasks as he might allocate, Nyell bemusedly accepts your offer to continue risking life and limb in the service of others. Speak with the despondent levemete to undertake further levequests, and take solace in the thought that the residents of Quarrymill, at least, will be cheered by your efforts...
TEXT_SUBFST101_00444_SEQ_00: Merthelin, the levemete at Camp Tranquil, seeks capable adventurers to undertake his many tasks.
TEXT_SUBFST101_00444_SEQ_01: Merthelin is eager to have you begin accepting levequests, but first you must complete a trial leve to prove that your skills as an adventurer are up to the task.
TEXT_SUBFST101_00444_SEQ_02: You have successfully completed the trial leve. Return to Camp Tranquil and report to the levemete, Merthelin.
TEXT_SUBFST101_00444_SEQ_03: Merthelin is clearly overjoyed at your success. Prove his trust in you is well placed by undertaking future levequests in service to the people of Camp Tranquil.
TEXT_SUBSEA058_00470_SEQ_00: Ostfyr hopes to assure the safety of wayfarers at the La Thagran Checkpoint by ridding the area of its dangerous denizens.
TEXT_SUBSEA058_00470_SEQ_01: You learn that the Rogue River has been particularly perilous of late. Overturn three yarzon nests, and extirpate the yarzons that appear.
TEXT_SUBSEA058_00470_SEQ_02: You have considerably thinned out the yarzon population at the Rogue River. Return to the La Thagran Checkpoint to let Ostfyr know that the creatures will menace wayfarers no more.
TEXT_SUBSEA058_00470_SEQ_03: The Yellowjackets are too few in number to guard the La Thagran Checkpoint, and the surrounding regions have not a man to spare. They need your help.
TEXT_SUBSEA059_00471_SEQ_00: Grynewyda seeks courageous pioneers who can tame the wilderness for Summerford Farms.
TEXT_SUBSEA059_00471_SEQ_01: The Admiral's settlement initiative rewards pioneers for settling the Lominsan frontier, but the washed-up pirates who work under Grynewyda have not been diligent in their work. If you would assist, take up the tiller's shovel at the nearby shack.
TEXT_SUBSEA059_00471_SEQ_02: You have taken up the tiller's shovel. Make your way to the designated area and clear away the rocks and debris.
TEXT_SUBSEA059_00471_SEQ_03: All is clear on the frontier. Report the completion of your task to Grynewyda.
TEXT_SUBSEA059_00471_SEQ_04: Summerford Farms has upheld the Admiral's settlement initiative. While the pirates the Admiral sent know how to sail the savage seas, they have much to learn about breaking the stubborn earth.
TEXT_SUBSEA060_00472_SEQ_00: Bhirdraeg's La Noscean oranges are ripe and ready for picking.
TEXT_SUBSEA060_00472_SEQ_01: Bhirdraeg has asked you to pick his ripe La Noscean oranges. The irascible pirates under him would rather pick fights than fruits, leaving the labor to you.
TEXT_SUBSEA060_00472_SEQ_02: You have picked an adequate number of oranges. Bring them back to Bhirdraeg.
TEXT_SUBSEA060_00472_SEQ_03: The pirates' antics have sown seeds of discontent among the local growers, and the Admiral appears to be entangled in the weeds.
TEXT_SUBSEA061_00473_SEQ_00: Bhirdraeg seeks to restore equilibrium by having the local fauna culled.
TEXT_SUBSEA061_00473_SEQ_01: Puks prey on the insects that pollinate La Noscean oranges, upsetting the balance of nature on Summerford Farms. Assist Bhirdraeg by culling five puk hatchlings.
TEXT_SUBSEA061_00473_SEQ_02: You have carried out the culling as bade. Return to Bhirdraeg and inform him that the puks stop here.
TEXT_SUBSEA061_00473_SEQ_03: With the bees back about their business, the La Noscean oranges will grow. Nevertheless, all will be for naught if the lazing pirates let the fruit rot on the boughs.
TEXT_SUBSEA062_00474_SEQ_00: Hi-potions are in short supply at Tiller's Rest, and Khanmhar hopes to remedy that.
TEXT_SUBSEA062_00474_SEQ_01: The retired pirates are restless, and the frequent fighting has depleted the farm's reserves of medicine. Wydaloef at Tiller's Rest would be thankful for a hi-potion to replenish his fast-dwindling stores.
TEXT_SUBSEA062_00474_SEQ_02: You can take the pirate out of the raging sea, but you cannot take the raging sea out of the pirate. One can only hope the buccaneers will someday find peace on earth.
TEXT_SUBSEA063_00475_SEQ_00: Ancreta, sentry at the Eyes, solicits assistance.
TEXT_SUBSEA063_00475_SEQ_01: Ancreta's grandfather, head of the Red Rooster Stead, has charged her with the procurement of three livers from the rivertoads indigenous to the Eyes. Alas, the squeamish sentry is sickened by the mere thought of handling the livers, and requests that you obtain them in her stead.
TEXT_SUBSEA063_00475_SEQ_02: You have obtained the requested amount of rivertoad livers. Show them to Ancreta at the Eyes.
TEXT_SUBSEA063_00475_SEQ_03: Unable to leave her post and loath to handle the livers, Ancreta tasks you with delivering them to her grandfather Anaoc at the Red Rooster Stead.
TEXT_SUBSEA063_00475_SEQ_04: The livers give Anaoc's fertilizer more potency...or so you are told. Adopting advanced agricultural techniques has served the farm well to date, and promises a prosperous future to come.
TEXT_SUBSEA064_00476_SEQ_00: Anaoc seeks an adventurer to assist the Red Rooster Stead.
TEXT_SUBSEA064_00476_SEQ_01: Anaoc asks you to deliver wool to the Grey Fleet. Retrieve the sack of fleece from the sheep's pen.
TEXT_SUBSEA064_00476_SEQ_02: You have obtained the sack of fleece. Deliver it to Weitzaren at the Grey Fleet.
TEXT_SUBSEA064_00476_SEQ_03: Weitzaren receives your delivery with equal parts exasperation and delight. Thanks to you, the miller may now begin making his felt.
TEXT_SUBSEA065_00477_SEQ_00: Weitzaren, high miller of the Grey Fleet, requires the help of an able adventurer.
TEXT_SUBSEA065_00477_SEQ_01: Weitzaren asks that you wreak vengeance on the galagos that robbed him of his milled grains, and recover the sacks of flour they stole.
TEXT_SUBSEA065_00477_SEQ_02: You have delivered swift retribution to the thieving galagos. Take the recovered flour to Skarnmhar at the Red Rooster Stead.
TEXT_SUBSEA065_00477_SEQ_03: Skarnmhar is appreciative of your help, but bemoans the fact the Stead hires no guards, and he must rely on the kindness of adventurers when things go awry.
TEXT_SUBSEA066_00478_SEQ_00: Skarnmhar of the Red Rooster Stead seeks an adventurer who can serve up some justice.
TEXT_SUBSEA066_00478_SEQ_01: A stagecoach has been waylaid en route to the Stead. The plucky coachman, a fellow by the name of Wahoy Mahoy, has followed the culprits back to Blind Iron Mines in hopes of salvaging his cargo. Seek him out and offer him your help.
TEXT_SUBSEA066_00478_SEQ_02: The kobolds that ransacked Wahoy's coach are hiding out in the mines. Clean up the kobolds and take back the cargo.
TEXT_SUBSEA066_00478_SEQ_03: You have defeated the kobolds and reclaimed Wahoy Mahoy's cargo─bundles of raiments. Deliver the good tidings to the coachman.
TEXT_SUBSEA066_00478_SEQ_04: An overjoyed Wahoy Mahoy is rearing to render the raiments to Skarnmhar. He asks that you complete the delivery in his stead while he repairs the stagecoach.
TEXT_SUBSEA066_00478_SEQ_05: Skarnmhar takes the news of kobold activity with a furrowed brow. It might be best to bring this matter to Anaoc's attention.
TEXT_SUBSEA066_00478_SEQ_06: The kobolds have been making steady inroads into Red Rooster Stead turf and show no signs of slowing down. It is only a matter of time before push comes to shove.
TEXT_SUBSEA067_00479_SEQ_00: Anaoc deems a confrontation with the kobolds imminent.
TEXT_SUBSEA067_00479_SEQ_01: The kobolds and Lominsans have long shared an armistice, but Anaoc is convinced that the peace is untenable, and that recent kobold incursions justify a preemptive attack. Arenlona of the Dawn Meadow will brief you on the stratagem.
TEXT_SUBSEA067_00479_SEQ_02: Arenlona posits that, since prolonged famine has driven the kobolds to raid the Stead for foodstuffs, they can be baited out. Speak to Anaoc about preparing the lure.
TEXT_SUBSEA067_00479_SEQ_03: Anaoc directs you to Skarnmhar, who can supply you with dodo meat from an unshipped consignment.
TEXT_SUBSEA067_00479_SEQ_04: K'wabati waits by the southern mouth of Blind Iron Mines to instruct you where to set the crate of meat.
TEXT_SUBSEA067_00479_SEQ_05: Set the crate of meat in the mines.
TEXT_SUBSEA067_00479_SEQ_06: Slay the kobolds that take the bait.
TEXT_SUBSEA067_00479_SEQ_07: Inform Anaoc that the mines are clear of kobolds.
TEXT_SUBSEA067_00479_SEQ_08: The immediate threat has been quelled, but the specter of a kobold uprising still looms. Speak with Baderon at the Drowning Wench to see what can be done to fortify the Red Rooster Stead for the trials ahead.
TEXT_SUBSEA067_00479_SEQ_09: Baderon recognizes that, in their zeal to summon Titan, the kobolds have been amassing crystals through increasingly violent means. He will speak with the Yellowjackets about a dispatch to defend the Red Rooster Stead, but it will matter little should Titan awaken.
TEXT_SUBSEA068_00480_SEQ_00: Moegramm doesn't know what to do about his dodos.
TEXT_SUBSEA068_00480_SEQ_01: Dodos have escaped from their pen at the Red Rooster Stead. Speak with X'payan if you would help to bring them back.
TEXT_SUBSEA068_00480_SEQ_02: Domesticated dodos are docile creatures that wouldn't dare wander into the wild. Find the bolting dodos on the Stead and capture them in the dodo-sized sacks.
TEXT_SUBSEA068_00480_SEQ_03: You have caught all the escaped birds. Take the dodo-filled sacks back to Moegramm.
TEXT_SUBSEA068_00480_SEQ_04: With the restoration of his beloved dodos, Moegramm discovers a newfound love for capable adventurers.
TEXT_SUBSEA069_00481_SEQ_00: Moegramm has been losing sleep over his sheep.
TEXT_SUBSEA069_00481_SEQ_01: The wool from Moegramm's sheep lacks its former luster, and won't fetch a fair price at market. The shepherd Chartain should know how to make the sheep shine again.
TEXT_SUBSEA069_00481_SEQ_02: Chartain attributes the lackluster fleece to lice, and attributes the lice to a lack of farmhands to help with brushing. Delouse three shaggy sheep with the lice comb.
TEXT_SUBSEA069_00481_SEQ_03: Inform Moegramm that his shaggy sheep now have a sheepy sheen.
TEXT_SUBSEA069_00481_SEQ_04: Moegramm is grateful you brushed up his wool for market. It would have been a shame to make mutton of the sheep when he seems so...attached.
TEXT_SUBSEA070_00482_SEQ_00: Arenlona has some moles she would like removed.
TEXT_SUBSEA070_00482_SEQ_01: The clever hedgemoles appear to be particularly fond of the ogre pumpkins Arenlona has cultivated. Visit the pumpkin patch and whack the moles.
TEXT_SUBSEA070_00482_SEQ_02: You have purged the patch of the pumpkin pinchers. Return to Arenlona with the glad tidings.
TEXT_SUBSEA070_00482_SEQ_03: Arenlona is constantly devising new cultivation methods to keep up with ever-evolving harvest woes, but having an adventurer around, even temporarily, should enable her to make significant strides.
TEXT_SUBSEA071_00483_SEQ_00: Arenlona is in a bit of a tight spot.
TEXT_SUBSEA071_00483_SEQ_01: Arenlona asks you to sprinkle aphid nectar upon Althyk lavender to lure little ladybugs, then squash them into three phials' worth of ladybug viscera.
TEXT_SUBSEA071_00483_SEQ_02: You have obtained the required amount of ladybug viscera. Deliver them to Arenlona.
TEXT_SUBSEA071_00483_SEQ_03: Arenlona explains that, since ladybugs are natural predators of aphids, the ladybug viscera will keep the aphids at bay. She insists that this is all very scientific.
TEXT_SUBSEA072_00484_SEQ_00: Loetrswys wishes to check for any trouble that might be milling about the Grey Fleet.
TEXT_SUBSEA072_00484_SEQ_01: Loetrswys is not one to leave until the morrow what can be done today. Find what's been going on around the mill by asking the millers.
TEXT_SUBSEA072_00484_SEQ_02: The task has come full circle. Let Weitzaren know.
TEXT_SUBSEA072_00484_SEQ_03: Weitzaren will arrange repairs for Eshushu's sail, just in case circumstances take an unexpected turn for the worse.
TEXT_SUBSEA073_00485_SEQ_00: Brimstone has blocked Broenruht out of Blind Iron Mines.
TEXT_SUBSEA073_00485_SEQ_01: Digging stoppages may endanger the miners' livelihoods, but a surfeit of sulphurous gas endangers their very lives. Only clear earth crystals can plug the gas plumes and decontaminate the shafts.
TEXT_SUBSEA073_00485_SEQ_02: The clear earth crystals worked like a charm on the gas plumes. Let Broenruht know that the mines are no longer brimming with brimstone.
TEXT_SUBSEA073_00485_SEQ_03: The demand for ore has risen sharply due to rebuilding efforts in the wake of the Calamity. Many miners would not think twice about risking their health for the healthy profits in store, but owing to your deeds, none will have to.
TEXT_SUBSEA074_00486_SEQ_00: Diminutive kobolds are wreaking great chaos at the Grey Fleet.
TEXT_SUBSEA074_00486_SEQ_01: Loetrswys seeks to enlist the aid of the Red Rooster Stead by contacting Moegramm.
TEXT_SUBSEA074_00486_SEQ_02: On hearing of Loetrswys's woes, Moegramm asks you to help send a missive to Ostfyr at the La Thagran Checkpoint. Broenruht can provide you with guidance through Blind Iron Mines, so that you may reach La Thagran in time.
TEXT_SUBSEA074_00486_SEQ_03: Broenruht informs you that the mine's inhabitants keep mostly to themselves, and that the route to La Thagran is relatively safe.
TEXT_SUBSEA074_00486_SEQ_04: On reading the report, Ostfyr fears for Summerford Farms, and asks that you inform Staelwyrn of the kobold threat.
TEXT_SUBSEA074_00486_SEQ_05: Staelwyrn has been more concerned with the Sahagin menace of late, but takes Ostfyr's warning to heart out of respect.
TEXT_SUBSEA075_00487_SEQ_00: There is no shortage of free advice or cheap hangovers at the Drowning Wench, and Gregory is happy to provide the guidance if not the grog.
TEXT_SUBSEA075_00487_SEQ_01: Gregory advises you to go pay your respects to other adventurers, as is the custom in Limsa Lominsa. For your first test, he targets Niniya as the recipient of your obeisance. A curious choice, but then again, Gregory is a curious man.
TEXT_SUBSEA075_00487_SEQ_02: Niniya asks what your business is, and you find yourself momentarily at a loss for words. With the chat mode firmly in Say, enter “I come in peace.” with all the dignity you can muster.
TEXT_SUBSEA075_00487_SEQ_03: While Niniya does not seem displeased by your greeting, she voices a preference for more common parlance. Take a deep breath, relax your shoulders, and with the chat mode in Say, enter the auto-translate option Hello! to greet Niniya again.
TEXT_SUBSEA075_00487_SEQ_04: Niniya is pleased, though you cannot tell whether it is by your greeting or your docility. She urges you to save your more formal utterances for the likes of Singing Stormcloud, and what better time than now?
TEXT_SUBSEA075_00487_SEQ_05: The Roegadyn with the fine contralto has heard of you, and would know more. With the chat mode in Say, follow Niniya's advice and greet the decorous adventurer by entering “Greetings and salutations!”
TEXT_SUBSEA075_00487_SEQ_06: Niniya's advice may have been given in jest, but if your reputation had not preceded you, Singing Stormcloud would likely have taken offense. The bluff adventurer tells you to observe Niniya's deeds and not her words, and such sound counsel deserves a Thank you.
TEXT_SUBSEA075_00487_SEQ_07: After thanking Singing Stormcloud for her advice, she seems more amenable to your forthrightness. Will she be as good as her word and summon you back one day for a worthy cause? Or will nothing more come of this encounter? Only time will tell.
TEXT_CHRHDB501_00490_SEQ_00: Ellie would share with you a shocking new turn in the phantom thief case.
TEXT_CHRHDB501_00490_SEQ_01:
Inspector's Log:
I daresay, that spell of physical exertion at the Coliseum served well to clear my mind. My inquisitive senses feel even more heightened than ever! Most auspicious timing, as it would seem the fiend I pursue has set his sights on his greatest prize yet, an act which I am bound by duty and honor to foil. The exact nature of this final Belah'dian relic eludes me for the moment, but for Hildibrand─agent of enquiry, inspector extraordinaire─inspiration is always but a stone's throw away!
　　　　　　　　　　　　*　*　*
The news Ellie shares with you is chilling indeed. Three prominent citizens of the sultanate have been murdered in cold blood, and evidence at the scene suggests that the thief of many faces is responsible. Meanwhile, the exact nature of the fourth and final relic that the thief is targeting remains unknown. At a loss for leads, Ellie proposes a visit to the sultanate's leading information-monger. Seek out Wymond on the Steps of Nald.
TEXT_CHRHDB501_00490_SEQ_02: Details on the phantom thief's movements are scarce, with Wymond able to offer only the knowledge that the Sultansworn have redoubled their efforts to keep the royal vaults safe from your quarry. He accompanies this with an ominous warning that this case may prove more dangerous than your previous forays. Ellie remains undaunted, and bids you accompany her to the Heart of the Sworn to seek further information from those in the know.
TEXT_CHRHDB501_00490_SEQ_03: At your destination, you are reunited with none other than Humphrey, the erstwhile two-gil swindler who has since amended his ways and enlisted in the Sultansworn with dreams of serving the realm not unlike Hildibrand, whom he idolizes. In return for your efforts in introducing him to his newfound role model, he introduces you to Phillice, who is leading the investigation. She is being assisted by Consulting Inspector Briardien, who has devised an ingenious powder capable of dispelling the phantom thief's disguises, and Hildibrand, who is convinced he has something to offer the investigation as well. After a less-than-enlightening briefing from Phillice on the details of the murders, you prepare to take to the field. Consult with Hildibrand as to your next course of action.
TEXT_CHRHDB501_00490_SEQ_04: Hildibrand suggests that you begin your search at the Eighty Sins of Sasamo, where the most recent victim's body was discovered. Make your way to western Thanalan and rendezvous with the inspector.
TEXT_CHRHDB501_00490_SEQ_05: Your inspection of the crime scene turns up a scattering of flowers, soon revealed to be placed there by the victim's elderly mother in memory of her departed son. Seemingly driven half-mad in her grief, the old woman spins a chilling─if somewhat far-fetched─tale of living men turned to zombies by a vengeful specter wielding the powers of forbidden Sil'dihn alchemy. Doubtless Inspector Hildibrand has his own theories as to the plausibility of the woman's ramblings...
TEXT_CHRHDB502_00491_SEQ_00: Hildibrand is onto something, or at least he thinks he is.
TEXT_CHRHDB502_00491_SEQ_01: Thoroughly convinced that your adversary─the phantom thief-turned-murderer─is a vengeful Sil'dihn spirit seeking retribution for centuries-old war crimes, Hildibrand proposes a trip to the Thaumaturges' Guild, where one might learn more about the troubled history of the sibling nations. Briardien acquiesces, if only to get his meddling rival out of his hair while he pursues his own line of investigation. Accompany Inspector Hildibrand to the guild to see what information might be had.
TEXT_CHRHDB502_00491_SEQ_02: Questioning a number of thaumaturges at the guild, you learn of the horrors of the so-called War of the Sisters, which culminated with Sil'dih's horrific attempt to raise a fearsome zombie legion from the ranks of its own citizens. Share these frightful findings with Inspector Hildibrand, who is surely eager to put his famed deductive powers to work.
TEXT_CHRHDB502_00491_SEQ_03: Upon hearing your report, Hildibrand proposes securing an apology from a doubtless long-dead Sil'dihn statesman as a means to appease the wayward soul that he still believes the phantom thief-cum-murderer to be. Briardien dismisses this theory out of hand, while granting that the Sil'dih connection is indeed worth exploring. As the consulting inspector ponders the relationship between the murder victims, Ellie shares rumors she heard about a man who was sighted trying to make contact with more than one of the victims while they still lived. Seek out this man, the trader Guguriya of Horizon, to see what stories he may have to tell.
TEXT_CHRHDB502_00491_SEQ_04: Despite his reluctance, Guguriya speaks with you after being prodded along by a timely appearance from Lady Durilda. He reveals that the victims were all members of the Arbiters of Truth─a secret society devoted to preventing false knowledge of Ul'dahn history from reaching the ears of the general populace─and that they were turned to zombies before being slain. He further shares with you the identity of his employer, a man by the name of Hob, who─fearing for his life after the murders of his colleagues─has already fled the sultanate. Hurry to Vesper Bay and seek the man out before he meets a similarly gruesome fate.
TEXT_CHRHDB502_00491_SEQ_05: Your arrival in Vesper Bay comes too late, as the unfortunate Hob has already been reduced to a slavering zombie. After you have finished putting the poor man out of his misery, Inspector Briardien proposes a return to the Heart of the Sworn in Ul'dah, that you may deliver a full report to Phillice. Ellie and Nashu set off for the Mythril Eye offices to do some additional investigating, with a plan to rendezvous when both groups have finished with their tasks.
TEXT_CHRHDB502_00491_SEQ_06: Your conversation with Phillice is interrupted by a scream from the direction of the vault. Racing to the scene, you come upon Miss Ellie and an unconscious Sultansworn, who a quick dash of demasking dust reveals to be none other than the thief of many faces. There is scarcely time to rejoice in this most unexpected and fortunate turn of events when a stumbling Hildibrand accidentally dumps a second sachet of dust on the fallen man's face, removing a second mask to reveal that he is indeed one of Phillice's men, after all. In the meantime, Ellie is nowhere to be found. Phillice is quick to take action, declaring the Mythril Eye reporter the phantom thief and sending her full contingent out to secure her arrest. And yet, in a case which has taken one surprising turn after the next, is everything as simple as it seems...?
TEXT_CHRHDB503_00492_SEQ_00: Not even the shockingest turn of events will deter the famed agent of enquiry.
TEXT_CHRHDB503_00492_SEQ_01: Undaunted in the face of recent developments, Hildibrand is convinced he might still persuade his erstwhile companion Miss Ellie from pursuing the consummation of her criminal plans. Meanwhile, after sending her men out in pursuit of the escaped thief, Phillice of the Sultansworn confesses that she is the last of the Arbiters of Truth─the thief's final target─and states her intention to go into hiding so as not to place any more lives in danger. Hildibrand assures her that he has the situation entirely under control, and promptly enlists your aid in canvassing the area for any suspicious individuals. Begin your search at the Hustings Strip.
TEXT_CHRHDB503_00492_SEQ_02: You come upon an anonymous letter urging you─or whomever it was intended for─to exercise extreme caution. Continue your search of the halls of the Hustings Strip.
TEXT_CHRHDB503_00492_SEQ_03: You come upon a second letter, this one a warning that even your closest companions are not to be trusted. A hint from an unknown ally, or a snare laid by your quarry? More evidence is necessary to evaluate the situation. Continue to scour the halls of the Hustings Strip to see what other clues might be had.
TEXT_CHRHDB503_00492_SEQ_04: No sooner do you come upon a third letter, this time accompanied by a sachet of demasking dust, than you are greeted from behind by none other than Godbert Manderville, father of Hildibrand and goldsmith extraordinaire. The Hammer─as he is known─eagerly offers his assistance in the pursuit of the thief, in part out of concern for his son's well-being and in part out of concern for his own. From his words, it would appear that Hildibrand's mother is also a force to be reckoned with. Return to the royal vault and see what Godbert has deduced about the current state of affairs.
TEXT_CHRHDB503_00492_SEQ_05: Godbert surmises that the thief may already have assumed the identity of one of your companions. Speak with Briardien, Nashu, and Phillice, and be especially on the lookout for any uncharacteristic reactions or behavior.
TEXT_CHRHDB503_00492_SEQ_06: Your questioning of Briardien, Nashu, and Phillice revealed nothing of particular interest─it would appear that the thief will not be so easily unmasked. Consult once again with Godbert to hammer out your next plan of action.
TEXT_CHRHDB503_00492_SEQ_07: Despite Hildibrand's best efforts, the thief blows her cover when the typically good-natured-to-a-fault Nashu snaps at her beloved inspector for an offhand comment about her facial complexion. You move swiftly to unmask the faux-Nashu, revealing─to the surprise of all─not Miss Ellie, but an unfamiliar woman's face. It would appear there is yet more to this case than anyone suspected...
TEXT_CHRHDB504_00493_SEQ_00: Who is this unfamiliar woman, and what secrets does she hold?
TEXT_CHRHDB504_00493_SEQ_01: The woman reveals herself as Cecy, sister to Ellie and the woman behind the phantom thief's many masks. She further tells of her quest for vengeance against Ul'dah for the heinous crime of turning her ancestors into zombies─a historical fact covered up, she insists, by Phillice and her fellow Arbiters. Seeking to deliver revenge by her own hand, Cecy casts a handful of zombie powder at Phillice, only to see the ever-chivalrous Hildibrand take the brunt of the attack in her stead. As all look on with shock and dismay, Hildibrand's mother, Julyan, arrives on the scene. Distressed at the sight of her beloved son in his zombified state, she delivers a violent reckoning to her husband Godbert, whom she holds responsible for Hildibrand's plight, and Gilgamesh, who really just picked a bad time to show up. Fortunately, she takes an instant liking to you, and enlists your aid in saving her son from permanently joining the ranks of the undead. Speak with the imposing matron and see what she has in mind.
TEXT_CHRHDB504_00493_SEQ_02: Julyan explains that holy water is a well-known remedy for those afflicted with a case of zombie-ism, and assures you that she can fashion a dose from two ingredients─Oversoul rags and twice-distilled water. That said, the cleansing agent must be administered before the ichor has diffused throughout the entire body. With time being of the essence, she sends you and a befuddled Gilgamesh into town to retrieve the necessary materials: the rags from Syntgoht of Syntgoht's Sundries, and the water from a trader by the name of Gest.
TEXT_CHRHDB504_00493_SEQ_03: A well-timed visit from Avila, the gladiatrix who you and Hildibrand befriended in your recent travails at the Coliseum, proves to be just the ticket in convincing Syntgoht to part with the last piece of Oversoul rags he has in stock. Count your blessings and seek out Gest at the Hustings Strip.
TEXT_CHRHDB504_00493_SEQ_04: Gest proves to be a thoroughly unpleasant sort who would just as soon see Hildibrand die on account of his dislike for the way the Manderville family conducts its business. Just as all hope seems lost, the most fortuitous appearance of Arabella, the maiden you and Hildibrand befriended at Costa del Sol, has Gest changing his tune, as he begrudgingly parts with a bottle of twice-distilled water in return for a dance with the lapis-tressed beauty. With the two ingredients safely in hand, deliver them to Julyan back at the vault and hope there is still time to save the unfortunate Hildibrand.
TEXT_CHRHDB504_00493_SEQ_05: Julyan swiftly synthesizes a phial of holy water and administers it to Hildibrand, assuring you that her son is strong enough of will and body to fight off the zombie curse. She promises to see to his care, urging you to go and stop Ellie before she can bring her plan to fruition─using the four relics to break the ancient Sil'dihn seal and drown all of Ul'dah in zombie dust. She further cows Gilgamesh into making another trip to the markets to procure the fire crystals to keep her son's body warm. Gilgamesh stands over a crate of crystals, wistfully recalling old times with his feathered companion. As he delivers a heartfelt plea, a blinding flash of light comes down from the heavens, reuniting the traveling warrior with a long-absent friend...
TEXT_SUBPST026_00496_SEQ_00: The postmoogle's quizzical brow suggests he has an unusual delivery for you.
TEXT_SUBPST026_00496_SEQ_01: The deputy postmoogle has entrusted you with an anonymous missive for Landenel, captain of the Sixth Spear, in Camp Tranquil. He sends you on your way, but not before warning you of recent rumors that the good captain has been acting strange of late. Nevertheless, the deputy postmoogle bids you safe travels, that the letter makes it safely to the hands of Captain Landenel.
TEXT_SUBPST026_00496_SEQ_02: You deliver the letter to Landenel, who greets you with a warm smile. However, the smile does not last, for the letter bears ill news: his beloved mentor, the former leader of the Company of Heroes, has passed away, and a memorial service is to be held in his honor. In a baffling development, the service will be hosted by none other than Wheiskaet, who had but recently agreed to help Landenel search for their commander. Landenel expresses his intent to go to Costa del Sol to demand an explanation from Wheiskaet, and requests your presence at the meeting lest he do something he will later regret.
TEXT_SUBPST026_00496_SEQ_03: Landenel is awaiting your arrival at Costa del Sol, seemingly calm yet exasperated. To his surprise and relief, Wheiskaet can only express bewilderment as he reads the anonymous missive, claiming to have no knowledge of the commander's death nor any plans for a memorial service. Landenel is relieved to hear this news, and reaffirms his intention to resign from the Wood Wailers to search for their commander. However, Landenel's renewed fervor to abandon his duties forces Wheiskaet to reconsider the purpose of the letter. Nearly certain of the missive's writer and their intent, he refuses to assist Landenel. Now blinded by anger, Landenel readies his spear to run his former captain through. Try reasoning with him to /soothe his temper.
TEXT_SUBPST026_00496_SEQ_04: Your words have reached Landenel, and he sheathes his spear with reluctance. Wheiskaet is disappointed by his friend's behavior, but before he can reason with his troubled comrade, Landenel storms off in search of better prospects for aid in his search. With a heavy heart, Wheiskaet confides in you the truth of Landenel's sorrowful past, making it clear why the distraught Wood Wailer holds his leader and mentor in such high regard. Though Landenel made no mention of where he would go, Wheiskaet knows him all too well, and suspects he has gone to Wineport in search of Shamani, a former member of the Company of Heroes. Follow him to Wineport, and see if he has found the counsel he needs.
TEXT_SUBPST026_00496_SEQ_05: You quickly confirm Wheiskaet's suspicions, finding Landenel recounting his visit to Costa del Sol to Shamani. Landenel is convinced that Wheiskaet no longer cares for their former commander, but Shamani can only disagree with his assumptions. Considering all that has transpired, he deduces who is behind the invitation, and is disappointed to find Landenel still remains oblivious to who would be so concerned for his well-being. Shamani then reminds him of who, above all others, was there to guide him in the Company of Heroes─their leader. A mention of his old company motto calls to mind his first meeting with the commander, and a hint to his whereabouts. Follow him to Costa del Sol, and see if his intuition is on the mark.
TEXT_SUBPST026_00496_SEQ_06: You reach the cliff south of Costa del Sol, but find only Landenel and an abandoned spear. Though the commander is nowhere to be found, Landenel at last understands his intentions, and resolves to live up to the words of his former company. With a newfound fervor for his duties, the future looks bright as the former mercenary returns to his chosen place among the Wood Wailers.
TEXT_CHRHDB505_00502_SEQ_00: Julyan would send you on your way.
TEXT_CHRHDB505_00502_SEQ_01: Assuring you that she will look after Hildibrand in your absence, Julyan urges you to hurry to the Sil'dih excavation site, where Ellie intends to obtain the lost supply of zombie powder and exact her ultimate revenge against Ul'dah. Hasten to the scene, and rendezvous with Phillice upon your arrival.
TEXT_CHRHDB505_00502_SEQ_02: Phillice and the others have located the fugitive Ellie, who stubbornly refuses to engage in conversation with her pursuers. Fearing the worst were an attempt to be made to apprehend her quarry by force, Phillice urges you to call out to your friend, and see if she might still be made to listen to reason. Step forward to where she might hear you, and, with the chat mode in Say, call out “Ellie!” to attract her attention.
TEXT_CHRHDB505_00502_SEQ_03: Ellie responds to you, but refuses to stand down, insisting that her quest for justice against those who wronged her homeland is more important than her and Cecy's very lives. A pack of zombies that she summons to attack are dispatched by Godbert and Gilgamesh, yet the undead legions keep coming. Just when you appear hopelessly outnumbered, a blinding light from on high heralds the arrival of none other than Inspector Hildibrand, with considerably more color in his cheeks than when last you saw him. Illogical as it may seem, it would appear that his own time spent in the company of the undead allowed him to develop an immunity to the Traders' Spurn. With the zombies now at the side of their erstwhile overlord, Ellie surrenders, bringing the case of the many-faced thief to an unexpected but satisfying end. Your work is not done, however, as the ever-enterprising Gilgamesh has taken advantage of the confusion to take into hand the Treaty-Blade, insisting that he will not relinquish the relic except to one who defeats him and his companion Enkidu at Amdapor Keep. Make for the South Shroud, and rendezvous with Hildibrand, whose legs have likely carried him to your destination well in advance.
TEXT_CHRHDB505_00502_SEQ_04:
You arrive before Amdapor Keep to find Hildibrand in a familiar position. Assuring you that he will be along as soon as he completes his subterranean investigation, the inspector urges you to commence the battle against your rivals in hopes of reclaiming the Treaty-Blade.

※The Battle in the Big Keep can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_CHRHDB505_00502_SEQ_05: You have emerged victorious over Gilgamesh and his primal companion, Enkidu. Leave the keep and return to the South Shroud.
TEXT_CHRHDB505_00502_SEQ_06: You emerge from the keep to observe that a certain inspector has finally extricated himself from the forest floor. Inform Hildibrand that the battle has been won, and the location of the Treaty-Blade gleaned.
TEXT_CHRHDB505_00502_SEQ_07:
Phillice and the others arrive at the scene, rejoicing at the news that the primal menace has been quelled, as Ellie and Cecy share the story of one last unsolved mystery: an incantation of Belah'dian legend whose great power can only be summoned forth by a Warrior of Light with the Treaty-Blade in hand. The conversation is interrupted by Hildibrand, who has successfully recovered that selfsame relic. The inspector, by mere coincidence, speaks something resembling the final words of the incantation, and─against all common sense─the Treaty-Blade responds, casting forth a brilliant beam of light that propels both blade and unsuspecting passenger into the heavens. A smile comes to Ellie's face, her dream of seeing the legendary power of her ancestors with her own eyes finally realized. Inspector Briardien is pleased to be rid of his incompetent rival, yet strangely moved by his inimitable gentlemanliness. Nashu and Julyan run off in search of the beloved inspector and son, as Godbert muses on the true calling of a Manderville man. Meanwhile, high above Eorzea, Hildibrand hurtles off to destinations unknown, as his keenly honed inspector's sense calls him to his next case. One can only hope that he will survive his inevitable landing with his memory intact...

※The next Hildibrand quest will be available from Nashu Mhakaracca in Ishgard once you have completed the main scenario quest “Heavensward.”
TEXT_SUBWIL096_00504_SEQ_00: Torrid Whisper at Copperbell Mines has lost his mining tools.
TEXT_SUBWIL096_00504_SEQ_01: In the chaos of escaping from the mines, Torrid Whisper left behind his sharpened pickaxe, old hammer, and heavy sledgehammer. Find the three tools and return them to their distraught owner.
TEXT_SUBWIL096_00504_SEQ_02: You have gathered all three of the mining tools. Deliver them to Torrid Whisper at Copperbell Mines.
TEXT_SUBWIL096_00504_SEQ_03: Reunited with his beloved tools, Torrid Whisper resolves to search for work elsewhere in Eorzea.
TEXT_SUBWIL097_00505_SEQ_00: Totoruna would like you to cull orobon in the Footfalls.
TEXT_SUBWIL097_00505_SEQ_01: Totoruna has asked you to slay six of the orobon infesting the waters of the Footfalls. Seek out the unlovely creatures and put them to death.
TEXT_SUBWIL097_00505_SEQ_02: You mercilessly slaughter six of the slimy beasts. Tell Totoruna your work is complete.
TEXT_SUBWIL097_00505_SEQ_03: Though the orobon pose no real threat, Totoruna is glad to be rid of the beasts. Should a thaumaturge suffer even a minor injury, the consequences for the Brass Blades would be most dire.
TEXT_SUBWIL094_00506_SEQ_00: Edalene of Crescent Cove seeks help removing debris caught in her nets.
TEXT_SUBWIL094_00506_SEQ_01: Edalene's trawling nets have become clogged with debris from the sea bottom. Aid her by removing whatever flotsam you can find.
TEXT_SUBWIL094_00506_SEQ_02: You have picked the nets clean. Speak with Edalene once more.
TEXT_SUBWIL094_00506_SEQ_03: After expressing her gratitude, Edalene goes on about how the life of a fishwife is one of repairing nets and praying for calm waters and large hauls.
TEXT_SUBWIL098_00530_SEQ_00: Blayves of Lost Hope is worried for a friend fallen ill.
TEXT_SUBWIL098_00530_SEQ_01: Blayves requires gigantoad secretions to treat an ailing friend. Travel to the Unholy Heir and obtain two vials of the foul stuff from the toxic toads that lurk there.
TEXT_SUBWIL098_00530_SEQ_02: You have obtained the two vials of gigantoad secretions. Deliver them to Blayves at Lost Hope.
TEXT_SUBWIL098_00530_SEQ_03: Blayves is confident that the gigantoad secretions you provided will help stay his friend's sickness. Though Lost Hope is indeed in a sad state of affairs, Blayves appears resigned to his lot in life.
TEXT_SUBWIL099_00531_SEQ_00: Hamund is looking for someone to make a delivery.
TEXT_SUBWIL099_00531_SEQ_01: It seems miners are being sought at Black Brush Station for temporary employment. Take Hamund's application to Beringaer at Black Brush.
TEXT_SUBWIL099_00531_SEQ_02: Beringaer has added Hamund's name to the list, but the work promises to be grueling and low paying. Are Thanalan's refugees fated to be exploited and thrown away?
TEXT_JOBREL016_00560_SEQ_00: Jalzahn wears a bittersweet smile upon his face, one that would suggest a parting is in the offing.
TEXT_JOBREL016_00560_SEQ_01: After expressing his gratitude, Jalzahn informs you he will return to his native Radz-at-Han ere long. However, he has one last favor to ask of you: deliver a bottle of Sunshine─an incomparable liquor distilled in the alchemist's very own cellarage─to Gerolt as a gift.
TEXT_JOBREL016_00560_SEQ_02: Though he would have preferred to receive the liquor from Jalzahn in person, Gerolt unsurprisingly accepts the present. Much to your surprise, however, the smith reveals that there is yet work to be done─awakening sentience itself within your Zodiac Weapon. Indeed, it would seem the arms of legend consciously bonded with the soul of their bearers. Upon overhearing this, Jalzahn pledges to postpone his homewards journey. He posits that certain varieties of crystal can transfer a sense─a fragment of consciousness─via soul resonance, and thereby awaken the sentience slumbering within your weapon. To obtain these crystals, Gerolt tasks you with obtaining an introduction to Remon, a man of the black market, from Rowena in Revenant's Toll. Go now and speak with her.
TEXT_JOBREL016_00560_SEQ_03: According to Rowena, Remon holds an old grudge against Gerolt─the result of an unpaid loan─and will not deal with any friend of the blacksmith without an apology from the man himself. Return to Hyrstmill and inform Gerolt of this, and that Remon resides in his “usual haunt.”
TEXT_JOBREL016_00560_SEQ_04: According to Gerolt, Remon's bitterness stems not from the loan unpaid, but rather from a love unrequited─though he will say no more on the subject. Jalzahn urges Gerolt to make his amends with a gift: the bottle of Sunshine. Once you, too, have added your voice to the proceedings, Gerolt reluctantly gives up his prized liquor. Take the bottle of Sunshine and seek out Remon in Swiftperch.
TEXT_JOBREL016_00560_SEQ_05: Remon, a fellow with many, many connections, has anticipated your coming. He accepts Gerolt's apology, and offers to trade you mahatma in exchange for aught that will profit Rowena. Speak to him again when you wish to begin your dealings.
TEXT_JOBREL017_00561_SEQ_00: Something seems to be giving Jalzahn pause.
TEXT_JOBREL017_00561_SEQ_01: Jalzahn is perplexed as to why such a priceless resource as the Book of Netherdark never came to light alongside the other Trials of the Braves. He wishes to learn more of the tome's origins for his own erudition, and asks that you accompany him to question Gerolt. Speak with the blacksmith, and help the alchemist solve this lingering mystery.
TEXT_JOBREL017_00561_SEQ_02: Upon consulting Gerolt, you learn that it was Jalzahn's ancient forefather who penned the Book of Netherdark. Moreover, you discover that the author left as his legacy the title of “Starforger” to the person who could succeed in fully recreating a legendary arm of yore. Gerolt and Jalzahn, both desirous of this, allow their pride to tear them apart. Speak with Jalzahn now, to discover if the matter has been resolved.
TEXT_JOBREL017_00561_SEQ_03: Unable to decide who should be crowned “Starforger,” Jalzahn has decided to remain in Hyrstmill until Gerolt gives up his claim. However, the alchemist can now continue to aid you with your arm should the need arise. With a fondness in his voice, Jalzahn bids you to go forth, and use your Zodiac Weapon for good and so create your own legend.
TEXT_SUBGSC105_00565_SEQ_00: Casting a curious glance in your direction, Katering is poised to ask you a question.
TEXT_SUBGSC105_00565_SEQ_01: Reminding you that your initiation into the ranks of chocobo jockeys is not yet complete, Katering bids you return to the Gold Saucer so that you may register your new fledgling. Return to the race counter in Chocobo Square and speak with the race chocobo registrar once more.
TEXT_SUBGSC105_00565_SEQ_02: The registrar welcomes your return and states that, once your registration has been accepted, you need only speak with her to enter your first race. Present your registration form to the race chocobo trainer to complete the process and take your first steps upon the path of a jockey!
TEXT_SUBWIL013_00571_SEQ_00: Wolkan of the Gladiators' Guild is muttering frantically to himself about an infestation of ladybugs in the region.
TEXT_SUBWIL013_00571_SEQ_01: Travel to western Thanalan and slay four of the pestilent ladybugs.
TEXT_SUBWIL013_00571_SEQ_02: You have bravely slain four unsuspecting ladybugs. Return to the Gladiators' Guild and tell Wolkan of your heroic deed.
TEXT_SUBWIL013_00571_SEQ_03: By felling several nefarious ladybugs, you have made the road through Thanalan a deal safer for traveling merchants.
TEXT_SUBWIL014_00572_SEQ_00: Erasmus of the Thaumaturges' Guild is preoccupied with his studies, but his brow is furrowed in a way that cries out for help.
TEXT_SUBWIL014_00572_SEQ_01: To further the Order of Nald'thal's knowledge of life and death, Erasmus has tasked you with gathering five bottles of marmot blood. Marmots are prolific outside the Gate of the Sultana, in western Thanalan.
TEXT_SUBWIL014_00572_SEQ_02: You have gathered all the marmot blood Erasmus requires. Return to the Thaumaturges' Guild and present him with the bottles.
TEXT_SUBWIL014_00572_SEQ_03: You have completed the task at hand, confident that five marmot lives are a small price to pay to advance the dark arcana.
TEXT_SUBWIL100_00573_SEQ_00: Amalberga needs your help to end the machinations of vile bandits.
TEXT_SUBWIL100_00573_SEQ_01: Amalberga has learned that the bandits occupying the Quiveron Manse have obtained a quantity of Nashachite, which they are trading for gil and arms. Steal the raw Nashachite and deliver it to Amalberga.
TEXT_SUBWIL100_00573_SEQ_02: You have robbed the robbers blind. Return to Lost Hope and deliver the Nashachite to Amalberga.
TEXT_SUBWIL100_00573_SEQ_03: Amalberga's eyes light up upon receiving the precious gemstones. She assures you they will be put to good use...
TEXT_SUBGSC106_00576_SEQ_00: The chocobokeep cannot seem to decide if you are who she thinks you are.
TEXT_SUBGSC106_00576_SEQ_01: After recognizing you as an accomplished jockey and trainer, a chocobokeep encourages you to consider arranging a covering for your veteran race chocobo. If all goes well, the offspring produced from the union would have the potential to become an even greater race chocobo─yet there is also risk involved, for you would need to retire an experienced chocobo first. Should you wish to learn more, speak with Katering at Moogle's Gift Mounts in the Central Shroud.
TEXT_SUBGSC106_00576_SEQ_02: While Katering states that she can make arrangements for a covering at any time, she reminds you that any newborn fledglings would need to undergo basic training prior to entering their first race. Thus acquainted with the process, you now stand at a crossroads: will you rely upon an established veteran chocobo, or will you seek greater glory through its offspring?
TEXT_MANWIL001_00594_SEQ_00: To be recognized as an adventurer in the city-state of Ul'dah, you must register yourself with the Adventurers' Guild.
TEXT_MANWIL001_00594_SEQ_01: Wymond suggests that you speak with Quicksand proprietress Momodi before you begin exploring.
TEXT_MANWIL001_00594_SEQ_02: Now that you have successfully registered yourself as an adventurer, you are almost ready to begin exploring Ul'dah. Speak with Momodi again to learn more about the city and the basics of adventuring.
TEXT_SUBWIL115_00624_SEQ_00: Tutusi of Camp Drybone needs someone to fetch some myotragus sirloins.
TEXT_SUBWIL115_00624_SEQ_01: Tutusi and Zozoru wish to give a grievously wounded man a feast of myotragus steaks for what may prove to be his last meal. Slay myotragus nannies and obtain the sirloins needed to fulfill their wish.
TEXT_SUBWIL115_00624_SEQ_02: You have obtained five myotragus sirloins. Deliver them to Sister Zozoru at the inn in Camp Drybone.
TEXT_SUBWIL115_00624_SEQ_03: Regretfully, the man who wished for the steak feast succumbed to his wounds. Report back to Tutusi with the bad news.
TEXT_SUBWIL115_00624_SEQ_04: Tutusi urges you not to let the unfulfilled wish of the dying man bother you. There is always work to be done in the business of death, and the merchants of Camp Drybone do not allow themselves the luxury of grief.
TEXT_SUBWIL116_00625_SEQ_00: Caitlyn seeks an adventurer to put down some mongrels.
TEXT_SUBWIL116_00625_SEQ_01: Caitlyn would like to commission a hunt to slay wild mongrels. Head to the southeast and hunt down seven of the beasts.
TEXT_SUBWIL116_00625_SEQ_02: You have slain seven mongrels. Return to Camp Drybone and speak with Caitlyn.
TEXT_SUBWIL116_00625_SEQ_03: Caitlyn confesses to you that her betrothed was torn apart by a pack of mongrels some years past. She seems determined to have passing adventurers wipe the beasts from the face of Eorzea. The hells hath no fury as a woman scorned.
TEXT_SUBWIL117_00626_SEQ_00: Esmour needs an exterminator at the Church of Saint Adama Landama.
TEXT_SUBWIL117_00626_SEQ_01: Corpses have drawn blowfly swarms to the vicinity of the church. Slay five of the swarms to keep them in check.
TEXT_SUBWIL117_00626_SEQ_02: You have slain five blowfly swarms. Report back to Esmour at the church.
TEXT_SUBWIL117_00626_SEQ_03: Esmour thanks you for having ensured the safety and well-being of the mourners who visit the church.
TEXT_SUBWIL118_00627_SEQ_00: Sister Airell has work for a willing adventurer once more.
TEXT_SUBWIL118_00627_SEQ_01: Simple graves are easily overlooked in the ever-expanding lichyard. As such, they often go neglected when flowers are offered. Aid Sister Airell by placing bouquets of Nymeia lilies at five of these graves.
TEXT_SUBWIL118_00627_SEQ_02: You have made offerings of the Nymeia lilies. Report back to Sister Airell at the church.
TEXT_SUBWIL118_00627_SEQ_03: Sister Airell tells you that the lichyard was once a small and humble place before the Calamity. Ever since, the number of bodies needing burials has steadily risen, granting those who tend the graves nary a moment's rest.
TEXT_SUBWIL119_00629_SEQ_00: Eaduuard wants to make a tombstone for his late sister.
TEXT_SUBWIL119_00629_SEQ_01: Eaduuard wants a solemn tombstone made that is worthy of his late sister. Find for him some cloud marble in the outcrops to the east.
TEXT_SUBWIL119_00629_SEQ_02: You have obtained the cloud marble. Take it to Brother Esmour at the Church of Saint Adama Landama.
TEXT_SUBWIL119_00629_SEQ_03: Brother Esmour seems displeased at Eaduuard's adamance for getting the cloud marble, but he understands the child's need to grieve in his own way. Speak with Eaduuard and let him know his stone has been acquired.
TEXT_SUBWIL119_00629_SEQ_04: Eaduuard is relieved that the tombstone for his sister can now be prepared using the proper materials. However, it seems he will have to work at the church for a while in order to cover the expenses of the funeral.
TEXT_SUBWIL120_00630_SEQ_00: Tutusi of Camp Drybone has a deed for a daring adventurer.
TEXT_SUBWIL120_00630_SEQ_01: Tutusi would like you to gather three sprigs of Althyk lavender from the gigantic goobbue carcass lying east of Camp Drybone.
TEXT_SUBWIL120_00630_SEQ_02: You have gathered the three sprigs of Althyk lavender. Deliver them to Tutusi at Camp Drybone.
TEXT_SUBWIL120_00630_SEQ_03: Althyk lavender is prized as an offering at funerals held at the Church of Saint Adama Landama. Apparently, the dead can appreciate the difference between a rare flower and a common one.
TEXT_SUBWIL121_00631_SEQ_00: Caitlyn of Camp Drybone looks like a woman in need of meat.
TEXT_SUBWIL121_00631_SEQ_01: Caitlyn has asked that you obtain five chunks of tuco-tuco meat and deliver them to her late fiancé's brother Beneger at the Golden Bazaar.
TEXT_SUBWIL121_00631_SEQ_02: You have obtained the five chunks of tuco-tuco meat. Deliver them to Beneger at the Golden Bazaar.
TEXT_SUBWIL121_00631_SEQ_03: Beneger is happy to receive the tuco-tuco meat, as he will soon need it to feed to a group of hungry miners. He is also dismayed at the idea of Caitlyn remaining in Camp Drybone for the sole purpose of ensuring the annihilation of mongrels. Beneger admits that the death of his brother is tragic, but believes that it is past time Caitlyn moved on with her life.
TEXT_SUBWIL122_00632_SEQ_00: Beneger of the Golden Bazaar needs help finding help.
TEXT_SUBWIL122_00632_SEQ_01: Beneger wants to recruit hands to aid in the building of a new inn. Post his hiring notices in five locations.
TEXT_SUBWIL122_00632_SEQ_02: You have posted the hiring notices. Report back to Beneger.
TEXT_SUBWIL122_00632_SEQ_03: Beneger is glad that his notices have been posted, but he does not want to leave anything to chance. To this end, he has given you five more of his hiring notices to hand out directly to random passersby.
TEXT_SUBWIL122_00632_SEQ_04: You have distributed the hiring notices. Report back to Beneger.
TEXT_SUBWIL122_00632_SEQ_05: Beneger seems determined to revitalize the Golden Bazaar with his new business endeavor.
TEXT_SUBWIL123_00633_SEQ_00: Lululo of the Golden Bazaar wants the vandalous imps terrorizing her dig site to be put down.
TEXT_SUBWIL123_00633_SEQ_01: Lululo wants to search for veins of mythril among the ruins to the east. The appearance of vandalous imps, however, has scared off the miners she hired to dig. Cull four of the imps to keep the others at bay.
TEXT_SUBWIL123_00633_SEQ_02: You have slain the vandalous imps. Report back to Lululo at the Golden Bazaar.
TEXT_SUBWIL123_00633_SEQ_03: Lululo is still troubled over the lack of progress due to the beasts in the area. She is convinced it will take a good deal of time before mining begins.
TEXT_SUBWIL124_00634_SEQ_00: Beneger has another task that needs to be done.
TEXT_SUBWIL124_00634_SEQ_01: To meet the request of an influential miner, Beneger would like you to gather five slabs of cloud marble from near the ruins of the Invisible City.
TEXT_SUBWIL124_00634_SEQ_02: You have gathered the cloud marble. Take them back to Beneger at the Golden Bazaar.
TEXT_SUBWIL124_00634_SEQ_03: If the glimmer found within the cloud marble indeed proves to be mythril, it could spell the revival of the Golden Bazaar. All of Beneger's hopes for the future are riding on these slabs of rock.
TEXT_SUBWIL125_00635_SEQ_00: Lululo of the Golden Bazaar once more seeks an adventurer to kill the beasts that vex her.
TEXT_SUBWIL125_00635_SEQ_01: An attack by a group of earth sprites has resulted in the shipment of Lululo's mining tools being delayed. Slay three earth sprites in the area to clear the road for safe passage.
TEXT_SUBWIL125_00635_SEQ_02: You have slain the earth sprites. Travel to Camp Drybone and tell the merchant Reremaki that the road is safe for delivery of the mining tools.
TEXT_SUBWIL125_00635_SEQ_03: Reremaki assures you that he will be taking the tools to the Golden Bazaar as soon as he and his chocobo are able.
TEXT_SUBWIL127_00637_SEQ_00: Jospaire is moved by the plants sprouting around the fallen goobbue.
TEXT_SUBWIL127_00637_SEQ_01: In a secluded area to the east of Drybone, you have found Jospaire, a botanist studying the newly grown foliage surrounding a fallen goobbue. To prevent the unique plants from succumbing to the desert heat, Jospaire bids you bring him some muddy water from the pond to the west.
TEXT_SUBWIL127_00637_SEQ_02: You have collected the muddy spring water. Deliver it to Jospaire.
TEXT_SUBWIL127_00637_SEQ_03: Not content with merely watering the greenery, Jospaire now asks you to remove the vilekin eggs that have been laid in the area before they hatch and begin to feed.
TEXT_SUBWIL127_00637_SEQ_04: You have spared the plants a grisly death at the maws of vilekin larvae. Speak with Jospaire once more.
TEXT_SUBWIL127_00637_SEQ_05: Little to your surprise, Jospaire has yet another request. He bids you pour stingbrew over thick bramble and slay any syrphid clouds that come forth.
TEXT_SUBWIL127_00637_SEQ_06: You have slain enough syrphid clouds to ensure the plants' safety. Speak with Jospaire to see if the botanist has any further tasks for you.
TEXT_SUBWIL127_00637_SEQ_07: Jospaire is elated that the plants have been saved. After completing his survey of the area, he means to take word of his extraordinary discovery back to the Botanists' Guild in Gridania.
TEXT_SUBWIL500_00638_SEQ_00: Swynbroes wishes to disseminate the secrets of materia creation.
TEXT_SUBWIL500_00638_SEQ_01: At the Bonfire, Swynbroes offers to teach you how to extract materia from well-worn gear. Speak with him again to commence your learning.
TEXT_SUBWIL500_00638_SEQ_02: You are now trained in the ways of materia extraction. Put your learning into practice and extract materia from an old piece of gear.
TEXT_SUBWIL501_00639_SEQ_00: F'hobhas wishes to teach you how to meld materia.
TEXT_SUBWIL501_00639_SEQ_01: At the Bonfire, F'hobhas offers to teach you how to meld materia to gear. Speak with her again to commence your learning.
TEXT_SUBWIL501_00639_SEQ_02: You are now trained in the ways of materia melding. Put this knowledge to use and try your hand at attaching materia to gear.
TEXT_SUBWIL502_00640_SEQ_00: You are given to understand that Mutamix is the keeper of secret materia techniques...
TEXT_SUBWIL502_00640_SEQ_01: Mutamix is willing to train you in his secret materia melding techniques. However, the goblin requires proof that you are sufficiently experienced. Demonstrate your skills by melding eight pieces of materia in front of him.
TEXT_SUBWIL502_00640_SEQ_02: You have melded the requisite number of materia. Speak with Mutamix once more to receive of his secret knowledge.
TEXT_SUBWIL502_00640_SEQ_03: Mutamix imparts to you advanced materia melding techniques, which will allow you to attach more pieces of materia to an item than ordinarily possible. Know, though, that success is not guaranteed, and failure means losing the materia.
TEXT_SUBWIL128_00642_SEQ_00: Sister Airell of the Church of Saint Adama Landama has her hands full with the Order's work.
TEXT_SUBWIL128_00642_SEQ_01: There are too many graves for Sister Airell to tend to in a timely manner. Gather six old offerings from graves in her stead.
TEXT_SUBWIL128_00642_SEQ_02: You have gathered the old offerings from the graves. Report back to Sister Airell at the church.
TEXT_SUBWIL128_00642_SEQ_03: It seems Sister Airell still has some straightening up to do around the church. Speak to her once more for another task.
TEXT_SUBSEA013_00661_SEQ_00: H'naanza has a simple yet profitable task for an interested adventurer.
TEXT_SUBSEA013_00661_SEQ_01: Baderon is offering a bounty to any adventurer willing to cull wharf rats. Venture outside the Tempest Gate and slay five of the pests.
TEXT_SUBSEA013_00661_SEQ_02: You mercilessly slaughter five of the disease-infested rats. Report to Baderon at the Drowning Wench and claim your reward.
TEXT_SUBSEA013_00661_SEQ_03: An anonymous benefactor was behind the bounty, claiming that the constant scurrying of rats was driving him insane. Yet despite your efforts, Baderon suspects that the strange man will forever be tormented by the furry creatures.
TEXT_SUBSEA014_00662_SEQ_00: O'kalkaya has advice for any adventurers headed to the Missing Member.
TEXT_SUBSEA014_00662_SEQ_01: O'kalkaya warns you that Captain Rhoswen, leader of the Sanguine Sirens and proprietress of the Missing Member, is in no mood to entertain customers. If you insist upon visiting, O'kalkaya strongly suggests that you first pay your respects and /kneel to the captain.
TEXT_SUBSEA014_00662_SEQ_02: Rhoswen explains that the Sanguine Sirens are struggling to capture imperial vessels because their rivals, the Kraken's Arms, are seizing them first. Show Captain Rhoswen that you are /disappointed with this turn of events.
TEXT_SUBSEA014_00662_SEQ_03: Brushing aside your gesture of sympathy, Rhoswen muses on how she might motivate her crew to redouble their efforts. Demonstrate to her how you would /rally their spirits.
TEXT_SUBSEA014_00662_SEQ_04: Though your gesturing nearly earns you a gruesome death, you unintentionally inspire Rhoswen to embrace her piratical proclivities and steal better ships so that the Sirens can plunder Garlean outposts. Let O'kalkaya know that her captain is in higher spirits.
TEXT_SUBSEA014_00662_SEQ_05: O'kalkaya thanks you for improving Captain Rhoswen's mood and ensuring that the Siren's deckswabs were not disposed of prematurely.
TEXT_SUBSEA015_00663_SEQ_00: Niniya has information that, unlike last time, is sure to be of interest to you.
TEXT_SUBSEA015_00663_SEQ_01: According to Niniya, the sentries stationed at the Eyes in lower La Noscea often turn to adventurers when they have too much work. Venture outside the city and speak with Ancreta to learn more.
TEXT_SUBSEA015_00663_SEQ_02: Once again, it appears Niniya was playing a prank on you, as Ancreta is forbidden from officially offering you work. If you are willing to assist in an unofficial capacity, though, the Yellowjacket might have something for you...
TEXT_SUBWIL150_00687_SEQ_00: Eustace is responsible for assigning guildleves at the Quicksand, and is offering to give you an introduction to the world of levequests.
TEXT_SUBWIL150_00687_SEQ_01: Guildleves are the means by which the Adventurers' Guild organizes and assigns the various requests made by the citizenry. To accept your first such task, make your way to Horizon and speak with Totonowa.
TEXT_SUBWIL150_00687_SEQ_02: In order to gauge your ability to handle the various guildleves he has to offer, Totonowa requires that you carry out a preliminary task.
TEXT_SUBWIL150_00687_SEQ_03: You have successfully completed the trial guildleve. Report to Totonowa at Horizon.
TEXT_SUBWIL150_00687_SEQ_04: Totonowa is now confident that you are capable of handling any of the trials and tribulations you might encounter at Horizon. Prove your worth as an adventurer, and continue to undertake the guildleves he has to offer.
TEXT_SUBWIL151_00688_SEQ_00: Poponagu, the local levequest representative in Camp Drybone, is seeking an adventurer to undertake guildleves.
TEXT_SUBWIL151_00688_SEQ_01: In order to gauge your ability to handle the various guildleves he has to offer, Poponagu requires that you carry out a preliminary task.
TEXT_SUBWIL151_00688_SEQ_02: You have successfully completed the trial guildleve. Report to Poponagu in Camp Drybone.
TEXT_SUBWIL151_00688_SEQ_03: Poponagu is now confident that you are capable of handling any of the trials and tribulations you might encounter around Camp Drybone. Prove your worth as an adventurer, and continue to undertake the guildleves he has to offer.
TEXT_SUBWIL152_00692_SEQ_00: Esmond, the local levequest representative in Little Ala Mhigo, is seeking an adventurer to undertake guildleves.
TEXT_SUBWIL152_00692_SEQ_01: In order to gauge your ability to handle the various guildleves he has to offer, Esmond requires that you carry out a preliminary task.
TEXT_SUBWIL152_00692_SEQ_02: You have successfully completed the trial guildleve. Report to Esmond in Little Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_SUBWIL152_00692_SEQ_03: Esmond is now confident that you are capable of handling any of the trials and tribulations you might encounter around Little Ala Mhigo. Prove your worth as an adventurer, and continue to undertake the guildleves he has to offer.
TEXT_SUBSEA901_00693_SEQ_00: T'mokkri is responsible for assigning guildleves at the Drowning Wench, and is offering to give you an introduction to the world of levequests.
TEXT_SUBSEA901_00693_SEQ_01: Guildleves are the means by which the Adventurers' Guild organizes and assigns the various requests made by the citizenry. To accept your first such task, make your way to Swiftperch and speak with Swygskyf.
TEXT_SUBSEA901_00693_SEQ_02: In order to gauge your ability to handle the various guildleves he has to offer, Swygskyf requires that you carry out a preliminary task.
TEXT_SUBSEA901_00693_SEQ_03: You have successfully completed the trial guildleve. Report to Swygskyf at Swiftperch.
TEXT_SUBSEA901_00693_SEQ_04: Swygskyf is now confident that you are capable of handling any of the trials and tribulations you might encounter at Swiftperch. Prove your worth as an adventurer, and continue to undertake the guildleves he has to offer.
TEXT_SUBSEA902_00694_SEQ_00: Orwen, the Adventurers' Guild representative for local levequests in Aleport, is seeking an adventurer to undertake guildleves.
TEXT_SUBSEA902_00694_SEQ_01: In order to gauge your ability to handle the various guildleves he has to offer, Orwen requires that you carry out a preliminary task.
TEXT_SUBSEA902_00694_SEQ_02: You have successfully completed the trial guildleve. Report to Orwen in Aleport.
TEXT_SUBSEA902_00694_SEQ_03: Orwen is now confident that you are capable of handling any of the trials and tribulations you might encounter around Aleport. Prove your worth as an adventurer, and continue to undertake the guildleves he has to offer.
TEXT_SUBSEA903_00695_SEQ_00: Ourawann, the Adventurers' Guild representative for local levequests at the Moraby Drydocks, is seeking an adventurer to undertake guildleves.
TEXT_SUBSEA903_00695_SEQ_01: In order to gauge your ability to handle the various guildleves he has to offer, Ourawann requires that you carry out a preliminary task.
TEXT_SUBSEA903_00695_SEQ_02: You have successfully completed the trial guildleve. Report to Ourawann at the Moraby Drydocks.
TEXT_SUBSEA903_00695_SEQ_03: Ourawann is now confident that you are capable of handling any of the trials and tribulations you might encounter around the Moraby Drydocks. Prove your worth as an adventurer, and continue to undertake the guildleves he has to offer.
TEXT_SUBSEA904_00696_SEQ_00: Nahctahr, the Adventurers' Guild representative for local levequests in Costa del Sol, is seeking an adventurer to undertake guildleves.
TEXT_SUBSEA904_00696_SEQ_01: In order to gauge your ability to handle the various guildleves he has to offer, Nahctahr requires that you carry out a preliminary task.
TEXT_SUBSEA904_00696_SEQ_02: You have successfully completed the trial guildleve. Report to Nahctahr in Costa del Sol.
TEXT_SUBSEA904_00696_SEQ_03: Nahctahr is now confident that you are capable of handling any of the trials and tribulations you might encounter around Costa del Sol. Prove your worth as an adventurer, and continue to undertake the guildleves he has to offer.
TEXT_SUBWIL140_00697_SEQ_00: Nedrick of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn has some useful information he wishes to share.
TEXT_SUBWIL140_00697_SEQ_01: Nedrick has told you of a training ground in eastern Thanalan known as Halatali. Find its entrance, and there speak with one Flame Private Fafajoni.
TEXT_SUBWIL140_00697_SEQ_02:
You have learned from Nedrick and Fafajoni that dangerous beasts reside within the abandoned corridors of Halatali. With some reluctance, the flame private has granted you leave to use the former training grounds as you see fit.

※Halatali can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_SUBSEA921_00699_SEQ_00: Swyrgeim wants to show you a whole new world of colors.
TEXT_SUBSEA921_00699_SEQ_01: Swyrgeim is dismayed at your appearance, and offers to help you remedy it. Before she will do so, however, she requires that you purchase a bottle of orange juice from the merchant by the northern gates and bring it to her so that her thirst might be sated.
TEXT_SUBSEA921_00699_SEQ_02: Thanking you for the orange juice, Swyrgeim proceeds to teach you how to go about dyeing your gear. Armed with this knowledge, go forth and fill your life with color.
TEXT_SUBFST120_00700_SEQ_00: Vorsaile believes it past time you were issued a personal chocobo.
TEXT_SUBFST120_00700_SEQ_01: To obtain your personal chocobo, you must present Cingur with a Serpent Chocobo Issuance. This document can be obtained by exchanging company seals with the serpent quartermaster. Here's hoping you have been setting aside your seals...
TEXT_SUBFST120_00700_SEQ_02: Cingur brings you your bird, and it is love at first sight. Name your new companion, and make it official.
TEXT_SUBFST120_00700_SEQ_03: After much deliberation, you decide on a name worthy of the noblest steed. Inform Cingur to complete the last of the formalities.
TEXT_SUBFST120_00700_SEQ_04: And so begins the adventures of  and . May their friendship last for eternity!
TEXT_SUBSEA910_00701_SEQ_00: R'ashaht Rhiki suggests you look into having a personal chocobo issued.
TEXT_SUBSEA910_00701_SEQ_01: To obtain your personal chocobo, you must present Fraegeim with a Storm Chocobo Issuance. This document can be obtained by exchanging company seals with the storm quartermaster. Here's hoping you have been setting aside your seals...
TEXT_SUBSEA910_00701_SEQ_02: Fraegeim brings you your bird, and it is love at first sight. Name your new companion, and make it official.
TEXT_SUBSEA910_00701_SEQ_03: After much deliberation, you decide on a name worthy of the noblest steed. Inform Fraegeim to complete the last of the formalities.
TEXT_SUBSEA910_00701_SEQ_04: And so begins the adventures of  and . May their friendship last for eternity!
TEXT_SUBWIL160_00702_SEQ_00: Swift believes you should get yourself a chocobo.
TEXT_SUBWIL160_00702_SEQ_01: To obtain your personal chocobo, you must present Mimigun with a Flame Chocobo Issuance. This document can be obtained by exchanging company seals with the flame quartermaster. Here's hoping you have been setting aside your seals...
TEXT_SUBWIL160_00702_SEQ_02: Mimigun brings you your bird, and it is love at first sight. Name your new companion, and make it official.
TEXT_SUBWIL160_00702_SEQ_03: After much deliberation, you decide on a name worthy of the noblest steed. Inform Mimigun to complete the last of the formalities.
TEXT_SUBWIL160_00702_SEQ_04: And so begins the adventures of  and . May their friendship last for eternity!
TEXT_SUBWIL142_00705_SEQ_00: Nedrick appears concerned about your equipment.
TEXT_SUBWIL142_00705_SEQ_01: Nedrick has introduced you to Rowena, an artifact collector who has set up shop at Revenant's Toll in Mor Dhona. If you are serious about your equipment, he recommends paying her a visit.
TEXT_SUBWIL142_00705_SEQ_02: Rowena tells you about a weaponsmith of no small repute named Gerolt, who she claims is skilled in the restoration of ancient relics. Find Gerolt at Hyrstmill in the North Shroud, and show him the promise of payment that Rowena has given you.
