TEXT_SUBWIL142_00705_SEQ_03: You meet and speak with Gerolt. Shamelessly exploiting the prodigious debt he owes Rowena, you coerce the man into lending you his expertise in the restoration of a relic weapon. Do as Gerolt directs if you wish to become the proud owner of a legendary arm of yore.
TEXT_GAIUSA005_00711_SEQ_00: Florimond seeks a capable adventurer to cull vermin in his stead.
TEXT_GAIUSA005_00711_SEQ_01: Owing to an injury, Florimond is unable to join his Wood Wailer comrades in a culling operation, and asks that you take his place. Make your way to Josselin's Spire and report to Aniud.
TEXT_GAIUSA005_00711_SEQ_02: Aniud bids you put down six black bats. Make your way to the Bramble Patch and slay the creatures.
TEXT_GAIUSA005_00711_SEQ_03: You have culled the black bats. Report back to Aniud at Josselin's Spire.
TEXT_GAIUSA005_00711_SEQ_04: Thanking you for your assistance, Aniud bids you bear a message to Florimond. Take yourself back to the Hawthorne Hut, where the injured Wood Wailer is convalescing.
TEXT_GAIUSA005_00711_SEQ_05: Upon receiving his captain's message, Florimond promises to focus his energies on recovery, and not fret to no avail over how his absence may inconvenience his comrades.
TEXT_GAIUSA006_00712_SEQ_00: Ysabel seeks to catch wild game and needs someone to lay traps.
TEXT_GAIUSA006_00712_SEQ_01: Ysabel has run out of fresh meat to prepare hot meals for frontier sentries. Take the box of hunting tools to the Bramble Patch, and there lay traps in her stead.
TEXT_GAIUSA006_00712_SEQ_02: You have set all the traps. Report back to Ysabel at the Hawthorne Hut.
TEXT_GAIUSA006_00712_SEQ_03: Ysabel expresses her admiration for the men and women who willingly shed blood that peace might reign in the Twelveswood. You silently join her in praying for a bountiful catch.
TEXT_GAIUSA007_00713_SEQ_00: Piralnaut needs capable volunteers to patrol the Gridanian frontier.
TEXT_GAIUSA007_00713_SEQ_01: Casualties have left the garrison at Josselin's Spire shorthanded, and Piralnaut requests that you patrol the area in the wounded's stead. There are three key strategic positions on the patrol route, each marked by a Twin Adder standard. Make your way to the three locations in turn.
TEXT_GAIUSA007_00713_SEQ_02: You have safely completed your patrol. Report back to Piralnaut.
TEXT_GAIUSA007_00713_SEQ_03: Learning of your encounter with fell fiends, Piralnaut expresses his concern at their growing numbers.
TEXT_GAIUSA008_00714_SEQ_00: Piralnaut, a sentry at Josselin's Spire, would delegate some of his duties to an eager adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSA008_00714_SEQ_01: The wild boar population in the area has grown out of control, and furthermore, the beasts have turned hostile toward sylphs and local residents. Go to the Bramble Patch and cull five of the feral swine.
TEXT_GAIUSA008_00714_SEQ_02: The feral swine have been dispatched. Report your success to Piralnaut.
TEXT_GAIUSA008_00714_SEQ_03: Home to an aetheryte and overlooking a key hub of transportation in the realm, Josselin's Spire demands the utmost vigilance from its sentries. Your swine-slaying bravery has inspired Piralnaut, who resolves to be ever more vigilant in his duties.
TEXT_GAIUSA102_00716_SEQ_00: Blaisette is troubled by something she saw.
TEXT_GAIUSA102_00716_SEQ_01: Blaisette swears she saw a child playing atop the roof of the hut at night. Investigate the scene and put her mind at rest.
TEXT_GAIUSA102_00716_SEQ_02: Upon climbing atop the roof, you discover an undersized cane. Might it offer a clue as to the identity of the mysterious figure? Return to Blaisette and see what she makes of it.
TEXT_GAIUSA102_00716_SEQ_03: Blaisette believes the cane you found belongs to a sylph. It would seem she mistook one of their kind for a child. Deliver the cane to a sylph named Dellexia, who abides in Little Solace.
TEXT_GAIUSA102_00716_SEQ_04: The cane was indeed one of Dellexia's prized possessions. Profuse with gratitude over its return, Dellexia promises her friendship and cooperation. Continue to seek out ways to provide succor to the sylphs, that you might fully earn their trust.
TEXT_GAIUSA106_00720_SEQ_00: Laxio of Little Solace remains unconvinced of your intentions.
TEXT_GAIUSA106_00720_SEQ_01: Laxio demands that you obey his every command as proof that you are a friend to the sylphs. First, /poke his back to scratch an itch.
TEXT_GAIUSA106_00720_SEQ_02: By touching Laxio, you have been afflicted with a sylphic curse that turns one's skin to moss. /examineself and ascertain its dire effect.
TEXT_GAIUSA106_00720_SEQ_03: The curse was a lie; Laxio was only fooling you. Express your adulation and /congratulate him on his brilliant ruse.
TEXT_GAIUSA106_00720_SEQ_04: Your sense of humor pleases Laxio, who now welcomes you to Little Solace with wings outspread.
TEXT_GAIUSA107_00721_SEQ_00: Laxio the sylph needs help to put down djiggas.
TEXT_GAIUSA107_00721_SEQ_01: Laxio explains that his people are being preyed upon by buzzing djiggas whenever they venture outside Little Solace to bathe in sunlight. He has instructed a pair of sylphs to act as bait to lure the ravenous parasites into the open, and asks that you put the vilekin down.
TEXT_GAIUSA107_00721_SEQ_02: You have exterminated the djiggas. Report back to Laxio at Little Solace.
TEXT_GAIUSA107_00721_SEQ_03: Back at Little Solace, you learn that sylphs need sunlight in order to survive. Thanks to your help, they can now get their required dose without becoming djigga fodder.
TEXT_GAIUSA108_00722_SEQ_00: Ameexia the sylph would beseech an adventurer's assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSA108_00722_SEQ_01: Ameexia is afraid to go out in the forest for fear of being attacked by boars. Search suspicious thickets for the fell swine, and put them down to set her mind at ease.
TEXT_GAIUSA108_00722_SEQ_02: Your boar-slaying mission was a success. Report back to Ameexia.
TEXT_GAIUSA108_00722_SEQ_03: Thanks to your efforts, Ameexia can frolic in the forest to her heart's delight once more.
TEXT_GAIUSA109_00723_SEQ_00: Ameexia of Little Solace is again in need of an adventurer's aid.
TEXT_GAIUSA109_00723_SEQ_01: Ameexia has lost her precious thread and is unable to do her weaving. Travel to the Bramble Patch and retrieve the three missing spindles.
TEXT_GAIUSA109_00723_SEQ_02: You have successfully recovered Ameexia's lost spindles of cloud silk. Return them to their owner.
TEXT_GAIUSA109_00723_SEQ_03: At long last able to return to her weaving, Ameexia expresses her profuse gratitude for your aid.
TEXT_GAIUSA204_00727_SEQ_00: Ianna at Buscarron's Druthers would have you slay fearsome beasts in her stead.
TEXT_GAIUSA204_00727_SEQ_01: Though antelopes are known to be tranquil beasts, the herds that roam the land south of Buscarron's Druthers have grown increasingly hostile of late. As Ianna tells it, however, the antelopes become enfeebled when doused with bits of sparhawk egg soup. Venture south of the Druthers, and utilize the soup given to you to help put down one of the scarred antelopes.
TEXT_GAIUSA204_00727_SEQ_02: You have succeeded in dispatching the belligerent beast. Report your success to Ianna.
TEXT_GAIUSA204_00727_SEQ_03: Ianna is grateful to you for helping to protect her second home. You have won yourself another friend in these parts.
TEXT_GAIUSA205_00728_SEQ_00: Ianna seeks an adventurer to gather the offerings necessary for a local custom.
TEXT_GAIUSA205_00728_SEQ_01: You learn that the locals observe a custom involving the placement of an offering of antelope innards and flowers before a withered treant. Following Ianna's instructions, gather the umbles of four antelope does and two kedtrap petals.
TEXT_GAIUSA205_00728_SEQ_02: You have successfully gathered umbles and petals suitable for the offering. First, place the four umbles before the withered treant.
TEXT_GAIUSA205_00728_SEQ_03: Having placed the umbles, next set down the two fragrant flowers.
TEXT_GAIUSA205_00728_SEQ_04: The offerings placed, proceed to /kneel in deference to this once-proud guardian of the forest.
TEXT_GAIUSA205_00728_SEQ_05: You have paid respect to the withered treant as instructed. Return to Buscarron's Druthers and let Ianna know that the custom has been observed.
TEXT_GAIUSA205_00728_SEQ_06: Ianna explains that the people of her region revere the treants as forest guardians, and look to them to protect the balance of life in the Twelveswood─a task made at once more needful and more difficult by the changes set in motion during the Calamity. With the piteous image of the withered treant still fresh in your mind, however, you cannot help wondering if the ancient creatures might not require protection of their own.
TEXT_GAIUSA206_00729_SEQ_00: Auphiliot wants you to cull the smallmouth orobon that have been decimating the river fish.
TEXT_GAIUSA206_00729_SEQ_01: Orobon have been eating all the fish that Buscarron would normally serve to his customers. Head east to the river and slay at least three of the voracious predators.
TEXT_GAIUSA206_00729_SEQ_02: You have gutted the requisite number of smallmouth orobon. Return to Buscarron's Druthers and proudly show your entrail-caked hands to Auphiliot.
TEXT_GAIUSA206_00729_SEQ_03: After witnessing your efforts against the orobon, Auphiliot believes you've earned a place at the Druthers and encourages you to continue helping Buscarron in his work.
TEXT_GAIUSA207_00730_SEQ_00: Yoenne wants you to check on the researchers surveying the ruins at Issom-Har.
TEXT_GAIUSA207_00730_SEQ_01: The researchers surveying the ruins at Issom-Har are overdue for their regular visit to Buscarron's Druthers. Head south to the nearby ruins, and look for the researcher known as Irielle.
TEXT_GAIUSA207_00730_SEQ_02: The unsuspecting victims of a swarm of chigoes, Irielle and her colleague had until recently been locked in a battle for their own survival. Though thankfully none the worse for the ordeal, Irielle asks that you discourage any further such attacks by summarily slaying five of the brood.
TEXT_GAIUSA207_00730_SEQ_03: You have exterminated the meddling chigoes and sent the rest of the brood scuttling back into the shadowy depths. Inform Irielle at Issom-Har of your deeds.
TEXT_GAIUSA207_00730_SEQ_04: Irielle and her colleague can now continue their survey, free of the insect menace. Report your success to Yoenne at Buscarron's Druthers.
TEXT_GAIUSA207_00730_SEQ_05: Yoenne is relieved to hear of her customers' safety, though at the same time disavowing all knowledge of Irielle's brother, or why she would be concerned with his safety.
TEXT_GAIUSA208_00731_SEQ_00: Rolandaix seeks a helping hand in his examination of Issom-Har.
TEXT_GAIUSA208_00731_SEQ_01: Rolandaix is surveying the ruins of Gelmorra, but finds that he has overestimated the amount of ground he can cover alone. Aid the researcher in his work by scouring the area around Issom-Har for domestic artifacts.
TEXT_GAIUSA208_00731_SEQ_02: You have uncovered a number of domestic relics. Present the objects to Rolandaix for examination.
TEXT_GAIUSA208_00731_SEQ_03: Rolandaix reveals that the items you uncovered were pieces of Gelmorran tableware, confirming his theory that the ruins are indeed what remains of Gelmorra's residential district. He goes on to express his fervent hope that the remnants of the city can one day be reestablished as a settlement for the displaced Duskwight Elezen.
TEXT_GAIUSA209_00732_SEQ_00: Auphiliot at Buscarron's Druthers seeks an adventurer's aid in dashing a Qiqirn-hatched plot.
TEXT_GAIUSA209_00732_SEQ_01: Auphiliot has caught word that Qiqirn raiders are hoarding large quantities of poison, which they intend to use in their efforts to waylay unsuspecting travelers. Use the firepots he has provided to destroy the stashes of poison before any of the Druthers' patrons come to harm.
TEXT_GAIUSA209_00732_SEQ_02: You have succeeded in destroying all the Qiqirn poison stashes, ensuring the safety of travelers en route to and from the Druthers. Report your deeds to Auphiliot.
TEXT_GAIUSA209_00732_SEQ_03: Auphiliot is pleased that you were able to preemptively thwart the Qiqirn's venomous plot, whatever it might have been. He further explains that the idea came from Buscarron, who believes in avoiding direct confrontation, that true peace might eventually return to the forest.
TEXT_GAIUSA303_00735_SEQ_00: Gegeroon of Memeroon's Trading Post has deliveries that need to be made.
TEXT_GAIUSA303_00735_SEQ_01: Gegeroon of Memeroon's Trading Post has a delivery to make, but not enough time to do it himself. Help him out and deliver a hot box lunch to Tanga Tonga in his cabin at Thalaos.
TEXT_GAIUSA303_00735_SEQ_02: Tanga Tonga is immensely pleased to receive his little bag full of toast and egg products. Fully sated, he can now focus on his research.
TEXT_GAIUSA304_00736_SEQ_00: Tanga Tonga seeks help excavating fossils at Thalaos.
TEXT_GAIUSA304_00736_SEQ_01: The researcher Tanga Tonga has need of an adventurer to aid in his study of the Thalaos boneyard. Survey the excavation site to see if you can discover any fossils worth recovering.
TEXT_GAIUSA304_00736_SEQ_02: You have found a couple different kinds of fossil that might serve to pique Tanga Tonga's interest. Return to the researcher in his cabin and let him pore over your discoveries.
TEXT_GAIUSA304_00736_SEQ_03: Tanga Tonga has identified two types of ancient creatures from the fossils you have brought him: a large sea animal eaten by Thalaos, and a small parasite that clung to the Thalaos. With these new discoveries, he has enough information to advance his studies for the time being.
TEXT_GAIUSA307_00739_SEQ_00: Auphiliot is worried about Buscarron in light of recent events.
TEXT_GAIUSA307_00739_SEQ_01: Buscarron is vexed by the appearance of Garleans in the Twelveswood. To ease his mind, Auphiliot would have you speak with a Coeurlclaw poacher and a flyer for the Redbelly Wasps, and ask that they keep an eye out for any Garleans they might spy.
TEXT_GAIUSA307_00739_SEQ_02: You have asked for the vigilant eyes of both poachers and Wasps alike. Take word of your deeds back to Auphiliot at Buscarron's Druthers.
TEXT_GAIUSA307_00739_SEQ_03: It turns out that Auphiliot had more in mind than assuring Buscarron that the Garleans are being kept in check. He also had you meet the poacher and the flyer so that they would know who you are, and that you do not fear them. He hopes such meetings will serve to make you ever more useful to the proprietor and clientele of Buscarron's Druthers.
TEXT_GAIUSA310_00742_SEQ_00: Auphiliot would be most grateful if you could hunt down some Garlean interlopers in his stead.
TEXT_GAIUSA310_00742_SEQ_01: A number of the Garleans responsible for the disappearance of the sylph elder remain in the area. Investigate the specified locations, and vanquish any Garleans you come upon.
TEXT_GAIUSA310_00742_SEQ_02: The Garlean intruders are no more. Report your success to Auphiliot.
TEXT_GAIUSA310_00742_SEQ_03: Thanks to your efforts, the Garleans have been driven off, and a small measure of peace has returned to the Twelveswood. At least for the moment.
TEXT_GAIUSA403_00745_SEQ_00: Knolexia wishes to show you her immense gratitude.
TEXT_GAIUSA403_00745_SEQ_01: Knolexia wishes to present you with a gift, but first asks that you bring her three bottles of djigga blood. Do so by using the bottles she provided you with on weakened swollen djiggas.
TEXT_GAIUSA403_00745_SEQ_02: You have procured the three bottles of djigga blood Knolexia requested. Deliver them to her at Little Solace.
TEXT_GAIUSA403_00745_SEQ_03: Using the djigga blood you have provided, Knolexia has created for you an enchanted garment to serve as a token of her appreciation. However, while you appreciate the gesture, it may take some time to get used to the idea of wearing vilekin blood as a good-luck charm.
TEXT_GAIUSA407_00749_SEQ_00: The researcher Claudian could use an adventurer's assistance in dispatching some bothersome birds.
TEXT_GAIUSA407_00749_SEQ_01: Winged purveyors of death and destruction are wreaking havoc with Claudian's investigation of the ruins. Set handmade scarecrows at the specified locations in Highbridge.
TEXT_GAIUSA407_00749_SEQ_02: The scarecrows have been placed. Inform Claudian that the avian pests will disrupt his research no more.
TEXT_GAIUSA407_00749_SEQ_03: Now free to immerse himself in his research, Claudian thanks you for your assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSA408_00750_SEQ_00: The researcher Gogoshu could use an adventurer's assistance in dispatching some bothersome buzzards.
TEXT_GAIUSA408_00750_SEQ_01: Overaggressive chasm buzzards are disrupting the ongoing investigation of the ruins near Highbridge. Slay four of the avian pests so that Gogoshu might resume her research.
TEXT_GAIUSA408_00750_SEQ_02: Four savage buzzards have fallen by your hand and will disrupt Gogoshu's research no more. Return and inform her of your deeds.
TEXT_GAIUSA408_00750_SEQ_03: Thanks to your culling of the flock, Gogoshu may resume her investigation of the ruins.
TEXT_GAIUSA409_00751_SEQ_00: Helmhart of Highbridge could use an adventurer's assistance with a hair-raising problem.
TEXT_GAIUSA409_00751_SEQ_01: Helmhart has a grievous physical ailment which requires immediate treatment. Slay phurbles around Highbridge to obtain three bottles of phurble blood, and deliver them to Helmhart with all speed.
TEXT_GAIUSA409_00751_SEQ_02: You have successfully obtained the requisite bottles of phurble blood. Hasten back to Helmhart and deliver them before his condition deteriorates.
TEXT_GAIUSA409_00751_SEQ_03: Helmhart concocts a potent hair tonic with the phurble blood you retrieved. Apply it liberally to his head, that his locks might flow forth once more.
TEXT_GAIUSA409_00751_SEQ_04: Having applied the hair tonic to his shiny pate, Helmhart rejoices at the pleasant tingling sensation it affords. Whether it has any effect beyond this remains to be seen.
TEXT_GAIUSA501_00753_SEQ_00: Claudian needs to secure additional resources for his research.
TEXT_GAIUSA501_00753_SEQ_01: Claudian's research has borne considerable fruit, but he lacks for the manpower and supplies to restore invaluable Belah'dian artifacts. Deliver an abstract of his findings to Kyokyozo at Thal's Respite, that the priest might be convinced to send aid.
TEXT_GAIUSA501_00753_SEQ_02: Kyokyozo is duly impressed with the historical significance of Claudian's findings, and promises to arrange for additional researchers and supplies to be sent to Highbridge without delay.
TEXT_GAIUSA502_00754_SEQ_00: Sister Kyokyozo of the Order of Nald'thal seeks an adventurer to slay creatures who are scaring away potential pilgrims to Thal's Respite.
TEXT_GAIUSA502_00754_SEQ_01: Pilgrims to Thal's Respite have grown scarce of late, and the vicious axe beaks who run rampant on the roads leading in are to blame. Slay four of the fearsome fowl.
TEXT_GAIUSA502_00754_SEQ_02: You have slain four axe beaks, that would-be pilgrims might enter the hallowed halls of Thal's Respite without fear for their safety. Inform Sister Kyokyozo of your deeds.
TEXT_GAIUSA502_00754_SEQ_03: Sister Kyokyozo informs you that, thanks to your aid, she has already welcomed a traveling merchant and her family to the Respite. She looks forward to the many encounters with which the Traders will now bless her.
TEXT_GAIUSA503_00755_SEQ_00: Sister Kyokyozo seeks an adventurer to deliver a missive to Highbridge.
TEXT_GAIUSA503_00755_SEQ_01: Sister Kyokyozo has entrusted you with a signed petition intended for Highwind Skyways. Deliver it to the merchant Hihibaru at Highbridge.
TEXT_GAIUSA503_00755_SEQ_02: The earnest petitions of the Order of Nald'thal and Hihibaru's trade union will carry considerable weight in persuading Highwind Skyways to establish regular flights to and from Highbridge. It is only a matter of time before prosperity comes to the area.
TEXT_GAIUSA506_00758_SEQ_00: Hihira would seek your help in her attempt to provide aid to the refugees.
TEXT_GAIUSA506_00758_SEQ_01: Hihira wants nothing more than to deliver succor to the ill and infirm of Little Ala Mhigo, but has been unable to earn the locals' trust. Deliver medicine to three suffering refugees in her stead.
TEXT_GAIUSA506_00758_SEQ_02: Despite your best efforts, the willful Ala Mhigans have chosen to prolong their suffering rather than seek succor in Ul'dahn remedies. Report your failure to Hihira.
TEXT_GAIUSA506_00758_SEQ_03: Hihira is saddened to hear of the Ala Mhigans' refusal, but is not surprised. However, not one to be discouraged, she resolves to continue her efforts.
TEXT_GAIUSA507_00759_SEQ_00: Hihira wonders if there might be another remedy the refugees might accept.
TEXT_GAIUSA507_00759_SEQ_01: Hihira suspects that suffering Ala Mhigans have refused her treatment due to the medicine's Ul'dahn origins. Seek out the old man Alfan on Hihira's behalf and see if there is no other remedy the villagers might accept.
TEXT_GAIUSA507_00759_SEQ_02: Alfan confirms Hihira's suspicions─that his neighbors are distrustful of Ul'dahn alchemical concoctions─and shares the recipe for a traditional Ala Mhigan remedy. Head without the encampment and slay five sabotenders, collecting their succulent fruit as you go.
TEXT_GAIUSA507_00759_SEQ_03: You have obtained five sabotender fruits. Deliver them to Hihira.
TEXT_GAIUSA507_00759_SEQ_04: With the sabotender fruits you procured, Hihira has brewed a pot of the traditional Ala Mhigan remedy. Deliver it to the suffering residents.
TEXT_GAIUSA507_00759_SEQ_05: The three sick Ala Mhigans, albeit with some reluctance, have partaken of Hihira's remedy. Report your success to Hihira.
TEXT_GAIUSA507_00759_SEQ_06: While encouraged by the Ala Mhigans' willingness to put prejudice aside and accept her medicine, Hihira is aware that true understanding and acceptance will not be so easily won.
TEXT_GAIUSA508_00760_SEQ_00: Annabel of the Immortal Flames has a task for a stalwart adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSA508_00760_SEQ_01: Lost souls from the age of Belah'dia are said to haunt the ruins south of Little Ala Mhigo. Using the blessed water provided by Annabel to weaken their powers, slay one tempered sword and one tempered brand.
TEXT_GAIUSA508_00760_SEQ_02: The tempered souls have been slain. Inform Annabel of your success.
TEXT_GAIUSA508_00760_SEQ_03: Impressed with your abilities, Annabel resolves to devote herself to her martial training, that one day she might perform similar deeds.
TEXT_GAIUSA602_00764_SEQ_00: Nedrick has a tantalizing bit of information to share with an adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSA602_00764_SEQ_01: Nedrick informs you that the Immortal Flames are recruiting adventurers to explore the Sunken Temple of Qarn. Travel to the entrance of the temple and seek out one Bibimu.
TEXT_GAIUSA602_00764_SEQ_02:
Bibimu has granted you permission to explore the Sunken Temple of Qarn. Steel yourself for the many challenges that lie in wait.

※The Sunken Temple of Qarn can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_GAIUSA604_00766_SEQ_00: Balan of the Wood Wailers at Quarrymill seeks an adventurer to help him settle the score with some poachers.
TEXT_GAIUSA604_00766_SEQ_01: Hunting snares set by poachers in the surrounding woods pose considerable danger for local fauna and unsuspecting travelers. Disarm the iron leg traps and deal with any poachers you encounter.
TEXT_GAIUSA604_00766_SEQ_02: Both the snares and the poachers have been dealt with. Inform Balan of your deeds.
TEXT_GAIUSA604_00766_SEQ_03: The poachers' traps have grown more deadly and numerous of late. Balan is convinced that the leader of the gang, the self-crowned King of the Coeurlclaws, is responsible.
TEXT_GAIUSA605_00767_SEQ_00: Wlfric of the Wood Wailers seeks an adventurer to root out poachers who have holed up in Quarrymill.
TEXT_GAIUSA605_00767_SEQ_01: A poacher captured by Wlfric has escaped and is hiding out somewhere in Quarrymill. Seek out and apprehend the runagate.
TEXT_GAIUSA605_00767_SEQ_02: You have found the poacher, who confesses that she only turned to a life of crime to feed her family. Moved by her remorse for her ill deeds, you choose to look the other way. Return to Wlfric and relate the sad tale to him.
TEXT_GAIUSA605_00767_SEQ_03: Wlfric of the Wood Wailers is outraged that the poacher has escaped justice, and fears the consequences of this grievous flouting of the elementals' will.
TEXT_GAIUSA606_00768_SEQ_00: Deidra of Quarrymill would invite you to live a farmer's life for a day.
TEXT_GAIUSA606_00768_SEQ_01: At Deidra's urging, you have consented to go apple-picking at the orchards north of Quarrymill. Speak with Fawkes at the orchards to see what is needed of you.
TEXT_GAIUSA606_00768_SEQ_02: Fawkes would have you harvest six sprite apples from the orchards.
TEXT_GAIUSA606_00768_SEQ_03: You have picked six of the sweetest, juiciest sprite apples in the orchard. Deliver the fruits of your harvest to Fawkes.
TEXT_GAIUSA606_00768_SEQ_04: Fawkes is impressed with your aptitude for apple-picking and invites you to inherit his orchard when your adventuring days are through.
TEXT_GAIUSA607_00769_SEQ_00: The orchard-keeper Fawkes seeks your aid in giving thanks for the harvest.
TEXT_GAIUSA607_00769_SEQ_01: Fawkes has been blessed with his most bountiful harvest in years, and would give due thanks to the guardian of the forest. Seek out the guardian to the southwest of Quarrymill and place a sprite apple in offering.
TEXT_GAIUSA607_00769_SEQ_02: The offering to the forest guardian made, deliver the remaining apple to Castellaint of Quarrymill.
TEXT_GAIUSA607_00769_SEQ_03: Castellaint declares the apple the finest he has tasted in years. The bounty of the forest has brought joy to Quarrymill once more.
TEXT_GAIUSA608_00770_SEQ_00: Faucertaux seeks your aid in reclaiming a village from a band of outlaws.
TEXT_GAIUSA608_00770_SEQ_01: A notorious band of outlaws known as the Redbelly Wasps has taken over an abandoned village and turned it into a hive of villainy. Slay a Redbelly lookout, sharpeye, and larcener.
TEXT_GAIUSA608_00770_SEQ_02: You have dispatched three of the Redbelly Wasps. Report your success to Faucertaux.
TEXT_GAIUSA608_00770_SEQ_03: Your success in routing the bandits has given Faucertaux hope that the day when Hyur and Elezen once again reside peacefully in the village is close at hand.
TEXT_GAIUSA609_00771_SEQ_00: Cuthbert of Quarrymill would seek your aid in recovering a family heirloom.
TEXT_GAIUSA609_00771_SEQ_01: The notorious Redbelly Wasps have in their possession a priceless heirloom that once belonged to Cuthbert's grandfather, the elder of the ill-fated village of Boughbury. Venture near Redbelly Hive and recover the axe.
TEXT_GAIUSA609_00771_SEQ_02: You have safely recovered the Boughbury Axe from the vicious bandits. Cuthbert will be overjoyed to see it returned after so many years.
TEXT_GAIUSA609_00771_SEQ_03: Taking his grandfather's prized heirloom in hand, Cuthbert swears vengeance against those who stole from his family their rightful home.
TEXT_GAIUSA610_00772_SEQ_00: Aedoc of Quarrymill has a culinary crisis on her hands.
TEXT_GAIUSA610_00772_SEQ_01: Aedoc has exhausted her supply of Mun-Tuy sauce, and she fears an alarming drop in morale if her culinary creations are made without the savory condiment. Make for the Mun-Tuy Cellars and obtain a bottle from Masher Erimmont.
TEXT_GAIUSA610_00772_SEQ_02: Erimmont informs you that the next batch of Mun-Tuy sauce will finish fermenting in a short while. Whether or not it will be ready in time to save Aedoc from being devoured by famished, bean-crazed soldiers remains to be seen...
TEXT_GAIUSA611_00773_SEQ_00: Erimmont of the Mun-Tuy Cellars would put you to work as an apprentice masher.
TEXT_GAIUSA611_00773_SEQ_01: In order to obtain a bottle of Mun-Tuy sauce without delay, you have agreed to help Erimmont apply the finishing touches to the latest batch. To start, you have been instructed to obtain the following three secret spices from the cellar's stores: a perilla leaf, an onze of Shroud pepper, and a dried dragon pepper.
TEXT_GAIUSA611_00773_SEQ_02: You have obtained the perilla leaf, Shroud pepper, and dried dragon pepper as bade. Add them to the gyle-fat to ensure Erimmont's Mun-Tuy sauce is given its distinctive flavor.
TEXT_GAIUSA611_00773_SEQ_03: The secret seasonings have been added, and the fermentation process complete. Speak with Geoffrey and obtain a bottle of Mun-Tuy sauce.
TEXT_GAIUSA611_00773_SEQ_04: After quite an ordeal, you have obtained a bottle of Mun-Tuy sauce. Deliver it to Aedoc before she is devoured alive by her own men.
TEXT_GAIUSA611_00773_SEQ_05: Aedoc is overjoyed to be restocked with Mun-Tuy sauce. Despite its unusual aroma, it remains an indispensable ingredient in many a beloved Gridanian dish.
TEXT_GAIUSA706_00779_SEQ_00: Hremfing needs your aid in disposing of some brigands.
TEXT_GAIUSA706_00779_SEQ_01: A particularly nasty band of outlaws known as the Corpse Brigade has set up shop in the vicinity of Little Ala Mhigo. Make your way northeast of the settlement and take down any thieves you encounter.
TEXT_GAIUSA706_00779_SEQ_02: You have thinned the ranks of the Corpse Brigade and sent a message that the denizens of Little Ala Mhigo will not stand for their villainy. Report your success to Hremfing.
TEXT_GAIUSA706_00779_SEQ_03: The men and women of the Corpse Brigade were honorable Ala Mhigans before degenerating into a band of petty thieves. Though not without pity for his countrymen, Hremfing means to do whatever must be done to keep them from sullying his homeland's name.
TEXT_GAIUSA707_00780_SEQ_00: Amelot needs something, and needs it now.
TEXT_GAIUSA707_00780_SEQ_01: Amelot needs to prepare an antidote─and quickly─but lacks for a vital ingredient. Use the bottle of leoformic acid she has entrusted to you to slay a rockskin peiste and obtain its poison.
TEXT_GAIUSA707_00780_SEQ_02: You have obtained a secretion of peiste poison. Deliver it to Amelot with due haste.
TEXT_GAIUSA707_00780_SEQ_03: As Amelot tells it, the poisons employed by the Corpse Brigade have grown increasingly potent of late, and antidote has been in short supply. Your efforts have made it possible for the Resistance to continue fighting the good fight.
TEXT_GAIUSA708_00781_SEQ_00: Amelot would ask another favor of you.
TEXT_GAIUSA708_00781_SEQ_01: Amelot has entrusted you with the task of exterminating disease-carrying wasps. Scatter cactus piss on the bodies of dead creatures to attract the vermin, then slay them.
TEXT_GAIUSA708_00781_SEQ_02: The loathsome wasp swarms will spread filth and disease to Little Ala Mhigo no more. Return to Amelot and inform her of your success.
TEXT_GAIUSA708_00781_SEQ_03: Amelot expresses her deep thanks for your selfless acts on behalf of her humble community, and her regret at being unable to repay you in proper.
TEXT_GAIUSA804_00788_SEQ_00: Somerhild of Fallgourd Float would ask your aid on behalf of a forgetful friend.
TEXT_GAIUSA804_00788_SEQ_01: A drinking companion of Somerhild's has misplaced the key to his room at the Bobbing Cork. Recover it to rescue the poor sop from a hard night sleeping on the streets.
TEXT_GAIUSA804_00788_SEQ_02: You have recovered the misplaced key. Deliver it to Aeluuin of the Bobbing Cork.
TEXT_GAIUSA804_00788_SEQ_03: Aeluuin thanks you for recovering the key lost by one of his drunken customers. What with a mysterious masked figure skulking about the surroundings of late, he is concerned for the safety of his patrons.
TEXT_GAIUSA805_00789_SEQ_00: Godwin of the Wood Wailers has a report that requires urgent delivery.
TEXT_GAIUSA805_00789_SEQ_01: Godwin has entrusted you with a classified report on recent happenings in the vicinity of Fallgourd Float. Deliver it to Vortefaurt of the Twin Adder with due haste.
TEXT_GAIUSA805_00789_SEQ_02: Godwin's report relayed sightings of a masked man that have stirred alarm in Fallgourd Float. Might the menacing figure described be an Ascian?
TEXT_GAIUSA806_00790_SEQ_00: Oriane of Florentel's Spire is concerned for the trees.
TEXT_GAIUSA806_00790_SEQ_01: Their resources needed to stave off Ixali raids, Oriane and her fellow Wood Wailers cannot attend to the baneful hares that are ravaging the flora of the Twelveswood. Pour flat ale on scarred trees to attract the pests, then slay them.
TEXT_GAIUSA806_00790_SEQ_02: The bark-chewing, leaf-eating hares will feast on local flora no more. Report your success to Oriane.
TEXT_GAIUSA806_00790_SEQ_03: Oriane thanks you for your efforts. She is resolved to protect the Twelveswood to honor the memory of Florentel, the legendary hero whose name the spire bears.
TEXT_GAIUSA807_00791_SEQ_00: Oriane needs your help in obtaining something not easily come by.
TEXT_GAIUSA807_00791_SEQ_01: Pumice golems─creatures of living stone that have sprung up from the sundered landscape─have overrun the area, and Oriane would know their origins. Weaken one of the creatures to some degree, then capture its soul with a sealing vessel.
TEXT_GAIUSA807_00791_SEQ_02: You have obtained the living soulstone of a pumice golem. The researcher Yhom Epocan at the Bobbing Cork in Fallgourd Float should be able to shed light on the creature's origins.
TEXT_GAIUSA807_00791_SEQ_03: Yhom Epocan is overjoyed to receive a soulstone in such pristine condition, and vows to begin her analysis straightaway.
TEXT_GAIUSA808_00792_SEQ_00: Aeluuin of the Bobbing Cork would ask you to help with housekeeping.
TEXT_GAIUSA808_00792_SEQ_01: Aeluuin's employees are shirking their duties of late, and the paintings that adorn the inn are collecting dust. Borrow the innkeep's chocobo duster and restore the masterpieces to a pristine state.
TEXT_GAIUSA808_00792_SEQ_02: Caked in dust not minutes ago, the paintings' vivid colors now shine through. Tell Aeluuin your job is done.
TEXT_GAIUSA808_00792_SEQ_03: Aeluuin is pleased to see his paintings spic-and-span again. Though he is quite partial to one of the paintings, he has thus far been unable to ascertain the artist's identity.
TEXT_GAIUSA809_00793_SEQ_00: Aeluuin is concerned for the well-being of one of his customers.
TEXT_GAIUSA809_00793_SEQ_01: A young woman who has reserved a room at the Bobbing Cork has yet to arrive, and Aeluuin fears the worst. Seek out the woman and see to her safety.
TEXT_GAIUSA809_00793_SEQ_02: You have dispatched the fiend that was threatening the young adventurer. Speak with her and calm her nerves.
TEXT_GAIUSA809_00793_SEQ_03: The young adventurer offers her thanks; she was so taken with the scenery that she failed to notice the fiend's presence. Return to the Bobbing Cork and assure Aeluuin that his customer is safe.
TEXT_GAIUSA809_00793_SEQ_04: Aeluuin is relieved for your tidings. What with fearsome rumors circulating of late, he feels ever more responsible for his customers' safety. He will prepare a warm bed and hot meal for the girl, that she might forget her ordeal.
TEXT_GAIUSA810_00794_SEQ_00: Gogolata doesn't want to go home.
TEXT_GAIUSA810_00794_SEQ_01: Gogolata is enjoying the comforts of life on the road, and seeks to delay his return home for as long as possible. Present Gogolata's envelope to the haughty houseboy who has come to find him.
TEXT_GAIUSA810_00794_SEQ_02: Upon opening Gogolata's envelope to discover reservation papers for a stay at the Bobbing Cork, the hired hand dashes off in delight. Return to speak with Gogolata.
TEXT_GAIUSA810_00794_SEQ_03: According to Gogolata, the hired hand expressed his gratitude, then rushed straight to his room where he now sleeps soundly. It would seem Gogolata is not the only one less than eager to return to Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSA811_00795_SEQ_00: Gogolata has a confession to make.
TEXT_GAIUSA811_00795_SEQ_01: Gogolata confesses to you the true reason he is reluctant to return to Ul'dah: his wares were stolen by Qiqirn bandits, and he will bear the full brunt of his wife's wrath if he returns without them. Gogolata suspects the thieves have taken the loot to their hideout south of Fallgourd Float. Retrieve them to spare the merchant a dire fate.
TEXT_GAIUSA811_00795_SEQ_02: You have recovered the stolen wares. Return them to Gogolata at the Bobbing Cork.
TEXT_GAIUSA811_00795_SEQ_03: Though relieved at the return of his property, Gogolata remains less than elated at the thought of returning to Ul'dah. What with ill rumors about, he decides to extend his sojourn for a while longer.
TEXT_GAIUSA901_00796_SEQ_00: Aeluuin would ask you to make a special delivery.
TEXT_GAIUSA901_00796_SEQ_01: Aeluuin has entrusted you with delivering meals to three prospectors at Finders' Bluff: Laughing Fury, Vavapu, and Ademar.
TEXT_GAIUSA901_00796_SEQ_02: The three prospectors were overjoyed to receive their long-awaited meals. Inform Aeluuin that they go hungry no more.
TEXT_GAIUSA901_00796_SEQ_03: Aeluuin is genuinely pleased to hear that the prospectors at Finders' Bluff enjoyed their meals. It is clear that the innkeep cares deeply for his customers.
TEXT_GAIUSA902_00797_SEQ_00: Ademar is in the dark and needs an adventurer's aid.
TEXT_GAIUSA902_00797_SEQ_01: Ademar has exhausted his supply of lantern oil, making it impossible for him to prospect at night. Procure an alternate light source for him by weakening bright balloons and then capturing them with his lamps.
TEXT_GAIUSA902_00797_SEQ_02: You have successfully fashioned two balloon lamps. Deliver them to Ademar.
TEXT_GAIUSA902_00797_SEQ_03: Ademar expresses his thanks, then promptly returns to his digging. The life of a prospector affords little time for idle banter.
TEXT_GAIUSA903_00798_SEQ_01: Ademar would explore for new ore veins, and seeks your aid in setting up ladders that will grant him passage to hard-to-reach places.
TEXT_GAIUSA903_00798_SEQ_02: You have placed all three ladders as instructed. Inform Ademar that the deed is done.
TEXT_GAIUSA903_00798_SEQ_03: Ore veins are quick to run dry, and prospectors must ever be on the lookout for their next quarry. Ademar digs on, hoping that the day he finds his fortune is not far off.
TEXT_GAIUSA907_00802_SEQ_00: Tyoh Moui would grant you passage through the White Wolf Gate.
TEXT_GAIUSA907_00802_SEQ_01: In recognition of your recent exploits, Serpent Corporal Tyoh Moui has opened the White Wolf Gate to you. To seek passage, show your gate pass to the gatekeeper, Franchemontiaux.
TEXT_GAIUSA907_00802_SEQ_02: With the presentation of your gate pass, you have been granted free passage through the White Wolf Gate. Any time you wish to pass, you need only speak to Franchemontiaux.
TEXT_GAIUSA908_00803_SEQ_00: Roustebant has a task for a capable adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSA908_00803_SEQ_01: Roustebant informs you that a fellow Wood Wailer is in need of an adventurer's aid. Travel to Dunstan's Spire and seek out Thievenaix.
TEXT_GAIUSA908_00803_SEQ_02: Recent rainfalls have left the wooden scaffolding at Dunstan's Spire in troubling condition. Inspect the scaffolding and see to any sodden planks or wood-boring pests you encounter.
TEXT_GAIUSA908_00803_SEQ_03: Your inspection of the scaffolding is complete. Report back to Thievenaix.
TEXT_GAIUSA908_00803_SEQ_04: Thievenaix expresses his thanks for your deeds, while ordering you not to discuss the presence of Shroud hares with Marcette. Who is this woman who strikes such fear into the hearts of brave warriors?
TEXT_GAIUSA909_00804_SEQ_00: The naturalist Marcette at Dunstan's Spire is in need of a research assistant.
TEXT_GAIUSA909_00804_SEQ_01: Marcette is doing research for the New Eorzean Geographic, her compendium of knowledge in the making, and requires toadstool caps to complete the chapter on fungi.
TEXT_GAIUSA909_00804_SEQ_02: You have successfully obtained the toadstool caps. Deliver them to Marcette.
TEXT_GAIUSA909_00804_SEQ_03: Marcette is immensely pleased with herself at her most recent scientific discovery─so pleased that she has entirely forgotten the identity of the adventurer who made it possible...
TEXT_GAIUSA910_00805_SEQ_00: Marcette would put you to work again, whether you like it or not.
TEXT_GAIUSA910_00805_SEQ_01: The genius naturalist Marcette has deigned to appoint you to the most honorable position of Research Assistant Six, and promptly ordered you to procure a live lightning spark for her research. Weaken the creature and capture it in the receptacle she has provided for you.
TEXT_GAIUSA910_00805_SEQ_02: You have captured a live lightning spark. Despite your concerns for the creature's fate, you have agreed to deliver it to Marcette.
TEXT_GAIUSA910_00805_SEQ_03: Marcette is on the verge of another pioneering discovery. Despite your continued contributions to her research, she has yet to remember your number, let alone your name.
TEXT_GAIUSA911_00806_SEQ_00: Hobriaut is suffering at the hands of the taskmaster Marcette.
TEXT_GAIUSA911_00806_SEQ_01: You agree to conduct a water survey on behalf of Hobriaut, who has been worked to the point of exhaustion by the unforgiving taskmaster Marcette. Obtain three bottles of water from Hopeseed Pond.
TEXT_GAIUSA911_00806_SEQ_02: You have completed the water survey entrusted to the young researcher Hobriaut. Deliver the three bottles of water to him.
TEXT_GAIUSA911_00806_SEQ_03: Though your assistance will spare Hobriaut from feeling Marcette's wrath today, the young researcher still fears for his life.
TEXT_GAIUSA912_00807_SEQ_00: Marcette would keep your nose to the grindstone.
TEXT_GAIUSA912_00807_SEQ_01: Marcette requires a freshly extracted stroper stomach for her latest experiment. Use the medicine she has provided you with to neutralize its foul breath, then slay the creature and extract its innards.
TEXT_GAIUSA912_00807_SEQ_02: You have obtained the putrid stomach of a stroper. Deliver the foul mess to Marcette before you pass out from the unbearable stench.
TEXT_GAIUSA912_00807_SEQ_03: Never have you seen anyone so happy to receive a putrid pile of innards. Marcette is once again tremendously pleased with herself, and─from the fact that she remembered your number─might even genuinely appreciate your efforts this time.
TEXT_GAIUSB006_00813_SEQ_00: This  finds Master Gegeruju, the brightest jewel in the glittering high society of Costa del Sol, in an unaccountably pensive mood.
TEXT_GAIUSB006_00813_SEQ_01: You have learned from Gegeruju that a quartet of dancing girls who were due to arrive have not yet presented their lissome selves. The driver of their carriage is certain to be nearby. Find him and discover the whereabouts of the fair guests.
TEXT_GAIUSB006_00813_SEQ_02: According to the driver, the dancers have gone spinning off towards the beach, exclaiming over the beauty of the sea. Track down the four girls.
TEXT_GAIUSB006_00813_SEQ_03: You have spoken to each of the dancers, but have found them loath to cut short their play among the surf. Bear the tale back to Master Gegeruju.
TEXT_GAIUSB006_00813_SEQ_04: Though you are initially fearful of the Lalafell's reaction, Gegeruju surprises you by being completely understanding of the situation. How could any child of verdant Gridania or arid Ul'dah resist the blue ocean that cradles Costa del Sol? Always generous, Gegeruju has declared that he will wait until the girls have had their fill of the beach.
TEXT_GAIUSB010_00817_SEQ_00: Detoh Moshroca needs a favor of an adventurer. The goodwill of a maid so proficient with polearms is surely worth having.
TEXT_GAIUSB010_00817_SEQ_01: Inspired by Captain Landenel's tales of intrigue from about the realm, Detoh Moshroca seeks Ul'dahn goods to expand her own worldly knowledge. To find something for her, speak with the Ul'dahn trader plying his wares in the Lower Paths.
TEXT_GAIUSB010_00817_SEQ_02: Upon locating the Ul'dahn trader on the Lower Paths, you find less vending of goods taking place and more defending against infernal birds of prey. You rescue the Lalafell from a dire fate, and receive a set of Ul'dahn incense as a token of thanks. Take the precious aromatics to Wood Wailer Detoh Moshroca.
TEXT_GAIUSB010_00817_SEQ_03: The set of Ul'dahn incense is now in the hands of the intrepid Wailer maid, who received them with much thanks and exclamations of delight. This could be the beginning of a beautiful friendship. Or not.
TEXT_GAIUSB011_00818_SEQ_00: Florent needs a capable adventurer to locate his lost goods.
TEXT_GAIUSB011_00818_SEQ_01: Arriving at Camp Tranquil via the southern rope bridge, Florent has dropped some of his precious lumber into Rootslake. He asks you to proceed under the south bridge to retrieve the pieces of wood from the scummy expanse.
TEXT_GAIUSB011_00818_SEQ_02: You have collected every precious length of lumber. Take them to Florent at Camp Tranquil.
TEXT_GAIUSB011_00818_SEQ_03: The lumber that you risked your life for is slated for the fireplace at Buscarron's Druthers. Though the wood is wet, Florent assures you that this can be quickly remedied.
TEXT_GAIUSB104_00823_SEQ_00: With nary a word, U'tykha Tia indicates that he has a delicate commission for you.
TEXT_GAIUSB104_00823_SEQ_01: You have learned from U'tykha Tia that a novice ranger of the U tribe, U'kahzuna, has gone forth to hunt anglers in the Sagolii Desert. However, she is long overdue for her return, and U'tykha Tia fears for her safety. With a susurrous sweep of his tail, the Miqo'te suggests you head southwest on a rescue mission.
TEXT_GAIUSB104_00823_SEQ_02: You have rescued U'kahzuna from the jagged maws of the approaching anglers. Though she appears to be none the worse for wear, she reproaches herself for failing to complete her mission. Return to U'tykha Tia in Forgotten Springs to hear what he has to say.
TEXT_GAIUSB104_00823_SEQ_03: U'tykha Tia judges the young one's failure to be no greater than those from his own youth. Out of the rawest novice may grow the finest ranger, if his tale is to be believed.
TEXT_GAIUSB105_00824_SEQ_00: People are talking, and U'khuba Tia would know what it is that they say.
TEXT_GAIUSB105_00824_SEQ_01: As the time of the Choosing draws ever nearer, U'khuba Tia does not favor the notion that U'tykha Tia is seen by many as the next chief of the U tribe. He bids you speak with immigrants, and discover their hopes for Forgotten Springs.
TEXT_GAIUSB105_00824_SEQ_02: You have spoken with three citizens newly immigrated to Forgotten Springs, and have found they all share some amount of discontentment at the lack of change. Return to U'khuba Tia and share with him their complaints.
TEXT_GAIUSB105_00824_SEQ_03: U'khuba Tia responds to your words as though he has heard them before, acknowledging that the U tribe will have to break with tradition in order to evolve. Whether the incorporation of such changes will result in positive growth, however, is a question to which no one has an answer.
TEXT_GAIUSB106_00825_SEQ_00: U'khuba Tia seems to be in an impatient mood.
TEXT_GAIUSB106_00825_SEQ_01: U'khuba Tia needs material for arrowheads, and, in the desert, that means only one thing─the dismemberment of unsuspecting creatures. After a short lecture on the intricacies of advancement within the U tribe, he bids you wrest six barbs from russet yarzons.
TEXT_GAIUSB106_00825_SEQ_02: Six yarzon barbs, still slick with blood and fury, rest in your palm. Take them to U'khuba Tia.
TEXT_GAIUSB106_00825_SEQ_03: You have delivered the fresh collection of yarzon parts to a grateful U'khuba Tia, who seems to be growing ever more confident about his upcoming challenge.
TEXT_GAIUSB107_00826_SEQ_00: Riridesu seems to need help with a delivery.
TEXT_GAIUSB107_00826_SEQ_01: Speaking to Riridesu elicits a small diatribe detailing the woes he incurred in his attempt to open a shop within Forgotten Springs. Apparently, the nunh of the U tribe forbade the shop due to cultural differences. Business must continue, however, so the Lalafellin merchant has bid you deliver a package to Odinel in Byregot's Strike.
TEXT_GAIUSB107_00826_SEQ_02: You have delivered the package to Odinel, who goes on to bemoan the inconvenient location of Riridesu's shop. Though he is not alone in his frustration about the nunh's decision, it seems as though there is little to be done to change the U tribe leader's mind in matters of tradition.
TEXT_GAIUSB108_00827_SEQ_00: Mumugoi has vast amounts of dirty and dangerous work for an adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSB108_00827_SEQ_01: Mumugoi has expressed his concern to you over the harm being done to the equipment of Byregot's Strike by the abundance of sand in the area. In order to forestall further maintenance, he has asked you to clean up three such piles of sand in the immediate vicinity. He has also warned you of the smoke bombs that may have burrowed into them.
TEXT_GAIUSB108_00827_SEQ_02: With much grit and elbow grease, you have banished both the sand piles and the bombs that lay within. Inform Mumugoi of the happy development.
TEXT_GAIUSB108_00827_SEQ_03: Mumugoi was thrilled to see you so easily dispatch the nuisances infecting the Strike. However, he informs you there is much and more to do, as the dangerous smoke bombs which surround the dig are often drawn in by the heat of the machinery. In order to keep the work site free of unwanted visitors, extinguish four of these fiends.
TEXT_GAIUSB108_00827_SEQ_04: You have defeated four smoke bombs in an exemplary fashion. The heat-loving creatures perished in strange jubilation, for to them your dripping, febrile form was as a thing divine. Report your success to Mumugoi.
TEXT_GAIUSB108_00827_SEQ_05: Mumugoi rejoices in the knowledge that four of the area's bombs have been taken care of. He also seems appreciative to have been able to devote more time to his chosen profession instead of the vexatious details that usually preoccupy his time.
TEXT_GAIUSB109_00828_SEQ_00: U'rahtalo would confide in you about her troubles.
TEXT_GAIUSB109_00828_SEQ_01: While happily unburdened by modesty, the U tribeswomen still expect their daily ablutions in the springs to not serve as a local attraction. Confront all the unwanted onlookers with /furious indignation.
TEXT_GAIUSB109_00828_SEQ_02: Your righteous indignation has caused the oglers to flee for their lives. Anger is a gift, and it seems that the Twelve have been generous with your share. Make pleasant your countenance, and report the happy news to U'rahtalo.
TEXT_GAIUSB109_00828_SEQ_03: U'rahtalo is well glad to be free of the madding crowd. However, it seems that she was not completely averse to the attention she was being offered.
TEXT_GAIUSB110_00829_SEQ_00: The reserved U'tykha Tia would have you light a fire within his struggling novice, U'kahzuna.
TEXT_GAIUSB110_00829_SEQ_01: U'tykha Tia informs you that he has the novice ranger U'kahzuna out practicing her skills on roving Amalj'aa in the east of the Sagolii Desert. As previously, he seems aware that she yet needs a push in order for her to reach her potential. Sensing that a teachable moment is nigh, he bids you seek U'kahzuna in the Sagolii Desert, and then defeat three Amalj'aa with her as witness.
TEXT_GAIUSB110_00829_SEQ_02: Three lizardmen have been dispatched by your hands, and U'kahzuna is perfectly caught between mortification and fury. Now, /psych her up as U'tykha Tia has requested.
TEXT_GAIUSB110_00829_SEQ_03: You have psyched up U'kahzuna with great subtlety and finesse. Go and make your report to U'tykha Tia.
TEXT_GAIUSB110_00829_SEQ_04: Before you can celebrate your successful demonstration, U'tykha Tia mentions with some irritation that U'khuba Tia saw fit to upbraid U'kahzuna on her return. He is worried that, without further intervention, the young ranger may cease her attempts to better herself.
TEXT_GAIUSB111_00830_SEQ_00: U'khuba Tia is looking at you with a very cross expression.
TEXT_GAIUSB111_00830_SEQ_01: U'khuba Tia seems ill pleased by your communion with U'tykha Tia, convinced that outsiders should not interfere with U tribe affairs. Carry word of his displeasure to U'tykha Tia.
TEXT_GAIUSB111_00830_SEQ_02: After speaking with U'tykha Tia, you have learned that he is more concerned about the novice U'kahzuna's well-being than he is U'khuba Tia's opinion of him. To ensure that she has not been too wounded by U'khuba Tia's critiques, seek out U'kahzuna in the Minotaur Malm and inquire as to her mental state.
TEXT_GAIUSB111_00830_SEQ_03: You arrive in the Minotaur Malm to find a new U'kahzuna, brimming with vigor. All she seems to require from you are three dune anglers. Proceed into the Sagolii Desert, and use empty angler-sized sacks on them once they have been sufficiently weakened.
TEXT_GAIUSB111_00830_SEQ_04: You are now the proud owner of three sacks full of angry fish monsters. Deliver the catch to U'kahzuna in the Minotaur Malm.
TEXT_GAIUSB111_00830_SEQ_05: A newly serene U'kahzuna has revealed that she is using the enfeebled anglers for archery practice on the advice of U'khuba Tia. Report this astonishing development to U'tykha Tia.
TEXT_GAIUSB111_00830_SEQ_06: U'tykha Tia and U'khuba Tia─surprisingly alike in their devotion to the tribe, but malms apart in all else. Who will become the next nunh, and what will it mean for Forgotten Springs? One thing is for sure: armed with new focus forged by U'tykha Tia and a new weapon furnished by U'khuba Tia, U'kahzuna stalks a brighter future.
TEXT_GAIUSB202_00833_SEQ_00: Many a quarrel has been started over empty larders, and Kuzai Tazai fears that soon, acrimony will be the order of the day in Costa del Sol.
TEXT_GAIUSB202_00833_SEQ_01: Kobolds have been making free with Costa del Sol's food supply, pilfering those morsels tastiest to their fastidious palates. Set a trap for them using the bloodstained sacks that Kuzai Tazai has given you.
TEXT_GAIUSB202_00833_SEQ_02: You have laid the bloody trap. Wait at the specified location and strike when the kobolds come for the meaty bounty.
TEXT_GAIUSB202_00833_SEQ_03: The kobolds perished hungry and surprised─not the worst way to go, all things considered. Return to Kuzai Tazai and tell him that the deed is done.
TEXT_GAIUSB202_00833_SEQ_04: Kuzai Tazai is relieved to hear your report, but he is not as happy as you expected. There is news far more disturbing than a few missing bits of headcheese: the kobolds are apparently arming themselves for war.
TEXT_GAIUSB203_00834_SEQ_00: Kuzai Tazai wants your help with some crustacean issues.
TEXT_GAIUSB203_00834_SEQ_01: Recent tremors off the shore of Costa del Sol have caused a troublesome influx of snippers. If that were not bad enough, Kuzai Tazai has informed you that the group is led by an even more fearsome creature. Providing you with a concoction that might be used to debilitate the larger foe, the Lalafell has bid you slay five of the snippers so that you might lure him out.
TEXT_GAIUSB203_00834_SEQ_02: You have dispatched five snippers, which should serve to provoke the gripper. Lie in wait at the specified location, and ambush the crab with your alchemic concoction when it appears.
TEXT_GAIUSB203_00834_SEQ_03: You have heroically slain the formidable gripper, making the shores safer for the time being. Report back to Kuzai Tazai.
TEXT_GAIUSB203_00834_SEQ_04: As before, Kuzai Tazai seems gladdened by your achievement, but remains reserved about the situation. There are rumors afloat that the seaside quakes are being caused by an unknown monster.
TEXT_GAIUSB204_00835_SEQ_00: Fyrilsunn has some makeshift explosives at his disposal. What could possibly go wrong?
TEXT_GAIUSB204_00835_SEQ_01: In an act of aggression towards the people of Costa del Sol, the kobolds have begun moving their underground refiners closer to the settlement. Unwilling to take this antagonism sitting down, Fyrilsunn has prepared makeshift bombs, which he bids you throw at the kobolds' refiners to destroy them.
TEXT_GAIUSB204_00835_SEQ_02: You have blown up all of the kobolds' refiners and have dispatched the angry bombs that were powering them. Report to Fyrilsunn.
TEXT_GAIUSB204_00835_SEQ_03: Fyrilsunn gives you a warm welcome upon your return, having witnessed the refiners' demise from his location. He expresses concern, however, at the fact that Costa del Sol is likely ill equipped to deal with future antagonistic acts from the kobolds. It would seem as though you might be needed in the area a bit longer.
TEXT_GAIUSB205_00836_SEQ_00: P'ebaloh is a maidservant of dignity on a rather inglorious errand.
TEXT_GAIUSB205_00836_SEQ_01: P'ebaloh is vexed by Master Gegeruju's belief that nearby buffaloes are to blame for the recent quakes. Though she has tried to persuade him otherwise, he is convinced the large beasts need to be taken care of. To satisfy him, P'ebaloh would have you cull six of them.
TEXT_GAIUSB205_00836_SEQ_02: You have slain six large buffaloes on a flimsy pretext. Report the slaughter to P'ebaloh.
TEXT_GAIUSB205_00836_SEQ_03: P'ebaloh thanks you for appeasing her master's whims. However, she believes that, deep in his heart, Gegeruju realizes that the true cause of the tremors is the primal Titan.
TEXT_GAIUSB206_00837_SEQ_00: The maidservant P'ebaloh has another task for your capable hands.
TEXT_GAIUSB206_00837_SEQ_01: P'ebaloh has told you that uragnites are making their homes on the pillars below. Use the steel spatulas to dislodge them for summary extermination.
TEXT_GAIUSB206_00837_SEQ_02: You have triumphed over every murderous mollusk. Report to P'ebaloh.
TEXT_GAIUSB206_00837_SEQ_03: P'ebaloh bemoans the fact that though she was once a member of the Company of Heroes, even the simple task you have performed is now beyond her. The wounds she suffered from a battle with a primal were more than skin-deep, causing her to trade in her sword for a salver.
TEXT_GAIUSB207_00838_SEQ_00: Fyrilsunn looks less than bright-eyed and bushy-tailed today. Something is definitely amiss.
TEXT_GAIUSB207_00838_SEQ_01: Fyrilsunn has told you that he has recently misplaced something of great value to him─three medals engraved with the image of a lion. Help out the distraught Roegadyn by searching for the medals around where he last saw them. He has suggested you begin by standing /lookout at the top of Gullperch Tower.
TEXT_GAIUSB207_00838_SEQ_02: The view provided by the tower has revealed three shining points of light along the ground below. Investigate each area to see if you can locate the medals.
TEXT_GAIUSB207_00838_SEQ_03: You have found the lost medals. Return them to Fyrilsunn in Costa del Sol.
TEXT_GAIUSB207_00838_SEQ_04: It turns out that the medals are Fyrilsunn's only remaining material connection to friends lost in a previous war. While he is grateful to have them back, the mementos also seem to make him wary of inevitable future conflicts.
TEXT_GAIUSB210_00841_SEQ_00: Etgar requires your assistance with a raptor predicament.
TEXT_GAIUSB210_00841_SEQ_01: Etgar, a local tender of Wineport's vineyards, has requested your assistance with a grass raptor problem. The scalekin have been munching on the outpost's precious vines, and they must be stopped. Track down four of the beasts and teach them a lesson.
TEXT_GAIUSB210_00841_SEQ_02: You have shown a quartet of raptors what for, and made the vineyards safe for another day. Report your success to Etgar.
TEXT_GAIUSB210_00841_SEQ_03: Etgar seems well pleased by your tidings, and vows to keep you in mind should he have need of your services in the future.
TEXT_GAIUSB211_00842_SEQ_00: Byrglaent, the master vintner of Wineport, is having difficulty acquiring good cork.
TEXT_GAIUSB211_00842_SEQ_01: Byrglaent is nearly apoplectic over the quality of the cork he has been supplied. Not willing to settle for anything less than first-rate, he has bid you slay five cork bulbs.
TEXT_GAIUSB211_00842_SEQ_02: You have slain five cork bulbs and ripped the quality cork from their lifeless corpses. Deliver the haul to Byrglaent in Wineport.
TEXT_GAIUSB211_00842_SEQ_03: The master vintner extols the virtues of the high-quality cork you have acquired. However, he cannot help but lament over his own staff's lack of ability when it comes to gathering the material themselves.
TEXT_GAIUSB303_00844_SEQ_00: Etgar seems to be in a state of some excitement this fine .
TEXT_GAIUSB303_00844_SEQ_01: Etgar has told you that Master Byrglaent has hired a miniaturist for the creation of a new wine label. Go and meet the artist at the Raincatcher Gully docks to inform him that the master vintner awaits his arrival.
TEXT_GAIUSB303_00844_SEQ_02: You have spoken with the renowned Ul'dahn artist and directed him to Wineport. Return to Etgar to ensure that the miniaturist arrived safely.
TEXT_GAIUSB303_00844_SEQ_03: Etgar is over the moon at the arrival of the artist, and is thrilled at the prospect of seeing Master Byrglaent's beatific image captured by the painter. The master vintner is clearly a man of great charisma.
TEXT_GAIUSB308_00849_SEQ_00: Etgar would have you once again slay his demons.
TEXT_GAIUSB308_00849_SEQ_01: Etgar worriedly recounts how the river has gorged itself sick on the winery's rich wastewater, causing gigantoads to run riot. He bids you dispatch three of the overgrown amphibians.
TEXT_GAIUSB308_00849_SEQ_02: You have beaten back the humongous hopping menaces. Report back to Etgar and tell him the deed is done.
TEXT_GAIUSB308_00849_SEQ_03: Though relieved that the sugar-soused pests have been dealt with, Etgar remains concerned about the impact of winemaking on the natural habitat. You cannot help but feel better about your own chosen trade and its relative lack of complication.
TEXT_GAIUSB310_00851_SEQ_00: Lock up your arcanists and hide the heavy equipment, Master Gegeruju is feeling bored.
TEXT_GAIUSB310_00851_SEQ_01: Master Gegeruju's idea is refreshingly harmless. In order to call up the winds, first collect three cores from wind sprites.
TEXT_GAIUSB310_00851_SEQ_02: You collected three wind sprite cores. Place them at the tip of the nearby cliffs to summon a storm sprite.
TEXT_GAIUSB310_00851_SEQ_03: Nature is not to be trifled with─the storm sprite attacks you. Report to Master Gegeruju.
TEXT_GAIUSB310_00851_SEQ_04: Far from apologetic, Master Gegeruju pouts that he only felt a whiffle. There is no greater adventure than serving at his pleasure.
TEXT_GAIUSB311_00852_SEQ_00: Ever capricious, Master Gegeruju demands to know how his colibri are faring.
TEXT_GAIUSB311_00852_SEQ_01: It seems poachers are luring the colibri northward with feed. Speak with them, but beware, for they bear you little love.
TEXT_GAIUSB311_00852_SEQ_02: The poachers say they are well within their rights to hunt the birds. Place the roselles along the specified trail to lure the colibri back.
TEXT_GAIUSB311_00852_SEQ_03: You have placed the flowers along the specified trail. Speak with the angry poachers again.
TEXT_GAIUSB311_00852_SEQ_04: Costa del Sol, jewel of the coast─and once a pioneer town built by the selfsame men now reduced to poaching colibri. Report the discovery to Master Gegeruju.
TEXT_GAIUSB311_00852_SEQ_05: The clash over the colibri is over. Both sides have their story, and each are convinced of the other's baseness. You are of course simply the messenger─or have you unknowingly chosen a side?
TEXT_GAIUSB312_00853_SEQ_00: The maidservant P'ebaloh comes to you for assistance, for her own fighting days are long past.
TEXT_GAIUSB312_00853_SEQ_01: A mysterious monstrosity has been spotted on the beach. Proceed to the spot and slay three of the pugils that seem to flock to it.
TEXT_GAIUSB312_00853_SEQ_02: A ripening carcass has been drawing the pugils to the area. Haul away the monster banquet, and all shall be well.
TEXT_GAIUSB312_00853_SEQ_03: You have hauled the carcass away. Report to P'ebaloh, and try to stay downwind of her.
TEXT_GAIUSB312_00853_SEQ_04: You speak to P'ebaloh and discover that groundskeepers have only recently tidied the beach. Dangerous visitors clearly grow more commonplace.
TEXT_GAIUSB402_00858_SEQ_00: Storm Private Blaugybal has a letter burning a hole on his bedside table.
TEXT_GAIUSB402_00858_SEQ_01: Blaugybal begs you deliver his pleas to Storm Commander Bloeidin at Camp Overlook. Use the lake crossing at Jijiroon's Trading Post, then head north to outer La Noscea.
TEXT_GAIUSB402_00858_SEQ_02: You deliver the plea to Commander Bloeidin, who laments Blaugybal's callowness and disallows the reinstatement. He clearly does so out of care rather than malice, but Blaugybal's disappointment will be great.
TEXT_GAIUSB403_00859_SEQ_00: Commander Bloeidin has a request of you, and when a Red Swallow asks nicely for something, it is best to oblige.
TEXT_GAIUSB403_00859_SEQ_01: Bloeidin is concerned about his scouts, who eat far too much weevil and too little meat and fish. Grill them a large trout using the nearby campfire.
TEXT_GAIUSB403_00859_SEQ_02: The fish looks enticingly crispy, a credit to your cooking prowess. Remove it from the fire.
TEXT_GAIUSB403_00859_SEQ_03: You have a grilled warmwater trout of great size, with deliciously singed skin and succulent flesh. You will not see its like again. Give it to the three Red Swallows.
TEXT_GAIUSB403_00859_SEQ_04: Notwithstanding the disheartening lack of three-star reviews, the scouts have been fed. Inform Commander Bloeidin that his troops are satiated.
TEXT_GAIUSB403_00859_SEQ_05: Having spoken with the commander, you find your heart strangely stirred by his words of admiration for his soldiers. While it would have been better manners for the scouts to have exclaimed over the fish, it cannot be expected of former pirates.
TEXT_GAIUSB404_00860_SEQ_00: Storm Private Augustine comes to you sore of neck and red of eye, having grown weary of scanning the sky.
TEXT_GAIUSB404_00860_SEQ_01: The inarticulate Private Augustine objects to birds menacing the balloon that ferries supplies to the embattled Camp Overlook. Proceed to the west and dispatch five of the troublesome highland condors.
TEXT_GAIUSB404_00860_SEQ_02: You have slain five birds. That will teach them to peck at things. Report to Augustine.
TEXT_GAIUSB404_00860_SEQ_03: The private is pleased, though he is as marble-mouthed in his happiness as he was in his perturbation. The Maelstrom truly is a roiling of humanity.
TEXT_GAIUSB405_00861_SEQ_00: Commander Bloeidin has something on his mind.
TEXT_GAIUSB405_00861_SEQ_01: The kobolds plan to create an army of golems, and this cannot come to pass. It is time to fight fire with fire, or clay with clay. Go to the Floating City and seize a soulstone from a golem.
TEXT_GAIUSB405_00861_SEQ_02: With a soulstone in your possession, it is time to set a trap at a likely spot.
TEXT_GAIUSB405_00861_SEQ_03: Your bait is in place. Lie in wait for the armored kobolds to appear, and defeat them using glass bottles of water.
TEXT_GAIUSB405_00861_SEQ_04: The Unbreakable kobold lies broken, and the threat of a golem army has crumbled ere it began. Report the news to Commander Bloeidin.
TEXT_GAIUSB405_00861_SEQ_05: You speak with Commander Bloeidin, who is much relieved. Yet his words send a frisson of unease through you, for if such a man as he expects more blood to flow, how could it be otherwise?
TEXT_GAIUSB406_00862_SEQ_00: Sergeant Swygrael wants something, and what this lady wants, she usually gets.
TEXT_GAIUSB406_00862_SEQ_01: In the charmingly feckless manner of maidens everywhere, Sergeant Swygrael of Camp Overlook has mislaid some personal items while beating velociraptors to death. She bids you gather raptor claws and serrated arrowheads, three of each.
TEXT_GAIUSB406_00862_SEQ_02: You have recovered the claws and arrowheads from the stinking velociraptor carcasses. Trudge back to the camp and give the loot to Swygrael.
TEXT_GAIUSB406_00862_SEQ_03: The kobolds' skill with metal is formidable, but could their covetousness for the enemy's leavings prove a weakness? Or is there a reason they so desire more metal?
TEXT_GAIUSB407_00863_SEQ_00: Sergeant Swygrael is a woman of many talents, as you discovered one memorable day. This fine , she is attempting to master another.
TEXT_GAIUSB407_00863_SEQ_01: Sergeant Swygrael has determined that the best way to fight the kobolds and their golem monstrosities is to train an army of coeurls. The fiery officer has bid you help with her plan by bringing in one of the large cats. Venture forth, weaken a young coeurl around the Floating City of Nym, then capture it using a large sack.
TEXT_GAIUSB407_00863_SEQ_02: You have a large sack of coeurl, which is neither the safest nor the most comfortable habitat for this majestic creature. Give it to Swygrael.
TEXT_GAIUSB407_00863_SEQ_03: You hand the captive beastkin to the sergeant, who appears not to have thought this idea through too well. For the love of the Twelve, do not tell her that her mother was right about her.
TEXT_GAIUSB408_00864_SEQ_00: Clearly, Commander Bloeidin has come to trust your skill and discretion.
TEXT_GAIUSB408_00864_SEQ_01: Storm Commander Bloeidin tells of recent kobold sightings close to Camp Overlook, and would send you off to investigate. Search the specified spots near the camp, and slay any kobold so unfortunate as to encounter you.
TEXT_GAIUSB408_00864_SEQ_02: You have adorned the hillside with the remains of vanquished foes. However, it is time to cut short this braggarts' sport and report to Commander Bloeidin.
TEXT_GAIUSB408_00864_SEQ_03: The storm commander's regard for you grows with every mission. Yet he is uneasy, for the kobold scouts stir a memory still as yet vague...
TEXT_GAIUSB409_00865_SEQ_00: Some minds are sieves and some are steel traps, and Commander Bloeidin has the latter sort. His remembrance of things past begins a mission of vengeance.
TEXT_GAIUSB409_00865_SEQ_01: Commander Bloeidin recounts to you the tale of how one Private Blaugybal was injured one rainy night in a kobold ambush. Racked with guilt over failing to protect his men, the commander now seeks revenge against a hated foe, the kobold priest of the 129th Order that arranged the deed. Use smoldering coal to set off three of the priest's bombs and lure him out of hiding.
TEXT_GAIUSB409_00865_SEQ_02: You have set off all the bombs. Lurk at the specified spot and slay the priest when he appears.
TEXT_GAIUSB409_00865_SEQ_03: After besting the cunning kobold priest, a strange impulse seizes you and you take his helm as a trophy. Show it to Commander Bloeidin.
TEXT_GAIUSB409_00865_SEQ_04: Commander Bloeidin hears your report, and marks you as a friend of the Red Swallows. He bids you take the helm to Camp Bronze Lake to place in the hands of Blaugybal, who yet remains an invalid.
TEXT_GAIUSB409_00865_SEQ_05: You give the dead kobold's helm to Blaugybal, who supplies the final piece of the story for that night. Much moved by his fellow Red Swallows' love for him, he renews his devotion to his brothers and sisters.
TEXT_GAIUSB410_00866_SEQ_00: Rukusa Farusa is a man much tried.
TEXT_GAIUSB410_00866_SEQ_01: Rukusa Farusa confides that a tourist has taken up residence in his infirmary. The man in question, a wealthy goldsmith, requires salamander oil for his hurts. Draw four vials' worth from salamanders nearby.
TEXT_GAIUSB410_00866_SEQ_02: After some deft work, you have four vials' worth of salamander oil. Show it to the goldsmith.
TEXT_GAIUSB410_00866_SEQ_03: The work is more hands-on than you were led to expect. Pour the salamander oil on Godbert, and remember that generosity is a virtue.
TEXT_GAIUSB410_00866_SEQ_04: Fortunately, you still have plenty of salamander oil. Unfortunately, there is still plenty more of Godbert in need of oiling. Keep pouring it onto the weary goldsmith.
TEXT_GAIUSB410_00866_SEQ_05: You may as well finish what you started. Knead the oil into Godbert's weary flesh. This too is a virtue, though one less well defined.
TEXT_GAIUSB410_00866_SEQ_06: Your work is far from over. Keep working those knots out of Godbert's tense muscles.
TEXT_GAIUSB410_00866_SEQ_07: Godbert has reached a heightened state of bliss thanks to your expert ministrations. Report your success to Rukusa Farusa.
TEXT_GAIUSB410_00866_SEQ_08: Rukusa Farusa tells that the Ul'dahn artisan is under a misapprehension. Or perhaps, it is the nature of those both wealthy and seeking to believe as they like.
TEXT_GAIUSB411_00867_SEQ_00: The healer A'rhunlika greets you with a smile and a chore, as she is wont to do. Who could mind when the cause is good and the smile so fair?
TEXT_GAIUSB411_00867_SEQ_01: A'rhunlika has prepared some mulled wine, redolent of Wineport sunshine and rich with herbs, and she needs it warmed. Take the bottles to the hot spring and submerge them.
TEXT_GAIUSB411_00867_SEQ_02: From the gentle steam and the heady fragrance, you judge the mulled wine well and truly warmed. Collect the warmwine from where you left it.
TEXT_GAIUSB411_00867_SEQ_03: In your hand, you hold a nectar most healthful, hot as the southern desert and deep as the northern sea. Deliver the wine to soldiers who heal their hurts under A'rhunlika's ministrations.
TEXT_GAIUSB411_00867_SEQ_04: The warmwine has been served to the wounded women and men. Speak with A'rhunlika.
TEXT_GAIUSB411_00867_SEQ_05: A'rhunlika listens, her smile tinged with sorrow. She is no bright-eyed young thing maudlin with hero worship. She knows too well what awaits us all─yet she would still raise a glass to all that is good and fair.
TEXT_GAIUSB412_00868_SEQ_00: Rukusa Farusa seems to be near the end of his tethers.
TEXT_GAIUSB412_00868_SEQ_01: Nearly inchoate with anger, Rukusa Farusa tells you that Godbert the goldsmith has swooned from the heat of the bath. See if a determined /poke will rouse him.
TEXT_GAIUSB412_00868_SEQ_02: Godbert remains insensate despite the potent prod. Do as the physicians do and douse him with a bottle of ice-cold lake water.
TEXT_GAIUSB412_00868_SEQ_03: Godbert does not respond. This calls for another dose of ice-cold lake water.
TEXT_GAIUSB412_00868_SEQ_04: Godbert stirs ever so slightly. Perhaps another dose of ice-cold lake water will do the trick.
TEXT_GAIUSB412_00868_SEQ_05: Godbert has regained his foot with surprising alacrity. How efficacious these tricks of physicking are! Report the happy development to Rukusa Farusa.
TEXT_GAIUSB412_00868_SEQ_06: Godbert is homebound, a man reborn. Rukusa Farusa ponders over how a man may be a figure both comic and tragic. Godbert has left you a precious ring, a strangely moving memento of the Calamity. Wear it with humility.
TEXT_GAIUSB501_00870_SEQ_00: There is an impish, conspiratorial look about Allene. If her injuries allowed, she would sidle.
TEXT_GAIUSB501_00870_SEQ_01: Allene tells you of the Wanderer's Palace, a glittering trove of treasures uncovered by the Calamity. She burns to return there, that much is obvious. Speak with Abazi Charazi down at the docks west of Camp Bronze Lake.
TEXT_GAIUSB501_00870_SEQ_02:
Unhinged by the loss of her lover to a tonberry's blade, Allene has been luring adventurers out to the palace with a tale much embroidered. Abazi Charazi offers to take you there, if you are prepared and so inclined.

※The Wanderer's Palace can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_GAIUSB504_00873_SEQ_00: The ache you carry cannot have escaped Father Iliud's sharp eyes, yet he makes no note of it.
TEXT_GAIUSB504_00873_SEQ_01: Iliud bids you go to Lost Hope, a raft of exiles lashed to the graceful ship of Ul'dah, and deliver four sticks of vilekin repellent to Zazawaka.
TEXT_GAIUSB504_00873_SEQ_02: Immediately wary and just as immediately courteous, Zazawaka asks you to apply the repellent. Take the sticks and use them at the appointed locations.
TEXT_GAIUSB504_00873_SEQ_03: You have applied the repellent. Report your success to Zazawaka.
TEXT_GAIUSB504_00873_SEQ_04: Grateful for your assistance, Zazawaka shares his private worries with you. You have no words of comfort, for the exile speaks true. Return to the Church of Saint Adama Landama and report to Father Iliud.
TEXT_GAIUSB504_00873_SEQ_05: You speak with Father Iliud, and sense the depth of his grief for the fate of these people. On your own cares too, he gives a brief and gentle counsel.
TEXT_GAIUSB505_00874_SEQ_00: Rousing himself from a considerable gloom, Barryn seems thankful for your presence.
TEXT_GAIUSB505_00874_SEQ_01: It seems that a mourner was attacked near an unusually verdant patch of wildflowers growing on a fallen goobbue. Barryn bids you investigate the scene and slay the creatures responsible.
TEXT_GAIUSB505_00874_SEQ_02: You have slain the Shroud mandragoras who had apparently claimed the goobbue mound as their own. Report your success to Barryn.
TEXT_GAIUSB505_00874_SEQ_03: Barryn thanks you, and emboldened, you ask about the goobbue. The Calamity has driven from their homes men and beasts alike, and Barryn broods that before long, few may be spared the fate of exile.
TEXT_GAIUSB506_00875_SEQ_00: There is an air of mystery about Brother Barryn. He would bid you help him with a gift.
TEXT_GAIUSB506_00875_SEQ_01: Barryn's heart is true and swift. Desiring to repay Father Iliud for his kindness, he has saved his gil─and, finding it wanting, enlisted your help. Your task is to raise more funds from both Brother Esmour within the church and Sister Zozoru at Camp Drybone.
TEXT_GAIUSB506_00875_SEQ_02: You receive a sack of gil each from Esmour and Zozoru without a single word of persuasion crossing your lips. In truth, you are slightly piqued, for you had taken some pains to prepare your cajolery. Give the sacks to Ermegarde.
TEXT_GAIUSB506_00875_SEQ_03: The gift is ready, made by Ermegarde's capable hands. Take the cinnamon cookies to Father Iliud at the Church of Saint Adama Landama.
TEXT_GAIUSB506_00875_SEQ_04: You present the cookies to a visibly moved Father Iliud. You can now return to Brother Barryn with the satisfaction of a job well done.
TEXT_GAIUSB506_00875_SEQ_05: You wonder anew at how few the Calamity left untouched. Ever has it been the lot of an obliging stranger to hear confidences from the low and the high, the guarded and the eager. Embrace your destiny.
TEXT_GAIUSB510_00879_SEQ_00: Fuandrec is a breath of fresh air in this house of tears and melancholy─very angry air. She needs you to find someone, and quick.
TEXT_GAIUSB510_00879_SEQ_01: Fuandrec's feckless cousin is late for a burial, not the first time he has failed to mark the time. There is naught to do but for you to look for a suitably slipshod person near Halatali.
TEXT_GAIUSB510_00879_SEQ_02: Near the ruin of training grounds, you encounter a pair of escaped Coliseum soulkin about to slice a wayfarer to pieces. Rather than wax philosophical, you dispatch the doctores and save Fuandrec's cousin. Report the happy news to her.
TEXT_GAIUSB510_00879_SEQ_03: You speak with Fuandrec and tactfully leave out her cousin's mention of her “overtight” corset lacing. However, judging from Fuandrec's own barbs, they are a two of a kind.
TEXT_GAIUSB511_00880_SEQ_00: Dedeju needs your help to mend a humble linen vestment.
TEXT_GAIUSB511_00880_SEQ_01: Dedeju, a weaver working from out of the Church of Saint Adama Landama, has been given the task of mending a vestment for Father Iliud. Alas, there is more wear on the vestment than Dedeju has cloth. Sharp as a needle and sure as a backstitch, she orders you to Black Brush Station in central Thanalan to pick up well-worn linen from a trusted merchant.
TEXT_GAIUSB511_00880_SEQ_02: The merchant gives you the linen as well as a brief foray into the curious art of mending. Deliver the cloth to Dedeju and see what else you can learn.
TEXT_GAIUSB511_00880_SEQ_03: Dedeju takes the cloth with words of thanks. As her clever fingers rapidly reweave the vestment, she mentions that she once repaired a charred garment thought to belong to lichkeeper Marques...
TEXT_GAIUSB603_00885_SEQ_00: Idristan is searching for an adventurer to undertake a distasteful task.
TEXT_GAIUSB603_00885_SEQ_01: You learn that voracious jackals have been spotted near Florentel's Spire. Having fled from snow-covered Coerthas, they are likely to be a danger to travelers.
