TEXT_GAIUSC801_01025_SEQ_02: Falkbryda welcomes your help, given the imminent danger of standing on the vanguard against the fearsome beast tribe.
TEXT_GAIUSC802_01026_SEQ_00: Falkbryda would like to have a word with you.
TEXT_GAIUSC802_01026_SEQ_01: Falkbryda tells you that the Sahagin have caught wind of a shipment of crystals bound for Aleport. Seek out Ururu Kogururu at Aleport, and learn how you might assist in protecting the precious crystal cargo.
TEXT_GAIUSC802_01026_SEQ_02: You have spoken with Ururu Kogururu, who bids you receive further instructions from a man named Dawson down by the pier.
TEXT_GAIUSC802_01026_SEQ_03: Dawson receives your arrival with suspicion, but he ultimately accepts your offer of aid. Pick up a box of supplies from the wharf.
TEXT_GAIUSC802_01026_SEQ_04: You have collected a box of Maelstrom supplies. Take it down to the destination on the pier.
TEXT_GAIUSC802_01026_SEQ_05: You have placed the box of Maelstrom supplies on the pier. Pick up another box of supplies.
TEXT_GAIUSC802_01026_SEQ_06: You have collected another box of Maelstrom supplies. Take it down to the destination on the pier.
TEXT_GAIUSC802_01026_SEQ_07: You have placed the box of Maelstrom supplies on the pier. Pick up the last box of supplies.
TEXT_GAIUSC802_01026_SEQ_08: You have collected the last box of Maelstrom supplies. Take it down to the destination on the pier.
TEXT_GAIUSC802_01026_SEQ_09: All the supply boxes are now where they should be. Report your success to Dawson.
TEXT_GAIUSC802_01026_SEQ_10: Thanking you for your labor, Dawson bids you return to Ururu Kogururu and inform him that your work on the pier is done.
TEXT_GAIUSC802_01026_SEQ_11: The ship will need to be loaded immediately upon arrival. If you need make any preparations, the time is now.
TEXT_GAIUSC803_01027_SEQ_00: Ururu Kogururu has tidings regarding the shipment of crystals.
TEXT_GAIUSC803_01027_SEQ_01: Ururu Kogururu informs you that the crystal-carrying ship has docked. Make your way to the pier and speak with Dawson.
TEXT_GAIUSC803_01027_SEQ_02: No sooner do you speak with Dawson than a merchant rushes up breathless with grim news that Serpent Reavers are at Aleport's gates. Dawson bids you recover the lost cargo and vanquish the Serpent Reavers.
TEXT_GAIUSC803_01027_SEQ_03: You defeated the Serpent Reavers and reclaimed the cargo. Return to the pier and report your success to Dawson.
TEXT_GAIUSC803_01027_SEQ_04: You arrive at the pier to find that the ship has sailed. It turns out that the Dawson you were dealing with was an impostor all this time. Make your way to Camp Skull Valley and inform Falkbryda that the Serpent Reavers have stolen the crystals.
TEXT_GAIUSC803_01027_SEQ_05: Now that the culprit has been identified as the dread pirate Drysnagl, there looms the daunting task of bringing the villain to justice.
TEXT_GAIUSC804_01028_SEQ_00: U'jughal needs a strong adventurer to eliminate the dread pirate Drysnagl.
TEXT_GAIUSC804_01028_SEQ_01: U'jughal wants you to hunt down Dawson's impostor, Drysnagl. Slip into the Serpent's Tongue and hunt down the dread pirate.
TEXT_GAIUSC804_01028_SEQ_02: You have delivered Drysnagl his comeuppance. Report the good news to U'jughal.
TEXT_GAIUSC804_01028_SEQ_03: U'jughal breathes easier knowing there is one less Serpent Reaver to worry about.
TEXT_GAIUSC805_01029_SEQ_00: Ahtzatrach seeks a sword hand swift and stout.
TEXT_GAIUSC805_01029_SEQ_01: Ahtzatrach hopes to chip away at the Serpent Reavers' numbers prior to battle, and asks you to slay five of their kind.
TEXT_GAIUSC805_01029_SEQ_02: You have done the deed. Report your success to Ahtzatrach.
TEXT_GAIUSC805_01029_SEQ_03: Ahtzatrach is elated that the Serpent Reavers will need to lick their wounds a bit.
TEXT_GAIUSC806_01030_SEQ_00: Eilis bears grim work for an accomplished adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSC806_01030_SEQ_01: Eilis informs you that the Sahagin are looking to launch an attack on Tidegate. Slay four of the creatures that prowl near by way of discouragement.
TEXT_GAIUSC806_01030_SEQ_02: Inform Eilis that you have delayed the advance of the Sahagin front line.
TEXT_GAIUSC806_01030_SEQ_03: Eilis will rest easier knowing you have kept her nightmare at bay.
TEXT_GAIUSC807_01031_SEQ_00: Eilis requires you to supply the lines of Tidegate.
TEXT_GAIUSC807_01031_SEQ_01: Eilis has asked you to deliver rations to the two tidegates. See one serving to the hands of Nortmoen in the north, and Sthalrhet to the south.
TEXT_GAIUSC807_01031_SEQ_02: You have delivered both servings of rations and borne witness to the sibling rivalry forewarned. Notify Eilis that the provisions have reached their destinations.
TEXT_GAIUSC807_01031_SEQ_03: While Eilis bemoans the brothers' bickering, she trusts the pair will work in lockstep when war comes to the wall.
TEXT_GAIUSC808_01032_SEQ_00: Eilis would call you to the wall once more.
TEXT_GAIUSC808_01032_SEQ_01: Eilis has briefed you on the need to divert Sahagin forces away from South Tidegate. Speak with Nortmoen about the tactical situation.
TEXT_GAIUSC808_01032_SEQ_02: Nortmoen outlines a simple plan: slay a pair of trenchtooth Sahagin.
TEXT_GAIUSC808_01032_SEQ_03: Apprise Eilis of the situation in the north.
TEXT_GAIUSC808_01032_SEQ_04: Eilis reports that the decoy attack was a success, and that the detachment returned safely through the southern gates without ado.
TEXT_GAIUSC809_01033_SEQ_00: Nortmoen would like to enlist your help in order to boost his troops' morale.
TEXT_GAIUSC809_01033_SEQ_01: Wanting to boost his troops' morale, Nortmoen asks that you bring back scintillating sea wasp umbrellas.
TEXT_GAIUSC809_01033_SEQ_02: You have procured the requested number of sea wasp umbrellas. Deliver them to Nortmoen.
TEXT_GAIUSC809_01033_SEQ_03: Nortmoen grows uncharacteristically giddy at the sight of the umbrellas, reveling in schadenfreude at the thought of his brother's potential jealousy.
TEXT_GAIUSC810_01034_SEQ_00: Sthalrhet hopes to send you out on a hunt.
TEXT_GAIUSC810_01034_SEQ_01: Sthalrhet asks you to eradicate sea wasps so that his brother will not have the opportunity to delight in them.
TEXT_GAIUSC810_01034_SEQ_02: Deliver the sea wasps you have culled to Sthalrhet.
TEXT_GAIUSC810_01034_SEQ_03: Sthalrhet savors his brother's misfortune, and is happy to give the sea wasps to anyone who is not Nortmoen.
TEXT_GAIUSC811_01035_SEQ_00: Falkbryda would summon you to action.
TEXT_GAIUSC811_01035_SEQ_01: Falkbryda asks you to infiltrate the Serpent's Tongue and use makeshift bombs to destroy the crystals, so that the Sahagin will have no means by which to summon Leviathan.
TEXT_GAIUSC811_01035_SEQ_02: You have blown the crystals into a thousand thousand fragments. Report your success to Falkbryda.
TEXT_GAIUSC811_01035_SEQ_03: Falkbryda thanks you for your part in preserving the peace. Let Radolf know that the Sahagin advance has been halted.
TEXT_GAIUSC811_01035_SEQ_04: Now that the Sahagin menace has abated, the Scions may seek to remedy the other maladies of the realm.
TEXT_GAIUSC903_01038_SEQ_00: Rafold needs a warden to stand watch.
TEXT_GAIUSC903_01038_SEQ_01: The garrison at Camp Bluefog has need of extra eyes to watch the Garleans to the north. Stand sentry at the three points where the standard of the Immortal Flames flies.
TEXT_GAIUSC903_01038_SEQ_02: You have stood vigil at the three locations. Return to Rafold and report on your findings.
TEXT_GAIUSC903_01038_SEQ_03: Rafold is relieved to hear no Garleans were found, but knows the enemy stands poised to strike as soon as the watchman blinks.
TEXT_GAIUSC905_01040_SEQ_00: Spiraling Path needs you to journey down the road.
TEXT_GAIUSC905_01040_SEQ_01: A covert supply troupe disguised as miners has left without a crate of scimitars. Spiraling Path bids you see the blades safely to their hands.
TEXT_GAIUSC905_01040_SEQ_02: Dodoroba thanks you for bringing the crate of scimitars. Return to Camp Bluefog and inform Spiraling Path of your success.
TEXT_GAIUSC905_01040_SEQ_03: The weapons are bound for where they are most needed, and with an adventurer assisting in their delivery, the Garleans will be none the wiser.
TEXT_GAIUSC906_01041_SEQ_00: Rafold hopes to turn a curse into a cure.
TEXT_GAIUSC906_01041_SEQ_01: Rafold has asked you to harvest a grenade claw. Lie in ambush at Dalamud's Talons for a grenade, and slay the creature for its appendage.
TEXT_GAIUSC906_01041_SEQ_02: You have obtained a grenade claw. Deliver it to Memezofu at the Ceruleum Processing Plant.
TEXT_GAIUSC906_01041_SEQ_03: Memezofu is thankful for your delivery, as he had just exhausted his supply of grenade claws.
TEXT_GAIUSC909_01044_SEQ_00: Memezofu has been hard at work making potions, and needs them delivered to those in need.
TEXT_GAIUSC909_01044_SEQ_01: Skirmishes with Garlean forces grow more frequent by the day. Memezofu has created a batch of potion cocktails, and bids you administer them to the wounded soldiers at Raubahn's Push.
TEXT_GAIUSC909_01044_SEQ_02: The wounded will live to fight another day. Apprise Memezofu of the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSC909_01044_SEQ_03: Memezofu reveals that he once fought on the front lines, explaining his passion for potions.
TEXT_GAIUSC910_01045_SEQ_00: Memezofu is once again in dire need of reagents.
TEXT_GAIUSC910_01045_SEQ_01: Memezofu requires a pair of ahriman corneas to continue making medicine. Slay ahrimans to procure the reagent.
TEXT_GAIUSC910_01045_SEQ_02: You now have two ahriman corneas. See them to Memezofu's hands.
TEXT_GAIUSC910_01045_SEQ_03: Memezofu remarks that it takes only a bit of the reagent to cure a great many wounds, but the alchemist is fully aware that an onze of prevention is worth a ponze of cure.
TEXT_SUBFST900_01135_SEQ_00: Nedrick Ironheart has information that is certain to set your heart to racing.
TEXT_SUBFST900_01135_SEQ_01: Sensing that you may be wanting for stimulation, Nedrick Ironheart tells you of Amdapor Keep, a ruined fortress situated in the South Shroud. If you would walk its halls and delve into the past, speak with Maxinne, the Wood Wailer who stands guard at the entrance.
TEXT_SUBFST900_01135_SEQ_02:
You learn that Amdapor Keep is overrun with the Lambs of Dalamud and the voidsent they have taken to summoning. Satisfied that you will hold your own against such foes, Maxinne grants you permission to enter.

※Amdapor Keep can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_JOBREL005_01140_SEQ_00: Ealdwine, treasure hunter extraordinaire, appears somewhat out of sorts.
TEXT_JOBREL005_01140_SEQ_01: Through slurred speech, Ealdwine kindly offers to give you his last mysterious map, before remembering that he isn't at liberty to do so; instead, he bids you deliver it to his mother at Revenant's Toll. See the map safely to Brangwine, lest poor Ealdwine be on the receiving end of a bloody flogging.
TEXT_JOBREL005_01140_SEQ_02: Brangwine informs you that mysterious maps work like a charm on kitchen stains, and expresses her willingness to part with some from her stores. To be king of your kitchen, you must bring her the object of her morbid desires.
TEXT_JOBREL006_01141_SEQ_00: Brangwine wants to confirm your interest in one of her mysterious maps.
TEXT_JOBREL006_01141_SEQ_01:
Brangwine is willing to give you a mysterious map in exchange for essentially robbing the dead. Though you cannot help but be suspicious as to her motivation, you must do as bid if you would be king of your kitchen. The personal effects of your slain peers are likely to be found where the deadliest creatures in the land prowl.

※The key item can be obtained by clearing a dungeon via Duty Roulette: High-level Dungeons.
TEXT_JOBREL006_01141_SEQ_02: You have acquired a sack bearing the personal effects of some hapless adventurer. Return to Revenant's Toll and present it to Brangwine.
TEXT_JOBREL006_01141_SEQ_03:
You hand over the sack of adventurer's effects to Brangwine, and for your troubles receive a mysterious map. Now you, too, can be king of your kitchen...if indeed that is your heart's desire.

※This repeatable quest can be undertaken once daily. Upon completing the quest, it will become available again the following day at   (Earth time).
TEXT_SUBSEA151_01142_SEQ_00: Private S'nairoh needs your help in the defense of Aleport.
TEXT_SUBSEA151_01142_SEQ_01: There is a first time for everything, and alas for S'nairoh, her first taste of war comes when she has naught but a passing adventurer to serve as her shield. You are charged with slaying five puk hatchlings while she arms the cannon.
TEXT_SUBSEA151_01142_SEQ_02: The hapless puks lie vanquished upon the ground, dead only hours after leaving the nest. It seems there are novices on either side of the ramparts today, for you found the victory all too easy. Report to S'nairoh.
TEXT_SUBSEA151_01142_SEQ_03: The critters prove not to have been a threat to Aleport. Spilling innocent blood─albeit beastly blood─is becoming something of an occupational hazard for you.
TEXT_SUBSEA152_01143_SEQ_00: Storm Private S'nairoh smells of salt, malt, and bad ideas, and appears intent on securing your services again.
TEXT_SUBSEA152_01143_SEQ_01: Despite your misgivings, you accept a task from S'nairoh. Leave her to her dubious schemes, and slay five hedgemoles.
TEXT_SUBSEA152_01143_SEQ_02: With the grace of the Twelve, you prevailed against these mostly harmless creatures. Report the happy news to S'nairoh.
TEXT_SUBSEA152_01143_SEQ_03: The hedgemoles had no designs on Aleport. They must be commended for fighting so bravely for their lives. Not all is lost, since the good private will now spend her diminished coin on leeches rather than ale.
TEXT_SUBSEA153_01144_SEQ_00: A wan and listless S'nairoh has for you a new request, the first that does not involve slaying half a dozen beasts.
TEXT_SUBSEA153_01144_SEQ_01: After the fireworks comes paperwork. S'nairoh has completed a report on the sordid incident of the hedgemoles. It falls upon you to deliver it to Commander Falkbryda at Camp Skull Valley.
TEXT_SUBSEA153_01144_SEQ_02: The report is safely in the hands of Commander Falkbryda, whose steel-grey eyes appear to miss very little of the goings-on in Aleport. The docked pay and the hard words will, you hope, prompt S'nairoh to mend her ways.
TEXT_SUBSEA154_01145_SEQ_00: , and Ahldfoet the sailor is in a mood to yarn.
TEXT_SUBSEA154_01145_SEQ_01: Ahldfoet has a slightly grisly request, though you are now an old hand at dismemberment. Hunt dusk bats and collect from them five wings.
TEXT_SUBSEA154_01145_SEQ_02: You have liberated the wings from less-than-cooperative dusk bats. Deliver the leathery trophies to Ahldfoet.
TEXT_SUBSEA154_01145_SEQ_03: The talismans tucked away in his cavernous pocket, Ahldfoet finally gives free rein to his tongue. While you itch to hear more of this tale, it seems clear that for now, the teller is content to let it lie.
TEXT_SUBSEA155_01146_SEQ_00: The bashful air ill suits a Roegadyn but Ahldfoet has it nevertheless, wearing the sheepishness like an incommodious singlet.
TEXT_SUBSEA155_01146_SEQ_01: Ahldfoet has promised a favor to a mother he met at a port of call, one whose entreaties seem to stir the poet in him. Take her letter to Wiltswys at Camp Skull Valley.
TEXT_SUBSEA155_01146_SEQ_02: Expecting a heartwarming scene, you hand Wiltswys the letter from her mother. Alas, you are sent away with a flea in your ear instead. Ah, family matters.
TEXT_SUBSEA161_01147_SEQ_00: Commander Falkbryda has a task for you, it seems. It is gratifying to know that at least one person in the encampment welcomes your presence.
TEXT_SUBSEA161_01147_SEQ_01: A bird in hand may be worth two in the bush, but the surfeit of nesting dodos draws predators to the camp. You are bid to remove the nest and smite any dodos that object.
TEXT_SUBSEA161_01147_SEQ_02: The nest is now but a memory. Deliver word of your success to Falkbryda.
TEXT_SUBSEA161_01147_SEQ_03: Falkbryda commends you on your speed, and proceeds to thank you with a tale of her encampment. Something tells you that there is still work to be done here.
TEXT_SUBSEA162_01148_SEQ_00: It is a cool and collected Sergeant Wiltswys who seeks an obliger today, rather than the heartsore fire-eater of the other day.
TEXT_SUBSEA162_01148_SEQ_01: Wiltswys's meticulous scrutiny has discovered an unacceptable shortfall in the poison cabinet. Whilst she checks the other deadly yet life-saving items in the camp's inventory, you have a task to perform: stalk the majestic Rothlyt pelicans and extract three vials' worth of poison.
TEXT_SUBSEA162_01148_SEQ_02: Exactly where the poison is secreted is a matter too discomfiting to discuss. It must suffice to say that the pelicans did not survive your exertions. Return to Wiltswys and give her the pelican poison.
TEXT_SUBSEA162_01148_SEQ_03: It seems that the way to Sergeant Wiltswys's heart is through a job well done. Listening to her tale of the Sahagin and the lost settlement, you see that she has no home but this vale and no family but the Maelstrom─and she will fight to the death to defend both...
TEXT_SUBSEA163_01149_SEQ_00: Quite thawed towards you after a wintry start, Wiltswys is practically humming as she devises a new task for you to undertake.
TEXT_SUBSEA163_01149_SEQ_01: Wiltswys has a mind to send a bottle of lowland wine each to the captains of the two tidegates. First, take the wine to Captain Sthalrhet at South Tidegate.
TEXT_SUBSEA163_01149_SEQ_02: You deliver the wine and note the gratified, if slightly ribald, response. Which part to report to Wiltswys is yours to decide.
TEXT_SUBSEA163_01149_SEQ_03: Wiltswys bids you take the second bottle to Captain Nortmoen, brother to Sthalrhet. Deliver the wine to the good captain at North Tidegate.
TEXT_SUBSEA163_01149_SEQ_04: Captain Nortmoen is taken with Wiltswys's choice of the vintage, until the alchemy of sibling rivalry transmutes the mild approval into love that pits brother against brother. How will the capable Wiltswys handle the logistics of this bizarre triangle?
TEXT_SUBSEA164_01150_SEQ_00: Learned men write that he who is wroth feels not the , and Alyrloef certainly seems insensible to all but his pressing need for your service.
TEXT_SUBSEA164_01150_SEQ_01: Sergeant Roehanth's presence is missed at Tidegate, and Alyrloef bids you hurry to the Founder's Crypt to find him. Speak to Roehanth, but remember that one disturbs a man at his devotions at one's own peril.
TEXT_SUBSEA164_01150_SEQ_02: Fortunately, you catch Roehanth at the end of his orisons, and the sight of the flowers in your hands disposes him favorably towards you. Place the spring stars on the grave.
TEXT_SUBSEA164_01150_SEQ_03: The clean scent of spring stars lifts the gloom of this lonely place, and Roehanth's aspect loses much of that brooding look. There is a tale that brings the rough Roegadyn soldier to his knees thus, one you may learn yet by speaking to him.
TEXT_SUBSEA164_01150_SEQ_04: Before Roehanth, a headstone. Under the stone, a settler named Aerghaemr who breathed his last not on his farm, but holding a trail against the Sahagin as his comrades made their escape. Such is the man that this sergeant and former corsair has chosen as his lodestar.
TEXT_SUBSEA165_01151_SEQ_00: Sergeant Roehanth has the cross-eyed look of a man threading a needle, and none can doubt that you are the stitch in time that saves nine.
TEXT_SUBSEA165_01151_SEQ_01: Killer mantises have spawned near the Founder's Crypt, and despite the Maelstrom's best efforts, several still roam free. You are bid to slay the remaining four.
TEXT_SUBSEA165_01151_SEQ_02: The last of the mantises are dead. One hopes they did not leave an egg sac or two behind. Make your report to Sergeant Roehanth.
TEXT_SUBSEA165_01151_SEQ_03: The dead may sleep without hearing the scrape of gristly scythe. Sergeant Roehanth is pleased. This task being Maelstrom business, you must take yourself to Commander Falkbryda at Camp Skull Valley for your pay.
TEXT_SUBSEA165_01151_SEQ_04: You report the destruction of the mantises to Commander Falkbryda, who appears to see new value in having an adventurer undertake such missions. A job well done is often a prelude to another.
TEXT_SUBSEA166_01152_SEQ_00: When the commander of Skull Valley herself wants a word with a humble adventurer before  takes to the road, all indications are that something unusual is afoot.
TEXT_SUBSEA166_01152_SEQ_01: Commander Falkbryda is a happy woman, for Maelstrom Command has relieved her men of investigating the Sastasha Seagrot. Of course, what she learned this morn, you knew some time ago for the replacement is none other than yourself. You must now find Sergeant Catguistl near the cave and relieve him.
TEXT_SUBSEA166_01152_SEQ_02: Your conversation with Catguistl has left you if not apprehensive, then certainly contemplative of entering the Seagrot.
TEXT_SUBFST911_01162_SEQ_00: Docette appears to have caught scent of something.
TEXT_SUBFST911_01162_SEQ_01: Having correctly guessed that you have your own chocobo, Docette suggests that you seek the counsel of Luquelot on how to attain even greater affinity with your trusty steed. Take yourself to Bentbranch Meadows and speak with the Ishgardian native.
TEXT_SUBFST911_01162_SEQ_02: Satisfied that you will not mistreat your bird, Luquelot agrees to help you train it in the ways of combat. To begin, he bids you bring him a fresh bunch of gysahl greens from the nearby field.
TEXT_SUBFST911_01162_SEQ_03: You have picked a fresh bunch of gysahl greens. Deliver it to Luquelot.
TEXT_SUBFST911_01162_SEQ_04: Luquelot explains to you the basics of fighting with your chocobo at your side. To put theory into practice, he bids you make your way to Sorrel Haven, and there put down three brood ziz with the aid of your feathered companion.
TEXT_SUBFST911_01162_SEQ_05: You have dispatched three brood ziz. Report your success to Luquelot.
TEXT_SUBFST911_01162_SEQ_06: There are numerous ways in which you and your companion can complement each other in battle. Experiment, and find the approach that serves you best.
TEXT_CHRHDB101_01204_SEQ_00: An old acquaintance of Wymond is at wit's end, and the businessman would have you help her.
TEXT_CHRHDB101_01204_SEQ_01: Nashu, former assistant of the late inspector Hildibrand, is investigating rumors regarding unusual zombie behavior. However, she has made little progress thus far, and so Wymond has asked you to seek her out and offer whatever assistance you can. Considering her recent frustrations, Wymond suspects that Nashu can be found praying at the grave of her mentor in Camp Drybone's lichyard.
TEXT_CHRHDB101_01204_SEQ_02: After waiting five years for her mentor to return, Nashu was devastated by the revelation that Inspector Hildibrand did not survive his journey to Dalamud. She then swore to carry on his legacy as an inspector herself, but has struggled to live up to his example. Her current investigation into a horde of dapper zombies had reached a standstill; however, with your help, she believes she might finally locate the zombies' leader. Travel to southern Thanalan and attempt to befriend any dapper zombies you encounter, or─failing that─slay and search them for clues.
TEXT_CHRHDB101_01204_SEQ_03: Your attempts to befriend the zombie populace met with dismal failure. However, your efforts were not for naught, as a curious parchment found in their possession appears to be a map of some sort. Return to the lichyard in eastern Thanalan and show the parchment to Nashu.
TEXT_CHRHDB101_01204_SEQ_04: Nashu confirms your suspicions that the parchment is a map, though she is unable to determine the significance of the phrase, “A gentleman is, rather than does.” In any case, she bids you follow her to the Sagolii Desert in southern Thanalan, to the destination marked on the map.
TEXT_CHRHDB101_01204_SEQ_05: Deducing that the phrase is a password, you call out to the dapper zombies, who surround you and Nashu with malicious intent. Fortunately, before you are forced to defend yourselves, a disheveled Inspector Hildibrand appears and commands his loyal minions to spare you and Nashu. The reunion between mentor and assistant nearly ends in tragedy, as Nashu resolves to restore Inspector Hildibrand's lost memories via liberal use of explosives. Inexplicably, her plan works. Afterwards, you use the power of the Echo to delve into Inspector Hildibrand's memories in a vain attempt to learn how he survived his fall, as well as being buried alive. Alas, you soon discover that there are mysteries in this world that defy all reason and explanation.
TEXT_CHRHDB102_01205_SEQ_00: A mild concussion will not sway Inspector Hildibrand from his true calling.
TEXT_CHRHDB102_01205_SEQ_01: Eager to resume his activities as an agent of enquiry, Inspector Hildibrand departs for Ul'dah in search of a new case. Though you would be entirely justified in leaving him to his own devices, it would be understandable if curiosity compelled you to do otherwise. Consider questioning the residents of Ul'dah for any information regarding the inspector's activities or recent incidents which may draw his attention.
TEXT_CHRHDB102_01205_SEQ_02: Although Inspector Hildibrand has been sighted in the city, the more popular topic of discussion in recent days is a marauding duelist who claims the weapons of his defeated opponents. Having exhausted free sources of information, go and see what Wymond will be willing to part with for a price.
TEXT_CHRHDB102_01205_SEQ_03: Your conversation with the consummate businessman is interrupted by the arrival of Inspector Hildibrand and Nashu. After recovering from the shock of seeing the man he thought dead alive, Wymond presses the inspector to explain his inconceivable resurrection. Brushing aside his inquiries, Inspector Hildibrand proclaims his desire to catch the thieving duelist, persuading Wymond to part with information regarding an incident which may be related. However, before Wymond can divulge the name of the victim, Inspector Hildibrand and his assistant abruptly depart, leaving you alone with Wymond and his exasperation.
TEXT_CHRHDB103_01206_SEQ_00: Wymond believes it would be best if you assisted Inspector Hildibrand with his investigation.
TEXT_CHRHDB103_01206_SEQ_01: According to Wymond, the victim Inspector Hildibrand seeks is a wealthy woman named Yellow Moon. Given her taste for the finer things in life, she can often be found in the Weavers' Guild, being fitted for a new garment. Go and speak with Yellow Moon─with luck, Inspector Hildibrand will not be far behind.
TEXT_CHRHDB103_01206_SEQ_02: Serendipitously, Inspector Hildibrand and Nashu arrive at the Weavers' Guild shortly after you, and together you all learn that Yellow Moon's Pure Heart is but one of several items that have been stolen. Unable to determine precisely when and where the perpetrator struck, Inspector Hildibrand proposes that you retrace Yellow Moon's path on the day of the theft. To that end, speak with him outside the Sunsilk Tapestries shop on the Steps of Nald.
TEXT_CHRHDB103_01206_SEQ_03: Other than a bizarre incident in which a complete stranger professed his undying love to her, Yellow Moon can recall nothing of note. Proceed to the Coliseum entrance next and see what the wealthy woman remembers.
TEXT_CHRHDB103_01206_SEQ_04: Other than yet another incident in which a complete stranger professed his undying love to her, Yellow Moon states that nothing out of the ordinary occurred. However, her testimony serves to spark something within Inspector Hildibrand, who demands to be left alone whilst he marshals his mental faculties. Respect his wishes and instead speak with Nashu, who appears to be contemplating the three large crates nearby.
TEXT_CHRHDB103_01206_SEQ_05: Nashu is overcome with an unbearable desire to learn the contents of the crates. Unable to discern a simple means of opening them, she proposes destroying them with makeshift explosives of her own design, and even offers to let you do the honors. Though such a reckless and dangerous act is wholly unjustified, she will almost certainly take matters into her own hands if you refuse...
TEXT_CHRHDB103_01206_SEQ_06: Naught remains of the crates save for their contents: three sweltering, terrified men wearing yellow robes, and Yellow Moon's Pure Heart. It would be prudent to bring this to Inspector Hildibrand's attention.
TEXT_CHRHDB103_01206_SEQ_07: The three men assert that they have followed Yellow Moon only out of a desire to keep her safe, and that the numerous items they stole were instead being kept for safekeeping. This explanation fails to satisfy the enraged woman, who attempts to seize the deviants as they flee for their lives. Inspector Hildibrand congratulates himself on a job well done, and begins to explain how the three men were also responsible for the weapon thefts─only to be corrected by Ellie, a reporter for the Mythril Eye, who reminds Inspector Hildibrand that the thief was also a duelist who defeated his victims in single combat. The reporter then offers to divulge the identity of one such victim, for which the inspector is tremendously grateful. However, as before, he neglects to linger long enough to receive the promised information, leaving you alone with Ellie and her exasperation.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_00: Having no other recourse, Ellie would instead tell you the identity of the victim.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_01: Judging you to be a friend of Inspector Hildibrand, Ellie elects to share the identity of the weapon thief's victim with you. She mentions in passing that the man is also guilty of a crime, though she does not say what─only that she is curious how the inspector will act when he learns of this fact. For now, seek out the adventurer named Humphrey at the Golden Bazaar, and pray that Inspector Hildibrand somehow finds his way to you.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_02: As usual, Inspector Hildibrand and Nashu arrive at the precise moment you locate Humphrey. To everyone's surprise, the self-proclaimed Warrior of Light claims to have defeated the duelist. His story is quickly disproven by an elderly man named Eleazar, who accuses Humphrey of surrendering an ancient sword he had been asked to deliver to a blacksmith for restoration. His bravado dispelled, Humphrey confesses to the crime and begs the assistance of Inspector Hildibrand. Although Ellie implores him to ignore the boy's pleas, the inspector agrees to help for Eleazar's sake. Assist Inspector Hildibrand by speaking with the residents of the Golden Bazaar.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_03: During the course of your investigation, you learn that Eleazar's sword was an authentic relic, and that many collectors have been fooled by well-crafted imitations. Such a rare weapon would be coveted by many, and it may have been sold for profit. Speak with Jojonpa the traveling merchant to see if he has seen or heard of the blade in question.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_04: Although Jojonpa has no knowledge of an ancient sword, he may have recently disposed of an imitation similar in design to Eleazar's treasured blade. Though it pains him to do so, Inspector Hildibrand proposes furnishing Eleazar with this counterfeit weapon for the time being, so that the elderly man might rest easy while the inspector continues to search for the genuine article. Travel to the spring east of Camp Drybone and ask Hildibrand how you might assist with the search for Jojonpa's discarded sword.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_05: Inspector Hildibrand is hesitant to enter the spring due to his accumulated injuries, which he fears may become infected unless first treated with salamander oil. Fortunately, he has an ample supply of the oil; unfortunately, he cannot apply it himself. Pour the salamander oil on Inspector Hildibrand, and remember that generosity is a virtue.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_06: You may as well finish what you started. Knead the oil into Inspector Hildibrand's weary flesh. This too is a virtue, though one less well defined.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_07: You forget your own strength, and bring the inspector to his knees in agony. Resume your duties with greater care.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_08: Inspector Hildibrand is responding to your ministrations in unexpected ways. Dwell not on his words and press onward, harder and faster.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_09: Keep going. You know what to do.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_10: A sublime golden glow now radiates from the body of Inspector Hildibrand, who fearlessly strides into the spring to search for the sword. Contribute to the effort by collecting anything of marginal interest.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_11: You have gathered three random items which are clearly not the sword you seek. Nevertheless, they should serve as proof of your efforts to Inspector Hildibrand.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_12: The imitation sword is finally discovered by Nashu, who trips over the blade during her search. Inspector Hildibrand begins to congratulate himself on a job well done, only to interrupt himself with a mighty sneeze. Observing that the inspector is in dire need of new clothes, Nashu departs for Ul'dah to purchase garments for Inspector Hildibrand, as well as a supply of hair tonic for Eleazar. With sword in hand, the inspector returns to the Golden Bazaar, bidding you to follow.
TEXT_CHRHDB104_01207_SEQ_13: Inspector Hildibrand's deception proves flawless, as Eleazar declares the sword to be exactly as he remembers. Mere moments after the inspector presents the imitation blade to the elderly man, Nashu arrives bearing clothes for Inspector Hildibrand and a supply of hair tonic for Eleazar. The matters at hand seemingly resolved, you begin to relax─only to whirl about in time to dodge a flying card, which embeds itself in the inspector's forehead. Upon the card is writ a challenge from the duelist: “I shall come to claim the collector's blade.” Inspector Hildibrand accepts, of course, with requisite grace and style, evoking a variety of reactions from all present. The self-proclaimed agent of enquiry will doubtless do his utmost to catch the duelist, but whether or not he will succeed is another question entirely...
TEXT_SUBCTS001_01208_SEQ_00: Diamanda's hands are idle, though by no fault of her own.
TEXT_SUBCTS001_01208_SEQ_01: The smith Diamanda has been dispatched to Pharos Sirius to assist in the restoration effort, only to find the lighthouse infested by a siren and her fell minions. Seek further information about this troubling turn of events from the foreman Mimidoa, who bides his time in Aleport.
TEXT_SUBCTS001_01208_SEQ_02: Master Mimidoa confirms the dire tidings and implores you to silence the siren's song, that he and his apprentice may get on with their work. Make for Pharos Sirius and speak with Davyd, a guard posted outside.
TEXT_SUBCTS001_01208_SEQ_03:
Heartened by your arrival, Davyd advises you to enter Pharos Sirius via the flood cellar so as to catch your foe off guard. Rid the lighthouse of the siren and her thralls so that the restoration effort might commence in earnest.

※Pharos Sirius can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_SUBCTS002_01209_SEQ_00: Diamanda would hear tidings of your battle with the siren.
TEXT_SUBCTS002_01209_SEQ_01: Diamanda is overjoyed to hear of your triumph over the siren, the brave deed having served to avenge her father and clear the way for the long-overdue restoration of Pharos Sirius. She urges you to convey the good news to Master Mimidoa in Aleport, that the two might commence their work.
TEXT_SUBCTS002_01209_SEQ_02: Good tidings were met with grim revelations, as Master Mimidoa revealed that the crew of undead seamen in the siren's thrall were none other than the wretched remains of Diamanda's beloved brother and his loyal mates. In hearing the painful truth from her master's mouth, the young smith is finally able to come to terms with that which she had long since suspected, and she resolves to devote herself to the restoration effort to honor the memory of her family.
TEXT_SUBCTS801_01210_SEQ_00: Rumors of a dangerous madman about town have S'dhodjbi ill at ease.
TEXT_SUBCTS801_01210_SEQ_01: S'dhodjbi speaks of fearsome rumors of the Slasher of Fisherman's Bottom, a knife-wielding lunatic who has the Lominsan populace in a panic. Impressed by your calm demeanor amidst the madness, she encourages you to investigate a scream she heard coming from the direction of the Hyaline.
TEXT_SUBCTS801_01210_SEQ_02: You have rushed to the scene of the cry to find a woman trembling in fear. The cultured madam insists that the man before her is none other than the Slasher, and encourages you to apprehend him before he claims any more victims. Express your /doubt as to the man's intentions.
TEXT_SUBCTS801_01210_SEQ_03: The madman insists that he has been misunderstood, and that the loss of the “very appendages of his soul” is responsible for his delirious state. Imploring you for aid, he asks you to seek out three influential acquaintances of his─Guildmasters H'naanza of the Armorers' Guild in Limsa Lominsa, Beatin of the Carpenters' Guild in Gridania, and Severian of the Alchemists' Guild in Ul'dah─before the inexplicable ailment he suffers from claims his very life.
TEXT_SUBCTS801_01210_SEQ_04: You have traversed the realm and spoken with the three guildmasters, each of whom entrusted you with a package for Jandelaine. Deliver them to the stricken man in hopes that, whatever the contents might be, they will cure him of his affliction.
TEXT_SUBCTS801_01210_SEQ_05:
Jandelaine, shunned as a dangerous madman, is revealed to be none other than the eagerly anticipated aesthetician, undergoing a remarkable transformation upon taking into hand the tools of his trade. Profusely grateful for your kindness in his hour of need, he offers you unlimited access to his services, with no need for reservation.

※Ring the crystal bell in any inn room to summon the aesthetician.
※If you opt to pay with Jandelaine's token, your service will be rendered free of charge.
TEXT_SUBCTS802_01211_SEQ_00: H'loonh would entice you with the prospect of untold riches.
TEXT_SUBCTS802_01211_SEQ_01: H'loonh regales you with a tale of buried treasure, as recounted to her by a half-wit drunkard at the local alehouse. With hopes high, set off in pursuit of her eminently reliable informant, said to be visiting a miner acquaintance in Raincatcher Gully.
TEXT_SUBCTS802_01211_SEQ_02: The miner puts little stock in the tall tales of his drinking companion, strongly advising you against chasing after apocryphal fortunes. Should you choose to ignore his warning, you may find the would-be treasure hunter Ealdwine where X marks the spot to the southeast of Camp Bronze Lake.
TEXT_SUBCTS802_01211_SEQ_03: Self-styled treasure hunter Ealdwine reeks heavily of his namesake and has likely not seen a bath in several moons. He invites you─for better or for worse─to open, in his stead, an unearthed casket, which he absolutely, positively, beyond-a-shadow-of-a-doubt assures you is not trapped.
TEXT_SUBCTS802_01211_SEQ_04: In an entirely unexpected turn of events, the chest was indeed trapped. Having dispatched the nasty critters lured to the scene, you are free to inspect the chest once more and retrieve its contents.
TEXT_SUBCTS802_01211_SEQ_05: You have retrieved the treasure─if one could call it that─from the casket. Deliver the tattered coinpurse and bottle you found to Ealdwine, and let him know that the rewards were hardly worth the effort.
TEXT_SUBCTS802_01211_SEQ_06: Showing considerably more concern for his own coinpurse than your ordeal, Ealdwine nevertheless encourages you to join him in the hunt for treasure, imparting to you the skill of map-reading to serve this end. Notwithstanding the liable nature of your mentor, who is to say what treasures lie hidden across the realm? With your newfound knowledge, strike forth in search of riches and glory.
TEXT_SUBCTS803_01212_SEQ_00: Margeria has information that may interest wealthy adventurers.
TEXT_SUBCTS803_01212_SEQ_01: Rumor has it that plots within the Lavender Beds are to be auctioned off, and that even foreigners will be permitted to purchase them. Should you wish to learn more, Margeria advises you to search for a Twin Adder representative at the Mirror Planks in the Central Shroud, where the ferry to the Lavender Beds can be found.
TEXT_SUBCTS803_01212_SEQ_02: Emblyn explains that only adventurers will be permitted to settle in the Lavender Beds, as part of an initiative to encourage immigration to Gridania. Though it would require substantial funds to build and maintain an estate, she assures you that it would be well worth the expense, and encourages you to visit the Beds so that you may see the lands for yourself.
TEXT_SUBCTS803_01212_SEQ_03: As promised, the Lavender Beds exceed all expectation. To learn more about the residential area, speak with the serpent recruit stationed at the docks.
TEXT_SUBCTS803_01212_SEQ_04: Alas, the recruit confirms that Gridanian citizens are prohibited from purchasing plots in the Lavender Beds. Doubtless many adventurers will flock to the region─and many Gridanians like Margeria will envy them deeply. Perhaps it would be best if you were the one to deliver the bad news to her.
TEXT_SUBCTS803_01212_SEQ_05: Margeria is understandably disappointed that she cannot participate in the land auctions, though she is aware that in these troubled times Gridania must rely on adventurers more than ever. Should you share her dream of home ownership, it would behoove you to speak with the resident caretaker in the Lavender Beds to learn more.
TEXT_SUBCTS804_01213_SEQ_00: Imme has information that may interest wealthy adventurers.
TEXT_SUBCTS804_01213_SEQ_01: Rumor has it that plots within the Goblet are to be auctioned off, and that even foreigners will be permitted to purchase them. Should you wish to learn more, Imme advises you to search for an Immortal Flames representative outside the gates to the Goblet in western Thanalan.
TEXT_SUBCTS804_01213_SEQ_02: Momoraji explains that only adventurers will be permitted to settle in the Goblet, as part of an initiative to encourage their immigration to Ul'dah. Though it would require substantial funds to build and maintain an estate, he assures you that it would be well worth the expense, and encourages you to visit the Goblet so that you may see the lands for yourself.
TEXT_SUBCTS804_01213_SEQ_03: As promised, the Goblet exceeds all expectation. To learn more about the residential area, speak with the flame recruit stationed near the entrance.
TEXT_SUBCTS804_01213_SEQ_04: Alas, the recruit confirms that Ul'dahn citizens are prohibited from purchasing plots in the Goblet. Doubtless many adventurers will flock to the region─and many Ul'dahns like Imme will envy them deeply. Perhaps it would be best if you were the one to deliver the bad news to her.
TEXT_SUBCTS804_01213_SEQ_05: Imme is understandably disappointed that she cannot participate in the land auctions, though she is aware that in these troubled times Ul'dah must rely on adventurers more than ever. Should you share her dream of home ownership, it would behoove you to speak with the resident caretaker in the Goblet to learn more.
TEXT_SUBCTS805_01214_SEQ_00: Ahctkoen has information that may interest wealthy adventurers.
TEXT_SUBCTS805_01214_SEQ_01: Rumor has it that plots within Mist are to be auctioned off, and that even foreigners will be permitted to purchase them. Should you wish to learn more, Ahctkoen advises you to search for a Maelstrom representative outside the gates to Mist in lower La Noscea.
TEXT_SUBCTS805_01214_SEQ_02: Roeganlona explains that only adventurers will be permitted to settle in Mist, as part of an initiative to encourage their immigration to Limsa Lominsa. Though it would require substantial funds to build and maintain an estate, she assures you that it would be well worth the expense, and encourages you to visit Mist so that you may see the lands for yourself.
TEXT_SUBCTS805_01214_SEQ_03: As promised, Mist exceeds all expectation. To learn more about the residential area, speak with the storm recruit stationed near the entrance.
TEXT_SUBCTS805_01214_SEQ_04: Alas, the recruit confirms that Lominsan citizens are prohibited from purchasing plots in Mist. Doubtless many adventurers will flock to the region─and many Lominsans like Ahctkoen will envy them deeply. Perhaps it would be best if you were the one to deliver the bad news to him.
TEXT_SUBCTS805_01214_SEQ_05: Ahctkoen is understandably disappointed that he cannot participate in the land auctions, though he is aware that in these troubled times Limsa Lominsa must rely on adventurers more than ever. Should you share his dream of home ownership, it would behoove you to speak with the caretaker-in-residence in Mist to learn more.
TEXT_SUBCTS101_01215_SEQ_00: Lauriane of Revenant's Toll looks as if she's seen a ghost.
TEXT_SUBCTS101_01215_SEQ_01: Lauriane's words are concerning, indeed. If the stranger she encountered in Gridania is to be believed, Haukke Manor─once cleansed of its demons by your own hand─now houses newfound horrors. Seek out your old acquaintance Ursandel to the northwest of the Lancers' Guild and see if there is any substance to the rumors.
TEXT_SUBCTS101_01215_SEQ_02: A visibly shaken Ursandel confesses to you that the rumors are all too true: someone─or something─has returned to Haukke Manor, and the blood of ill-fated young maidens spills more freely than it did at the height of his lady's reign of madness. Set forth for the manor, that you might witness the horrors with your own eyes.
TEXT_SUBCTS101_01215_SEQ_03:
You have gained entrance to Haukke Manor. Lend your strength to the Wood Wailers who do battle within, and put an end to the tragic horrors of this accursed place once and for all.

※Haukke Manor (Hard) can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_SUBCTS102_01216_SEQ_00: Hugubert of Revenant's Toll has news he would share in the strictest of confidence.
TEXT_SUBCTS102_01216_SEQ_01: In hushed tones, Hugubert speaks of ill tidings from the mines of Copperbell. The fiendish hecatoncheires─believed to have been driven back to the umbral depths─have resurfaced, and many a roseate miner has paid the eternal price for returning to work too hastily. Your informant encourages you to speak to the Stone Torch posted outside the mines, located in western Thanalan, to see if aught can be done about the situation.
TEXT_SUBCTS102_01216_SEQ_02:
The proud Stone Torch grudgingly admits that hecatoncheires have returned to plague the mines and, what is more, have proven far too formidable an opponent for his vaunted unit. Indeed, the entire mining operation is at risk if this new threat is not dealt with, and swiftly. It would seem that Copperbell dost want for an adventurer's succor once more.

※Copperbell Mines (Hard) can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_SUBSEA156_01289_SEQ_00: Skribyld seeks the aid of an able-bodied adventurer.
TEXT_SUBSEA156_01289_SEQ_01: Skribyld has tasked you with investigating the trafficking of coeurls to Vylbrand. Confront R'kontai at the Aleport gates to uncover the truth behind the coeurls' aberrant migration.
TEXT_SUBSEA156_01289_SEQ_02: You have confronted R'kontai, but she flees before you can ask her any questions. Scour the docks for the merchant.
TEXT_SUBSEA156_01289_SEQ_03: You have found R'kontai at the end of the pier and trounced the bodyguard who attempted to bar your way. Speak with R'kontai once more, that she may confess the truth of the pirates' schemes.
TEXT_SUBSEA156_01289_SEQ_04: R'kontai explains that she was but another victim of the pirates, and they are to blame for the coeurls and jackals attacking one another. Report your findings to Skribyld.
TEXT_SUBSEA156_01289_SEQ_05: You have informed Skribyld of the pirates' plan to eradicate the escaped coeurls using jackals, destroying any evidence of their smuggling in the process. Skribyld believes something must be done before the people of Aleport fall prey to the beasts now roaming Vylbrand.
TEXT_SUBSEA157_01290_SEQ_00: Skribyld is ready to set his plans into motion.
TEXT_SUBSEA157_01290_SEQ_01: Skribyld believes R'kontai may be concealing more jackals for future black market sales. He has requested you speak with her to confirm his suspicions.
TEXT_SUBSEA157_01290_SEQ_02: R'kontai reveals that, although there are no longer jackals in her care, she has a wolf pup in her keeping. Fearing that the pirates will come and take him away, the remorseful merchant begs you to retrieve him. Find the wolf pup and give him a succulent bone to win his trust.
TEXT_SUBSEA157_01290_SEQ_03: The starved pup hungrily hunkers down on the bone, but still seems wary of you. Attempt to /soothe the frightened pup by rubbing his belly.
TEXT_SUBSEA157_01290_SEQ_04: You have earned the pup's trust, and he now seems willing to go with you. Make your way back to Skribyld and show him what you found.
TEXT_SUBSEA157_01290_SEQ_05: Skribyld is thrilled to hear that the pup is in good health and safe from the hands of the pirates. Seeing as the pup has grown so fond of you, Skribyld believes it best that he remains in your care.
TEXT_SUBSEA158_01291_SEQ_00: Skribyld requires assistance with an ongoing investigation.
TEXT_SUBSEA158_01291_SEQ_01: Skribyld explains to you the growing threat of coeurls still roaming the lands around Aleport. Fearful for the local populace, Skribyld feels there is no other choice but to exterminate the remaining coeurls. You are to head to Skull Valley and carry out this grievous task.
TEXT_SUBSEA158_01291_SEQ_02: You locate a coeurl, but find she has been slain by a pack of jackals, leaving behind a defenseless newborn. As you ponder what is to be done with the kitten, you are set upon by a pair of the grisly jackals. You defeat them with your usual flourish, but the question of how to care for the baby coeurl remains. Approach him with gentleness to see what comfort you might provide.
TEXT_SUBSEA158_01291_SEQ_03: To your surprise, the baby coeurl immediately warms to your presence. Take him back to Skribyld and report your findings.
TEXT_SUBSEA158_01291_SEQ_04: Although relieved to hear the coeurls running rampant in Aleport are no more, Skribyld is saddened by the loss of life and the now orphaned baby coeurl. Rather than leave him to fend for himself in the wilderness, Skribyld insists that you look after him, that he may grow to become a friend to man.
TEXT_SUBCTS901_01308_SEQ_00: Alys would like to introduce you to someone.
TEXT_SUBCTS901_01308_SEQ_01: A wandering minstrel has come to Revenant's Toll in search of inspiration─namely, tales of heroic feats and derring-do. Alys can think of no one better qualified to quench the traveler's thirst for tales, and urges you regale the minstrel with your greatest exploits.
TEXT_SUBCTS901_01308_SEQ_02:
Your words serve to satisfy the minstrel beyond measure, who at once composes a ballad of your battle with the Ultima Weapon. Alas, his penchant for exaggeration has transformed the trial into something quite unlike what you remember...

※The Minstrel's Ballad: Ultima's Bane can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_SUBCTS901_01308_SEQ_03: Using the power of your imagination, you relive the events of that fateful day in the Praetorium, as described in the minstrel's ballad. Considering how certain details differ drastically, it may behoove you to correct the minstrel's misconceptions.
TEXT_SUBCTS901_01308_SEQ_04: The minstrel makes no apologies for embellishing your tale, claiming that others would have done the same in time. A valid point, to be sure, though his artistic license will only serve to hasten the process...
TEXT_GAIUSB614_01310_SEQ_00: Torn between curiosity and scorn, Maucolyn would report an odd sighting.
TEXT_GAIUSB614_01310_SEQ_01: Maucolyn has recently observed a local trader capering in the cold, tossing snowballs in what the dour chocobokeep assumes to be a fit of hypothermic hysteria. Speak with this trader, Duvicauroix, and inquire as to his well-being.
TEXT_GAIUSB614_01310_SEQ_02: Happily, there proves to be a method to Duvicauroix's madness. The trader asserts that playing in the snow can warm the body and heart on a cold winter's day more so than even a fire, and teaches you how to /throw a snowball as the first step toward mastering this invigorating form of play...
TEXT_GAIUSB615_01311_SEQ_00: When there's more snow on the ground than hot meals on the table, all you can do is join Duvicauroix in a little snow-toss.
TEXT_GAIUSB615_01311_SEQ_01: Duvicauroix wants you to toss a snowball at him. Do as bade and /throw at the merry trader, making sure to aim first.
TEXT_GAIUSB615_01311_SEQ_02: You have learned that performing a /throw in a snowy spot lets you toss snowballs. Pleased with your zeal but disinclined to continue serving as your target, Duvicauroix suggests you seek out a snowman.
TEXT_GAIUSB615_01311_SEQ_03: You have found to your astonishment that the snowman seems hungry, but also that he refuses to eat anything that throws as weakly as you do. Prove yourself a worthy snack and /throw another snowball at him.
TEXT_GAIUSB615_01311_SEQ_04: Your second toss has done nothing to convince the frozen chatterbox. Take aim again and /throw hard to still the stream of criticism.
TEXT_GAIUSB615_01311_SEQ_05: The third toss has proven to be the charm, and the snowman is finally content with the quality of your throw. While the snowman's final warning to you is mildly unnerving, you take some comfort from the fact that no further mention was made of being eaten. Tell Duvicauroix of what has passed.
TEXT_GAIUSB615_01311_SEQ_06: Duvicauroix cheerily dismisses as a delusion your tutelage at the icy hands of a snowman. While you have no great desire to be leeched, you may want to consider some physicking if you continue hearing voices...
TEXT_CHRHDB201_01315_SEQ_00: Ellie wishes to share her latest discoveries with you.
TEXT_CHRHDB201_01315_SEQ_01:
Inspector's Log:
These tales of a thieving duelist continue to confound me! But perhaps it is to be expected─I am but recently returned to civilized, un-undead society, after all. The case of Yellow Moon's missing Pure Heart was a welcome refresher, to be sure, but my second case was a grim reminder that dubious acts are sometimes necessary to achieve a greater good. Still, I hold out hope that we may yet find Eleazar's sword in the possession of my nefarious nemesis. But how am I to catch him if I know naught of the “collector's blade” he seeks?
　　　　　　　　　　　　*　*　*
Using her skills as a reporter, Ellie has managed to identify the sword the duelist seeks: the Treaty-Blade, a weapon which was recently purchased by an Ul'dahn collector. Ellie is eager to investigate the collector, but she is also concerned that her friendly overtures may be rebuffed. A small gift might serve to pave the way─perhaps a rare flower purchased from Tutusi in Camp Drybone.
TEXT_CHRHDB201_01315_SEQ_02: While in Camp Drybone, you and Ellie observe an Elezen inspector extracting a confession from a merchant who murdered his former partner. Ellie is impressed by the man's skills as an investigator─though her mood darkens upon hearing the name of a certain other inspector. Avoid further mention of the gentleman in question and journey to Vesper Bay, where the Ul'dahn collector, Lady Durilda, resides.
TEXT_CHRHDB201_01315_SEQ_03: Lady Durilda is less than enthused with your flowers, and even further annoyed when Inspector Hildibrand and his assistant make a most inopportune appearance. It is then the agent of enquiry's turn to grow flustered when the gentleman from Camp Drybone arrives and is revealed to have been hired by Lady Durilda. Declaring that Consulting Inspector Briardien and her guardsmen can ensure the security of the Treaty-Blade, the collector demands that you all leave. However, there may be another way to earn the approval of Lady Durilda. Maria, her daughter, lost a priceless antique vase in the wilds of Thanalan, and its successful recovery may serve as sufficient proof of the inspector's investigative skills. Begin your search near Nophica's Wells.
TEXT_CHRHDB201_01315_SEQ_04: Your investigation leads you to a large, flamboyantly dressed man. At his feet lies something man-made. Perhaps it warrants a closer look.
TEXT_CHRHDB201_01315_SEQ_05: Alas, the vase is no more, having been crushed beneath the heel of the flamboyant oaf. However, Inspector Hildibrand appears to have a plan. First, you must gather the muddy potsherds.
TEXT_CHRHDB201_01315_SEQ_06: In a refreshing change of pace, the potsherds you pulled from the water were in fact the ones you sought. Present them to Inspector Hildibrand.
TEXT_CHRHDB201_01315_SEQ_07: The inspector declares that you have gathered more than enough pieces of the vase. Yet even with all the pieces, he could not possibly mean to reconstruct the vase...or could he?
TEXT_CHRHDB202_01316_SEQ_00: A shattered antique vase will not deter Inspector Hildibrand from his mission.
TEXT_CHRHDB202_01316_SEQ_01: According to Inspector Hildibrand, the vase could be reconstructed with the aid of a certain master goldsmith─a man as fearsome as he is skilled, capable of wielding his hammer as both a tool of creation and destruction. The goldsmith is like to be found in Bluefog, where he often goes to gather his materials. With the aid of your comrades─including the newly recruited Gilgamesh and his loyal companion, Enkidu─begin your search there.
TEXT_CHRHDB202_01316_SEQ_02: You find Nashu poking a dead doblyn, which was likely slain by the goldsmith given its wounds. A trail of bloody footprints leads to the north...
TEXT_CHRHDB202_01316_SEQ_03: The trail leads you to a dead basilisk, which Gilgamesh observes was slain with a single blow to the head. Fresh tracks lead to the north─and gods only know what else.
TEXT_CHRHDB202_01316_SEQ_04: At the end of the trail, you find a dead ahriman and chimera, but naught else, leading Inspector Hildibrand to conclude that the goldsmith is nearby, possibly concealing himself until the party makes its intentions known. Though it pains him greatly, the inspector proclaims that he must perform the dance of House Manderville in order to declare your peaceful intent, and begins to do so at once. Alas, a sudden injury renders him unable to continue, and, left with no other option, he bequeaths knowledge of the dance to you.
TEXT_CHRHDB203_01317_SEQ_00: The time has come for you to do what only a Manderville can.
TEXT_CHRHDB203_01317_SEQ_01: Having shared with you the secrets of House Manderville, Inspector Hildibrand now asks that you do what he cannot. Stand before the fallen chimera and dance as only a Manderville can.
TEXT_CHRHDB203_01317_SEQ_02: A half-naked Highlander answers your summons and announces himself as Godbert the goldsmith. As he ponders how you came to learn the Manderville, he and Hildibrand lock eyes momentarily, causing the inspector to inexplicably flee the scene. All is explained after Godbert catches up to Hildibrand, though, as the goldsmith proceeds to berate his son in front of all present. Brushing aside his father's legitimate complaints, Hildibrand convinces Godbert to reconstruct the shattered vase. Though the results are less than ideal, perhaps Lady Durilda will be satisfied. Return to Vesper Bay so that Maria can present the vase to her mother.
TEXT_CHRHDB203_01317_SEQ_03: Lady Durilda is dissatisfied with the vase until Godbert unexpectedly arrives and reveals that he was the one who reconstructed it. This fact, coupled with the knowledge that he, a member of the Syndicate, is also Hildibrand's father, is enough to convince the noblewoman to grant the inspector permission to assist with Briardien's investigation. Not only is Inspector Hildibrand unaware of his father's recent rise to power, he is also completely oblivious to how he personally benefited from it, as he simply states that you all must review the facts of the case with Inspector Briardien.
TEXT_CHRHDB203_01317_SEQ_04: In between sighs and shrugs, Inspector Briardien explains his plan to lure out and catch the duelist using counterfeit Treaty-Blades being transported from Coerthas. Reluctantly, he states that you and your comrades might serve as additional “smallfolk,” watching the roads in and out of the Observatorium for anything suspicious. This suggestion pleases Inspector Hildibrand, who states with confidence that the duelist should be easy to find in snowy Coerthas, given his large frame and garish red clothing─a description he subsequently misremembers when reunited with a certain warrior and his rooster.
TEXT_CHRHDB204_01318_SEQ_00: Inspector Hildibrand would have you accompany him to Coerthas.
TEXT_CHRHDB204_01318_SEQ_01: Having received the blessings of Lady Durilda and Inspector Briardien, Inspector Hildibrand wishes to depart for Coerthas at once. Journey to the Observatorium and seek out any sellswords in Lady Durilda's employ.
TEXT_CHRHDB204_01318_SEQ_02: Hildibrand quickly identifies one of Lady Durilda's sellswords, though the man is quick to deny the inspector's assertions. Inspector Briardien subsequently appears and explains the situation, much to the sergeant's chagrin. Recognizing you to be the most competent member of your party, the sergeant then asks that you assist one of his subordinates near the Observatorium's east gates.
TEXT_CHRHDB204_01318_SEQ_03: The snows of Coerthas can play tricks on one's eyes, as you soon observe. While the sellsword watchman ventures outside to investigate something suspicious, Inspector Hildibrand nearly mistakes Gilgamesh for the thieving duelist. Electing to search a different area, Hildibrand and Nashu wander off. Follow them and see if their search yields anything of interest.
TEXT_CHRHDB204_01318_SEQ_04: Ellie astutely observes that Inspector Hildibrand is unlikely to find the duelist inside the walls of the Observatorium. That being said, it would be dangerous to survey the wilderness unarmed─which is why Hildibrand is grateful when Nashu returns with a curious “spear” in her possession. The inspector immediately recognizes the weapon as the selfsame one which helped him journey to Dalamud five years ago. Precisely what inexplicable series of circumstances led to this reunion would doubtless make for an engrossing tale─alas, there are more pressing matters at hand. Survey the wilderness east of the Observatorium with the inspector and his assistant.
TEXT_CHRHDB204_01318_SEQ_05: Fate can be ever so cruel. The budding friendship between Hildibrand and Gilgamesh is torn asunder when the warrior recognizes the inspector's spear as his own cherished weapon. What small hopes for reconciliation remain are further crushed when Ellie and Inspector Briardien arrive and identify Gilgamesh as the nefarious thieving duelist─a charge the warrior both confirms and denies. Distraught at being misunderstood by those whom he had come to trust, Gilgamesh flees to the south as Hildibrand gives chase─and so must you.
TEXT_CHRHDB204_01318_SEQ_06:
Outside the gates to Griffin Crossing, you find an incapacitated Inspector Hildibrand. Imploring you to stop his misguided former friend, you begin to search the bridge, and quickly find Gilgamesh waiting for you. The warrior proposes what he deems a duel─though his terms allow for you to summon allies. Triumph, and he will yield the spear. But should you fail, your weapons will be forfeit.

※Battle on the Big Bridge can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_CHRHDB204_01318_SEQ_07: Declaring that you have received a sufficient beating, Gilgamesh withdraws without claiming your weapon. Inform Inspector Briardien of all that has transpired.
TEXT_CHRHDB204_01318_SEQ_08: Annoyed by yet resigned to Gilgamesh's escape, Inspector Briardien deems it safe to proceed with the Treaty-Blade's delivery. Proceed to Vesper Bay so that you may be present for the occasion.
TEXT_CHRHDB204_01318_SEQ_09: Lady Durilda gleefully accepts the Treaty-Blade and takes her leave─only to appear a second time inquiring as to the whereabouts of her weapon. Inspector Briardien immediately deduces that the first Lady Durilda was in fact the thief who sent the challenge in disguise, and that Gilgamesh was a different thief who had no interest in the Treaty-Blade. The flying card which then embeds itself in the inspector's forehead appears to substantiate this theory, as the words writ upon it match the style of the previous challenge. “I shall come to claim the lapis maiden's virtue,” it reads, a bold challenge Inspector Briardien is glad to accept─until Inspector Hildibrand preempts his declaration, driving his rival into a frenzy. As the two men circle Lord Lolorito's statue in the square, Maria bursts into laughter, and her normally stern mother soon does the same. Despite failing to protect the Treaty-Blade, it would seem Inspector Hildibrand achieved an arguably more worthwhile measure of success.
TEXT_SUBCTS003_01389_SEQ_00: Brother E-Sumi-Yan would like a word on behalf of a most illustrious client.
TEXT_SUBCTS003_01389_SEQ_01: The magicks entombing the Lost City of Amdapor have recently faded, and the darkness within grows restless. Brother E-Sumi-Yan would have you still its stirring, and in his subtlety, has sent you to consult with Seedseer Raya-O-Senna. Make your way to Camp Tranquil in the South Shroud, where the Padjal awaits.
TEXT_SUBCTS003_01389_SEQ_02: The Seedseers Raya-O-Senna and her brother, A-Ruhn-Senna, apprise you of the darkness that has emerged within Amdapor. Suffice it to say, it falls to you to vanquish the fell presence. To venture into the lost city, speak with Alphene, the Wood Wailer stationed at the entrance in the South Shroud.
TEXT_SUBCTS003_01389_SEQ_03:
From Alphene, you learn that the great gates he guards offer a way into the lost city. By all accounts, what awaits you is hideously dangerous and likely to be revolting. Meet the corruption in Amdapor with your loins girt!

※The Lost City of Amdapor can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_SUBCTS103_01410_SEQ_00: Hugubert has heard word of great deeds being done at Halatali, and would share with you the tales of triumph.
TEXT_SUBCTS103_01410_SEQ_01: According to Hugubert, the training grounds at Halatali have been reopened to challengers, and your reputation as a seasoned battler precedes you. If you would take Hugubert up on his offer, make your way back to the reinvigorated training arena and speak with its sentry, Arlh.
TEXT_SUBCTS103_01410_SEQ_02:
Arlh informs you that the former death trap is now a well-oiled dungeon. While there are myriad calls on your talents, you cannot deny the appeal of proving yourself in Halatali.

※Halatali (Hard) can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_SUBCTS104_01411_SEQ_00: As Bloezoeng eyes you from his corner, you get the impression that he has a dangerous task in mind.
TEXT_SUBCTS104_01411_SEQ_01: Your wanderings have led you into the company of one Bloezoeng, a local chef in the Seventh Heaven. As it turns out, you and he share a mutual acquaintance: Dyrstweitz, the owner of the Flying Shark in Costa del Sol. Dyrstweitz, it would seem, has sent out a call for help on behalf of his own friend, Wheiskaet. For friendship's sake, seek out Wheiskaet in eastern La Noscea to see what is troubling him.
TEXT_SUBCTS104_01411_SEQ_02: Wheiskaet has pointed you in the direction of yet another old acquaintance, Brayflox Alltalks from the Company of Heroes. Proceed to Brayflox's Longstop, and assist the goblin in any way you are able.
TEXT_SUBCTS104_01411_SEQ_03:
You speak with Brayflox and discover that her camp is under attack by the Illuminati, a secretive fraternity of goblin scholars. This enigmatic band may well have good reasons for their assault, but in the name of friendship, you must brush such doubts aside as you prepare to stand with Brayflox.

※Brayflox's Longstop (Hard) can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_SUBCTS806_01421_SEQ_00: Such is Wiscard's personal charisma that you feel yourself positively compelled to speak with him.
TEXT_SUBCTS806_01421_SEQ_01: You are a tad fuzzy on the details, but, with a wink and a nod, Wiscard has sent you off to deliver a leather bag to Rowena. You can only hope that his promises of newfound performance and fashion have merit.
TEXT_SUBCTS806_01421_SEQ_02: You have conveyed the bag and Wiscard's well-wishes to Rowena, with explosive results. Try to think happy thoughts as you hasten back to the flamboyant trader.
TEXT_SUBCTS806_01421_SEQ_03: Wiscard practically writhes in ecstasy at Rowena's loathing, proving that one truly does create one's own reality. He presents you with a glamour prism, which has the power to make one object look like another. Now you, too, can look the part of a successful adventurer!
TEXT_SUBCTS807_01422_SEQ_00: Wiscard has a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for you. How could you possibly pass it up?
TEXT_SUBCTS807_01422_SEQ_01: Wiscard confides that there are energies at work in every action, which constrain him from seeking payment for a very valuable skill he would teach you. But of course, you are happy to perform a small errand for him in return, and deliver a letter to Rowena.
TEXT_SUBCTS807_01422_SEQ_02: Rowena receives the message with ill grace. Her facility for curses is impressive, but you are left wondering why anyone would fall into arrears with this daughter of the Fury. Your ears still ringing with invectives, return now to Wiscard.
TEXT_SUBCTS807_01422_SEQ_03: From Wiscard's reaction, you get an inkling of what all this talk of energy exchange might mean, and ponder over public persona and private predilections. Rather than go down this primrose path, it might be best to simply purchase whatever tomes from Tataroga you find desirable; only then can you learn the master crafting recipes held within...
TEXT_SUBCTS808_01423_SEQ_00: There is much to see about Revenant's Toll, but Guiding Star only has eyes for you.
TEXT_SUBCTS808_01423_SEQ_01: The sharp-eyed Guiding Star correctly determines that you are a person with skilled hands, and asks to see your tool of choice. While such a request would usually offend your sense of propriety, so earnest is he that you decide to speak with him again after equipping your gatherer's or crafter's primary tool (item level 50 and higher).
TEXT_SUBCTS808_01423_SEQ_02: Guiding Star beheld your tool with all the decorum and delicacy called for by the occasion. Judging you to be both sufficiently adept and inadequately equipped, he introduces you to the toolsmith Talan. Deal with this surly smith and surely you will profit by it, in equipage and ability both.
TEXT_SUBCTS809_01424_SEQ_00: Following a trying sea voyage, Tatafu could use an adventurer, a mop, and a bath─in that order.
TEXT_SUBCTS809_01424_SEQ_01: Tatafu's seasick courier being otherwise occupied, you have been charged with delivering cargo to Nanalai in Crescent Cove. You know not to tarry, for these burlap sacks large and small are eagerly awaited.
TEXT_SUBCTS809_01424_SEQ_02: It turns out the sacks contained soil and seeds that will aid Nanalai in becoming a farmer. As wild as the scheme seems, the soon-to-be former fisher struck you as no fool. Now, hurry back to Vesper Bay, for Tatafu is owed payment for the merchandise.
TEXT_SUBCTS809_01424_SEQ_03: Tatafu is dubious of the fisherman's chances, but admits to knowing little of the farming trade. While the same could be said of you, you cannot help but find your thoughts wandering back to the extra seeds you were given, and the idea of a small garden all your own...
TEXT_SUBFST159_01425_SEQ_00: Eral has noticed a rare bit of excitement within the serene city-state and would share with you what he knows.
TEXT_SUBFST159_01425_SEQ_01: Eral has espied a lovely maid frolicking in the Acorn Orchard, and would have you discover whether a feast is nigh. Head off toward the play area outside the Carpenters' Guild to see what so pleases the fair Yedythe.
TEXT_SUBFST159_01425_SEQ_02: Yedythe proves to be a dancing master, albeit a rather agitated one at the moment. The younglings under her instruction have fled for more congenial pursuits. Yedythe wonders if Timbermaster Beatin may be of assistance in tracking them down.
TEXT_SUBFST159_01425_SEQ_03: Beatin's solution is deceptively simple: a toy for each child. Using the skills that won you acclaim as a tracker, find the truant younglings and present them with the toys.
TEXT_SUBFST159_01425_SEQ_04: The younglings see the toys through the lens of their hopes, and return to the orchard resolved to give their nervous dance instructor another try. Return to Yedythe and tell her of what transpired.
TEXT_SUBFST159_01425_SEQ_05: Yedythe is delighted to realize that she and the younglings have formed a tentative bond. She teaches you the harvest dance, and is impressed at your talent for it. However, before her plaudits can continue, Beatin appears and inadvertently scares off the poor instructor.
TEXT_SUBSEA159_01426_SEQ_00: There is a hectic flush of panic on Dodozan's face as he looks wildly about Hawkers' Round.
TEXT_SUBSEA159_01426_SEQ_01: Dodozan has been trading with pirates, and some miscreant has made off with a cask of ale meant for the Bloody Executioners. Surely, someone at Fisherman's Bottom has seen something.
TEXT_SUBSEA159_01426_SEQ_02: Your inquiries have garnered answers, and you have learned that the cask of ale may have ended up exactly where it was supposed to, after all─with the Bloody Executioners aboard their ship, the Astalicia. It might be best to head off in that direction to confirm whether the customer was indeed the thief.
TEXT_SUBSEA159_01426_SEQ_03: It turns out that one of the underling pirates had more thirst than sense, and so brings down his captain's wrath upon him. The good captain would have you courier the payment to Dodozan.
TEXT_SUBSEA159_01426_SEQ_04: Dodozan is pleased to see the money and even more pleased that a watery demise will not be an item on his personal ledger this day. Moenskaet is correct, after all; it takes cods to trade with folk who have a long keel.
TEXT_SUBWIL159_01427_SEQ_00: When P'molminn approaches, beware, for the impetuous Miqo'te always leads a merry dance.
TEXT_SUBWIL159_01427_SEQ_01: P'molminn the dancing girl aspires to a professional engagement at one of the grand balls. The legendary dancing master Guillaunaux is her only hope, and his whereabouts may be common knowledge among the uncommon set on the Steps of Thal.
TEXT_SUBWIL159_01427_SEQ_02: The ladies who lunch─and loure─inform you that Master Guillaunaux is eminently desirable and soon to be unavailable. Unless you catch up to him at the Hustings Strip, he may well slip through P'molminn's slender fingers.
TEXT_SUBWIL159_01427_SEQ_03: Master Guillaunaux proves less amenable to your overture than you had hoped. The only way to his heart─or even to something resembling a civil conversation─is to /dance for him on the Hustings Strip.
TEXT_SUBWIL159_01427_SEQ_04: The tormented dancing master praises the rugged potential of your dance, whilst dismissing P'molminn's overseasoned steps with cutting cruelty. Yet the Miqo'te's grit and caprice carry the day, and it is the master and the adventurer who are left staring after the student who never was.
TEXT_SUBFST122_01428_SEQ_00: Spinning Blade knows that whatever is lost is always found─as long as somebody is on the lookout.
TEXT_SUBFST122_01428_SEQ_01: Spinning Blade has given you an airship ticket misplaced by a friend. Deliver it to the hapless Raimondaux before he misses his flight.
TEXT_SUBFST122_01428_SEQ_02: You find Raimondaux outside the airship landing worrying over his upcoming flight. A friendly greeting is certain to soothe his nerves. With the chat mode in Say, enter “Hail fellow well met!” to let him know he's among friends.
TEXT_SUBFST122_01428_SEQ_03: Raimondaux gives chilly acknowledgement of your greeting. It would seem you came on too strong. Attempt to subdue your excitement and try something a bit more general. With the chat mode in Say, enter the auto-translate option Hello!.
TEXT_SUBFST122_01428_SEQ_04: Your second, less flamboyant greeting is better received. Raimondaux confesses that he feels uneasy about something, but he cannot put a finger on it. Clearly, you have the right man.
TEXT_SUBFST122_01428_SEQ_05: From his reaction, you surmise that Raimondaux is not expecting a messenger. He is obviously unaware that he is one airship ticket short of a trip. Needless suspense is a gift; with the chat mode in Say, enter “Got everything?” and see whether it sends Raimondaux into a fit of anxiety.
TEXT_SUBFST122_01428_SEQ_06: Raimondaux is horrified to realize from your question that his airship ticket is missing. How much kinder it would have been to just present him with the misplaced item! But of course, he will be all the happier when you restore the precious ticket─as you will right this moment.
TEXT_SUBFST122_01428_SEQ_07: Raimondaux is relieved to see his ticket, and grateful to both you and Spinning Blade. Why exactly he must leave Gridania so urgently is certainly none of your business. It is time to depart gracefully by entering the auto-translate option Good-bye. with the chat mode in Say.
TEXT_SUBFST122_01428_SEQ_08: You can never go wrong with a standard farewell, it seems. With Raimondaux taking to the air, it falls upon you to deliver his words of thanks to Spinning Blade.
TEXT_SUBFST122_01428_SEQ_09: Spinning Blade is happy to hear that his old friend is safely out of Gridania, and will say no more about why. Your curiosity is unsatisfied, but if what Spinning Blade said is true, you may have made a valuable ally this day.
TEXT_SUBWIL101_01429_SEQ_00: A friend in need is a friend indeed, and Memenaru is determined to stay the course despite the object of his kindness making himself scarce.
TEXT_SUBWIL101_01429_SEQ_01: Memenaru would like you to convey a message to Botulf about the debt owed by the latter. The lender may be unable to see the borrower, but you will surely find the beholden man at the Quicksand.
TEXT_SUBWIL101_01429_SEQ_02: You have spoken to Botulf, who seems positively haggard with worry over the unpaid debt. With the chat mode in Say, enter “Well met!” and make his acquaintance.
TEXT_SUBWIL101_01429_SEQ_03: You greet Botulf, who recognizes you from your brief tête-à-tête with Memenaru, and draws his own fearful conclusions. What else is there to do but enter the auto-translate option Hello!, with the chat mode in Say?
TEXT_SUBWIL101_01429_SEQ_04: The ring of your voice pulls Botulf back from the brink of madness. It is an achievement to be proud of, though you will hardly dine out on this tale. Speak with Botulf and ascertain the reason for his terror.
TEXT_SUBWIL101_01429_SEQ_05: Botulf believes you to be a debt collector. Desperate must his circumstances be for that thought to strike such unreasoning fear into his heart. With the chat mode in Say, enter “You misunderstand.”
TEXT_SUBWIL101_01429_SEQ_06: You assuaged Botulf's fears and delivered Memenaru's message. With the chat mode in Say, enter the auto-translate option Good-bye. and leave Botulf to savor the relief.
TEXT_SUBWIL101_01429_SEQ_07: You have taken your leave of Botulf. Let us hope that his moment of sudden clarity will persist, and he will refrain from trying to cadge coin from every  that drops by.
TEXT_SUBSEA922_01430_SEQ_00: A salty stalwart is the acting guildmaster Sisipu, but today she seems distinctly distrait.
TEXT_SUBSEA922_01430_SEQ_01: Her tart tongue reasserting itself, Sisipu urges you towards the docks, where Wawalago awaits you with a distinguished visitor.
TEXT_SUBSEA922_01430_SEQ_02: Wawalago and Ascelyn bend your ear until you can hardly stand straight─such is scholarship. All you need to note is that Wawalago needs a titanic sawfish from you.
