The time has come for you to build a stable on the patch of ground you call home, and there, raise a magnificent bird who will accompany you on your adventures. If love and skill are indeed what make a knack, you have the one and can win the other.
TEXT_SUBPST010_01570_SEQ_00: The deputy postmoogle's trust in you must surely grow, for a letter between Seedseers is serious business indeed.
TEXT_SUBPST010_01570_SEQ_01: The deputy postmoogle has tasked you with an important delivery. Place the missive given to you in the hands of Raya-O-Senna in Camp Tranquil, and ask not what message it contains.
TEXT_SUBPST010_01570_SEQ_02: Letters between Padjals are no biscuit recipes as a rule, and this one is no exception. The sender himself appears on the scene, and A-Ruhn-Senna and Raya-O-Senna rope you into a convoluted scheme to stage an intervention for the deputy postmoogle. But first, the bait in the form of another letter must be delivered to the postmoogle outside Bulwark Hall on the lower decks of Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_SUBPST010_01570_SEQ_03: The bait has been delivered to the deputy postmoogle, who after much hemming, hawing, and kupoing agrees to meet with you─and unbeknownst to him, the Seedseers─near Little Solace in the East Shroud.
TEXT_SUBPST010_01570_SEQ_04: You arrive on the scene to find no trace of the dutiful postmoogle, much to your surprise. What could have prevented him from honoring the rendezvous? There are some fell things in the forest, especially on the path between Little Solace and the Hawthorne Hut. Look sharp, for whatever keeps the postmoogle from his duty will have no love for his assistant.
TEXT_SUBPST010_01570_SEQ_05: A wounded thing always draws predators, and thus it is with the postmoogle. Have no mercy for the fell things that seek to make a meal of your mentor.
TEXT_SUBPST010_01570_SEQ_06: The postmoogle's secret was one of great pathos, as secrets desperately guarded are wont to be. A windmill sail had all but incapacitated the poor letter carrier, but a  who dashes a moogle's hopes shall ever burn in the seventh hell. What can one do but carry on the moogle's work, mentor more carriers, and pray? By the grace of the Twelve, may the Padjals find healing for his battered little body...
TEXT_SUBPST011_01571_SEQ_00: Ah, to have the trust of the diminutive deputy postmoogle! For this you would gladly risk the roughest cutthroats in outer La Noscea, yes, you would.
TEXT_SUBPST011_01571_SEQ_01: There is a letter addressed to Sergeant Swygrael, which you must deliver forthwith in spite of the postmoogle's airy talk of baleful glances and untamed corsairs.
TEXT_SUBPST011_01571_SEQ_02: The sergeant of the Red Swallows takes the letter with a thanks and a stream of curses. The unit's recruiting drive has apparently been less successful than she would like. The sergeant's last hope may currently be facing difficulties among the Nymian ruins. This so-called miniature marauder would no doubt appreciate any assistance you can render her.
TEXT_SUBPST011_01571_SEQ_03: The marauder was indeed under attack by a trio of kobolds as vicious as─well, as herself. Rabid Ratata may be aptly named and best avoided, but a compliment from a fighter so feral must be taken as high praise. Follow her back to Camp Overlook and see if Sergeant Swygrael has further use of your talents.
TEXT_SUBPST011_01571_SEQ_04: Sergeant Swygrael has her quota of lumber but not muscle. Her attempts to woo the strange Salthound have fallen as dead and flat as the young Lalafell's eyes. Speak with this killer born and bred, and see whether she can be coaxed to join the Red Swallows.
TEXT_SUBPST011_01571_SEQ_05: Ratata's tendency to bring up one's mortality is something of a conversation killer. Walk off the unfortunate pun by speaking to the one they call the Salthound stevedore, whose paternal concern for his captain belies his fearsome countenance.
TEXT_SUBPST011_01571_SEQ_06: The stevedore shares Swygrael's desire to see Ratata take her place among the Red Swallows and learn something of life beyond the next dying scream and the company of Salthounds. Surely, one so fearless as Ratata can be persuaded, if not goaded, to fly the nest.
TEXT_SUBPST011_01571_SEQ_07: If Ratata is indeed a mad dog, there is a method to her madness. She has reasons enough to refuse Swygrael's offer, this you cannot deny. The stevedore may grieve to hear that the wider world holds no interest for her, but the father's heart in him will rejoice to know that the deadly apple of the Salthounds' eye will remain in Poor Maid's Mill.
TEXT_SUBPST011_01571_SEQ_08: After your conversation with the stevedore, he and Ratata begin the return journey to the Mill, both lighter of heart. As for you─you, who know the enigmatic killer's secret─sleep will not come easily tonight. Try to forget her obsidian stare, and tell Sergeant Swygrael that she will not have the miniature marauder under her command, not this day and not ever.
TEXT_SUBPST011_01571_SEQ_09: The Red Swallows may be poorer for Ratata's refusal, but Swygrael is a soldier enough to see the tactical advantages in the lethal Lalafell's presence in Poor Maid's Mill. Shorthanded they may be, the Maelstrom can get on without her; unfortified as it is, the Mill cannot.
TEXT_SUBPST012_01572_SEQ_00: The deputy postmoogle wants you to slip into something more comfortable.
TEXT_SUBPST012_01572_SEQ_01: In honor of your selfless contributions to the delivery service, the deputy postmoogle would like to reward you with a relaxing trip to meet Wawalago, the laid-back master of the Fishermen's Guild, and learn the secrets of easy living. The fact that a letter needs delivering to the very same man is entirely coincidental.
TEXT_SUBPST012_01572_SEQ_02: Wawalago lazily scans the lines of the letter: it is from Rorojaru, a fast friend of the guildmaster and previously prosperous purveyor from Ul'dah who has fallen on trying times. He writes to request a trade: an item of immense interest to a fish fancier for a single fish─the rarer the better. Wawalago directs you to the ferry docks to receive Rorojaru and relay the guildmaster's reply.
TEXT_SUBPST012_01572_SEQ_03: You meet with Rorojaru at the docks and deliver Wawalago's note. The troubled trader is staking the last remnant of his once-mighty fortune on this deal, and relishes Wawalago's receptiveness to his request. But one problem remains: the guildmaster would make the trade at Candlekeep Quay, but how to transport the treasure all that way? If only there were an adventurer adept at delivering packages nearby... Remember─lift with your legs, not with your back.
TEXT_SUBPST012_01572_SEQ_04: You lift Rorojaru's chest with aplomb. All that remains is to transport it to Candlekeep Quay in lower La Noscea, and reunite it with its owner.
TEXT_SUBPST012_01572_SEQ_05: Wawalago inspects the trader's treasure, but to Rorojaru's dismay, he deems it of insufficient value to cover the cost of the fish. Still, the guildmaster offers his friend a lifeline to rescue the deal: if Rorojaru should catch a fish─any fish─in the time it takes for you to return with a Lominsan anchovy, he will sanction the trade. If not, the deal is dead, and the trader's dreams with it. By what method you obtain the fish, and how quickly you choose to present it to Wawalago, are for your own conscience to decide.
TEXT_SUBPST012_01572_SEQ_06: You hand over the Lominsan anchovy to Wawalago. Despite his best efforts, Rorojaru has been unable to capture a single sprat in the time it took you, leaving the deal dead in the water. But as Rorojaru mourns the loss of his fortune, Wawalago catches a fish of superlative rarity and presents it to his friend as a reward for his endeavors, before taking his leave. To your surprise, the money-mad merchant releases the prize catfish that was to be his ticket to regaining his riches, choosing instead to emulate Wawalago in living the carefree life of a fish. He throws off the trammels of the trading life, starting and ending with the last of his fortune─a shining subligar buffed to an iridescent sheen, prized in fishing circles for its power to invigorate the local fish stocks. May it offer you similar support in your adventures to come.
TEXT_SUBPST013_01573_SEQ_00: The deputy postmoogle holds a colorful, heavily perfumed envelope in his paw.
TEXT_SUBPST013_01573_SEQ_01: The deputy postmoogle has foisted another assignment on you, as is his wont. Play the willing assistant and deliver the garishly decorated missive to a certain gentleman of heightened aesthetic sensibilities who has been seen about Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_SUBPST013_01573_SEQ_02: The man thought to be the renowned aesthetician Jandelaine was in fact his brother, a staid youth by the name of Guillefresne. He informs you that he, in fact, is the author of the missive you carry, explaining that he has traveled from Ishgard to convince his brother to return home and succeed their stricken father as lord of the family domain. Hearing from the chatty madam that Jandelaine has gone to procure a new comb, Guillefresne sets out for the Carpenters' Guild in Gridania. Pursue the youth and speak with Master Beatin.
TEXT_SUBPST013_01573_SEQ_03: Master Beatin is seemingly unconvinced that Guillefresne has his brother's best interests at heart. He tells the youth a cryptic tale, instructing him to ponder on its meaning as he journeys to Ul'dah, where Jandelaine has gone to consult with Guildmaster Severian of the Alchemists' Guild.
TEXT_SUBPST013_01573_SEQ_04: Adamantly opposed to the notion of his fellow genius returning to Ishgard, Severian stubbornly refuses to provide Guillefresne with any information on his brother's whereabouts, until he has a sudden change of heart for reasons unknown. Travel to the Adventurers' Guild in Limsa, that you might at long last deliver the letter to the man for whom it was intended.
TEXT_SUBPST013_01573_SEQ_05: You successfully deliver the letter to Jandelaine. Guillefresne confronts his brother, strongly insisting that the aesthetician abandon his profession and return to the family lands in Ishgard. Jandelaine responds with a flourish of his blades, giving his timid brother stately locks that instill him with newfound confidence and resolve. Now enlightened as to the true callings of both sibling and self, the reborn Guillefresne swears to do his family proud before bidding both you and his brother farewell.
TEXT_SUBPST014_01574_SEQ_00: Letters are the most eloquent in what they do not say, and the tale behind this wordless missive could fill many a parchment scroll.
TEXT_SUBPST014_01574_SEQ_01: The deputy postmoogle has a task for you. Deliver a letter to Mauh Lihzeh, a traveling merchant who can be found on Sweetbloom Pier in the East Shroud.
TEXT_SUBPST014_01574_SEQ_02: You give the letter to Mauh Lihzeh and receive a tale in return. Mauh's long-missing sister Urha can perhaps be found in the South Shroud, if you would go to the marked spots and keep your eyes open.
TEXT_SUBPST014_01574_SEQ_03: Your search for Urha Lihzeh is abruptly interrupted by an attack from the Coeurlclaw poachers, a gang much feared and loathed in the Black Shroud. Lest they return in force, move on to the next spot marked on the map and keep watch.
TEXT_SUBPST014_01574_SEQ_04: With her rough-hewn beauty and quick temper, Urha Lihzeh cuts a very different figure from her younger sister. Present her with the letter lest she dispatch you with the same brutality she showed the Wood Wailer.
TEXT_SUBPST014_01574_SEQ_05: Urha Lihzeh's demeanor changes the instant she learns you come from her sister. Suddenly fearful yet full of longing, she asks you to meet her in Urth's Gift.
TEXT_SUBPST014_01574_SEQ_06: Urha's tale is one lived out in every zone of chaos, every realm where the granaries are locked against those in need. Now a hardened lawbreaker and a part of the cultish Coeurlclaw gang, Urha still longs to see her only living family, if you would take her words to Mauh Lihzeh on Sweetbloom Pier.
TEXT_SUBPST014_01574_SEQ_07: Mauh confides in you that she is determined to persuade her sister to leave a life of crime. Now that Urha has asked Mauh to meet her, Mauh believes she can bring her home from the Upper Paths─with your help.
TEXT_SUBPST014_01574_SEQ_08: The reunion is a bittersweet one, so full of secrets and sorrow is the past. And it promises to soon turn bloody, for Urha's gang is onto her secret meeting. Cut the poachers down in their hiding spot, while the sisters escape.
TEXT_SUBPST014_01574_SEQ_09: Thanks to you, these poachers will hunt Urha and Mauh no more. You have a rendezvous to keep with the sisters, and some difficult persuading to do. Make your way to the Lower Paths, where the sisters await.
TEXT_SUBPST014_01574_SEQ_10: You did not have far to go before running into Urha and Mauh at a Wood Wailer checkpoint...and into the poachers' self-styled king, who plays on Urha's fears to reclaim her as his chattel. Urha is a hardened killer with much to answer for, yet witnessing the Wailers' treatment of the two Miqo'te leaves a bad taste in your mouth. But this is not your concern─Mauh's safety is.
TEXT_SUBPST014_01574_SEQ_11: In Mauh Lihzeh's anger and resolve, you see the shades of another young woman bent on saving her family─and trading away her own future for it. If Mauh Lihzeh is to hunt the Coeurlclaw King as she swears, she will need all the help she can get. Henceforth, any Coeurlclaw poacher you see is fit to be put down.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_00: The deputy postmoogle holds out a soil-stained letter, suspiciously blemished with beak marks.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_01: The deputy postmoogle asks you to deliver a letter to the beautiful North Shroud, the playground of his own happy mooglinghood. Or to be more accurate, redeliver it: the moogle who preceded you was ambushed by the Ixal, and barely escaped with his pom-pom still attached. The deputy postmoogle bids you make a second attempt: brave the Ixali gauntlet to Eugenia's Spire, and place the letter in the unyielding hands of Miah Molkot, ferocious leader of the White Rams.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_02: Miah scans the note, and licks her lips at the happy news within: her dear friend Philota and the lady's young grandson are to visit. But delight soon turns to alarm when she realizes that the day of their expected arrival has come and gone. Fearing the malign intervention of the Ixal, she bids you seek out her man in Treespeak, slaying any birdman you should encounter along the way.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_03: In Treespeak, you meet with Miah's man─a Gods' Quiver bowman who has fallen into an Ixali ambush. You swiftly defeat his attackers, but the man is still reeling from the birdman assault. Offer the injured bowman your aid.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_04: As you tend to the wounded archer, another Ixal leaps from the brush, swinging his axe. Just as he is about to strike, a familiar figure appears: Miah Molkot. Terrified at the fate that awaits him at the hands of the famous Black Cat, the Ixal proffers a deal: in exchange for his life, he and his comrades will find Philota and her grandson, and return them unharmed. He bids you speak with his leader by the river bend, to whom he will deliver Miah's friends.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_05: You make contact with the Ixali headwing, but he refuses to honor his subordinate's unauthorized pledge. Instead, he presents you with an ultimatum for the White Rams: the Ixal hold Philota and her grandson hostage, and demand to be given free rein in the Twelveswood until such time as they complete a secret objective. As proof of their word, Philota is to be released in advance, on the cliffs overlooking Fallgourd Float. Go to her, and ensure her safety.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_06: The Ixal spoke the truth: on the cliffside stands Philota, shaken yet unharmed. She confirms that the Ixal do indeed have her grandson in their clutches, and bids you return to Eugenia's Spire to enlist Miah's aid in the boy's rescue.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_07: You report to Miah Molkot, who vows to devote her all to the rescue effort. She tells you how Philota's son was the leader of the White Rams before his untimely passing, and the child held hostage is his son in turn. For the Ixal to have kidnapped the boy is an insult to the White Rams' honor, and Miah will stop at nothing until those responsible are brought to her own personal brand of justice. She asks you to return to Philota, now resting at the Bobbing Cork, and assure her that her grandson will be saved.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_08: Philota is reassured by Miah's zeal, but fears her personal involvement in this case may drive the White Rams' leader beyond her usual exuberance and into recklessness. She asks you to return to Eugenia's Spire, and urge Miah not to take any unnecessary risks.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_09: You explain Philota's misgivings to Miah Molkot, but restraint is no longer an option for the maddened Miqo'te. Not only have the Ixal been taunting the White Rams by roaming the Twelveswood at will, using the boy as a shield, they now appear to be repairing to their own lands with the child in tow. Just as Miah is about to give the order to strike, a message comes from her scouts: true to their word, the Ixal have released Philota's grandson near Proud Creek. Fearing for his safety, Miah urges you to assist her men in finding the child before something more dastardly does.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_10: Despite the White Rams' best efforts, it is your eagle eye that first picks out Philota's grandson. He explains to you how the Ixal who held him hostage were not an invasion force, but a rescue team, hunting for a missing hatchling. Furthermore, the chieftain who released the boy left behind some strange words that seem to relate to some forgotten past. But Proud Creek is no place to linger in thought─you link up with another of the search team, who agrees to convey the boy back to the relative safety of Eugenia's Spire. Rendezvous with them there, and report these latest developments to Instructor Molkot.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_11: You meet with the bowman back at Eugenia's Spire, but all is not well. Despite the pleas of her soft-hearted subordinate, Miah Molkot is determined to take revenge on the Ixali rescue team, and strike them down before they reach the border─hatchling and all. The bowman urges you to speak with Philota at the Bobbing Cork and explain the situation, that she might convince the ruthless instructor to call off the attack.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_12: You relay the events to Philota, who vows to do all she can to persuade Miah to be merciful. She asks you to return with all haste to Eugenia's Spire, and delay the attack until she arrives.
TEXT_SUBPST015_01575_SEQ_13: You return to the spire in time to hear Miah giving the final order to set upon the retreating Ixal. But just as the bowmen are about to depart, Philota arrives to relate a fateful tale from the past. Twenty years earlier, the White Rams, under the leadership of Philota's late son, released Ixali hatchlings to secure the safety of a young girl─a girl by the name of Miah Molkot. By the Ixali headwing's words, he could only be one of those hatchlings whose life was spared in exchange for hers. Unwilling to sever the ties of destiny put in place by her master so long before, Miah Molkot calls off the attack. And so, after twenty long years, a temporary truce returns to the Twelveswood.
TEXT_SUBPST016_01576_SEQ_00: The deputy postmoogle would task you with an urgent delivery to Little Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_SUBPST016_01576_SEQ_01: Another day, another task from the deputy postmoogle. This time, your furry friend would have you deliver a letter from Hihibaru to his daughter Hihira in Little Ala Mhigo. Though the moogle seems merry as ever, he dispatches you with a warning that there may be more to this missive than meets the eye...
TEXT_SUBPST016_01576_SEQ_02: The letter safely in her hands, Hihira reads aloud her father's message, only to discover Hihibaru is stricken with a fatal malady of the stomach. Ever the kindly daughter, however, she is quick to conceive of a cure, a herbal remedy brewed using Trader vetch roots. With panic in her eyes, she begs you unearth three such tubers in Zanr'ak.
TEXT_SUBPST016_01576_SEQ_03: Malms of wilderness and dozens of Amalj'aa at your back, you finally come upon patches of Trader vetch. With three tubers from the herb safely in hand, make your way back to Little Ala Mhigo─through the malms of wilderness and dozens of Amalj'aa that stand between you and Hihira.
TEXT_SUBPST016_01576_SEQ_04: Though happy to have the crucial roots, Hihira remains worried about her father being alone in his time of need, and asks you to keep a watch over Hihibaru in Highbridge till she can complete her concoction.
TEXT_SUBPST016_01576_SEQ_05: You arrive moments before Hihira to find Hihibaru hale as he ever was. The mystery unravels as he reveals that it is his ailing business that causes his gastric distress, not a mortal malady. Livid, Hihira storms off, leaving you to explain the situation to her father. Hihibaru realizes his mistake...and that his daughter is heading straight towards an Amalj'aa camp. Hihibaru begs you follow her into Drybone, and defend her from any dangers about.
TEXT_SUBPST016_01576_SEQ_06: You spy Hihira hemmed in by Amalj'aa. Save her from a nasty end.
TEXT_SUBPST016_01576_SEQ_07: Spared death on the point of an Amalj'aa spear, a thankful Hihira wends her way home─but only after tasking you with delivering the glad tidings of her safety to Hihibaru in Highbridge.
TEXT_SUBPST016_01576_SEQ_08: Heaving a sigh of relief at the news you bring, Hihibaru hands you a neckpiece. He explains the object belonged to his late wife who perished after long moons spent in painful battle with the Green Rot. The man admits his improvidence, both for having excited fear he suffered a similar illness, and for having driven Hihira away years earlier. He entreats you to give the neckpiece─along with his apologies─to Hihira in Little Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_SUBPST016_01576_SEQ_09: You deliver Hihira both the neckpiece and her father's words of pride. Deeply moved, the girl tells you of her mother's teachings of kindness, and Hihibaru's thirst for gil. Now, however, Hihira thinks her father a changed man, and vows to have more talk of all these things with him.
TEXT_SUBPST017_01577_SEQ_00: The deputy postmoogle has a demanding yet satisfying assignment for you.
TEXT_SUBPST017_01577_SEQ_01: The deputy postmoogle would have you deliver a demand for satisfaction to a drunken, fractious pirate. What could possibly go wrong? Anselm, the cutthroat in question, has been seen loitering around Limsa Lominsa's lower decks.
TEXT_SUBPST017_01577_SEQ_02: Anselm's long-simmering feud with Fiebras has come to a head, and you have been appointed arbiter of their final showdown. He flies to the Drowning Wench to confront Fiebras, and bids you follow him forthwith, lest he should be forced to settle the squabble with steel.
TEXT_SUBPST017_01577_SEQ_03: The cantankerous couple would have you be the arbiter not of a duel, but a dispute. Both claim to have discovered ladies whose charms eclipse their former tavern wench of choice, but whose taste is better? There's only one way to find out: follow Fiebras to Bulwark Hall to evaluate his claim.
TEXT_SUBPST017_01577_SEQ_04: Fiebras nominates the tourist information twins of Bulwark Hall as his exemplars of feminine grace. Have a heart-to-heart with N'delika to see what all the fuss is about.
TEXT_SUBPST017_01577_SEQ_05: It seems the winsome sisters are more than they let on. As undercover Yellowjackets, they defend the realm from undesirable elements─one Fiebras the Dull included. Return to Fiebras to relate the happy news.
TEXT_SUBPST017_01577_SEQ_06: Being the victim of a covert espionage operation was not enough to sway Fiebras's convictions, but Anselm is further emboldened. He bids you accompany him to Fisherman's Bottom to survey the object of his own infatuation.
TEXT_SUBPST017_01577_SEQ_07: Anselm wishes to draw your attention to stately Sisipu, jewel of the Lalafells. He urges you to speak with her, and bask in her glory.
TEXT_SUBPST017_01577_SEQ_08: Sisipu, materfamilias of Fisherman's Bottom, gives you some sage advice to curb Anselm's competitive streak. Will these wise words be enough to put an end to all this silly bother?
TEXT_SUBPST017_01577_SEQ_09: Anselm, the eternal agonist, is not so easily dissuaded by Sisipu's attempted appeasement. In fact, it seems to have only strengthened his resolve. The disputatious duo head to the docks to await your final judgment.
TEXT_SUBPST017_01577_SEQ_10: Just as you are about to deliver your verdict, the flighty pirates' affections are captivated by the brusque charms of Captain Rhoswen, leader of the Sanguine Sirens. And though their budding hopes are swiftly crushed, the heartbroken heroes pledge to follow Rhoswen down the pirate path. Henceforth, they will settle their feuds not with rational argument, but with a few swift knocks in the kisser. If you are ever of a mind to witness “pirate justice” firsthand, you have an open invitation to Candlekeep Quay, where the truculent twosome will be drinking, wenching, and settling scores until somebody loses an eye.
TEXT_SUBFST980_01670_SEQ_00: Jalzahn seems to be glaring at Gerolt.
TEXT_SUBFST980_01670_SEQ_01: Jalzahn complains that Gerolt's preoccupation with kettle-making has made it impossible to address the question of who should rightfully bear the title of Starforger. Having been wholly unable to tear Gerolt away from the object of his obsession, he asks that you attempt to reason with the heedless blacksmith in his stead.
TEXT_SUBFST980_01670_SEQ_02: Gerolt is swift to dismiss you, but you decide to relay Jalzahn's message regardless. He duly rejects the alchemist's appeal out of hand, and demands that you help him apply the finishing touches to his latest brainchild: a kettle valuable enough to pay off his debts and restore his renown in one fell swoop. For this masterwork, he apparently requires fifty pieces of alexandrite...
TEXT_SUBFST980_01670_SEQ_03: Having taken receipt of the alexandrite, Gerolt wastes no time finishing his masterpiece, and with a bang and a clang, he presents to you a kettle of breathtaking quality. Drawn by the clamor of hammer and anvil, Jalzahn then comes to inspect Gerolt's work. Though reasonably impressed, the alchemist declares that the kettle is not yet of a standard befitting the creator of a Zodiac Weapon, and duly offers to help Gerolt improve it. For this purpose, he requests that you furnish him with ten bottles of Thavnairian mist.
TEXT_SUBFST980_01670_SEQ_04: Through the power of alchemy, the kettle is reborn, a vision of culinary perfection. Eager to test their masterpiece, Gerolt and Jalzahn triumphantly set about making tea, only for Drake to appear, his face a picture of dismay. Having been forced to expedite a large order of kettles, the young apprentice admits to having forsaken quality for quantity, producing wares which he fears will have customers up in arms. Though Gerolt and Jalzahn say nothing, both cannot help noticing that Drake's offerings perform markedly better than their own. When Drake subsequently departs, head hung in shame, both blacksmith and alchemist loudly proclaim their intention to begin their work in earnest. Jalzahn duly decides to infuse the kettle with an aether-rich elixir, but requires an Inferno fragment, Vortex fragment, and Crag fragment to complete the task. Gerolt bids you good luck as they prepare for the next phase of their plan.
TEXT_SUBFST980_01670_SEQ_05: You brave scorching flames, gale-force winds, and terrible tremors to procure the materials needed for Gerolt's kettle. Hurry back to Hyrstmill that he may at last complete his magnum opus.
TEXT_SUBFST980_01670_SEQ_06: Thanks to your efforts, Gerolt and Jalzahn are able to combine their skills to create what is undoubtedly the zenith of kitchen utensils─Ultimate Kettle Nexus. Gerolt is especially overjoyed at the sight, knowing his return to fame is all but assured. With eerily impeccable timing, however, Drake appears once again, bearing more unfortunate news. According to him, this particular kettle was requested just over two years ago, the order having long since been canceled. Hearing this, Gerolt is predictably inconsolable, lamenting the millions of gil that would have ensured his freedom from debt. Jalzahn, meanwhile, is furious. Before you know it, the pair begin exchanging words and then blows, succeeding at last in rendering each other unconscious. In light of all that has occurred, Drake suggests you keep the kettle as a token of thanks for your well-intentioned help.
TEXT_HEAVNZ001_01726_SEQ_00: This Fury-fearing Elezen has a story to tell.
TEXT_HEAVNZ001_01726_SEQ_01: You are greeted by an Elezen at the steps to the aetheryte plaza who immediately takes note that you are not native to Ishgard. Never one to pass up the opportunity to share his stories, he offers to show you around and regale you with tales of Ishgard's history. He asks you to meet him at Saint Reinette's Forum if you wish to hear more.
TEXT_HEAVNZ001_01726_SEQ_02: You meet up with the elderly Elezen, who proceeds to tell you of the legendary dragoon Saint Reinette for which the Arc of the Humble was named. For his next story, he asks you to speak with him at Saint Valeroyant's Forum.
TEXT_HEAVNZ001_01726_SEQ_03: The elderly Elezen tells you of Saint Valeroyant and the Azure Dragoons, those chosen by the Eye to lead the nation's dragoons into battle. Though the statue before you was erected in his image, it has been damaged much like other sections of Foundation. Despite the despoilment, however, the elderly Elezen is not disheartened by what has befallen Ishgard. He has no more stories to tell you, but suggests you speak with Outreguerlain at Saint Reymanaud's Cathedral should your thirst for knowledge remain unquenched.
TEXT_HEAVNZ001_01726_SEQ_04: Outreguerlain greets you warmly and speaks with you of the patron saints of Ishgard for which many places are named. Though there is much of Ishgard you do not yet know, he asks for your understanding that it is through their faith that the people of Ishgard have stood united in their struggle against the Horde.
TEXT_HEAVNZ002_01727_SEQ_00: Cliaux cannot help but frown as she reads over her work.
TEXT_HEAVNZ002_01727_SEQ_01: Cliaux is preparing a test flight for an airship currently under repair, and needs her plan delivered right away. Take the flight plan to Jannequinard at the Athenaeum Astrologicum.
TEXT_HEAVNZ002_01727_SEQ_02: You deliver the flight plan to Jannequinard. Seeing the dates listed for the test flight leaves him gravely concerned, as he predicts significant dragon activity at that time. Rather than delaying the shipment, he suggests hastening repairs on the airship. Speak with Fromelaut at the Skysteel Manufactory and see what can be done about the repairs.
TEXT_HEAVNZ002_01727_SEQ_03: You relay Jannequinard's suggestion to rush repairs on the airship, leaving Fromelaut taken aback. Though he is hesitant to do so, he agrees to do whatever is necessary to make repairs as quickly as possible. Report to Cliaux and tell her it will be ready on the appointed day.
TEXT_HEAVNZ002_01727_SEQ_04: Cliaux thanks you for your help in setting her plans into motion. She tells you that conflicts with the Dravanian Horde make even simple airship deliveries a trying task, but the cooperation of the astrologians and machinists, under the guidance of the Holy See, has ensured safe passage through the skies of Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNZ003_01728_SEQ_00: Gibrillont is never one to leave a patron fallen in the dumps.
TEXT_HEAVNZ003_01728_SEQ_01: A regular of the Forgotten Knight has fallen on hard times, and Gibrillont is counting on a bottle of mulled wine to grant him a few moments of solace. Take the bottle that Gibrillont has given you to the bibulous bloke in the basement.
TEXT_HEAVNZ003_01728_SEQ_02: You hand over the wine to the bibulous bloke, who still seems to be reeling at the recent course of events in his life. He tells you the lady of the noble house he served was accused of heresy, leading to a series of events that ultimately ruined the family and cost him his employment. But rather than drown his sorrows in wine, he asks that you take the bottle to his former lord, as a token of appreciation for allowing him to serve the family. Deliver the bottle of mulled wine to the title-stripped lord, who you are like to find near the airship landing.
TEXT_HEAVNZ003_01728_SEQ_03: You see the bottle of wine into the hands of the title-stripped noble. While he is touched at his former knight's concern, he has already resigned himself to the judgment of Halone, and has prepared to take an airship to parts unknown with his son. However, his son is missing, and he is starting to worry. He asks that you find his son before they are late for the flight.
TEXT_HEAVNZ003_01728_SEQ_04: You find the former noble's son standing not far from the Supreme Sacred Tribunal, where his mother stood trial. His father vowed to do all within his power to save the boy's mother and see justice served. Unfortunately, justice was not what they expected it to be. As the boy turns to leave for the airship landing, he cannot help but wish there was more he could have done to protect his mother.
TEXT_HEAVNZ004_01729_SEQ_00: Mathye is looking for an adventurer who is not afraid of a little hard work.
TEXT_HEAVNZ004_01729_SEQ_01: Mathye can sense you are eager to add a few coins to your purse and makes you an offer. He needs a sack of chocobo fodder delivered to the Holy Stables in Foundation. Although he was paid up front, there is an additional charge to be paid upon receiving the fodder. He says you are welcome to whatever money they offer if you deliver the fodder for him. Pick up the sack of chocobo fodder for delivery.
TEXT_HEAVNZ004_01729_SEQ_02: You pick up the sack of chocobo fodder. Deliver the sack of chocobo fodder to the Holy Stables in Foundation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ004_01729_SEQ_03: You deliver the fodder to a most gracious stable master. She tells you of their work breeding cavalry chocobos. However, when she turns to introduce her assistant, he is nowhere to be found. She suspects he has gone to see the chocobos battle at the Lightfeather Proving Grounds and asks you to call him back to the stables. Head to the Lightfeather Proving Grounds and search for the stable master's assistant.
TEXT_HEAVNZ004_01729_SEQ_04: You find Cevilia's assistant at the proving grounds, eagerly awaiting the next match to begin. He speaks to you about his passion for chocobos and he soon reveals he works at the Holy Stables. After telling him that Cevilia is searching for him, he suddenly turns pale and runs out of the proving grounds. Report back to Cevilia and ensure the stableman has returned to work.
TEXT_HEAVNZ004_01729_SEQ_05: You return to the Holy Stables, and Cevilia subsequently informs you that the stableman came back not long ago. She goes on to tell you how Ishgard is famous for its chocobos, encouraging you to visit the Lightfeather Proving Grounds to see her birds in action. So long as the realm has need of finely bred chocobos, Cevilia seems determined to supply them.
TEXT_HEAVNZ005_01730_SEQ_00: Brictt is looking to keep warm tonight.
TEXT_HEAVNZ005_01730_SEQ_01: Brictt tells you of the recent attacks on Ishgard, and how many men and women are now left freezing on the streets of Foundation. He asks that you speak with Vaincannet at the Congregation of Our Knights Most Heavenly and request whatever firewood they can spare.
TEXT_HEAVNZ005_01730_SEQ_02: You speak with Vaincannet and make it clear to him just how dire the situation is in Foundation. Although there is no firewood to spare, he offers an alternate solution. A number of buildings were destroyed in a recent dragon attack, and the lumber from these buildings cannot be used again for construction. Therefore, you are welcome to use the scrap wood as fuel for the needed fires. Return to the Brume and show Brictt the bundle of scrap wood.
TEXT_HEAVNZ005_01730_SEQ_03: You show the bundle of scrap wood to Brictt, and the embers of hope in his eyes are rekindled. He asks that you ration out the wood to the freezing vagrants down below in the Brume.
TEXT_HEAVNZ005_01730_SEQ_04: You pass out the wood to several freezing vagrants, but there may still be others in need of a warm fire tonight. Continue searching for townsfolk in need of scrap wood.
TEXT_HEAVNZ005_01730_SEQ_05: You find a young Elezen girl cold and alone in an alleyway. You offer her scrap wood and she is overwhelmed by your hospitality─so much so that she offers to distribute the remaining scrap wood in your stead. Being intimately familiar with the Brume, she guarantees to have the job done without delay. Report to Brictt and tell him the good news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ005_01730_SEQ_06: Brictt is pleased to hear the people of the Brume will stay warm for another night. When you tell him of your young Elezen helper, however, his face turns stern. Osaulie, the child who ran off with the scrap wood, is well known for thievery, and now her antics have jeopardized the well-being of all those seeking respite from the cold. You need to retrieve the scrap wood before it is too late.
TEXT_HEAVNZ006_01731_SEQ_00: Torsefers seeks assistance with a rather delicate issue.
TEXT_HEAVNZ006_01731_SEQ_01: House Fortemps is preparing to host a banquet, and invitations must be delivered to the other High Houses. Assuming you will be unable to meet with the lords and ladies of each house, Torsefers asks that you deliver invitations to the guards standing watch at each house.
TEXT_HEAVNZ006_01731_SEQ_02: You speak with Bartelot at Haillenarte Manor and hand him the banquet invitation. He regretfully informs you that, although his lord would be pleased by the invitation, he has been kept busy in the wake of recent Dravanian assaults and matters concerning heretics. Move on to Dzemael Manor and deliver the next invitation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ006_01731_SEQ_03: You reach Dzemael Manor to find Jainelette standing guard outside. She tells you that her lord has been preoccupied with the restoration of Falcon's Nest and has little time for aught else. Nevertheless, she promises to see the invitation delivered. Proceed to Durendaire Manor to deliver the last invitation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ006_01731_SEQ_04: You deliver the invitation to Framoncis standing guard at Durendaire Manor, and he finds the proposed banquet to be suspect at best. He goes on to tell you that House Durendaire and House Fortemps are not on good terms. He agrees to deliver the invitation if only to prevent undue tension between the two houses. Report to Torsefers and inform him the invitations have been delivered.
TEXT_HEAVNZ006_01731_SEQ_05: You return to Torsefers empty-handed, and he is thankful for your assistance. He tells you that the four High Houses are descended from the heroes who helped establish Ishgard. Although they are a formidable alliance in the face of their Dravanian enemies, they are quick to turn on one another when seeking political clout. He warns you to be careful, as making new friends may also result in new enemies.
TEXT_HEAVNZ007_01732_SEQ_00: Noirterel grows worried about the supply stores at Falcon's Nest.
TEXT_HEAVNZ007_01732_SEQ_01: Noirterel has asked you to gather meat for him. Kill three steinbocks and obtain their meat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ007_01732_SEQ_02: You slay the steinbocks and butcher their carcasses. Return to Noirterel with the meat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ007_01732_SEQ_03: Noirterel explains that, as a key strategic location, Falcon's Nest must withstand some of the Horde's most vicious attacks. These onslaughts take the form of both direct, frontal assaults and long, drawn-out sieges. The meat you recovered will be frozen and stored for use as emergency rations in the event that supply lines are severed.
TEXT_HEAVNZ008_01733_SEQ_01: A large amount of supplies were recently stolen from Falcon's Nest. Auriaune asks you to be on the lookout for a group of suspicious characters moving a large crate of Ishgardian supplies in the Coerthas area.
TEXT_HEAVNZ008_01733_SEQ_02: You have found the thieves and dealt with them. Return the stolen crate to Auriaune at Falcon's Nest.
TEXT_HEAVNZ008_01733_SEQ_03: Auriaune thanks you for recovering the stolen goods. She also finds something curious within the crate: a feather ornament. She is able to identify it as being from the Sixth Astral Era, but can tell no more than that. She asks you to take it to Sigan, a local man who collects relics from that period.
TEXT_HEAVNZ008_01733_SEQ_04: Sigan thanks you for the ornament. He points out that they were a common sight in Falcon's Nest─before the Calamity, that is.
TEXT_HEAVNZ009_01734_SEQ_00: Sigan is reminiscing about the past.
TEXT_HEAVNZ009_01734_SEQ_01: Sigan tells you that he collects antiques from the now-buried village at Falcon's Nest from the Sixth Astral Era. He explains that the villagers' belongings are all buried deep beneath the snowdrifts. He asks you to keep a keen eye out for any relics buried in the snow.
TEXT_HEAVNZ009_01734_SEQ_02: You have found several artifacts from the Sixth Astral Era. Return them to Sigan.
TEXT_HEAVNZ009_01734_SEQ_03: Sigan graciously accepts your finds. The Holy See's restoration of Falcon's Nest has completely changed the area. The old village he once called home has been left beneath the snow, while the fortress grows taller and more imposing than ever before.
TEXT_HEAVNZ010_01735_SEQ_00: Ysaudore peers over the cliff with concern.
TEXT_HEAVNZ010_01735_SEQ_01: The area around Camp Riversmeet was once a field of rich, rolling meadows. Now it is a frozen wasteland, home to fierce, hungry wolves. Ysaudore seems intent on driving these beasts away and has entrusted you with a mission: slay three silver wolves.
TEXT_HEAVNZ010_01735_SEQ_02: You have slain the wolves as requested. Return to Ysaudore, and let her hear of your success.
TEXT_HEAVNZ010_01735_SEQ_03: Ysaudore thanks you for your hard work. Camp Riversmeet once served as a military outpost, quartering Ishgardian troops and facilitating patrols of the surrounding area. Ysaudore hopes to see the camp reclaimed and the area made safe once more.
TEXT_HEAVNZ011_01736_SEQ_00: Ingaret lets out a long, forlorn sigh.
TEXT_HEAVNZ011_01736_SEQ_01: Ingaret had hoped for an opportunity to search the frozen docks near Camp Riversmeet for her grandfather's lost things, but cannot leave her post unmanned. With feral beasts prowling the docks, she cannot send just anyone to search the area in her place─she decides that you are just the  for the job. Prove her judgment sound by negotiating the wildlife and returning with her grandfather's trappings.
TEXT_HEAVNZ011_01736_SEQ_02: After scouring the docks, you find everything you can that matches Ingaret's description. Return these items to her at Falcon's Nest.
TEXT_HEAVNZ011_01736_SEQ_03: Ingaret thanks you for recovering her grandfather's trappings─reminders of his time as a ferryman at Riversmeet. As mementos of the duty and responsibilities he left behind when fleeing the highlands, she hopes they will help him rediscover the purpose he has lost in his life in recent years.
TEXT_HEAVNZ012_01737_SEQ_00: The hot-tempered knight is trying to catch his breath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ012_01737_SEQ_01: A knight was attacked by a large swarm of frost grenades. He escaped unharmed, but they tore apart his magic talisman and escaped with the pieces! Slay these thieving critters and recover the three pieces of the magic talisman.
TEXT_HEAVNZ012_01737_SEQ_02: You successfully recover the pieces of the talisman. Return them to the knight at Gorgagne Mills.
TEXT_HEAVNZ012_01737_SEQ_03: The knight is relieved that you were able to recover all the pieces of his talisman. He tells you how his family made it for him from an ice crystal. Realizing that the freezing Coerthan snowdrifts are hardly the ideal place to carry ice crystals on one's person, he decides to leave the talisman in the barracks next time he goes on duty.
TEXT_HEAVNZ013_01738_SEQ_00: Caribault is taking stock of the pumpkin patch, but with an odd sense of dejection.
TEXT_HEAVNZ013_01738_SEQ_01: You speak with Caribault, asking what work there is to be done about Camp Cloudtop. He tells you all about the trouble being caused by wild gastornis, which have destroyed the camp's crops on a number of occasions. In the hopes of thinning their numbers, he asks that you slay three of the feathered fiends in his stead. And not wanting to waste the opportunity, he also asks you to retrieve the meat from the gastornis you fell.
TEXT_HEAVNZ013_01738_SEQ_02: You have dispatched the gastornis and obtained three chunks of their meat. Report back to Caribault with your bounty.
TEXT_HEAVNZ013_01738_SEQ_03: Caribault is relieved to hear of your success in culling the gastornis population. The gastornis meat, he tells you, will be a much-needed reprieve from the dreary salt-cured meats the men about camp are accustomed to. The merits of your work are twofold: a safer harvest and more appetizing provisions for the men of Camp Cloudtop.
TEXT_HEAVNZ014_01739_SEQ_00: Though the Rose Knight cook seems exhausted, the fire in her eyes tells of work to be done.
TEXT_HEAVNZ014_01739_SEQ_01: The Rose Knight cook has prepared packed meals for the men and women of Camp Cloudtop. In her old age, however, their delivery proves more difficult than she would care to admit. Determined to see her hard work is not wasted, she asks you to distribute three sets of packed meals in her stead. Pick up the packed meals and prepare to make your delivery.
TEXT_HEAVNZ014_01739_SEQ_02: You pick up the three sets of packed meals. See them safely to the knights of Camp Cloudtop.
TEXT_HEAVNZ014_01739_SEQ_03: You have delivered all of the packed meals, garnering you many thanks for temporarily relieving the resident cook of her duties. Head back and speak with the Rose Knight cook.
TEXT_HEAVNZ014_01739_SEQ_04: Though she lacks the vigor to jump for joy, her look of gratitude is unmistakable as she conveys the pleasure she takes in preparing their meals. Though the thinner air of the Sea of Clouds is harsh in her old age, she assures you a meal cooked by their hands is equally unkind, vowing to continue to work so long as she is able.
TEXT_HEAVNZ015_01740_SEQ_00: Gildon seeks an adventurer of exceptional renown.
TEXT_HEAVNZ015_01740_SEQ_01: Gildon is beside himself with disappointment at the state of affairs at Camp Cloudtop. As he tells it, the men and women stationed there are those found to be of little or no use elsewhere. This subtle form of demotion has left them disheartened, carrying out their duties with an empty sense of obligation. But Gildon is determined to reignite the fire in their bellies with proper nourishment. To achieve this goal, however, he must convince the quartermaster Fabrellet to make reforms to the shipment and distribution of provisions. Gildon believes Fabrellet will not listen to him, but may lend his ear to a reputable adventurer. Speak with Fabrellet, and see if he might relent on the issue.
TEXT_HEAVNZ015_01740_SEQ_02: You propose the idea of improving the camp's provisions, but behind your words, Fabrellet can only hear the rumblings of Gildon's stomach. Those discontent with what they are given are free to forage for themselves, and Fabrellet believes he should do just that. To ease Gildon into taking this initiative, or at the very least quell his rumbling belly, Fabrellet asks you to procure a particular variety of mushroom known to be both nutritious and filling.
TEXT_HEAVNZ015_01740_SEQ_03: You have found a cloud mushroom. Deliver it to Gildon that he may focus less on his hunger and more on his duties.
TEXT_HEAVNZ015_01740_SEQ_04: You deliver the cloud mushroom to Gildon, and his interest in your delectable offering nearly distracts him from the matter at hand─your talks with Fabrellet. Gildon is taken aback by Fabrellet's insinuation that he only means to satisfy a selfish desire for heartier meals. Though his plan bore no fruit, Gildon has not been deterred from his goal, and is determined to find a new way to reinvigorate the camp.
TEXT_HEAVNZ016_01741_SEQ_00: Gildon requires aid that he may embolden his comrades.
TEXT_HEAVNZ016_01741_SEQ_01: Gildon continues his quest to revitalize the spirit of Camp Cloudtop. To achieve this goal, he means to slay a dragon together with his men. This plan will fall through, however, if no dragons can be found in the area. Still waiting to be relieved from sentry duty, he asks that you gather information from the guards about Camp Cloudtop. Speak with the guards, then venture off in search of his prey.
TEXT_HEAVNZ016_01741_SEQ_02: You speak with the men standing guard about Camp Cloudtop. While none have seen leathery hide nor tail of dragons, one guard suspects they are being watched as they continue repairs of the Protector. Search the area for what may be monitoring the camp and prepare yourself for the worst.
TEXT_HEAVNZ016_01741_SEQ_03: While hunting for dragons, you find a Vanu atop a cliff with a clear view of Camp Cloudtop. The Vanu engages you, but is no match for your long-proven skill in combat. Report back to Gildon and tell him of your findings.
TEXT_HEAVNZ016_01741_SEQ_04: You tell Gildon of the Vanu, but he is disappointed rather than surprised. Uninterested in the threat of Vanu, he continues his search for a way to motivate his men.
TEXT_HEAVNZ017_01742_SEQ_00: This House Durendaire knight needs an adventurer who can keep a secret.
TEXT_HEAVNZ017_01742_SEQ_01: Seeing you are not native to Ishgard, a knight of House Durendaire requests a favor of you. He asks that you deliver a gift to Falcon's Nest. What the gift is, he is not at liberty to say. All he can tell you is that the knight of the brush has a package waiting for you at the Forgotten Knight.
TEXT_HEAVNZ017_01742_SEQ_02: You arrive at the Forgotten Knight, and the knight of the brush recognizes you right away. He hands you the package, insisting that you do not open the box. It is not safe to be seen out in the open. He insists that you head to Falcon's Nest and deliver the package to Emerissel. And if anyone asks, you and the knight of the brush have never met.
TEXT_HEAVNZ017_01742_SEQ_03: Emerissel is curious why you give him such strange looks─that is, until he sees the package. One glimpse of the painting wrapped inside sends him into the throes of a strange euphoric experience, ranting about renewed religious fervor. He soon regains his composure and asks you to keep this all secret. However, you cannot shake the feeling that you have done something terribly wrong.
TEXT_HEAVNZ018_01743_SEQ_01: Lord Emmanellain has tasked Torsefers with delivering a letter to Lady Laniaitte at the Rosehouse in the Sea of Clouds. Fearing that something may go wrong─and thereby incurring the wrath of Lord Emmanellain─Torsefers asks you to deliver it in his stead.
TEXT_HEAVNZ018_01743_SEQ_02: You deliver the letter to Lady Laniaitte, and the overpowering fragrance of roses tells her immediately who sent it. As she tells it, she and Lord Emmanellain have known one another since childhood. Though he is a man grown, his behavior can still be childish at times.
TEXT_HEAVNZ019_01744_SEQ_00: Ingaret is muttering something about bridge repairs.
TEXT_HEAVNZ019_01744_SEQ_01: Ingaret has been tasked with driving away the upland mylodons on the far side of the Black Iron Bridge. The bridge needs repairs, but the craftsmen cannot work safely when there are monsters within pouncing distance. Ingaret is not confident that she can take on so many beasts at once, so kill three of the monsters and she will finish off the rest.
TEXT_HEAVNZ019_01744_SEQ_02: You make short work of the mylodons. Return to Ingaret so she can do her part.
TEXT_HEAVNZ019_01744_SEQ_03: Ingaret thanks you for your help and pays you your share of the bounty on the beasts. She also tells you about a farm on the far side of the bridge. It has fallen into disrepair, but if the mylodons are driven away completely, it might be possible to rebuild it.
TEXT_HEAVNZ020_01745_SEQ_00: Redwald is looking for someone to carry out an investigation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ020_01745_SEQ_01: Redwald informs you that a mysterious sickness has suddenly taken hold of a great many men in the Falcon's Nest garrison. Suspecting foul play, but lacking the manpower to mount a full investigation, he has turned to you for help. Speak to troops in the fortress and see what you can find out.
TEXT_HEAVNZ020_01745_SEQ_02: You have gathered information from several soldiers in the area: it seems that everyone who fell sick did so shortly after eating dinner. Return to Redwald and report on what you have discovered.
TEXT_HEAVNZ020_01745_SEQ_03: All meals go past the head chef, Noirterel. Speak with him and find out what he knows about this issue.
TEXT_HEAVNZ020_01745_SEQ_04: Noirterel personally checks the quality and freshness of all ingredients used in meals served to the troops. However, he does not drink and so cannot vouch for the wine served with dinner. Suspecting the wine to be at fault, he asks you to recover the empty wine bottles from the sutler at the airship landing so that they can be checked for traces of contaminants.
TEXT_HEAVNZ020_01745_SEQ_05: The sutler tells you that the bottles should still be on the airship landing somewhere, but offers no further assistance.
TEXT_HEAVNZ020_01745_SEQ_06: You have found the empty bottles. Take them back to Noirterel.
TEXT_HEAVNZ020_01745_SEQ_07: Noirterel confirms his suspicions. The bottles carry a strange, barely detectable odor─one that definitely shouldn't be there. Take one of the bottles to Redwald and inform him of the situation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ020_01745_SEQ_08: Redwald is shocked to discover that someone would poison the wine, but glad to have found the cause for the illness striking his soldiers. He thanks you for your assistance and hints at his intention to see this investigation through to its conclusion.
TEXT_HEAVNZ021_01746_SEQ_00: Redwald wants to make the next move in his investigation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ021_01746_SEQ_01: Redwald wants you to go to Auriaune and show her the bottle that contained the poisoned wine. She is in charge of logistics at Falcon's Nest and should be able to determine who would have had chance to poison the wine.
TEXT_HEAVNZ021_01746_SEQ_02: Auriaune realizes that the poisoned wine was in the crate of stolen supplies that you previously recovered for her. She posits that the thieves poisoned the wine under the assumption that the crate would be recovered. It has since come to light that these men were not working alone. They had accomplices who have been sighted several times at Camp Riversmeet. Go there, find these heretics, and question them.
TEXT_HEAVNZ021_01746_SEQ_03: The heretics attack you, but not before gloating that the poison they used was made from dragon venom. There is no known antidote. Report to Redwald with this grim news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ021_01746_SEQ_04: Redwald, having been informed of the situation by Auriaune, was ready and waiting for your report. He is not surprised to hear of the heretics' involvement and is resolved to finding an antidote to the poison before it is too late.
TEXT_HEAVNZ022_01747_SEQ_00: Redwald is eager to continue his investigation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ022_01747_SEQ_01: Redwald is desperate to find an antidote to the poison afflicting his troops. He provides you with a report outlining the patients' symptoms and asks you to deliver it to Noirterel. He hopes that he might be able to help develop a cure.
TEXT_HEAVNZ022_01747_SEQ_02: Though Noirterel does not know how to develop an antidote, he is reminded of a book, predating the Calamity, that described a poison-breathing dragon. He does not know any more himself, but suspects this dragon may be the source of the poison afflicting the troops. Someone more knowledgeable about the Sixth Astral Era might be more helpful. Find Sigan and show him Redwald's report.
TEXT_HEAVNZ022_01747_SEQ_03: Sigan relates an old Coerthan tale describing the source of the dragons' poisonous breath─a deadly and poisonous type of brambleweed known as thorny viper. A creature that nests near Gorgagne Mills, the blackblood zu, eats this same toxic plant. Whatever grants the zu immunity to the thorny viper may hold the key to creating an antidote to the dragon poison ultimately stemming from the same root. Sigan provides you with an ember and some fragrant herbs. Travel to Gorgagne Mills, use the herbs to lure the zu from its nest, and retrieve its blood.
TEXT_HEAVNZ022_01747_SEQ_04: You find a conveniently located brazier and light it with the ember. Use this hearty fire to burn the aromatic herbs and draw the zu from hiding.
TEXT_HEAVNZ022_01747_SEQ_05: The burning herbs will soon attract the zu. Lie in wait for the beast. When it appears, kill it and take its precious blood.
TEXT_HEAVNZ022_01747_SEQ_06: You have slain the zu. Return to Sigan with its blood.
TEXT_HEAVNZ022_01747_SEQ_07: No sooner do you deliver the blood to Sigan than Redwald appears. He apologizes wholeheartedly for disregarding the hard-earned wisdom of Coerthas' native citizens. He sends for Ishgard's finest alchemists to refine the zu blood into an antidote and pledges to repay Sigan's assistance with the hospitality he deserves.
TEXT_HEAVNZ023_01748_SEQ_00: Laniaitte seeks an adventurer with a delicate touch.
TEXT_HEAVNZ023_01748_SEQ_01: Laniaitte asks you to obtain a wing sample from a gaelicat, an adorable yet ferocious cloudkin native to the surrounding area. She warns you, however, that these creatures are very delicate. Only a perfectly preserved sample will suffice, and she doubts that she or her men could fell them while leaving their leathery appendages intact. No matter how many gaelicats it takes, she implores you to retrieve one of their wings.
TEXT_HEAVNZ023_01748_SEQ_02: You have slain several gaelicats to no avail. But as Laniaitte said, you must not grow disheartened. Continue slaying gaelicats in search of a suitable sample.
TEXT_HEAVNZ023_01748_SEQ_03: You obtain an undamaged wing from the gaelicats. Deliver the specimen to Laniaitte.
TEXT_HEAVNZ023_01748_SEQ_04: You return to the Rosehouse with the sample, and Laniaitte is more than impressed by your delicate precision. As it turns out, the wing sample was requested by Atelloune, a naturalist of no small renown, who is hard at work on an article for New Eorzean Geographic. Her piece on cloudkin physiology is sure to be a smashing success due in no small part to your assistance.
TEXT_HEAVNZ024_01749_SEQ_00: Gildon seeks help to learn more of the Vanu's plans.
TEXT_HEAVNZ024_01749_SEQ_01: Gildon informs you that, according to reports from the other men, your tussle with the Vanu atop the cliff northeast of camp was not a one-off encounter. In fact, they believe the Vanu are conducting routine surveillance of the area. The only question that remains is to what end, and Gildon requests your assistance in finding the answer. Travel northeast to where you were assaulted by the Vanu and search for clues to what they are planning.
TEXT_HEAVNZ024_01749_SEQ_02: Returning to where you last encountered the Vanu scout, another has taken its place, peering out into the distance toward Camp Cloudtop. You make short work of the beastman spy, and find a strange bone in his possession.
TEXT_HEAVNZ024_01749_SEQ_03: You pick up the bone and decide it may be a clue. Return to Camp Cloudtop to have Gildon examine it.
TEXT_HEAVNZ024_01749_SEQ_04: You return to Camp Cloudtop and hand over the gnawed bone to Gildon. Inspecting it more closely reveals a strange pattern scratched into its surface. With this newest clue, the search for the truth has sparked a fire in Gildon. Perhaps this will lead to rekindling the spirits of his fellow cavalrymen.
TEXT_HEAVNZ101_01750_SEQ_00: The weather is cold, but Bohemondas seems red hot with anger.
TEXT_HEAVNZ101_01750_SEQ_01: As Bohemondas tells it, the knights of Ishgard plan to make his former home into a military encampment. This has upset Bohemondas greatly, made worse by the fact that his son has enlisted to help. He asks that should you see him, you present him with two choices: return to his family or forfeit them for good. Travel to Falcon's Nest and relay Bohemondas's message to his son.
TEXT_HEAVNZ101_01750_SEQ_02: You arrive at Falcon's Nest, and tell Josseloux of his father's plea to return home. Josseloux is not swayed by his father's words. While the appearance of Falcon's Nest may change, he promises to protect the traditions he believes make it the home they cherish.
TEXT_HEAVNZ102_01751_SEQ_00: This Hyur seems vexed by the memory of forgotten promises.
TEXT_HEAVNZ102_01751_SEQ_01: You happen across a young man torn between personal desires and obligations. As a young boy, he promised he would wed when he came of age. This runs counter to his present goal of becoming a Temple Knight, which forbids marriage while undertaking training. He shamefully admits he cannot recall the girl's name, but remembers she was a ward of House Haillenarte. He asks that you find her and tell her she need not worry of fulfilling their promise. Speak with Bartelot outside Haillenarte Manor and see what you can discover.
TEXT_HEAVNZ102_01751_SEQ_02: You speak with Bartelot at Haillenarte Manor. While there is no shortage of wards under the care of their house, he supposes Lady Laniaitte would be of an age with the woman you seek. Speak with Lady Laniaitte at the Rosehouse in the Sea of Clouds and see what she knows.
TEXT_HEAVNZ102_01751_SEQ_03: You speak with Lady Laniaitte and learn she has heard of no such promises of marriage. However, she is certain that Marielle is of the right age for the girl you are after. Speak with Marielle about the promised marriage.
TEXT_HEAVNZ102_01751_SEQ_04: Marielle confirms that she is in fact the woman you are looking for. To your surprise, however, she is indifferent to the message you bring to her. She too forgot the promise to marry many ages ago, and is committed to serving Lady Laniaitte at the Rosehouse.
TEXT_HEAVNZ103_01752_SEQ_00: The widow is gazing mournfully at the bunch of flowers she is carrying.
TEXT_HEAVNZ103_01752_SEQ_01: A well-mannered widow wants to pay her respects at her husband's grave, but is unable to make the long journey to Gorgagne Mills. Take her flowers to the farm and place them on her husband's grave for her.
TEXT_HEAVNZ103_01752_SEQ_02: You place the flowers on the grave. Return to the widow and let her know that her respects have been paid.
TEXT_HEAVNZ103_01752_SEQ_03: The widow tells you that her husband was once tutor to the heir to House Durendaire. The bright young boy was a true prodigy, but he went missing one day during an excursion and was never seen again. The man never recovered from this loss and left the employ of the house to become a farmer, starting the farm at Gorgagne Mills.
TEXT_HEAVNZ104_01753_SEQ_00: The spiteful knight is staring wistfully out over the frozen lake.
TEXT_HEAVNZ104_01753_SEQ_01: A knight reflects upon the great battles once fought over the Dusk Vigil. The remains of those who fell in combat rest peacefully at the bottom of the lake, but gelati now wander its surface, sullying their memory and marring the lake's beauty. He bids you slay these disrespectful monsters.
TEXT_HEAVNZ104_01753_SEQ_02: You slay the gelati as requested. Let the knight know that the resting place of his brothers-in-arms is a little bit more tranquil now.
TEXT_HEAVNZ104_01753_SEQ_03: The old veteran thanks you for your work. Without the gelati obscuring his vision, the great lake surrounding the Dusk Vigil once more appears like it did in the days of his youth.
TEXT_HEAVNZ105_01754_SEQ_00: The nonplussed noblewoman is looking up into the parapets with a panicked expression.
TEXT_HEAVNZ105_01754_SEQ_01: A noblewoman's beloved pet has gotten itself into quite a pickle. She has found her way up onto the roof and cannot get down. Help the poor thing get back down to the ground.
TEXT_HEAVNZ105_01754_SEQ_02: You rescue the kitten. It is suspiciously coeurl-like, but take it back to the noblewoman anyway─she promised a reward!
TEXT_HEAVNZ105_01754_SEQ_03: The woman is overjoyed to have her pet back safe and sound. You try to inform her that it seems more like a coeurl pup than a cat, but she is thoroughly convinced that it is an adorable kitten. All you can do now is to pray for her safety.
TEXT_HEAVNZ106_01755_SEQ_00: The uneasy air about Laniaitte can only mean trouble.
TEXT_HEAVNZ106_01755_SEQ_01: Laniaitte informs you that weapons and armor have been stolen from their storehouse. Although she dispatched men to retrieve them, she has yet to receive word of their progress and fears the Vanu are to blame. Knowing that they planned to begin searching around Vundu Ok' Bendu, Laniaitte asks that you head there and look for signs of the Rose Knights.
TEXT_HEAVNZ106_01755_SEQ_02: You arrive at Vundu Ok' Bendu and find a wounded soldier. He tells you the lieutenant crossed a nearby bridge heading further into Vanu territory.
TEXT_HEAVNZ106_01755_SEQ_03: You find the lieutenant whole of body, if somewhat worse for wear. With the camp's weapons and armor still in the Vanu's possession and his subordinates now scattered, completing their mission will not be an easy feat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ107_01756_SEQ_00: Gildon is at a complete loss.
TEXT_HEAVNZ107_01756_SEQ_01: Unable to make neither heads nor tails of the bone, Gildon asks you to show it to others in the hopes that they might offer some insight into its meaning. Present the bone to the knights of Camp Cloudtop and see what they have to say.
TEXT_HEAVNZ107_01756_SEQ_02: Alas, none of the Rose Knights know what to make of the bone's markings─or, in the case of Fabrellet, are inclined to care. On the bright side, the quartermaster mentions that a shipment of provisions is scheduled to arrive soon. Perhaps this news will serve to lift Gildon's spirits.
TEXT_HEAVNZ107_01756_SEQ_03: Upon hearing of the shipment, Gildon has an epiphany: the Vanu were using the bone to count the days between shipments, which always include a substantial quantity of crystals. Believing that the beastmen intend to launch an attack, he goes to warn Lady Laniaitte, and bids you warn Fabrellet in his stead.
TEXT_HEAVNZ107_01756_SEQ_04: Fabrellet is unwilling to lend credence to Gildon's fears, and suggests that you make for the Protector if you are so concerned for the shipment's welfare.
TEXT_HEAVNZ107_01756_SEQ_05: You board the Protector and find a Vanu preparing to flee with his prize. However, you make quick work of him and his allies. Examine the shipment to see that everything is accounted for.
TEXT_HEAVNZ107_01756_SEQ_06: So far as you can tell, the Vanu were unable to steal any of the provisions. Return to Fabrellet and inform him that there was indeed a Vanu raid, and that you have foiled it.
TEXT_HEAVNZ107_01756_SEQ_07: Fabrellet and Lady Laniaitte are pleased to learn that, thanks to you, the shipment is secure. At your insistence, the commander recognizes Gildon for his part in uncovering the Vanu's plans, offering him the opportunity to serve elsewhere, should it be his desire. Gildon declines, however, stating that his sole desire is to rekindle the spirits of his fellow knights. To that end, he proposes that he and the others partake of the provisions in celebration. Though Fabrellet scoffs at the idea, Lady Laniaitte agrees, and bids the quartermaster make it known whom the Rose Knights have to thank for their boon.
TEXT_HEAVNZ108_01757_SEQ_00: Terremiaux is gravely concerned for the well-being of his subordinates.
TEXT_HEAVNZ108_01757_SEQ_01: Having sorely underestimated their enemy, Terremiaux finds himself separated from his subordinates. As they attempt to stay out of the Vanu's reach, he would ask you find them and see they withdraw from Vundu Ok' Bendu. Search for his three missing subordinates and relay his orders to withdraw.
TEXT_HEAVNZ108_01757_SEQ_02: You have relayed orders to all missing subordinates. Report to Terremiaux.
TEXT_HEAVNZ108_01757_SEQ_03: You return to Terremiaux, and his relief at the return of his subordinates is palpable. Nevertheless, there is still work to be done, and Terremiaux would ask you help him see his mission through.
TEXT_HEAVNZ109_01758_SEQ_00: Terremiaux has the look of a man who hates unfinished business.
TEXT_HEAVNZ109_01758_SEQ_01: With his subordinates safe, Terremiaux can at last return to his original task─the retrieval of stolen weapons and armor. And to avoid the pitfalls of his initial undertaking, he has devised a plan. First, he will create a diversion to draw the attention of as many Vanu as he can. This will offer you the chance to reclaim the equipment with diminished resistance.
TEXT_HEAVNZ109_01758_SEQ_02: You have successfully retrieved all the stolen equipment. Return beyond the bridge to Vundu Ok' Bendu and speak with Terremiaux.
TEXT_HEAVNZ109_01758_SEQ_03: You return to Terremiaux, and he is at a loss as to how to repay you. He asks that you return the equipment to Laniaitte back at camp and relay to her all that has transpired.
TEXT_HEAVNZ109_01758_SEQ_04: Laniaitte is relieved to hear the search party is safe and the equipment is all accounted for. Although the Vanu's sudden interest in finer weaponry concerns her, she is glad to have had the aid of such a capable adventurer, and foresees need of your skills again in the future.
TEXT_HEAVNZ110_01759_SEQ_00: Luciae stares out over the snowdrifts, a grim expression upon her face.
TEXT_HEAVNZ110_01759_SEQ_01: Polar bears have been stealing into the Convictory and helping themselves to the food supplies. Luciae has asked you to thin their numbers by killing four of the beasts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ110_01759_SEQ_02: You slay four polar bears, significantly reducing the threat they pose to the Convictory. Return to Luciae with the news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ110_01759_SEQ_03: Luciae is overjoyed to learn that someone has finally dealt with the polar bears. It would seem that the nobles she enjoined to do so have no interest in hunting beasts other than dragons, even when the beasts in question have been pillaging their stores with abandon...
TEXT_HEAVNZ111_01760_SEQ_00: Jantellot wants you to experience firsthand what life at the Convictory is like.
TEXT_HEAVNZ111_01760_SEQ_01: Jantellot wants you to know what life is like at the Convictory, and suggests a bit of hunting as an example. Though the Convictors slay dragons, Jantellot recommends a warm-up before confronting the Dravanian Horde itself. He suggests hunting rheums instead. Locate and slay three rheums.
TEXT_HEAVNZ111_01760_SEQ_02: You venture out into the highlands and slay the rheums as instructed. Return to Jantellot at the Convictory and let him know that you are ready for something a bit more draconic.
TEXT_HEAVNZ111_01760_SEQ_03: Jantellot congratulates you on your kills. It seems that the rheums were no match for you. But dragons are another thing altogether. He suggests you speak with him again sometime if you want to try your hand at the real thing.
TEXT_HEAVNZ112_01761_SEQ_00: Jantellot thinks you are ready to try your hand at hunting dragons.
TEXT_HEAVNZ112_01761_SEQ_01: In light of how easily you dispatched the rheums he previously tasked you with, Jantellot proposes that you hunt down some actual dragons this time. Archaeornis make up the vanguard of the Dravanian Horde, and a number of them roam the snowdrifts to the north of the camp, near Banepool. Jantellot tells you to find and slay three of these scaly, feathered beasts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ112_01761_SEQ_02: With relative ease, you seek out and slay three archaeornis. Return to the Convictory and let Jantellot know that you did not shirk from this challenge.
TEXT_HEAVNZ112_01761_SEQ_03: Impressed by the efficiency with which you slew your quarry, Jantellot explains that you would be more than welcome as a member of the Convictors, should you wish to join. They are always in need of more good men and women.
TEXT_HEAVNZ113_01762_SEQ_01: Dominiac wants to support Ser Aymeric, but cannot do so without first gaining glory slaying dragons. Unfortunately, he is not having much luck. He simply does not know much about what he is hunting. Lend him a hand by finding out what you can about these mysterious creatures.
TEXT_HEAVNZ113_01762_SEQ_02: The sly scout says he is happy to share his knowledge of dragons, but for a price. Do his patrol duty for him and he'll tell you what he knows.
TEXT_HEAVNZ113_01762_SEQ_03: You have completed the patrol duty as requested. Return to the scout at the Convictory and find out what he knows.
TEXT_HEAVNZ113_01762_SEQ_04: True to his word, the scout shares a useful secret about dragons. For reasons as yet unknown, the bodies of slain dragons seem to attract more powerful dragons. This has obvious tactical and strategic implications, but the scout implores you not to share this information, as it has the potential to be very, very dangerous. Tell Dominiac anyway.
TEXT_HEAVNZ113_01762_SEQ_05: Dominiac realizes that he can start with a small dragon and, by leaving its corpse, attract larger prey. By repeating this process, he can attract increasingly larger dragons until he gains the glory he seeks. Hopefully he will use this knowledge wisely.
TEXT_HEAVNZ114_01763_SEQ_00: Luciae is looking for someone to help keep her warm through the cold Coerthan nights.
TEXT_HEAVNZ114_01763_SEQ_01: The bitter cold of Coerthas is taking its toll upon the garrison's morale, and Luciae has asked you to help her supplement the Convictory's store of blankets by collecting yak wool for use in their creation. Slay three wooly yaks so that you can harvest their wool.
TEXT_HEAVNZ114_01763_SEQ_02: You slaughter the yaks and shear their carcasses. Deliver the wool to Luciae and collect your reward.
TEXT_HEAVNZ114_01763_SEQ_03: Luciae declares the wool to be of the highest quality she has ever seen. The thick, warm blankets she will make with it will do much to protect the garrison from the elements.
TEXT_HEAVNZ115_01764_SEQ_00: Dominiac is hoping for your assistance in executing a plan.
TEXT_HEAVNZ115_01764_SEQ_01: Dominiac asks for your help in executing his plan to lure out a powerful dragon. He has delegated most of the actual work to a new recruit at the Convictory─Saintrelmaux─and has asked you to help this talented but inexperienced man.
TEXT_HEAVNZ115_01764_SEQ_02: The first step of the plan is the acquisition of a Dravanian corpse. A rare breed of Dravanian─a tulihand─has been sighted near the large tree northeast of the camp. Meet with Saintrelmaux there.
TEXT_HEAVNZ115_01764_SEQ_03: You make short work of the tulihand. Check with Saintrelmaux for the next step of the plan.
TEXT_HEAVNZ115_01764_SEQ_04: Saintrelmaux thanks you for your assistance and tells you that he will handle transporting the body of the fallen beast to the Convictory. He tells you to go on ahead and inform Dominiac of the plan's success.
TEXT_HEAVNZ115_01764_SEQ_05: Dominiac is thrilled to hear that everything is going so well. He hints that future steps in his plan will be increasingly dangerous, but seems confident that, with your help, it will not be anything that cannot be handled.
TEXT_HEAVNZ116_01765_SEQ_00: Dominiac wants to enact the next step in his plan.
TEXT_HEAVNZ116_01765_SEQ_01: Saintrelmaux is preparing for the next step in Dominiac's plan. Dominiac asks you to travel to the top of the cliff north of the Convictory and provide any assistance that might be needed.
TEXT_HEAVNZ116_01765_SEQ_02: The tulihand you slew did indeed attract a larger dragon─a wadjet. It fled with the corpse of its thrall to beneath the cliff to the northwest. The men who tried to stop it were kicked aside by the skittering beast. Track it down and kill it while Saintrelmaux and his retainer tend to the wounded.
TEXT_HEAVNZ116_01765_SEQ_03: You track down and slay the wadjet. Report back to Saintrelmaux.
TEXT_HEAVNZ116_01765_SEQ_04: Saintrelmaux ponders the Dravanians' motivations behind collecting the bodies of their comrades. His retainer suggests that they respect their fallen warriors, but Saintrelmaux argues that even the Ishgardians do not afford their soldiers that courtesy. Regardless, they set off to gather the body of the wadjet. Report back to Dominiac and advise him of the plan's satisfactory progress.
TEXT_HEAVNZ116_01765_SEQ_05: Dominiac is pleased to hear that the information you gathered was indeed accurate─that the body of the weaker dragon attracted a more powerful one. With this success, he plans to attract ever more powerful Dravanians to slay.
TEXT_HEAVNZ117_01766_SEQ_00: Dominiac wants help with the next step of his plan.
TEXT_HEAVNZ117_01766_SEQ_01: Saintrelmaux has finished preparations for the next stage of Dominiac's plan and is waiting for you on the cliff to the north of the Convictory.
TEXT_HEAVNZ117_01766_SEQ_02: The bait has attracted an aevis, which takes the prize, but with Saintrelmaux's men in close pursuit. Hurry to where the bait was set─the bottom of the cliff northwest of the Convictory─and follow the trail from there.
TEXT_HEAVNZ117_01766_SEQ_03: With the aevis having fled west into Dragonspit, Saintrelmaux proposes a plan. He and his men will guard the exits and block its escape, allowing you to move in and dispose of it at your leisure.
TEXT_HEAVNZ117_01766_SEQ_04: You have dealt with the aevis. Let Saintrelmaux know.
TEXT_HEAVNZ117_01766_SEQ_05: Something about the beast you killed weighs heavily on Saintrelmaux. He says that these wretched creatures were once men, but he struggles to comprehend what could make a man change himself so. Leave Saintrelmaux to his thoughts and the job of collecting the aevis's corpse. Report back to Dominiac.
TEXT_HEAVNZ117_01766_SEQ_06: Dominiac thanks you once again for your help: he can now set the next stage of his plan in motion. He seems unsurprised by Saintrelmaux's ponderings, hoping simply that this experience will galvanize his resolve in the ongoing struggle with the Horde.
TEXT_HEAVNZ118_01767_SEQ_00: Jantellot will not stop moaning about his leg.
TEXT_HEAVNZ118_01767_SEQ_01: Jantellot tells you that, despite his remarkable combat abilities, he has suffered injury at the claws of a monstrous dragon. He bids you fetch some healing spring water from Dragonspit, supplying you with a bottle for the purpose.
TEXT_HEAVNZ118_01767_SEQ_02: You fill the bottle with water from the spring. Return it to Jantellot so that he might regain his strength.
TEXT_HEAVNZ118_01767_SEQ_03: You provide Jantellot with the spring's healing water. He explains that, while the Convictory's supplies─particularly of healing potions─are low, the water you retrieved is more effective than the strongest of potions...or so some people say.
TEXT_HEAVNZ119_01768_SEQ_00: Luciae keeps looking worriedly out towards the east.
TEXT_HEAVNZ119_01768_SEQ_01: Luciae sent a messenger out on a mission near Riversmeet. He should have returned long ago, but there is still no sign of him. Head out after him and find out what happened.
TEXT_HEAVNZ119_01768_SEQ_02: You find the missing man near Riversmeet as expected. He completed his mission but was attacked by a yeti and thrown from his chocobo. The steed saved his life by bravely drawing the beast away, but has not been seen since. The messenger returns to base to report to Luciae, but asks you to track down his beloved chocobo, Amberbeak, fearing for his safety.
