TEXT_HEAVNZ119_01768_SEQ_03: You find the chocobo─or rather, its corpse. You pluck a feather from its slowly freezing body, a token from the fallen bird. Take the feather back to the Convictory and break the grim news to Amberbeak's fretting owner.
TEXT_HEAVNZ119_01768_SEQ_04: The hope fades from the man's eyes as you hand him the feather. He is heartbroken to have lost his loyal companion, but appreciates you retrieving this memento of his cherished steed.
TEXT_HEAVNZ120_01769_SEQ_01: Saintrelmaux has been preparing the next step of Dominiac's plan, but he seems to be even more out of sorts than he normally is. He should be waiting near the base of the cliff to the north of the Convictory. Find him and find out what is wrong.
TEXT_HEAVNZ120_01769_SEQ_02: Saintrelmaux assures you that there is nothing wrong with him. The trap, however, does not seem to be working. The more powerful members of the Dravanian Horde seem to be much more cunning and wise. Perhaps there is something about the corpse that gives it away as a trap. Examine it and make sure there is nothing amiss.
TEXT_HEAVNZ120_01769_SEQ_03: The aevis corpse seems fine to you. Tell Saintrelmaux that you could not find anything wrong with it.
TEXT_HEAVNZ120_01769_SEQ_04: With no visible problems with the trap, the only option is to wait patiently for a Dravanian to take the bait.
TEXT_HEAVNZ120_01769_SEQ_05: You have slain the wyvern that was attracted by the dead aevis. Report back to Saintrelmaux.
TEXT_HEAVNZ120_01769_SEQ_06: Inform Dominiac that the plan has succeeded. Saintrelmaux will handle getting the slain beast back to the Convictory.
TEXT_HEAVNZ120_01769_SEQ_07: Dominiac thanks you for all your hard work. He asks you to check and make sure that Saintrelmaux has made it back to the camp safely.
TEXT_HEAVNZ120_01769_SEQ_08: Saintrelmaux has finished hauling the downed dragons back to the Convictory and is about to start examining the wyvern's body for abnormalities. Lend a hand!
TEXT_HEAVNZ120_01769_SEQ_09: Upon checking the wyvern's claws, you discover scales from both a tulihand and a wadjet─no doubt from the creatures you previously slew. Return them to Saintrelmaux.
TEXT_HEAVNZ120_01769_SEQ_10: Upon seeing the tulihand and wadjet scales, Saintrelmaux starts to realize the level of camaraderie among the Horde. Not to be outdone by the Dravanians, he pledges his life to the protection of those he knows and cares about─his friends and the people of Ishgard. Report to Dominiac that all is well.
TEXT_HEAVNZ120_01769_SEQ_11: Dominiac is pleased with the progress of the plan and with Saintrelmaux's newfound purpose. The young soldier's example could serve as a beacon to other lost youths and rally them to Ser Aymeric's cause.
TEXT_HEAVNZ201_01770_SEQ_00: Virgeaume seems to have chocobos on his mind.
TEXT_HEAVNZ201_01770_SEQ_01: Virgeaume has asked you to check on the two traps he set up: one is upstream of the Whilom River and the other lies to the east of Tailfeather. Check if the chocobo traps have caught anything.
TEXT_HEAVNZ201_01770_SEQ_02: It appears the chocobos that Virgeaume had intended to ensnare made off with the bait without triggering the traps. Bring him the sad news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ201_01770_SEQ_03: Although Virgeaume mourns the loss of his bait, he is surprised that the birds─and you─were able to avoid his cleverly dug pitfalls.
TEXT_HEAVNZ202_01771_SEQ_00: Marcechamp is looking for a reliable pair of feet.
TEXT_HEAVNZ202_01771_SEQ_01: Marcechamp has not heard from his three chocobo camps for a while, and wants to know how the hunting fares. Visit the leader of each camp and return to Marcechamp with their reports.
TEXT_HEAVNZ202_01771_SEQ_02: Each camp faces its own set of problems, with some more urgent than others. Return to Tailfeather and inform Marcechamp.
TEXT_HEAVNZ202_01771_SEQ_03: You relay the words of each camp leader to Marcechamp, who expresses his annoyance at their poor reporting habits. Marcechamp asks you to help out with the troubles of each camp.
TEXT_HEAVNZ203_01772_SEQ_00: Leonulfe is on the lookout for buzzing bugs.
TEXT_HEAVNZ203_01772_SEQ_01: Leonulfe is on the lookout for feather fleas, which have been terrorizing the camp's chocobos. Slay four of them to give the hunters a respite from the bugs.
TEXT_HEAVNZ203_01772_SEQ_02: The feather fleas will no longer be able to feast on chocobo blood. Return to the camp and tell Leonulfe that the task is done.
TEXT_HEAVNZ203_01772_SEQ_03: You inform Leonulfe that four fewer feather fleas will bother his birds. The hunters can sleep easy tonight knowing that the bugs will not be harassing the chocobos for some time.
TEXT_HEAVNZ204_01773_SEQ_00: Guenaret needs help calming a distressed chocobo.
TEXT_HEAVNZ204_01773_SEQ_01: The chocobo just taken by Guenaret has been crying out incessantly, and he asks that you return to the site of the capture─specifically to look out for a chocobo nest.
TEXT_HEAVNZ204_01773_SEQ_02: Upon investigating the site, you find several chocobo eggs lying in an undisturbed nest. Return to Guenaret and report your findings.
TEXT_HEAVNZ204_01773_SEQ_03: After returning to Guenaret, he informs you that a rule among hunters forbids the capture of chocobos that are nursing eggs. The future mother will be released back to her nest, ensuring the chocobo population remains stable.
TEXT_HEAVNZ205_01774_SEQ_00: Aimebert is in need of an adventurer to do his fighting for him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ205_01774_SEQ_01: Bandersnatches have been making easy meals of trapped chocobos. Aimebert bids you slay three of these opportunistic predators.
TEXT_HEAVNZ205_01774_SEQ_02: The bandersnatches are no longer a threat to the trapped chocobos. Inform Aimebert that his trapped birds are now safe.
TEXT_HEAVNZ205_01774_SEQ_03: Aimebert is pleased with the good news. He expresses regret that chocobos in his traps fell victim to hungry predators, and is grateful that no more birds will meet such grisly fates on his account.
TEXT_HEAVNZ206_01775_SEQ_00: Loupard is looking for someone to watch over a novice hunter.
TEXT_HEAVNZ206_01775_SEQ_01: Loupard has been kind enough to tell you everything you'd like to know about the hunters at Tailfeather. Among many other facts, you learn that the prospect of a quick fortune brings many inexperienced hunters to Tailfeather in hopes of joining in on the lucrative chocobo hunting trade. He introduces you to Q'yantaa, a young Miqo'te who wishes to fill her pockets in the Dravanian forelands. Loupard's explanation turns into a request when he explains to you that she is in need of a partner, entrusting you with the care of the fledgling hunter until he can find someone willing to team up with her. Speak to Q'yantaa to hear her plan and judge whether or not she has a hunter's instincts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ206_01775_SEQ_02: Q'yantaa, while inexperienced, already has a plan to catch her very first chocobo. One of the most difficult parts of catching the birds is tricking their keen sense of smell, which can detect the scent of even the most cautious hunter. Q'yantaa plans to use a fragrant mushroom called chandler's wick to mask the betraying odors, and asks you to gather several to be used in the chocobo traps. Head east of Tailfeather and let your nose guide you to where the mushrooms grow.
TEXT_HEAVNZ206_01775_SEQ_03: After gathering the mushrooms, you learn that “fragrant” was hardly the adequate word to use when describing their scent. Try to keep from retching while you return to Tailfeather and deliver the mushrooms to Q'yantaa.
TEXT_HEAVNZ206_01775_SEQ_04: Behind the hand covering her nose, you can tell that Q'yantaa is delighted that you managed to find the mushrooms she requires. Luckily, she volunteers to take care of the task of grinding the mushrooms into a powder to be mixed with the gysahl greens. Return to Loupard and tell him of your first successful operation together.
TEXT_HEAVNZ206_01775_SEQ_05: While Loupard remains skeptical that Q'yantaa's plan will work, he seems impressed at Q'yantaa's creativity. There may be hope for this novice hunter yet.
TEXT_HEAVNZ207_01776_SEQ_00: It looks like Loupard has some good news for you.
TEXT_HEAVNZ207_01776_SEQ_01: Loupard has received information that a lone chocobo has been spotted wandering around to the south of Tailfeather. He suggests that such an easy mark would make the ideal first catch for the novice hunter Q'yantaa. Speak to her and see if she has any ideas regarding catching the bird.
TEXT_HEAVNZ207_01776_SEQ_02: Q'yantaa's informed hunting strategy is to set up traps to the north of Tailfeather instead of the south, outwitting all of the other hunters. It becomes clear that while inexperienced, and sometimes over-enthusiastic, Q'yantaa does possess some measure of hunting instinct. Place her special concoction─some very fragrant gysahl greens─at the designated area to see if Q'yantaa's instincts bear any reward.
TEXT_HEAVNZ207_01776_SEQ_03: You have placed the fragrant greens, glad to be rid of their pungent odor. Speak with Q'yantaa at the chocobo hunters' camp to the north.
TEXT_HEAVNZ207_01776_SEQ_04: As if by fate, you hear the cry of a chocobo coming from where you set the trap just moments after you meet Q'yantaa in the northern camp. Hurry to see whether or not the chocobo fell for Q'yantaa's tricky concoction.
TEXT_HEAVNZ207_01776_SEQ_05: You find a chocobo asleep peacefully near where the trap was set, and Q'yantaa exclaims her happiness in a barely legible manner. Return to Tailfeather and report the success of your unlikely duo to Loupard.
TEXT_HEAVNZ207_01776_SEQ_06: Loupard can barely contain his disbelief when you tell him that Q'yantaa's scheme actually managed to catch something. Both he and you gain a newfound respect for the hunting instincts of the Miqo'te.
TEXT_HEAVNZ208_01777_SEQ_00: Loupard has finally found a potential partner for Q'yantaa.
TEXT_HEAVNZ208_01777_SEQ_01: Thanks to Q'yantaa's rising reputation in Tailfeather, Loupard finally has an eager volunteer for the position of her partner. Venture to the southeast of Tailfeather to inform Q'yantaa of the good news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ208_01777_SEQ_02: You find Q'yantaa staring diligently at a rock wall for reasons unknown and unexplained to you. After you inform her of Loupard's good news, she hurries off to Tailfeather before telling you exactly what it was she was doing. Return to Tailfeather and speak with Loupard to finally meet your potential replacement.
TEXT_HEAVNZ208_01777_SEQ_03: The partner that Loupard has found looks uncomfortable in the chocobo hunter's garb, and the disappointment is clear in Q'yantaa's expression. Since he seems hesitant to introduce himself, speak with him to lighten the mood.
TEXT_HEAVNZ208_01777_SEQ_04: It seems Q'yantaa has been busy using her hunter's instincts to find the best places for chocobo hunting, but she seems skeptical of her new partner's abilities. Once again, she asks you to help her hunt. Split up and investigate the trap locations for any signs of chocobos.
TEXT_HEAVNZ208_01777_SEQ_05: Try as you might, you fail to find any trace of chocobos in or around the traps. Return to Tailfeather and inform Q'yantaa of the bad news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ208_01777_SEQ_06: Q'yantaa seems surprisingly accepting of the fact that her instincts failed her, and instead she expresses her frustration at Gysol's tardiness. In a sudden show of compassion, her frustration turns to worry that her new partner might actually be in danger, and she resolves to go looking for him with you in tow. Accompany her to find the nervous hunter before some other beast does.
TEXT_HEAVNZ208_01777_SEQ_07: You find Gysol in a surprising situation: cooing over a chocobo hatchling which has apparently been separated from its parents. Despite Q'yantaa's protestations, Gysol resolves to take care of the chick himself, and to give up on chocobo hunting in favor of working in the stables. Return to Tailfeather and inform Loupard of this confusing hunting trip.
TEXT_HEAVNZ208_01777_SEQ_08: Loupard explains that hunters are not allowed to capture chocobo eggs or chicks, but decides to make an exception for Gysol considering that the chick would be helpless without him. With one more person in Eorzea realizing their dreams thanks to the Warrior of Light, you begin your search for Q'yantaa's partner anew.
TEXT_HEAVNZ209_01778_SEQ_00: Virgeaume needs someone to help him with his new trap.
TEXT_HEAVNZ209_01778_SEQ_01: Virgeaume has designed a new chocobo trap, and needs you to obtain a key component. Take yourself to the caves to the south and look for a lampshade mushroom.
TEXT_HEAVNZ209_01778_SEQ_02: You have obtained the lampshade mushroom. Deliver it to Virgeaume, who awaits you at Tailfeather.
TEXT_HEAVNZ209_01778_SEQ_03: Virgeaume chops up the mushroom and mixes it well with some regular gysahl greens. Next, he bids you take this peculiar salad upstream and place it on a bed of straw he has prepared.
TEXT_HEAVNZ209_01778_SEQ_04: You have placed the gysahl greens on the straw. Report the completion of your task to Virgeaume.
TEXT_HEAVNZ209_01778_SEQ_05: Virgeaume proudly explains to you the workings of the trap. The mushroom induces drowsiness in chocobos, rendering them easier to capture, and without risk of causing injury.
TEXT_HEAVNZ210_01779_SEQ_00: The forest is under threat, and Marcechamp needs your help to save it.
TEXT_HEAVNZ210_01779_SEQ_01: Slugs have infested the forest around Tailfeather, and Marcechamp requests your assistance in their extermination. Sprinkle the solution he gave you on trees in the south of the Chocobo Forest, and slay any slugs that appear.
TEXT_HEAVNZ210_01779_SEQ_02: You have slain your fair share of the slugs, thus preserving the health of the forest. Return to Marcechamp with the tale of your success.
TEXT_HEAVNZ210_01779_SEQ_03: Marcechamp thanks you for your assistance. He goes on to explain that a healthy forest means happy chocobos, which in turn means happy hunters─a mutually beneficial relationship.
TEXT_HEAVNZ211_01780_SEQ_00: The Whilom River's new inhabitants are too much for this hunter to bear.
TEXT_HEAVNZ211_01780_SEQ_01: A burly gang of bears has taken up residence upstream of the Whilom River. A troubled hunter has asked you to scare them away so that he might resume his hunting. Slay four bears to send the rest running to a new watering hole.
TEXT_HEAVNZ211_01780_SEQ_02: Four bears now lie at the bottom of the Whilom River. Return to the hunter and tell him of the slaughter.
TEXT_HEAVNZ211_01780_SEQ_03: The hunter seems relieved, but says he must wait for supplies and a change of weather before he resumes his work. Hopefully no more bears decide to return in the meantime.
TEXT_HEAVNZ212_01781_SEQ_00: Loupard has one more hunter that might meet Q'yantaa's standards.
TEXT_HEAVNZ212_01781_SEQ_01: Eager not to repeat the failure of last time, Loupard has found another hunter whose reputation in the camp is growing fast. However, something about the hunter's attitude fills Loupard with trepidation, and he has asked you to look after Q'yantaa once more. Speak with Bauricoin and make sure Q'yantaa will be safe with her new partner.
TEXT_HEAVNZ212_01781_SEQ_02: While Bauricoin's rude and arrogant temperament rubs both you and Q'yantaa the wrong way, Q'yantaa is determined to show him that she is much more than the naive novice that he thinks she is. Speak with Q'yantaa at the northwestern camp to see where this hunt will lead.
TEXT_HEAVNZ212_01781_SEQ_03: You arrive at the encampment at the agreed-upon time, but Bauricoin is nowhere to be found. Q'yantaa will keep a diligent eye out from her post─search the surrounding area for any signs of the haughty hunter.
TEXT_HEAVNZ212_01781_SEQ_04: You find Bauricoin hunched over a lifeless chocobo with an arrow through its neck, and nearby you see a tragic sight: unhatched chocobo eggs. Bauricoin claims credit for this grisly deed, and seems unfazed by this brazen affront to the rules of Tailfeather, declaring that he will bring his catch back to the camp on his own. Hurry and inform Q'yantaa of this tragic turn of events.
TEXT_HEAVNZ212_01781_SEQ_05: Q'yantaa can barely contain her rage as you recount the story of Bauricoin to her, showing a surprising amount of compassion for the wild chocobos. She will hurry back to Tailfeather to inform Loupard of Bauricoin's infraction of the camp's long-standing rules. Follow her back to the camp to watch the drama unfold.
TEXT_HEAVNZ212_01781_SEQ_06: Loupard is disgusted at Bauricoin's selfish and deplorable actions, summarily exiling him from Tailfeather. Although the search for Q'yantaa's partner must begin anew, the forests of the Dravanian forelands are a bit safer thanks to the strict rules of its chocobo hunters.
TEXT_HEAVNZ213_01782_SEQ_00: Loupard wants to try something new in his search for Q'yantaa's partner.
TEXT_HEAVNZ213_01782_SEQ_01: Taking the previous two failures to heart, Loupard has decided to try a different approach in the search for Q'yantaa's partner. He bids her introduce herself to an experienced hunter by the name of Hudde, and she rushes off, eager to elevate her hunting career. The unpleasant experience with Bauricoin is still fresh in Loupard's mind, and he asks you to look after Q'yantaa until this new partnership is solidified. Find Hudde in the north part of Tailfeather to see how the two are getting on.
TEXT_HEAVNZ213_01782_SEQ_02: Hudde skips his own introduction, brusquely exclaiming that he has no need for a partner such as Q'yantaa, and walks off without giving you the chance to convince him otherwise. Q'yantaa, as always, looks like she may have a plan to get what she wants. Speak with her to find out what she means to do.
TEXT_HEAVNZ213_01782_SEQ_03: Despite Hudde's harsh dismissal of her partnership, Q'yantaa is determined to win him over. She decides that the best course of action will be to soothe his cool demeanor by appealing to his soft side. Talk to the hunters of Tailfeather to find out if there are any chinks in Hudde's stoic armor.
TEXT_HEAVNZ213_01782_SEQ_04: After asking around, it seems that despite Hudde's established reputation as a hunter, few know much about him. However, Loupard mentions in passing one thing that may be of interest: Hudde can often be seen carrying Dravanian lilies on his self, although what for remains a mystery. Report your findings to Q'yantaa and see if the cunning Miqo'te has any insight.
TEXT_HEAVNZ213_01782_SEQ_05: Q'yantaa's clever plan is to win Hudde over by presenting him with a Dravanian lily. She runs off in search of the flower, which supposedly grows in the vicinity of the northeast chocobo hunter camp. Follow her to ensure that in her enthusiasm she does not trample over any precious lilies.
TEXT_HEAVNZ213_01782_SEQ_06: You find Q'yantaa standing in front of a fully bloomed Dravanian lily. In a predictable turn of events, she asks you to pick the flower for the sake of her budding partnership. Steady your hands and pick the lily, and make sure nary a petal comes to harm.
TEXT_HEAVNZ213_01782_SEQ_07: You manage to pick the flower with the grace of a skilled florist. Hand it over to Q'yantaa so she may use it to convince Hudde that she is more than just a naive girl.
TEXT_HEAVNZ213_01782_SEQ_08: Q'yantaa rushes off in the direction of Tailfeather, eager to please her future hunting partner. Follow her back and see if her well-intentioned gift will prove to be successful.
TEXT_HEAVNZ213_01782_SEQ_09: Although Q'yantaa smiles wide when presenting the Dravanian lily to Hudde, the action is met with scorn by the gruff hunter. Despite the plain hopelessness of the situation, Q'yantaa is still determined to have Hudde as her partner, and begins devising the next step in her plan.
TEXT_HEAVNZ214_01783_SEQ_00: Q'yantaa refuses to give up on Hudde.
TEXT_HEAVNZ214_01783_SEQ_01: Q'yantaa wants to try one more time to convince Hudde to join up with her, and enlists your help to go looking for him. She rushes off to the northeast. Go after her in search of any clues of Hudde's whereabouts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ214_01783_SEQ_02: There are even fewer Dravanian lilies blooming than the first time you picked them. Q'yantaa rushes to the northwest, as if she had caught the scent of a certain someone. Follow her deeper into the forest and see if her instincts were correct.
TEXT_HEAVNZ214_01783_SEQ_03: You follow along Hudde's trail and come upon a single petal from a Dravanian lily. Q'yantaa proceeds further into the forest, certain that Hudde is not far ahead. Follow on her heels before she abandons you in her eagerness.
TEXT_HEAVNZ214_01783_SEQ_04: Q'yantaa's tracking skills bring you to a recently abandoned camp. The novice hunter seems convinced that it was none other than Hudde who camped there, and ventures deeper into the woods. Follow her to see where this hunt will end.
TEXT_HEAVNZ214_01783_SEQ_05: Among some dragon-infested ruins you find a Dravanian lily placed in front of a pile of rubble. Q'yantaa seems confused as to why such flowers would be placed here, and bids you investigate the lily for clues.
TEXT_HEAVNZ214_01783_SEQ_06: Your inspection of the Dravanian lily is interrupted by Hudde, who is surprised that Q'yantaa was able to track him down despite the efforts he made to hide his tracks. However, he remains adamant that Q'yantaa is unfit to be his partner. After she prods him for an explanation, Hudde relates to you the tragic story of his previous partner, who died at these selfsame ruins during a routine hunt. After Hudde finishes his tale, Q'yantaa restates her desire to learn the ways of hunting under Hudde's tutelage, and ensures him that she will not meet the same fate as Hudde's previous partner. Hudde, moved by the strength of her conviction, finally agrees to take her under his wing, but warns that being his partner will be far from easy. Hudde and Q'yantaa return to Tailfeather to make preparations for their first hunt together. Bring news of this new partnership to Loupard.
TEXT_HEAVNZ214_01783_SEQ_07: Loupard is overjoyed at the good news, and is confident that the pairing is beneficial for both hunters. Q'yantaa will soon begin her journey to become one of the realm's great chocobo hunters, and Hudde will finally be able to leave behind his tragic past.
TEXT_HEAVNZ215_01784_SEQ_00: The hunter is staring into the basin with tears in her eyes.
TEXT_HEAVNZ215_01784_SEQ_01: A jumpy hunter has asked you to recover her favorite bow after she dropped it into the Hundred Throes. It should not have gone far. Get your feet wet and start searching.
TEXT_HEAVNZ215_01784_SEQ_02: You have found the lost bow downstream. Return it to the distressed hunter so she can defend herself.
TEXT_HEAVNZ215_01784_SEQ_03: You have given the hunter her bow, much to her elation. Unfortunately, she can no longer use it due to a damaged bowstring. She will return to Tailfeather for repairs.
TEXT_HEAVNZ216_01785_SEQ_00: Remaclon looks like he has just seen a ghost...or worse.
TEXT_HEAVNZ216_01785_SEQ_01: Remaclon has asked you to confirm a frightening sight: dragons in the vicinity of Mare's Oath. Go to the ruins and see if the creatures were more than just ale-fueled visions.
TEXT_HEAVNZ216_01785_SEQ_02: At Mare's Oath, you find two lifelike dragon statues, which may pass for living creatures to a drunk. Return to Tailfeather and report your discovery to Remaclon.
TEXT_HEAVNZ216_01785_SEQ_03: Remaclon seems relieved at your news, and informs you that the ruins at Mare's Oath are said to have been constructed by heretics. He will be steering clear from that area in the future.
TEXT_HEAVNZ217_01786_SEQ_01: Cibleroit has a hunger for nanka eggs, and you must help him sate it. Harvest five eggs from a ninki nanka in the nearby river and bring them to him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ217_01786_SEQ_02: You have gathered the sticky, slimy nankaspawn. Get it off your hands as quickly as possible by delivering it to Cibleroit.
TEXT_HEAVNZ217_01786_SEQ_03: Cibleroit is delighted to receive the eggs. The Hungerer, however, thinks they are disgusting. Unlike the Gnath of the Onemind, differences of opinion─and all they entail─seem to be a unique characteristic of the Nonmind.
TEXT_HEAVNZ218_01787_SEQ_00: The Vath Hungerer is casting furtive glances in the direction of Mare's Oath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ218_01787_SEQ_01: The Hungerer describes to you a tree that grows on a raised area in front of Mare's Oath. The fruit of that tree, she explains, is beyond compare─the riper the better. The ripest fruit falls from its branches to the ground beneath. She asks that you gather three of these fruits for her.
TEXT_HEAVNZ218_01787_SEQ_02: You find the tree where the Hungerer said it would be. You collect the fruit as requested, their sweet, overripe odor hanging about you. Take them back to the waiting Hungerer at Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ218_01787_SEQ_03: The Hungerer is elated to receive the fruit, but Cibleroit nearby regards them with disgust. This occasional difficulty in seeing eye-to-compound-eye is one of the many elements of individuality that brings variety to life in the Nonmind.
TEXT_HEAVNZ219_01788_SEQ_00: Cibleroit stares longingly into the distance.
TEXT_HEAVNZ219_01788_SEQ_01: Cibleroit has become enraptured with the thought of eating the meat of the nearby loaghtans. He asks you to cross the nearby river and hunt these loaghtans, collecting three flanks of their succulent meat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ219_01788_SEQ_02: You slaughter the loaghtans like cattle. Return to Loth ast Vath with your haul.
TEXT_HEAVNZ219_01788_SEQ_03: Cibleroit and the Hungerer both agree: the meat is exquisite. One advantage of being of the Nonmind is the right of individuals to decide for themselves what they will eat. In the Onemind, only members of the warrior caste have the privilege of eating meat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ220_01789_SEQ_00: The Vath Hungerer seems distracted by something in the forest.
TEXT_HEAVNZ220_01789_SEQ_01: The Vath Hungerer explains that the nearby meliae interfere with the Vath's hunting and gathering. She asks you to kill four of the monsters, lest her tribe go hungry, unable to collect food.
TEXT_HEAVNZ220_01789_SEQ_02: You fell the meliae as requested. Return to the Hungerer with the good news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ220_01789_SEQ_03: The Hungerer tells you that, to the Vath, fighting is simply a means to gather food. The idea of attacking something inedible is unpalatable to them. Though, from the way they talk, it is clear they have tried to eat meliae before.
TEXT_HEAVNZ221_01790_SEQ_00: The Vath fleetfoot is examining the weapon stores with a concerned expression.
TEXT_HEAVNZ221_01790_SEQ_01: The Vath fleetfoot tells you that the Vath's weapon stores are worryingly low. He asks you to help them restock by taking flintlocks from the nearby Gnath hive.
TEXT_HEAVNZ221_01790_SEQ_02: You pry the Gnath's firearms from their cold, dead hands. Take them to the fleetfoot at Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ221_01790_SEQ_03: The fleetfoot thanks you for the weapons. He goes on to explain how unnerving he finds the Gnath's shared thoughts and actions. Though they are of the same blood and breed, though all Vath were once Gnath, he finds it difficult to believe they are of the same race.
TEXT_HEAVNZ222_01791_SEQ_00: The voracious Vath is examining the Vath nests.
TEXT_HEAVNZ222_01791_SEQ_01: The voracious Vath explains to you that, while the Vath are self-sufficient with regard to food, they are unable to gather the materials necessary to build and maintain their nests. He asks you to retrieve Dravanian clay from the hive at Loth ast Gnath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ222_01791_SEQ_02: You collect the clay from the Gnath hive. Return it to the voracious Vath at Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ222_01791_SEQ_03: The voracious Vath thanks you for the construction materials. You learn that Gnath nests are made by combining this clay─extracted from deep beneath the Smoldering Wastes─with Gnath saliva.
TEXT_HEAVNZ223_01792_SEQ_00: The Vath storyteller is concerned about the risk of Dravanian attack.
TEXT_HEAVNZ223_01792_SEQ_01: The Vath storyteller asks you to gather silver dew. The plant grows on a raised area to the west of Tailfeather. Head there, collect three bunches of silver dew, and deliver them to the Vath storyteller.
TEXT_HEAVNZ223_01792_SEQ_02: You have found and gathered the silver dew. Return to Loth ast Vath and deliver it to the storyteller.
TEXT_HEAVNZ223_01792_SEQ_03: The storyteller explains to you how the Vath have avoided Dravanian attacks for so long: burning silver dew produces a strong-smelling smoke. Dragons cannot stand the smell of this smoke and avoid the area of Loth ast Vath altogether.
TEXT_HEAVNZ301_01793_SEQ_00: The voracious Vath is staring towards the southern sky.
TEXT_HEAVNZ301_01793_SEQ_01: The voracious Vath has asked you to collect four yellow pebbles for him. Such pebbles can be found in the craters to the south of Anyx Trine.
TEXT_HEAVNZ301_01793_SEQ_02: You successfully obtain the requested stones. Take them back to the voracious Vath at Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ301_01793_SEQ_03: The voracious Vath is impressed with how quickly you retrieved the yellow pebbles. He tells you that they are one of the main ingredients of Gnathic firesand, but seems uneager to go into the details of what else is required.
TEXT_HEAVNZ302_01794_SEQ_00: The Vath strongarm is in a frightful panic.
TEXT_HEAVNZ302_01794_SEQ_01: The Vath strongarm was ambushed by Gnath and forced to abandon his wain. Though the cargo held within is of great value, he fears his attackers still lurk thereabouts, and he asks that you recover it in his stead. Search near the river west of Loth ast Gnath for the abandoned goods.
TEXT_HEAVNZ302_01794_SEQ_02: As expected, the Gnath were lying in ambush and waiting for someone to try to recover the Vath strongarm's property. You promptly dispatch the assailants and recover the cargo. Take it back to Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ302_01794_SEQ_03: The Vath strongarm's cargo included a special gift for a lady Vath he has had his eye on. He is elated that you have recovered it for him, and grateful that you have avenged the Gnath's attack on him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ303_01795_SEQ_00: The Vath fleetfoot is concerned about the state of the Vath weapon stores.
TEXT_HEAVNZ303_01795_SEQ_01: The Vath fleetfoot thanks you again for procuring firearms to supplement the Vath's weapon supplies. Now, their stockpiles of firesand─necessary to use these firearms─are starting to run low. He entreats you to retrieve some from the Gnath hive.
TEXT_HEAVNZ303_01795_SEQ_02: You pilfer some of the Gnath's firesand stocks. Return to the Vath fleetfoot with your ill-gotten gains.
TEXT_HEAVNZ303_01795_SEQ_03: The firesand provides the Vath fleetfoot with some peace of mind. Should the Vath's supply of firesand be depleted, it would severely hamper their ability to defend themselves. Thanks to your efforts, this risk has been ameliorated for the time being.
TEXT_HEAVNZ304_01796_SEQ_00: The Vath storyteller is shaking with rage.
TEXT_HEAVNZ304_01796_SEQ_01: The Vath storyteller, furious that his fellow Vath have been attacked by the Gnath, wants revenge. Exact vengeance for him by slaying an irondrone, a haildrone, and a forager.
TEXT_HEAVNZ304_01796_SEQ_02: You carry out the storyteller's brutal reprisal. Return to Loth ast Vath and inform him that justice has been done.
TEXT_HEAVNZ304_01796_SEQ_03: The storyteller thanks you for avenging his brothers. Though the Gnath you killed may not have been the specific individuals that attacked the Vath, the storyteller assures you that since all Gnath share a linked consciousness, this is not a meaningful distinction to make.
TEXT_HEAVNZ305_01797_SEQ_00: Marcechamp is wrestling with a new kind of problem.
TEXT_HEAVNZ305_01797_SEQ_01: One of Marcechamp's hunters was attacked by a chocobo allegedly larger and more fierce than any the hunters have encountered. Marcechamp has asked you to gather any information that would help in the wild bird's capture. Start by asking the leaders of his three camps what they know.
TEXT_HEAVNZ305_01797_SEQ_02: After talking to the leaders of each camp, you find that the chocobo has been terrorizing hunters across the forest. Return to Tailfeather and report to Marcechamp.
TEXT_HEAVNZ305_01797_SEQ_03: You have relayed the information on the wild chocobo to Marcechamp, and he explains to you that the prospect of dealing with a monster as smart as a chocobo is more terrifying than its actual size. Catching this bird will not prove to be an easy task.
TEXT_HEAVNZ306_01798_SEQ_00: Marcechamp is preparing for the most dangerous game.
TEXT_HEAVNZ306_01798_SEQ_01: Marcechamp has asked you to aid in the hunt for a wild chocobo that has been terrorizing the forest around Tailfeather. Follow his tracker and investigate the broken trap near the Whilom River for clues of the bird's whereabouts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ306_01798_SEQ_02: You arrive on scene to find Marcechamp's tracker on her knees, apparently having been attacked by the chocobo standing over her. As you approach, the chocobo runs off in the direction of the Hundred Throes. Give chase, and be ready for a fight should it come to that.
TEXT_HEAVNZ306_01798_SEQ_03: The chocobo attacks you when you approach, and you are forced to slay it after a fierce fight. Check on the wounded tracker to see how she is faring.
TEXT_HEAVNZ306_01798_SEQ_04: Since you were the one to put the mighty chocobo to its rest, the tracker thinks it best that you should be the one to inform Marcechamp of the final battle. Head back to Tailfeather and make your report.
TEXT_HEAVNZ306_01798_SEQ_05: You have informed Marcechamp of the battle that transpired near the Hundred Throes. He informs you that because chocobos are highly intelligent animals, they must be put down if they get it in their minds to attack people, as it is the chocobo's primary purpose to serve, not harm.
TEXT_HEAVNZ307_01799_SEQ_00: You notice the sound of Toh Y Thrah's grumbling stomach.
TEXT_HEAVNZ307_01799_SEQ_01: After hearing tales from his kin of miacid meat and its savory taste, Toh Y Thrah wishes to taste it for himself. However, he is not yet strong enough to hunt them without severe repercussions. Slay any miacids you come across in the wilds and obtain three chunks of their meat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ307_01799_SEQ_02: You slay three miacids and obtain their meat. Take them to Toh Y Thrah, that he may sate both his hunger and curiosity.
TEXT_HEAVNZ307_01799_SEQ_03: You deliver the meat to Toh Y Thrah. With a single bite his eyes grow wide with amazement. He proclaims the meat is indeed quite succulent, anticipating the day he can freely hunt it for himself.
TEXT_HEAVNZ308_01800_SEQ_00: The grumbling of Toh Y Thrah's stomach seems to be growing louder.
TEXT_HEAVNZ308_01800_SEQ_01: With his hunger for meat sated, Toh Y Thrah now asks that you bring him gallimimus eggs. Search the gallimimus nests of the Sohm Al foothills and procure eggs for his next meal.
TEXT_HEAVNZ308_01800_SEQ_02: You pilfer the eggs from gallimimus nests. Deliver them to Toh Y Thrah and quiet the rumbling of his stomach.
TEXT_HEAVNZ308_01800_SEQ_03: You deliver the gallimimus eggs to Toh Y Thrah. You can see him beaming with delight as the eggs find their way to the recesses of his belly. Satisfied with the meal, he seems determined to steal eggs for himself in the future.
TEXT_HEAVNZ309_01801_SEQ_00: Though his stomach no longer grumbles, Toh Y Thrah has yet to sate his curiosity.
TEXT_HEAVNZ309_01801_SEQ_01: Toh Y Thrah notices you have not eaten any of the food you brought him, and now he is curious to see what foods you would eat. Although you have no food to give him, you notice he makes mention of people living in the Chocobo Forest. Search for the forest's residents, and see if you can find a meal Toh Y Thrah may enjoy.
TEXT_HEAVNZ309_01801_SEQ_02: You come across a small campsite in the Chocobo Forest, and as luck would have it, a meal slow roasting over an open flame. You speak with Leonulfe, the chef of the seemingly delectable dish, and he agrees to share some with you. In return, he asks that you obtain chocobo meat that he can prepare another serving for later. Slay a wild chocobo for its meat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ309_01801_SEQ_03: You slay a wild chocobo and obtain its meat. Take it to Leonulfe and receive a small helping of his cooking.
TEXT_HEAVNZ309_01801_SEQ_04: You return to the campsite with the wild chocobo meat. Leonulfe thanks you for your quick work, and directs your attention to a plate of freshly fried chocobo he prepared while you were away.
TEXT_HEAVNZ309_01801_SEQ_05: With the fried chocobo in hand, you are ready to return to Toh Y Thrah. Deliver the fried chocobo, and give him his first taste of a properly cooked meal.
TEXT_HEAVNZ309_01801_SEQ_06: You return to Toh Y Thrah with the fried chocobo. He is intrigued by its scent and eagerly takes a bite. To his dismay, however, he finds the taste of cooked meat revolting. He fails to understand why anyone would sacrifice the natural flavors of raw meat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ310_01802_SEQ_00: Ess Khas looks upon you in wonder, curious of your potential.
TEXT_HEAVNZ310_01802_SEQ_01: Ess Khas suspects you are more powerful than you appear, and would see your strength put to good use. He asks that you do battle with his children to teach them a lesson. Travel beyond the tower, and speak with the young dragons of their father's request.
TEXT_HEAVNZ310_01802_SEQ_02: You speak with the youngest of the three, who is incredulous of his father's idea. Not one to argue with his elders, he prepares to fight. Defeat Kohm Gahn and teach him a lesson.
TEXT_HEAVNZ310_01802_SEQ_03: Kohm Gahn is dumbfounded by your prowess in battle, but your work is not yet done. Speak with Kohm Scorh and prepare for another fight.
TEXT_HEAVNZ310_01802_SEQ_04: Kohm Scorh is shocked by your victory over his younger sibling. Although he still doubts your strength, he will not hold back. Defeat Kohm Scorh and show him what you can do.
TEXT_HEAVNZ310_01802_SEQ_05: Yet another young dragon is left awestruck in the wake of your power. The match is yours, but he is certain Kohm Khur can defeat you. Speak with Kohm Khur and prepare for your final fight.
TEXT_HEAVNZ310_01802_SEQ_06: Kohm Khur appears slighted by the defeat of his younger siblings, and is ready to take out his anger on you. Defeat Kohm Khur and show them you are not to be trifled with.
TEXT_HEAVNZ310_01802_SEQ_07: You defeat Kohm Khur, depriving him of a release for his anger. The younglings are now left to contemplate the strength of men, and you find your work is complete. Return to Ess Khas and tell him of what transpired.
TEXT_HEAVNZ310_01802_SEQ_08: You speak with Ess Khas, who is pleased to hear the egos of his children have been put in check. He was once worried the young dragons, if left to their own devices, would grow too prideful and unwilling to accept mankind. Your efforts have shown that man is not an inferior being, but rather a more-than-suitable equal.
TEXT_HEAVNZ311_01803_SEQ_00: Gullinkambi is wrinkling her nose at something.
TEXT_HEAVNZ311_01803_SEQ_01: Gullinkambi has an exceptionally acute sense of smell, and she can no longer bear the stench of Gnath. They have devices placed outside the tower pouring strange fumes into the air. She implores you to disable them and end her suffering.
TEXT_HEAVNZ311_01803_SEQ_02: You have disabled the Gnathic devices and the fumes are dissipating. Return to Gullinkambi and tell her the devices are no more.
TEXT_HEAVNZ311_01803_SEQ_03: You return to Gullinkambi, who can now breathe easier for lack of the Gnath's fumes. She thanks you for your work as she nestles closer to her eggs.
TEXT_HEAVNZ312_01804_SEQ_00: One of the Gnath in the storeroom looks confused and bewildered.
TEXT_HEAVNZ312_01804_SEQ_01: The Nonmind drone can no longer hear her orders from the Onemind. At a loss for what to do, she asks you for help. Go to Loth ast Vath and inform the Vath storyteller of the situation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ312_01804_SEQ_02: The Vath storyteller immediately takes this as good news. He seems encouraged by the thought of a new member of the Nonmind. He tells you to direct the lost Gnath to Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ312_01804_SEQ_03: You relay the storyteller's message to the Nonmind drone. She seems excited at the thought of finding others like herself and heads to Loth ast Vath straightaway. Hopefully she is able to integrate with her new hive easily.
TEXT_HEAVNZ313_01805_SEQ_00: The Nonmind drone is trying to catch your attention.
TEXT_HEAVNZ313_01805_SEQ_01: The Nonmind drone wants to express her thanks to the Vath storyteller and the Vath who took her in. Help her by slaying hippocerfs and gathering three hippocerf skins.
TEXT_HEAVNZ313_01805_SEQ_02: You slay and skin the hippocerfs. Deliver the hides to the Nonmind drone.
TEXT_HEAVNZ313_01805_SEQ_03: The Nonmind drone gives the hides to the storyteller and fleetfoot to eat as a gift of thanks. Seeing them enthusiastically eating her gifts, she leaves on a journey to explore the realm.
TEXT_HEAVNZ313_01805_SEQ_04: Within moments of the drone's departure, the storyteller admits that the taste of the hippocerf skin was near-unbearably disgusting.
TEXT_HEAVNZ314_01806_SEQ_00: The astute Vath gazes out at the Smoldering Wastes.
TEXT_HEAVNZ314_01806_SEQ_01: The astute Vath has heard the voice of a lost Gnath and asks you to find the owner of this voice. Search the area to the southwest of Anyx Trine.
TEXT_HEAVNZ314_01806_SEQ_02: You have found a wandering Gnath, confused and disoriented. But with his attention transfixed by the wyverns circling nearby, he does not respond to your attempts to guide him to Loth ast Vath. Slay one of the dragons and put his mind at ease.
TEXT_HEAVNZ314_01806_SEQ_03: With the nearest wyvern dealt with, the wandering Gnath might now feel more at ease and be willing to join the Vath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ314_01806_SEQ_04: Though the imminent threat of wyvern attack no longer looms, the wandering Gnath still does not know where to go or what to do. You explain about Loth ast Vath and tell him of the other Gnath that lost the link to the Onemind. Return to Loth ast Vath and inform the astute Vath of the impending new arrival.
TEXT_HEAVNZ314_01806_SEQ_05: The astute Vath informs you that the wandering Gnath never made it to the Vath hive, but he seems to know more than he lets on, suggesting you search near Loth ast Gnath for the missing Gnath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ314_01806_SEQ_06: You find the wandering Gnath on his way back to his old hive, single-mindedly intent on returning and resuming his work. Return to the astute Vath and explain the situation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ314_01806_SEQ_07: You break the bad news to the astute Vath. Just as he had feared, the Gnath's mental link to the Overmind had been reestablished and the poor creature is once again a drone of the Onemind. The astute Vath seems to harbor a gnawing fear that the same could one day happen to him, stripping him of all individuality and rendering him another mindless slave of the Overmind.
TEXT_HEAVNZ315_01807_SEQ_00: The Vath fleetfoot is keeping a vigilant eye on the borders of Loth ast Vath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ315_01807_SEQ_01: Incursions by the Gnath into Vath territory continue to trouble the Vath fleetfoot. Lacking sufficient warriors to adequately guard their borders, he asks you to patrol the area near the Stained One and slay any Gnath that may be hiding there.
TEXT_HEAVNZ315_01807_SEQ_02: You have slain the Gnath lying in wait at the Stained One. Inform the fleetfoot that the area is now safe.
TEXT_HEAVNZ315_01807_SEQ_03: The fleetfoot is relieved that the Vath borders are safer now. You learn that the Gnath generally consider those who lose their link to the Onemind an aberrant impurity, and attempt to eliminate them. Loth ast Vath is the only safe haven for those who no longer share a consciousness with the hive, and this is why it must be protected.
TEXT_HEAVNZ316_01808_SEQ_00: The Vath fleetfoot stares at the ground, a look of concern clear upon his face.
TEXT_HEAVNZ316_01808_SEQ_01: Vath scouts have told the Vath fleetfoot that the Gnath are gathering supplies in the Smoldering Wastes, creating a staging area from which to attack Loth ast Vath. In an attempt to forestall these attacks, he provisions you with a flint stone, asking you to find the supplies and destroy them.
TEXT_HEAVNZ316_01808_SEQ_02: You find the war equipment and set it ablaze. Report to the fleetfoot with news of your success.
TEXT_HEAVNZ316_01808_SEQ_03: Your destruction of the Gnath hive's war equipment brings a sense of relief to the fleetfoot. It will take the Gnath some time to recover, allowing the Vath a chance to strengthen their defenses.
TEXT_HEAVNZ317_01809_SEQ_00: Gullinkambi is drumming her claws on the floor, a look of lividity clear on her face.
TEXT_HEAVNZ317_01809_SEQ_01: In the wake of the primal Ravana's defeat, the Gnath have grown reckless, and Gullinkambi senses them approaching the tower. Fearing for the safety of her children, she asks that you turn them away by whatever means necessary.
TEXT_HEAVNZ317_01809_SEQ_02: You have defeated the Gnath invaders. Return to Gullinkambi and tell her the tower is safe.
TEXT_HEAVNZ317_01809_SEQ_03: You return to Gullinkambi, who is relieved to hear the Gnath have been dealt with. This reprieve may be brief, but she is thankful for your help all the same.
TEXT_HEAVNZ318_01810_SEQ_01: Gullinkambi complains to you of an aching body, desperate for relief from pain. She asks that you retrieve a flower named gron mhar from Ehs Daih that may grant her relief.
TEXT_HEAVNZ318_01810_SEQ_02: You find a gron mhar. Bring it to Gullinkambi and see if it improves her condition.
TEXT_HEAVNZ318_01810_SEQ_03: You bring a gron mhar to Gullinkambi. She immediately feels the tension in her body melting away. She tells you that warming the eggs for weeks and months on end causes her body to grow sore, and thus she becomes irascible. She thanks you for giving her the peace she needs to continue guarding her eggs.
TEXT_HEAVNZ319_01811_SEQ_00: This indomitable wyvern is beside himself with panic over something lost.
TEXT_HEAVNZ319_01811_SEQ_01: Although hesitant at first, the indomitable wyvern admits to the cause for his distress: his younger brother has gone missing. He cannot say for certain, but he believes his sibling may be lost somewhere in Mourn. Search the cavern of Mourn for the missing dragon youngling.
TEXT_HEAVNZ319_01811_SEQ_02: You find the dragon youngling safe and sound, rousing from sleep. His mind still fuzzy from slumber, he regards you with indifference bordering on distaste. One mention of his brother, however, quickly sends him flying toward the exit. Head back to the indomitable wyvern and see if his younger brother has returned safely.
TEXT_HEAVNZ319_01811_SEQ_03: You exit the cave to find the indomitable wyvern in the company of his younger brother. He thanks you and looks down to his little brother, hoping the young dragon will also pay respects. You are offered only silence as he flies off without saying a word. The indomitable wyvern quickly apologizes, promising his brother will be dealt with in short order.
TEXT_HEAVNZ320_01812_SEQ_00: Ess Khas stares at you intently, a strange hunger burning in his eyes.
TEXT_HEAVNZ320_01812_SEQ_01: Ess Khas was impressed with the way you fought against his children. So impressed, in fact, he wishes to challenge you himself. He also sees this as another chance to show the younglings a real fight. Find Kohm Khur south of the tower and prepare for battle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ320_01812_SEQ_02: Ess Khas gives his all in a fierce duel with you, but your command of the battlefield remains unmatched. Speak with Kohm Khur and see what he thinks of your latest victory.
TEXT_HEAVNZ320_01812_SEQ_03: Kohm Khur is humbled to see his father defeated and apologizes for doubting you before. He gives you a scale plucked from his body in the hopes of offering his father a swift recovery. Take the dragon scale to Ess Khas and see to his injuries.
TEXT_HEAVNZ320_01812_SEQ_04: Ess Khas thanks you for the medicine, knowing full well his son is the one who supplied it. He then tells you of the duels he once enjoyed with honorable knights in days long past.
TEXT_HEAVNZ321_01813_SEQ_00: Ess Khas seems greatly perturbed by something.
TEXT_HEAVNZ321_01813_SEQ_01: The dragons' chosen place of interment, Mourn, is infested with beasts unfit to walk its hallowed halls. Of the tyrannosaurs, vinegaroons, and syrictae now running rampant in Mourn, Ess Khas asks that you slay five of any beast you see to help reduce their numbers.
TEXT_HEAVNZ321_01813_SEQ_02: You slay the beasts running amok in the cave. Return to Anyx Trine and speak with Ess Khas.
TEXT_HEAVNZ321_01813_SEQ_03: You speak with Ess Khas, whose heart swells to hear the halls of Mourn will know peace, if only for a short time. He tells you that lesser dragons are gathering for the war, drawing beasts of various sorts to the cave. Only a truly despicable beast could defile such a place, and he thanks you for doing your part to purge the cave of its intruders.
TEXT_HEAVNZ322_01814_SEQ_00: Gullinkambi needs someone to deliver a message.
TEXT_HEAVNZ322_01814_SEQ_01: Gullinkambi would task her child, Kal Myhk, with today's hunt, but he has yet to return home. She asks that you find him, and relay her words to him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ322_01814_SEQ_02: You find Kal Myhk not far from Anyx Trine. In trying to ascertain what manner of being you are, he comes to the erroneous conclusion that you are an enemy from Ishgard, and flees in a panic. Search for Kal Myhk, and deliver his mother's message.
TEXT_HEAVNZ322_01814_SEQ_03: You find Kal Myhk again close by. Convinced you are an enemy sent to slay him, he runs off yet again before you can talk to him. Search for Kal Myhk, and deliver his mother's message.
TEXT_HEAVNZ322_01814_SEQ_04: You find Kal Myhk, but this time he refuses to run away. He stands his ground, prepared for the worst, but is caught by surprise to hear you bring word from his mother. Before you can relay this message, however, he insists on testing you. He asks you to catch him as he flies off to parts unknown. Track down Kal Myhk, and deliver his mother's message.
TEXT_HEAVNZ322_01814_SEQ_05: You find Kal Myhk hiding naively in the ruins close to his last hiding spot. Having taken interest in you, he asks for your name. Convinced you will not find him again, he challenges you to find him one last time. Track down Kal Myhk, and deliver his mother's message.
TEXT_HEAVNZ322_01814_SEQ_06: You find Kal Myhk, this time out in the open near the entrance to Anyx Trine. He is impressed that you were able to keep up with him, and decides you will make a good partner. For what, exactly, only he knows. But with games of hide-and-seek finally over, you can at last tell him of his mother's request.
TEXT_HEAVNZ323_01815_SEQ_00: Kal Myhk wishes to hear his mother's request.
TEXT_HEAVNZ323_01815_SEQ_01: You finally tell Kal Myhk what his mother requests of him─to hunt for the day's meal. He makes for the nearby river without delay, and asks you to accompany him. Head south and meet with Kal Myhk.
TEXT_HEAVNZ323_01815_SEQ_02: You meet Kal Myhk down at the river. He confesses that he has never taken charge in hunting by himself, but he explains to you the way his elders catch their prey. Slay a clearwater nanka to use as bait.
TEXT_HEAVNZ323_01815_SEQ_03: You slay a clearwater nanka and are ready to catch your prey. According to Kal Myhk, his elders would lay their bait along the nearby rocks and wait for their prey to come biting. Do as his elders do, and strike down any beast that comes looking for an easy meal.
TEXT_HEAVNZ323_01815_SEQ_04: A jagil leaps up from the river to claim your bait, but you slay it with swift precision. Speak with Kal Myhk and show him what you caught.
TEXT_HEAVNZ323_01815_SEQ_05: You show Kal Myhk your freshly caught jagil. He is impressed with your hunting skills. So much so, that he decides to try by himself. Take your catch to Gullinkambi while he tries his hand at catching fish.
TEXT_HEAVNZ323_01815_SEQ_06: You bring the jagil to Gullinkambi. Realizing you carried out the hunt in her son's stead, she apologizes. At a mere thirty years of age, Kal Myhk is but a dragonling and lacks experience. She is glad, however, to see that he has grown to trust you.
TEXT_HEAVNZ324_01816_SEQ_00: Kal Myhk looks to be in a state of panic.
TEXT_HEAVNZ324_01816_SEQ_01: Kal Myhk tells you his brother has been seriously injured. In the hopes of promoting a swift recovery, he wishes to keep his brother well fed. To that end, he asks that you help him hunt for food. Meet with Kal Myhk down at the river and be ready to hunt.
TEXT_HEAVNZ324_01816_SEQ_02: Kal Myhk plans to bring his brother both jagil and loaghtan meat, and needs your help. The loaghtans are known to graze up north, but he is forbidden from traveling so far upstream. He asks that you hunt one in his stead.
TEXT_HEAVNZ324_01816_SEQ_03: You slay a loaghtan and obtain its meat. Return south with your bounty and report your success to Kal Myhk.
TEXT_HEAVNZ324_01816_SEQ_04: Kal Myhk is quite pleased with your kill. With meat and fish in hand, he insists on going straight to his brother in Mourn.
TEXT_HEAVNZ324_01816_SEQ_05: You arrive at Mourn and find Kal Myhk but a few steps inside. Next to him is his brother, lying motionless on the floor. Kal Myhk rouses him and offers him the fish and meat you procured. His brother refuses, and becoming aware of your presence, grows increasingly angry at the offering. He recalls the men who plucked him from the skies of Coerthas, nearly claiming his life. He warns Kal Myhk that no man can be trusted, and claims that you too will soon turn to betray him. Kal Myhk is at a loss for words, and quickly leaves the cave to consider his brother's words. Seek Kal Myhk near Anyx Trine, and see how he is handling this news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ324_01816_SEQ_06: You find Kal Myhk on the steps of Anyx Trine, a sullen look on his face. While he appreciates all you have done for him, it seems he would choose to heed his brother's warning.
TEXT_HEAVNZ325_01817_SEQ_00: Kal Myhk is looking at you with unease.
TEXT_HEAVNZ325_01817_SEQ_01: His brother's brush with death at the hands of men has left Kal Myhk conflicted. Despite the bond you have formed with him, he now wonders if you would have slain him had you met under different circumstances. Do what you can to /soothe him and cast aside his fearful thoughts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ325_01817_SEQ_02: While Kal Myhk accepts the reality of his brother's near-fatal encounter, you have helped him understand that not all men are evil. No longer distracted by burdens of fear and doubt, he asks for your help in finding a way to heal his brother. He suggests speaking with his mother, Gullinkambi, in the tower of Anyx Trine.
TEXT_HEAVNZ325_01817_SEQ_03: You speak with Gullinkambi hoping to find a method for rehabilitating dragons. She tells you that dragons are not wont to interfere in the healing process. Ohl Ahs was warned not to venture near Ishgard, and he will either recover from sleep or remain forever in the halls of Mourn. However, she recalls a man who once labored to create medicine capable of healing dragons. If you are intent on healing Ohl Ahs with the medicines of man, she bids you find his research. She believes they may be in the remnants of his home somewhere in the Sohm Al foothills. Speak with Kal Myhk and discuss your next course of action.
TEXT_HEAVNZ325_01817_SEQ_04: Kal Myhk believes he has seen the hovel of rocks she spoke of. Meet with him outside on the path up the mountain.
TEXT_HEAVNZ325_01817_SEQ_05: You find Kal Myhk outside where the path splits in opposite directions. He urges you upward, and moves ahead. Follow the path upward and search for Kal Myhk.
TEXT_HEAVNZ325_01817_SEQ_06: You find Kal Myhk further up the mountainside, and he says you are on the right track. Continue following Kal Myhk up the path.
TEXT_HEAVNZ325_01817_SEQ_07: Kal Myhk tells you to climb down the mountainside to a new path. Make your way down and continue following him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ325_01817_SEQ_08: You find Kal Myhk standing before the remains of the house from his mother's story. Search the building for signs of the research.
TEXT_HEAVNZ325_01817_SEQ_09: You find a tablet amidst the rubble. The letters are faded, but it describes the work of an Elezen healer. Show Kal Myhk what you found.
TEXT_HEAVNZ325_01817_SEQ_10: You show the begrimed tablet to Kal Myhk, and he is pleased to be one step closer to helping his brother. Return to Anyx Trine and show the tablet to Gullinkambi.
TEXT_HEAVNZ325_01817_SEQ_11: You present the tablet to Gullinkambi, and after briefly examining it, she confirms you have found the research on healing dragons. With the tablet in hand, you at last have the knowledge needed to heal Kal Myhk's brother.
TEXT_HEAVNZ326_01818_SEQ_00: Gullinkambi is prepared to see the healing of man in action.
TEXT_HEAVNZ326_01818_SEQ_01: Gullinkambi reminds you that dragons are wont to let nature take its course when healing, but she has no objections to using knowledge of the tablet to help Ohl Ahs. She asks that you take Kal Myhk with you as you prepare the medicine described on the tablet.
TEXT_HEAVNZ326_01818_SEQ_02: Kal Myhk asks you what ingredients are required for the medicine, and after examining the faded tome, you find the recipe calls for wyvern tails. He tells you they can be found northeast of Anyx Trine. Journey to the Iron Feast and locate the items.
TEXT_HEAVNZ326_01818_SEQ_03: You traverse the narrow cliffs of the mountain and acquire wyvern tails. Return to Anyx Trine and confer with Kal Myhk regarding your next course of action.
TEXT_HEAVNZ326_01818_SEQ_04: Examining the tablet further, you discern the next step is an infusion of the wyvern tails, which extracts their healing properties with boiling water. Travel to Camp Tailfeather and seek out tools for the infusion.
TEXT_HEAVNZ326_01818_SEQ_05: You search Camp Tailfeather and the surrounding area and come across a small camp with a pot over a roaring fire. After speaking with the camp's residents, they agree to let you use the pot and produce a wyvern tail infusion. Return to Anyx Trine and show Kal Myhk the fruits of your labor.
TEXT_HEAVNZ326_01818_SEQ_06: You return to Anyx Trine, and Kal Myhk is thrilled at the thought of seeing his brother make a swift recovery. With the infusion in hand, there is only one thing left to do: meet Kal Myhk inside Mourn and prepare to treat Ohl Ahs.
TEXT_HEAVNZ326_01818_SEQ_07: You find Kal Myhk just beyond the mouth of Mourn and his brother is fast asleep. Apply the wyvern tail infusion to his wounds, but try not to wake him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ326_01818_SEQ_08: You carefully apply the infusion, but upon closer inspection find broken spear tips still lodged in his wounds. Their removal awakens Ohl Ahs who is displeased to see his sleep disturbed, more so by the fact that it was your doing. However, his anger is soon abated as he realizes the pain that gripped him for so long is finally gone. Kal Myhk explains that it was you who labored to treat his injuries, and helps him understand that not all people are wicked. Return to Anyx Trine, and inform Gullinkambi that the treatment was a success.
TEXT_HEAVNZ326_01818_SEQ_09: You arrive at Anyx Trine, and Gullinkambi can tell by your look of satisfaction that Ohl Ahs has recovered from his injuries. She thanks you for all you have done not only to heal Ohl Ahs, but also fostering the first of many friendships to come between dragons and mankind.
TEXT_HEAVNZ401_01819_SEQ_00: Mogret is in desperate need of a bath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ401_01819_SEQ_01: A popular moogle bathing spot has been taken over by half-fish, half-dragon monstrosities called hropkens. Slay three of them, scattering the beasts so Mogret can finally clean under her wings.
TEXT_HEAVNZ401_01819_SEQ_02: You have slain the hropkens, although their odor still remains fresh in your nose. Return to Mogret and inform her that the waters are once again safe.
TEXT_HEAVNZ401_01819_SEQ_03: Mogret is overjoyed at your news, and explains that she can't stand the smell of raw fish. She suggests that maybe you should also consider taking a dip in the waters.
TEXT_HEAVNZ402_01820_SEQ_00: Mogmug is flitting about frantically looking for someone to do his bidding.
TEXT_HEAVNZ402_01820_SEQ_01: Mogmug has asked the newest member of his fan club─you─to gather four sankchinni vines. Head north of Moghome and gather the vines.
TEXT_HEAVNZ402_01820_SEQ_02: The sankchinnis fall easily. Gather their vines and return to Mogmug.
TEXT_HEAVNZ402_01820_SEQ_03: Mogmug is pleased at your obedience, and plans to use the vines to make a harp that will charm the attendees of the harvest fête, further expanding his army of fans.
TEXT_HEAVNZ403_01821_SEQ_00: Mogleo is looking for someone to help him catch his dream.
TEXT_HEAVNZ403_01821_SEQ_01: Mogleo will not let the servants of Nidhogg threaten his home any longer, and has resolved to join the Pomguard in their defense of the Churning Mists' moogles. However, not just any moogle can join the revered group of defenders. Only one whose strength is recognized by all can hope to join the elite group, and Mogleo needs your help to show that he has the mettle required to stand among such noble guardians. He plans to prove his strength by helping the many troubled moogles across the land, and promptly leaves in search of the first recipient of his kindness. Meet with Mogleo near Moghome to see if he has found a sufficiently distressed moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ403_01821_SEQ_02: Using his supermoogle sense of empathy, Mogleo has already found a moogle in dire need of his aid. Mogleo, deep in thought about what could be troubling this poor soul, bids you ask the moogle yourself.
TEXT_HEAVNZ403_01821_SEQ_03: It seems the troubled moogle lost track of a prized painted pebble, and guesses he may have dropped it while napping to the northeast of Moghome. Mogleo, eager to make his name as a helper of mooglekind, flits off hurriedly in that direction, bidding that you come as well. Meet with Mogleo to the northeast of Moghome to see if his search has produced aught of value.
TEXT_HEAVNZ403_01821_SEQ_04: You arrive to a terrifying sight: Mogleo is absorbed in his search, and behind him stands a ravenous dragon, ready to make a meal of the moogle. You leap to Mogleo's rescue, and the preoccupied moogle barely acknowledges your fierce battle. With the dragon dealt with, speak with Mogleo to find out if his intensive search was productive.
TEXT_HEAVNZ403_01821_SEQ_05: Luckily, it appears that Mogleo was able to somehow find the lost pebble among the hundreds of other pebbles littering the area. Return to Moghome and return the pebble to its rightful owner.
TEXT_HEAVNZ403_01821_SEQ_06: The despondent moogle's face lights up when you return the pebble to him, and Mogleo seems pleased with the results of his first foray into magnanimity. In fact, he proposes to help even more moogles, and next time plans to seek a troubled soul from outside of Moghome.
TEXT_HEAVNZ404_01822_SEQ_00: Mogomo is staring longingly into the distance.
TEXT_HEAVNZ404_01822_SEQ_01: Mogomo tells you of rare hornbloom flowers blooming north of Moghome, and asks you to pick three of them. Travel to the area near the House of Letters and look for the freshly sprouted flowers.
TEXT_HEAVNZ404_01822_SEQ_02: You have picked three hornblooms, and they are even more lovely than described. Return to Moghome and deliver them to Mogomo.
TEXT_HEAVNZ404_01822_SEQ_03: Mogomo flits with joy at receiving his bouquet. He plans to use the flowers in his secret garden, which he welcomes you to visit upon its completion.
TEXT_HEAVNZ405_01823_SEQ_00: Mogsy is gazing fearfully at the road to Asah.
TEXT_HEAVNZ405_01823_SEQ_01: Mogsy tells you of the terrible archaeosaurs stalking the road to Asah, attacking innocent moogles along the path. Slay three of them to open the route to moogle traffic once more.
TEXT_HEAVNZ405_01823_SEQ_02: You have slain the archaeosaurs. Go to Asah and inform Mogmont that they are no longer a threat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ405_01823_SEQ_03: The archaeosaurs have been troubling moogles coming to and from Asah for some time, and Mogmont thanks you for helping make the road safe.
TEXT_HEAVNZ406_01824_SEQ_00: Mogleo has finally found a moogle in Asah in need of help.
TEXT_HEAVNZ406_01824_SEQ_01: Mogleo has once again used his preternatural ability to seek out the troubled and beleaguered to find yet another moogle to help in Asah, and is eager to hear the story of his distress. Speak to the moogle and find out if there is any comfort you can give him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ406_01824_SEQ_02: The moogle in Asah has a tragic story to tell. He was in possession of a borrowed knife, made from the razor-sharp spine of a hulking wadjet. For reasons known not even to himself, he brought the knife on a days-long romp around the Churning Mists, at the end of which the knife was nowhere to be found. Unable to face his friend without the knife, he has decided that the only course of action is to make a new one, but he is too scared to get close enough to a pull a spine from one of the dangerous wadjets. Mogleo eagerly volunteers to get a wadjet spine in the moogle's stead, and hurries to the northeast, where the beasts are said to inhabit. Follow Mogleo and speak to him to find out what exactly his plan is.
TEXT_HEAVNZ406_01824_SEQ_03: Mogleo's master plan is to sneakily pull a spine from one of the wadjets while you fight it. Create a distraction and throw yourself against a wadjet's wrath so Mogleo can wrench a spine from the preoccupied beast.
TEXT_HEAVNZ406_01824_SEQ_04: The wadjet lies dead at your feet. Speak with Mogleo to see if he was able to obtain a wadjet spine.
TEXT_HEAVNZ406_01824_SEQ_05: It seems the wadjet was too slippery for Mogleo to pull off one of its spines, and he asks you to try again. Slay one more wadjet, and this time take care not to move the monster around too much.
TEXT_HEAVNZ406_01824_SEQ_06: Another wadjet falls before you, although you cannot tell if it has any less spines than it did before. Mogleo may indeed have had the strength to pull a spine off this time, but the only way to know is to ask him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ406_01824_SEQ_07: Once again the wadjet has proven too wily for Mogleo to wrench off a spine, but he assures you that they were of poor quality anyways. Go forth and slay one more wadjet, and pray that Mogleo's fingers are dextrous enough to grab a spine this time.
TEXT_HEAVNZ406_01824_SEQ_08: With the third, and hopefully final, wadjet dispatched, make your way back to Mogleo's perch and see if he managed to get the squeeze on the massive reptile.
TEXT_HEAVNZ406_01824_SEQ_09: At last, Mogleo has successfully pulled one of the wadjet's spines from its body. Speak with the moogle at Asah, who is surely waiting in anticipation at your thoughtful gift.
TEXT_HEAVNZ406_01824_SEQ_10: The moogle at Asah is impressed that you were able to provide an even keener spine than the one he lost, and decides that he will make an even better blade for him. With one less troubled moogle in the realm, Mogleo goes off in search of the next dilemma to solve in his crusade of kindness.
TEXT_HEAVNZ407_01825_SEQ_00: Mogson is gazing at the adventurer with an awed expression.
TEXT_HEAVNZ407_01825_SEQ_01: Mogson is astounded that something from the surface is walking amongst the Churning Mists. After recovering from his fluster, he comments that he forgot three baskets around the Four Arms. Help this connoisseur of landlord artifacts find his missing items.
TEXT_HEAVNZ407_01825_SEQ_02: You have recovered the woven baskets, although their importance remains a mystery. Deliver them to Mogson.
TEXT_HEAVNZ407_01825_SEQ_03: The moogle barely acknowledges the baskets, exclaiming that meeting someone from the surface is a much better treat than any relics the ruins could hold.
TEXT_HEAVNZ408_01826_SEQ_00: Mogmum looks so mad that his pom-pom is going to burst.
TEXT_HEAVNZ408_01826_SEQ_01: Mogmum has asked you to slay the amphipteres that run amok in the moogles' flower gardens. Slay three of the beasts to stop their rampage.
TEXT_HEAVNZ408_01826_SEQ_02: The wyrms lie dead at your feet, and the flowers look happy. Report to Mogmum in Asah.
TEXT_HEAVNZ408_01826_SEQ_03: Mogmum seems happy to hear the good news. When the dread wyrm Nidhogg's roar rang out across the land, it sent the dragons into a fury, during which they disrespectfully damaged Mogmum's precious flower beds. Now, thanks to you, hopefully the dragons have a newfound appreciation of the effort required to raise flowers.
TEXT_HEAVNZ409_01827_SEQ_00: Mogmont is flapping his tired wings vigilantly.
TEXT_HEAVNZ409_01827_SEQ_01: Constant conflicts between the dragons of the north and south are taking their toll on Mogmont's health. Slay three of each to give him time for much-needed rest.
TEXT_HEAVNZ409_01827_SEQ_02: You have slain the moss dragons and lower skylords. Report back to Mogmont with the good news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ409_01827_SEQ_03: Behind Mogmont's tired eyes you see a well of gratitude. The moogles must ensure that the servants of Nidhogg do not lay waste to Hraesvelgr's sacred domain.
TEXT_HEAVNZ410_01828_SEQ_00: This moogle is scouring every nook and cranny in Zenith.
TEXT_HEAVNZ410_01828_SEQ_01: A group of moogles are playing hide-and-seek near Zenith, but the seeker has run out of energy. Find the three moogles hiding around the area so they can go home.
TEXT_HEAVNZ410_01828_SEQ_02: After a quick search you find the three hiding moogles. Inform the seeking moogle near Zenith.
TEXT_HEAVNZ410_01828_SEQ_03: The exasperated moogle is grateful that you have found his friends, and invites you to their next game of hide-and-seek.
TEXT_HEAVNZ411_01829_SEQ_00: This manic moogle looks too busy to attend to his own matters.
TEXT_HEAVNZ411_01829_SEQ_01: The moogle on botanical duty near Zenith has asked you to deliver rich blackloam from the area to his friend in Moghome. Collect the soil from the clay pot.
TEXT_HEAVNZ411_01829_SEQ_02: You have collected the rich blackloam, and you can smell why it is so precious. Deliver it to Mogomo at Moghome.
TEXT_HEAVNZ411_01829_SEQ_03: Mogomo looks surprised at the delivery, but happy nonetheless. He explains that the moogles have an agreement with the great wyrm, Hraesvelgr, to care for Zenith in exchange for help dealing with any rampaging dragons.
TEXT_HEAVNZ412_01830_SEQ_00: Mogomo has the next step of his perfect garden planned.
TEXT_HEAVNZ412_01830_SEQ_01: Mogomo wants you to get him five kupo nuts so he can grow kupo trees in his garden. Visit Moggzia and ask him if he has any nuts to spare.
TEXT_HEAVNZ412_01830_SEQ_02: Moggzia has agreed to let you gather kupo nuts for Mogomo. Gather five from the trees that dot the surrounding area.
TEXT_HEAVNZ412_01830_SEQ_03: You have found five of the most impressively firm and large kupo nuts in Moghome. Bring them to Mogomo, and make sure to handle them with the same delicate attention you would give your own.
TEXT_HEAVNZ412_01830_SEQ_04: Mogomo is thrilled that his dream garden is one step closer to completion. He wants to eventually trade his kupo nuts to visitors from the surface for their shiny objects and tools.
TEXT_HEAVNZ413_01831_SEQ_00: Mogleo has found the next lucky recipient of his kindness.
TEXT_HEAVNZ413_01831_SEQ_01: The thoroughness of Mogleo's search for those in need surprises you once again, for he has somehow found another distressed moogle quite far from any established settlement. Mogleo looks eager to help, and it falls once again upon you to strike up conversation and find out what troubles this particular moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ413_01831_SEQ_02: The poor moogle at Zenith has perhaps the most heartbreaking story yet. It seems that dragons have overrun the flower bed he had been so dutifully caring over, and drove him away when he attempted to impart onto them the flowers' importance. Now, the moogle is trapped at Zenith with no way to return to Asah because the road is blocked by the selfsame dragons that invaded his flower bed. Mogleo, seeing an opportunity to help yet another desperate moogle, volunteers his protection while the heartbroken moogle makes his way home. Speak with Mogleo again, who wants to discuss the battle strategy of this next adventure with you.
TEXT_HEAVNZ413_01831_SEQ_03: Mogleo seems determined to take on this task alone, but also states that in the case of an actual dragon attack, your assistance would be more than welcome. Follow Mogleo and the troubled moogle as they make their way to Asah so that you may see Mogleo's courageous display of moogle strength.
TEXT_HEAVNZ413_01831_SEQ_04: Much to the surprise of no one at all, you find Mogleo and his charge cowering in fear before an enraged dragon. Save the moogles before they become the dragon's next meal.
TEXT_HEAVNZ413_01831_SEQ_05: Mogleo and the worried moogle are grateful for your rescue, and promptly continue down the road to Asah. Follow them to make sure they do not fall prey to any more of the Churning Mists' hungry dragons.
TEXT_HEAVNZ413_01831_SEQ_06: Once again, you arrive to find the two moogles in a difficult situation involving dragons. Intervene before their journey to Asah is cut prematurely short.
TEXT_HEAVNZ413_01831_SEQ_07: After you rescue the two frightened moogles, Mogleo claims that he was close to felling the dragon himself before continuing on the path towards Asah. Whether or not his boasting is true, follow the moogles to guarantee their safe arrival.
TEXT_HEAVNZ413_01831_SEQ_08: The two moogles have arrived safely at Asah, but Mogleo is ashamed that he was not able to dispatch the dragons himself. However, with the encouragement of the moogle he guided to Asah, he resolves to continue helping moogles until he finds the courage to overcome his fear himself.
TEXT_HEAVNZ414_01832_SEQ_00: Mogleo has found a moogle in a most compromising position.
TEXT_HEAVNZ414_01832_SEQ_01: Mogleo, in his journey to help moogles everywhere, has come upon a prone member of the Pomguard. However, it is not certain whether the moogle is injured or merely taking a nap. Talk to the moogle to find out if he is in a predicament that needs solving, or if he would just like to be left in dreamland.
TEXT_HEAVNZ414_01832_SEQ_02: It seems an encounter with a nearby tree has left the Pomguard moogle dazed, confused, and unable to move. The only thing that may possibly save him is a kupo nut. Though Mogleo is leery of the seriousness of the moogle's condition, he decides to aid him nonetheless. Speak with Mogleo to receive instructions.
TEXT_HEAVNZ414_01832_SEQ_03: Mogleo laments that he cannot solve this problem on his own, and decides that he will stand watch over the Pomguard moogle while you return to Moghome for a kupo nut. Make your way back to the settlement and ask Moggzia if he has any of the precious nuts to spare.
TEXT_HEAVNZ414_01832_SEQ_04: Moggzia seems to have more kupo nuts than he knows what to do with, and readily hands one over to aid a member of the Pomguard. Hurry and give the nut to the ailing moogle before the last of his limited energy leaves his pom.
TEXT_HEAVNZ414_01832_SEQ_05: Upon eating the kupo nut, the Pomguard moogle's disposition changes drastically, and his earlier ailment seems like a distant memory. Before you can even wonder at his remarkable recovery, he bids you and Mogleo join him back at Moghome for a meeting with his commander, Captain Mogloo.
TEXT_HEAVNZ414_01832_SEQ_06: Mogleo hesitantly presents himself before Captain Mogloo of the Pomguard, who scolds him for putting himself in danger by going out into the wilderness alone. To ensure that Mogleo has a proper outlet for his altruistic tendencies, Mogloo names him a new member of the Pomguard. It would seem that moogles from all over the Churning Mists have vouched for Mogleo, the Pomguard member he but recently rescued among them. With his courage and selflessness, Mogleo will make a fine addition to the lauded ranks of the Pomguard.
TEXT_HEAVNZ415_01833_SEQ_00: Mogson looks to be in a gift-giving mood.
TEXT_HEAVNZ415_01833_SEQ_01: Mogson wants to do something nice for his friend Mogmill in Moghome, who is something of an aficionado of the tools of the landlords. Go to the Landlord Colony and look for anything that might make a suitable present.
TEXT_HEAVNZ415_01833_SEQ_02: After searching the ruins of the Landlord Colony, you find a collection of tools that should be enough to impress an enthusiast of rusty equipment. Deliver them to Mogmill in Moghome.
TEXT_HEAVNZ415_01833_SEQ_03: Mogmill is amazed at the worn tools you hand him, excited to add them to his ever-growing collection.
TEXT_HEAVNZ416_01834_SEQ_00: Mogmont is scouring the horizon for signs of mooglelife.
TEXT_HEAVNZ416_01834_SEQ_01: The time has come for a lookout to replace Mogmont, but the moogles meant to relieve him are nowhere to be found. Search the road to the Monsterie for any signs of the group.
TEXT_HEAVNZ416_01834_SEQ_02: You have found the first of the missing moogles, who were scattered in a sudden dragon attack. Keep an eye out for the remaining three.
TEXT_HEAVNZ416_01834_SEQ_03: The moogles look shaken, but all are unharmed. Inform the first lost moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ416_01834_SEQ_04: Relieved that all members of the group escaped harm, the moogles will return to Asah with their pom-poms extra alert.
TEXT_HEAVNZ417_01835_SEQ_00: The moogle on the watchtower is cradling her rumbling tummy.
TEXT_HEAVNZ417_01835_SEQ_01: It is almost time for a change in shift, and this poor moogle's replacement is nowhere to be found. Slay four tulihands to secure a safe path and ensure the moogle on the watchtower does not starve.
TEXT_HEAVNZ417_01835_SEQ_02: You have slain the tulihands, and now the shift replacement should be able to report to duty safely. Deliver the good news to the hungry moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ417_01835_SEQ_03: The on duty moogle hurries home after hearing your report, eager to get her hands on some kupo nuts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ501_01836_SEQ_00: It's hard to tell whether this moogle is injured or just napping.
TEXT_HEAVNZ501_01836_SEQ_01: You find a lonely moogle lying atop a rock in the Monsterie, and he tells you that he is there resting his wings after expending all his energy looking for a moca leaf to give to his sick friend in Moghome. Since you seem fresh and rested, the tired moogle has asked you to collect the moca leaf in his stead. Search southeast of the Monsterie for any signs of a moca leaf.
TEXT_HEAVNZ501_01836_SEQ_02: After an exciting search, you finally manage to find the leaf you require. Return to the mercurial moogle to make sure that this is indeed the leaf you were looking for.
TEXT_HEAVNZ501_01836_SEQ_03: The mercurial moogle seemingly is not recovered from his feverish search, and asks you to deliver the moca leaf for him. Hurry to Moghome to give it to the sick moogle before he succumbs to whatever sickness he has.
TEXT_HEAVNZ501_01836_SEQ_04: You deliver the moca leaf to one of the moogles at Moghome, and he says that he will soon make a medicine out of it for his ailing friend. Thanks to you, the moogles of Moghome get to go another day without a terrible medical tragedy.
TEXT_HEAVNZ502_01837_SEQ_00: Mogret is gazing at these wilting flowers with a concerned expression.
TEXT_HEAVNZ502_01837_SEQ_01: It seems that Mogret is fretting over some flowers that are in danger of wilting before her very eyes, but she cannot water them due to the hropken that has moved into her favorite spring. Go to Eil Tohm and slay the inconsiderate hropken, then fill the empty ewer Mogret gave you with water for the flowers.
