TEXT_HEAVNZ502_01837_SEQ_02: The hropken will no longer be a problem for the moogles of Moghome, and the once-empty ewer is now filled with sparkling spring water. Bring it to Mogret before her flowers wilt away into nothing.
TEXT_HEAVNZ502_01837_SEQ_03: Mogret is ecstatic that her flowers will be able to bloom even further. It seems the increase in dragons is a recent phenomena, and Mogret seems convinced that they have only come to give the moogles a hard time.
TEXT_HEAVNZ503_01838_SEQ_00: The malcontent moogle of Moghome is pondering the moca leaf with distinct dissatisfaction.
TEXT_HEAVNZ503_01838_SEQ_01: The malcontent moogle informs you that while moca leaf has its uses, it will not allay his friend's fever on its own. To complete the medicine, he must add a handful or three of blistering scales, freshly sliced from the skin of a Mists biast. The malcontent moogle hands you a Moglinglaive to strip the scales from the lizards' tails, and sends you on your way.
TEXT_HEAVNZ503_01838_SEQ_02: You successfully relieve the local Mists biasts of their scales. Deliver them to the malcontent moogle of Moghome, so that he might prepare the medicine to cure his febrile friend.
TEXT_HEAVNZ503_01838_SEQ_03: The malcontent moogle is reasonably satisfied with your haul of scales, and immediately sets about brewing the medicine that will calm his friend's fever. The meandering moogle of Moghome shall surely soon be back on his feet and ready to resume his wanderings.
TEXT_HEAVNZ504_01839_SEQ_00: The meandering moogle of Moghome is tossing and turning.
TEXT_HEAVNZ504_01839_SEQ_01: The meandering moogle has taken his medicine and is well on the mend, but one thing hampers his recovery─his concern for his fluffy friend, who has not yet returned from his moca-gathering expedition. He bids you return to the Monsterie and bring the mercurial moogle back to Moghome.
TEXT_HEAVNZ504_01839_SEQ_02: You find the mercurial moogle hiding from a swarm of vicious vilekin. You do away with the insects, freeing the moogle to return to his friend's side. Follow the mercurial moogle back to Moghome to check on the patient's progress.
TEXT_HEAVNZ504_01839_SEQ_03: Relieved of his burden of cares by his friend's safe return, the meandering moogle has made a full recovery. He thanks you effusively for saving not only his own life, but that of his flighty friend as well.
TEXT_HEAVNZ505_01840_SEQ_00: Mogmill looks like he's daydreaming─or not, it's hard to tell.
TEXT_HEAVNZ505_01840_SEQ_01: Mogmill, always thinking about where to get his paws on the next piece of landlord treasure, has recruited you to go to the House of Letters and look for shiny objects. He assures you that all the other moogles go to Tharl Oom Khash, so there should be plenty lying around. Go to the House of Letters and collect five shiny objects of dubious value.
TEXT_HEAVNZ505_01840_SEQ_02: You have obtained five shiny spillikins, and although they are shiny, you fail to see any practical value. Return to Moghome and deliver them to Mogmill─maybe he will put them to better use.
TEXT_HEAVNZ505_01840_SEQ_03: Mogmill is thrilled at the objects you deliver to him, and is one step closer to having the largest collection of shiny, useless objects out of any moogle from Moghome.
TEXT_HEAVNZ506_01841_SEQ_00: Something has Mogmont's pom-pom in a twist.
TEXT_HEAVNZ506_01841_SEQ_01: Mogmont's sense of duty has been highly offended by a brazen dragon who has built a nest just outside Zenith. The dutiful moogle bids you steal an egg from this nest, but does not say for what purpose. Go to the plaza in front of Zenith and take the egg from under the dragon's snout.
TEXT_HEAVNZ506_01841_SEQ_02: Understandably, the dragon attacks you when you attempt to steal the egg, but you manage to subdue it. Grab an egg from the nest before the dragon recovers.
TEXT_HEAVNZ506_01841_SEQ_03: The egg is warm to the touch, and you can feel the heat of the soon-to-be-born dragon within. Bring the egg back to Mogmont to finally find out what he plans to do with it.
TEXT_HEAVNZ506_01841_SEQ_04: After handing the dragon egg over to Mogmont, he reveals the final step in his master plan: he will return it. However, not before giving the thoughtless dragon an earful and lecturing him on the importance of keeping such a holy place as Zenith clean and tidy.
TEXT_HEAVNZ507_01842_SEQ_00: Mognell has a lump on his nose and a buzzing in his ears.
TEXT_HEAVNZ507_01842_SEQ_01: Mognell has spotted a swarm of oversized insects about to lay their eggs in the lands beneath his lookout post. He bids you to eliminate three of these expecting damselflies, to prevent the Churning Mists being overrun by their evil offspring.
TEXT_HEAVNZ507_01842_SEQ_02: You successfully destroy a trio of expecting damselflies. Return to Mognell atop the ruins of Asah to inform him of your success.
TEXT_HEAVNZ507_01842_SEQ_03: Mognell is relieved to hear of the damselflies' deaths. He tells you how the appearance of invasive vilekin is a common occurrence in the Churning Mists, their eggs brought back from the world below in the soil stuck between the claws of returning dragons. The next time such a species appears, Mognell will deal with it himself...provided he can't convince a passing adventurer to do his job for him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ508_01843_SEQ_01: Mogeuge tells you how the elder wyverns have been amassing their forces below his lookout spot in preparation for an all-out attack. His nerves frayed by the constant vigilance required of his position, he begs your assistance to delay the wyverns' plans. Drop down to the Four Arms and slay four elder wyverns, buying Mogeuge some time to rest his weary mind.
TEXT_HEAVNZ508_01843_SEQ_02: You slay the requisite number of elder wyverns, thereby postponing their attack. Return to the top of the Asah ruins and report your success to Mogeuge.
TEXT_HEAVNZ508_01843_SEQ_03: Mogeuge is relieved to hear that you have thinned the elder wyverns' ranks. The moogle has been in constant fear of the dragons ever since Nidhogg's roar drove them into a frenzy. However, your kind assistance has bought the fraught moogle a few hours of rest and relaxation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ509_01844_SEQ_01: Mogeuge has heard the characteristic clicking of crackleweed seedlings drifting on the wind from the lands below his lookout point. Though he is glad to know the plants still survive in the scorched soil of the Four Arms, he fears for their chances of thriving. To secure their survival, he bids you collect five of the seedlings and deliver them to Moggzia, head gardener of Moghome, to be replanted in kinder climes.
TEXT_HEAVNZ509_01844_SEQ_02: You successfully collect five crackleweed seedlings from the Four Arms. Travel to Moghome to deliver them into Moggzia's green-fingered paws.
TEXT_HEAVNZ509_01844_SEQ_03: You deliver the seedlings to Moggzia, who agrees to replant them in his hilltop haven. Since Nidhogg's roar drove the dragons into a frenzy, the scalekins' wanton acts of destruction have brought much of the local flora to the brink of extinction. But as long as moogles like Moggzia are around, the plants and flowers of the Churning Mists have a fighting chance of thriving in pastures new.
TEXT_HEAVNZ510_01845_SEQ_00: The impatient moogle appears to have reached the end of his tether.
TEXT_HEAVNZ510_01845_SEQ_01: The impatient moogle tells you that his three young charges have disappeared into the dragon-infested wastes of Ohl Tahn, seeking to emulate the adventurers they idolize. He implores you follow the young moogles into this den of danger, and save them from themselves.
TEXT_HEAVNZ510_01845_SEQ_02: You find the adventurous mooglings and convince them to return to their master. Head back to Zenith to ensure that they have all returned safely to the impatient moogle's side.
TEXT_HEAVNZ510_01845_SEQ_03: The impatient moogle thanks you for rescuing his charges, before lambasting them for their reckless behavior. However, it seems that your successful rescue effort has only served to increase their admiration for adventurers. Knowing full well that it will further test their master's meager patience, the undeterred trio head out on another exciting adventure.
TEXT_HEAVNZ511_01846_SEQ_00: The impatient moogle has had it up to here with the local wildlife.
TEXT_HEAVNZ511_01846_SEQ_01: The impatient moogle is sick to his back teeth of the bladed vinegaroons, those spiny scalekin who terrorize travelers along the path through Ohl Tahn. He asks that you destroy four of their number to allow at least some passersby to escape unscathed.
TEXT_HEAVNZ511_01846_SEQ_02: You take down four of the bladed beasts. Return to Zenith, where the impatient moogle awaits word of your success with bated breath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ511_01846_SEQ_03: The moogle thanks you for your efforts, satisfied that the vinegaroons no longer pose an imminent threat. However, he cannot rest on his laurels just yet─so as long as the monsters continue to pursue any passing traveler, he must remain ever watchful.
TEXT_HEAVNZ512_01847_SEQ_00: Mogson looks like he's forgotten something again.
TEXT_HEAVNZ512_01847_SEQ_01: It appears that the absent-minded Mogson has left his baskets behind again, this time in Tharl Oom Khash. Recover them for the poor moogle so he can stop fluttering about in distress.
TEXT_HEAVNZ512_01847_SEQ_02: You find the baskets scattered around Tharl Oom Khash, and it is a mystery how the tiny moogle expected to carry them back in the first place. Return to Mogson and deliver his precious baskets back to him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ512_01847_SEQ_03: Mogson is delighted to have the baskets returned to him, grateful that he can resume crafting with the crystals stored inside the baskets. It seems that a distant dragon's roar scared the moogle off while he was gathering the crystals. Now, thanks to you, the nervous moogle can resume crafting whatever it is he makes.
TEXT_HEAVNZ513_01848_SEQ_01: The unmaneuvering moogle has lost his nuts in an unfortunate encounter with a vinegaroon. As the moogle was traveling through Ohl Tahn, the bladed beast spotted him and gave chase. The terrified moogle escaped to Zenith unharmed, only to discover that he dropped his kupo nut collection along the way. He asks you to return to the scene of his disgrace and retrieve his five precious nuts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ513_01848_SEQ_02: You collect the five kupo nuts that make up the unmaneuvering moogle's collection. Return to Zenith to reunite him with his nuts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ513_01848_SEQ_03: The unmaneuvering moogle is moved by the kindness you have shown him. Now that he has his nuts back, he is a happy moogle once more.
TEXT_HEAVNZ514_01849_SEQ_00: The unmaneuvering moogle has birds on the brain.
TEXT_HEAVNZ514_01849_SEQ_01: The unmaneuvering moogle informs you the heights of Zenith play host to a flock of migratory wildfowl, and this year's chicks have recently flown the roost. While the sight of the young birds setting out on the first leg of their life's long journey is soothing to the soul, the decomposing piles of leaf litter and broken eggshells they leave behind are less welcome. The moogle asks you to scour the heights of Zenith for the fledglings' abandoned nests and bring them back to him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ514_01849_SEQ_02: You clear away the empty wildfowl nests, leaving the heights of Zenith spick-and-span and ready for the birds' return. Descend from Zenith and deliver the nests to the unmaneuvering moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ514_01849_SEQ_03: The moogle thanks you for clearing away the nests and lets you in on a little secret─he has heard rumors that birds' nests can be used to make a delicious soup, and plans to use those you have collected to test the recipe. If you should ever wish to try a hot cup of sticks, feathers, eggshells, and regurgitated worms, then the unmaneuvering moogle is the chef to speak with.
TEXT_HEAVNZ515_01850_SEQ_00: A moogle in knight's armor is flitting to and fro in the Rookery.
TEXT_HEAVNZ515_01850_SEQ_01: Mogzun and his band of intrepid moogles have taken it upon themselves to defend mooglekind from the impending wrath of Nidhogg's minions, forming the “Mog Squad.” Look for the patrolling Mogkon and Mogoot so the group can begin their first training drill.
TEXT_HEAVNZ515_01850_SEQ_02: You have found the patrolling members of the Mog Squad. Report to Mogzun posthaste.
TEXT_HEAVNZ515_01850_SEQ_03: The Mog Squad assembles and informs you of your appointment as their commander. Shape these moogles up to be the shield of mooglekind.
TEXT_HEAVNZ516_01851_SEQ_00: Mogzun is staring down his surroundings with all of his might.
TEXT_HEAVNZ516_01851_SEQ_01: Mogzun's assignment is to slay the meliae infesting the area─but first he needs someone to show him how to do it. Slay three meliae and bring Mogzun branches pulled from their corpses as proof.
TEXT_HEAVNZ516_01851_SEQ_02: The meliae have been slain and their branches are in your possession. Deliver them to Mogzun.
TEXT_HEAVNZ516_01851_SEQ_03: You have delivered the branches to Mogzun, and he claims to have learned much from watching you fight. However, apparently watching is just as hard as doing, and he has decided to end his training for the day.
TEXT_HEAVNZ517_01852_SEQ_00: Mogkon is shaking her wand furiously at the air.
TEXT_HEAVNZ517_01852_SEQ_01: Mogkon has been assigned to kill the drakes slinking about the area. Before she tries to take one on herself, she needs you to gauge their strength and bring her three drake tails from your fallen foes.
TEXT_HEAVNZ517_01852_SEQ_02: The drakes fall one after the other, and the tails are now in your hands. Deliver them to Mogkon.
TEXT_HEAVNZ517_01852_SEQ_03: Mogkon thanks you for giving her an accurate read on the drakes' strength. However, she decides that she probably needs to train more before attempting to take one on herself.
TEXT_HEAVNZ518_01853_SEQ_00: Mogoot is watching the nearby golems with a keen eye.
TEXT_HEAVNZ518_01853_SEQ_01: Mogoot's assignment is to take down limestone golems. He uses this opportunity to express doubt regarding your qualifications to be the Mog Squad's commander. Slay three golems and bring Mogoot their cores to show him your mettle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ518_01853_SEQ_02: The golems crumble into pebbles before you. Bring their cores back to Mogoot.
TEXT_HEAVNZ518_01853_SEQ_03: Mogoot is astounded by your fighting skills, and doubts that he will ever be able reach such dizzying heights. His mission complete, he returns to think on what he learned.
TEXT_HEAVNZ519_01854_SEQ_00: The Mog Squad is surrounded by a host of malicious-looking monsters.
TEXT_HEAVNZ519_01854_SEQ_01: The Mog Squad has been suddenly accosted by a throng of angry monsters. Save the frightened moogles from the beasts before they come to any harm.
TEXT_HEAVNZ519_01854_SEQ_02: The moogles are safe, if a little terrified. Speak with Mogzun about what happened.
TEXT_HEAVNZ519_01854_SEQ_03: Mogzun shamefully explains to you that he knows that everyone cheated during their drills, asking their commander to do their work for them. With a heavy heart, he decides to disband the Mog Squad and return to the quiet life of an ordinary moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ520_01855_SEQ_00: This malingering moogle looks all tuckered out.
TEXT_HEAVNZ520_01855_SEQ_01: This troubled moogle has been beset upon by a mob of inquisitive dragonets. Slay four of them to give the moogle some breathing room.
TEXT_HEAVNZ520_01855_SEQ_02: You have slain the dragonets, ensuring they will no longer nip at the moogle's heels. Report your deed to the malingering moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ520_01855_SEQ_03: The malingering moogle is relieved that he can finally take a break from running. As much as he likes the attention, wild animals should not be taken lightly, especially in large numbers.
TEXT_HEAVNZ521_01856_SEQ_00: Something in Tharl Oom Khash is bugging this moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ521_01856_SEQ_01: A nest of horrifying flying insects has been discovered by a moogle expedition exploring Tharl Oom Khash. Slay them so the expedition can continue.
TEXT_HEAVNZ521_01856_SEQ_02: You have slain the insects, clearing the way for the curious moogles. Report back to the entrance of Tharl Oom Khash.
TEXT_HEAVNZ521_01856_SEQ_03: The moogles are grateful that they can resume their expedition. The ruins of Tharl Oom Khash are home to a wealth of potential knowledge about the landlords that lived there ages ago.
TEXT_HEAVNZ522_01857_SEQ_00: The moogle expedition has run into an unexpected problem.
TEXT_HEAVNZ522_01857_SEQ_01: Monsters of unknown origin have burst forth from the eggs littering the ruins of Tharl Oom Khash. Slay them so the moogles can continue their expedition undisturbed.
TEXT_HEAVNZ522_01857_SEQ_02: The corpses of the beasts now lie among the ruins. Report to the glimpsing moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ522_01857_SEQ_03: The moogle thanks you for your bravery, excited that the expedition can get back on its way.
TEXT_HEAVNZ523_01858_SEQ_00: The malingering moogle is shivering in fear.
TEXT_HEAVNZ523_01858_SEQ_01: The moogle expedition is visiting the ruins of Tharl Oom Khash to learn more of the time when dragons and mankind lived amicably together. However, the leader of the expedition has cold wings and is scared to explore any further. Inform the rest of the moogles in the expedition that it is time for them to return home.
TEXT_HEAVNZ523_01858_SEQ_02: You have informed the moogle expedition that the time has come for them to leave. Despite some protests, they have complied with their orders. Report back to the expedition leader.
TEXT_HEAVNZ523_01858_SEQ_03: It seems that the ruins were once home to a great wyrm by the name of Ratatoskr. The moogles are surprised that another great wyrm besides Hraesvelgr and Nidhogg had ever inhabited these lands.
TEXT_HEAVNZ524_01859_SEQ_00: This green-fingered moogle is fluttering flusteredly.
TEXT_HEAVNZ524_01859_SEQ_01: New plants have sprouted to the northwest of Ohl Tahn, but this moogle cannot get close enough to pick them for fear of the aggressive monsters stalking the area. Pick three of the seedlings so the moogle can plant them in a safer place.
TEXT_HEAVNZ524_01859_SEQ_02: You have gathered the seedlings. Deliver them to the concerned moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ524_01859_SEQ_03: The moogle flutters in delight when you hand him the seedlings, and plans to plant them in an area devoid of monsters, completing the first step in his dream to eventually grow his own garden.
TEXT_HEAVNZ525_01860_SEQ_00: Moggzia is looking desperately around the surrounding grass.
TEXT_HEAVNZ525_01860_SEQ_01: A sudden gust of wind has taken Moggzia's precious cloud mallows into its greedy currents. Look for the three pieces that were carried off towards the Mother of the Sheave statue.
TEXT_HEAVNZ525_01860_SEQ_02: You have recovered the three tufts of Moggzia's precious cloud mallow. Return them to the worried moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ525_01860_SEQ_03: A noticeable weight lifts off of Moggzia's shoulders when you hand over the mallow tufts he holds so near and dear. It would seem he would have gone hungry without his tufts to use for skyfishing.
TEXT_HEAVNZ526_01861_SEQ_00: This moogle scavenger looks empty-handed and crestfallen.
TEXT_HEAVNZ526_01861_SEQ_01: The moogle scavenger has been hard at work collecting tools and weapons once used by the landlords, but his day's work has been stolen by a group of vouivres. Recover the tools from the dragons and return them to the moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ526_01861_SEQ_02: You have recovered the tools from the clutches of the greedy dragons. Deliver them to the moogle scavenger.
TEXT_HEAVNZ526_01861_SEQ_03: The moogle is elated to have his precious spoils back in his paws. The dragons infesting the Rookery still carry a grudge towards the landlords, allowing no one─not even moogles─to lay their hands on tools once belonging to the dragons' ancient enemies.
TEXT_HEAVNZ527_01862_SEQ_00: This moogle has lost something precious to him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ527_01862_SEQ_01: This poor moogle's ring was picked up by a syricta after the moogle dropped it during a leisurely stroll through the House of Letters. Get the precious ring back from one of the vicious syrictae in the area.
TEXT_HEAVNZ527_01862_SEQ_02: You have slain four elder syrictae, but none of them were the one that stole the poor moogle's ring. Slay more syrictae until you find the brazen beast that stole the ring.
TEXT_HEAVNZ527_01862_SEQ_03: The syricta gives up the lost ring after a fierce battle. Return it to the downcast moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNZ527_01862_SEQ_04: The moogle lights up when you present the ring to him─apparently it cost him every kupo nut he had.
TEXT_HEAVNZ528_01863_SEQ_00: Mogloo requires the stout arm of an adventurer.
TEXT_HEAVNZ528_01863_SEQ_01: Mogloo, Captain of the Pomguard, has asked you to aid in the defense of Zenith against the encroaching minions of the dread wyrm Nidhogg, which have become more bold since the dragon's awakening. Mogloo bids you speak with Mogkul, his second-in-command, at Asah for further details of your duty.
TEXT_HEAVNZ528_01863_SEQ_02: On the road to Asah, you come across Mogkul being beset upon by a dragon, and quickly dispatch it, saving the tired moogle. Speak with him to ensure that he is hale and whole.
TEXT_HEAVNZ528_01863_SEQ_03: Although Mogkul managed to fell two of the beasts when they attacked, it seems a third one was just too much for him to bear. He thanks you for your assistance, and bids you return to Asah with him to speak further of Zenith's defense.
TEXT_HEAVNZ528_01863_SEQ_04: Mogkul explains that the moogles in the Churning Mists have a sacred agreement with the great wyrm Hraesvelgr to keep up the maintenance of the landlords' many structures dotting the land. However, the increasing rashness of Nidhogg's brood has made it even more difficult to do their duty, and Mogkul is overjoyed when you agree to help them. Begin your valiant defense of Zenith with the other moogles at your side.
TEXT_HEAVNZ529_01864_SEQ_00: Mogkul is ready to set off towards Zenith with an adventurer in tow.
TEXT_HEAVNZ529_01864_SEQ_01: Mogkul is eager to set off towards Zenith, for the minions of Nidhogg could decide to intrude upon the sacred palace at any moment. Head towards Zenith and rendezvous with Mogkul to see what he has in mind for you.
TEXT_HEAVNZ529_01864_SEQ_02: As you arrive to speak with Mogkul, a dastardly dragon sticks his snout into your conversation. Mogkul is confident that he and Mogok can handle the threat, and instructs you to head north and meet with Mogga, who may have run into dragon-related trouble herself. Search for Mogga and slay any dragons that interfere with your business.
TEXT_HEAVNZ529_01864_SEQ_03: Mogga is fighting─or fleeing─for her life against a dragon when you come upon her, and you barely manage to come to her rescue in time. The moogle still appears flustered─make sure she has come to no harm.
TEXT_HEAVNZ529_01864_SEQ_04: Mogga is grateful that you saved her from the clutches of certain death, and hurries back to Zenith to make sure the other Pomguard moogles are safe. Return to the sacred tower and speak with Mogkul for his read on the situation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ529_01864_SEQ_05: It seems Mogkul and Mogok had no trouble dispatching the dragon that was troubling them, but bids you to come with them to Zenith to avoid any more rude interruptions. Speak with Mogkul again once you are within the safety of Zenith.
TEXT_HEAVNZ529_01864_SEQ_06: The nefarious dragons of Nidhogg's brood have only recently begun to come near Zenith, a place sacred to the great wyrm Hraesvelgr. Mogkul fears that the dragons intend to tear down the monument in a brazen show of disrespect to the moogles' protector.
TEXT_HEAVNZ530_01865_SEQ_00: Mogkul has lost track of Mogleo's whereabouts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ530_01865_SEQ_01: Mogkul refuses to give up Zenith to Nidhogg's brood, but has lost sight of Mogleo, who should be on patrol nearby. He sends the other two moogles on their respective patrols, and bids you find the errant Mogleo before he falls victim to a dragon attack.
TEXT_HEAVNZ530_01865_SEQ_02: You find Mogleo lying atop a broken piece of the ruins, apparently wounded in a fight with one of the dragons in the surrounding area. His wounds do not appear to be severe, but he worries for the safety of the others and begs you to inform Mogkul that Zenith has been overrun.
TEXT_HEAVNZ530_01865_SEQ_03: You arrive to find Mogkul breathing heavily over the fallen corpses of two dragons at his feet. He is dismayed and surprised that so many of Nidhogg's brood have infested Zenith, and is overcome with worry about the two moogles he sent on patrol. After you tell him of what happened to Mogleo, Mogkul resolves to go and aid his comrade-in-arms, and bids you find Mogga and Mogok before one of Nidhogg's brood gives them an unpleasant surprise.
TEXT_HEAVNZ531_01866_SEQ_00: Something is keeping Mogga from crossing this bridge.
TEXT_HEAVNZ531_01866_SEQ_01: Mogga has been tasked with patrolling Zenith for any signs of dragons serving the evil Nidhogg, and it seems she may have found some across the bridge she is cowering in front of. However, the poor moogle is too frightened to check herself, and bids you go in her stead. Cross the bridge and be on the lookout for any dragons that may be lurking about.
TEXT_HEAVNZ531_01866_SEQ_02: You have rid this part of Zenith of the dragon threat...for now. Report to Mogga and tell her the hardest part of her patrol is finished.
TEXT_HEAVNZ531_01866_SEQ_03: Relieved that she will no longer have to deal with the wrath of dragons, Mogga returns to her patrol duty and asks you to warn Mogok to be extra alert on his patrol.
TEXT_HEAVNZ532_01867_SEQ_00: Mogok is eyeing the horizon with suspicion.
TEXT_HEAVNZ532_01867_SEQ_01: Mogok, hard at work on his patrol, has seen something suspicious in the distance. Since the moogle dares not take his eyes off this area, he asks you to cross the bridge and make sure that none of Nidhogg's minions have snuck into Zenith undetected.
TEXT_HEAVNZ532_01867_SEQ_02: Mogok's suspicions prove to be correct, and the servants of Nidhogg attack you on sight. You fell them easily, but their mere presence in Zenith is worrying. Mogok will want to hear that Zenith has been invaded.
TEXT_HEAVNZ532_01867_SEQ_03: Surprised that the dragons made it this deep into Zenith, Mogok returns to his patrol, extra alert. Continue helping the Pomguard defend this sacred area from the ill-mannered clutches of these invasive wyrms.
TEXT_HEAVNZ533_01868_SEQ_00: Mogkul is worried about the invading dragons' intentions.
TEXT_HEAVNZ533_01868_SEQ_01: Mogkul is confused as to why dragons would be attacking them if their true intention was to destroy Zenith. Mogleo, having just recently joined the Pomguard, asks Mogkul why the dragons are loath to let the holy place stand. Mogkul explains that Zenith stands as a symbol of the once-strong friendship between the landlords and the skylords, and is all that remains standing after Nidhogg's wrath laid waste to the land. Mogleo surmises that the dragons are not aiming to destroy the whole tower, but the object that most symbolizes it: the spire. Mogkul and the others rush off towards the spire, and Mogkul commands Mogleo to stay put due to his wounds. Mogleo asks you to aid the Pomguard in defense of Zenith.
TEXT_HEAVNZ533_01868_SEQ_02: It seems Mogleo was correct, and upon arriving at the spire of Zenith you see the injured members of the Pomguard with a fearsome dragon flapping its wings menacingly above them. While the dragon is impressed that the moogles were able to survive thus far, it has no intention of letting anyone escape this time. It attacks, but you slay it as you have many dragons before it. Check on the grounded members of the Pomguard to ensure that their wounds are not severe.
TEXT_HEAVNZ533_01868_SEQ_03: The moogles seem to recover from their battle relatively quickly, and are filled with pride that Zenith still stands unharmed. The moogles say that they will continue to honor their sacred covenant with Hraesvelgr, but express regret that they lack the means to do anything more than patrol the palace and clean up the occasional minor mess. However, the moogles are proud of their accomplishment this day, and Mogkul states they will perform one final patrol of Zenith to ensure that there are no more dragons wandering about. Return to Moghome and tell Captain Mogloo about his troops' heroic deeds.
TEXT_HEAVNZ533_01868_SEQ_04: Mogloo is grateful that you were able to assist the Pomguard in protecting Zenith, and proud that they were able to save it from disaster. Echoing Mogkul's sentiment, Mogloo wishes that the moogles could do something to repair the damage Zenith suffers as the years pass. However, until the day arrives when the moogles learn the required skills, they will dutifully continue their patrol and cleaning duties.
TEXT_HEAVNZ601_01869_SEQ_00: Mathye has the look of a man who has lost everything.
TEXT_HEAVNZ601_01869_SEQ_01: Mathye received an order from Saint Endalim's Scholasticate, his most esteemed client, but has lost record of what they requested. All he can recall is they are missing a volume from the Seventy-two Articles of Halonic Polity. He asks that you go to the scholasticate and ask around to figure out which volume they require.
TEXT_HEAVNZ601_01869_SEQ_02: You arrive at the scholasticate and have a look around. You find a shelf listing volumes one through nine, but volumes four and six seem to be missing. Looking on another shelf you find volume six. You also notice volume ten lying on one of the tables. A young seminarian named Theomocent tells you he is studying volumes twelve and thirteen, while Archombadin tells you of his work with volume fourteen in a condescending tone. The student standing outside, Leigh, tells you he borrowed a volume from the scholasticate, but he has forgotten which one. After speaking with Janchette, however, you learn that Leigh has borrowed volume four but is too busy to study its contents. Report to Mathye and tell him what you have learned.
TEXT_HEAVNZ601_01869_SEQ_03: Your astute observations reveal that the scholasticate is lacking for volume eleven. Thanks to your keen eye, Mathye can go on to sell his wares another day.
TEXT_HEAVNZ602_01870_SEQ_00: Elaisse is waiting for something with bated breath.
TEXT_HEAVNZ602_01870_SEQ_01: A thief has been stealing money from the shops along the Jeweled Crozier and Elaisse has had enough. She has placed three sacks in the area containing counterfeit coins, and is waiting for the thief to take her bait. Check the sacks of counterfeit coins and see if her traps are still in place.
TEXT_HEAVNZ602_01870_SEQ_02: After taking a look around the Jeweled Crozier, you find one of the bags is missing. Return to Elaisse and tell her the trap has been sprung.
TEXT_HEAVNZ602_01870_SEQ_03: Letting the thief steal her bag of coins was only the first step of her plan. A small hole has been cut in the bottom, and the coins spilling from it will make a trail leading to the culprit. Follow the counterfeit coins and find who is behind this rash of robberies.
TEXT_HEAVNZ602_01870_SEQ_04: Following the trail of coins leads you to Osaulie, the young thief you encountered in the Brume. She runs away before you can reprimand her for what she has done. In her haste, she leaves behind the sack of counterfeit coins. Retrieve the sack and see what remains.
TEXT_HEAVNZ602_01870_SEQ_05: You retrieve the sack of counterfeit coins. Though its load has been lightened, it was all according to plan. Return to Elaisse and reveal to her the culprit's identity.
TEXT_HEAVNZ602_01870_SEQ_06: You tell Elaisse that Osaulie was the thief making off with the merchants' money. She immediately recognizes the name of the Brume's most notorious thief. Although she was not apprehended, Elaisse suspects Osaulie has learned her lesson, and will no longer be a nuisance to the Jeweled Crozier.
TEXT_HEAVNZ603_01871_SEQ_00: Maenne has one last request for you before she returns to Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNZ603_01871_SEQ_01: With her mission complete, Maenne makes preparations to return to Ishgard, but not before requesting one more thing of you. She asks that you deliver the sealed crate containing the aetherometers as well as the observation log from the northeast scout to Commander Handeloup at the Congregation. Your first task is simple: obtain the sealed crate not far from where Maenne is.
TEXT_HEAVNZ603_01871_SEQ_02: The sealed crate is heavier than it looks, but you manage to collect it nonetheless. Proceed with the second part of Maenne's request and obtain the observation report from the scout to the northeast.
TEXT_HEAVNZ603_01871_SEQ_03: You arrive to where the scout is posted to find out that he has already written the report of his observations. However, he will remain behind with the rest of the scouts to continue their work until Maenne calls for them. Return to the Congregation and give Commander Handeloup the items you have collected.
TEXT_HEAVNZ603_01871_SEQ_04: Handeloup is pleased that the survey was completed without any major incidents, but expresses concern that transformed heretics still exist. It seems that he wants to learn more of the history and environment of the Churning Mists, so that more light can be shed on the time when dragons and mankind purportedly lived together. He asks that you act as an intermediary and use your relationship with the moogles to convince them to hear out his request. Speak with Moglin to see if he would be inclined to help the curious Ishgardians.
TEXT_HEAVNZ603_01871_SEQ_05: Moglin seems willing to teach the knights from Ishgard of the history of his land, on one condition: the war between mankind and dragonkind must come to an end. He sends members of the Pomguard to meet Ser Handeloup, and bids you follow them as well. Speak with Mogkul of the Pomguard once you reach the party at the Rookery.
TEXT_HEAVNZ603_01871_SEQ_06: You meet Ser Handeloup, Maenne, and the moogles of the Pomguard, and after a short conversation they come to an amicable agreement. Ser Handeloup will do what he can to convince the Holy See to send carpenters and stonemasons to teach the moogles how to mend the stone structures of Zenith with their own paws. In return, the moogles will share what they know about the Churning Mists. With this, mankind and mooglekind will work together and attempt to repair the damage of the past and rebuild what has been lost.
TEXT_HEAVNZ604_01872_SEQ_00: This unflinching Temple Knight seeks the aid of the adventurer who felled the mighty Nidhogg.
TEXT_HEAVNZ604_01872_SEQ_01: A knight standing calmly in the snowy Pillars has told you that Second Commander Handeloup of the Temple Knights seeks an audience with you. Go to the Congregation of Our Knights Most Heavenly and speak to Commander Handeloup to hear what he requires.
TEXT_HEAVNZ604_01872_SEQ_02: Once you arrive at the Congregation, Commander Handeloup explains that the Temple Knights would like to know more about the state of the Churning Mists since the fall of Nidhogg, and are planning a reconnaissance mission into the heart of the former dragon stronghold. Commander Handeloup has requested your strength and knowledge to aid Maenne, who will be leading the mission. Speak with her to find out more details of this dangerous mission.
TEXT_HEAVNZ604_01872_SEQ_03: Maenne introduces herself as the leader of the reconnaissance mission, and asks for you to share any knowledge of the Churning Mists that may be of aid. She determines that the best place to land will be at the Rookery, and bids you meet her there at your soonest convenience.
TEXT_HEAVNZ604_01872_SEQ_04: Maenne and her fellow dragoons have landed safely at the Rookery, and they await their orders hesitantly in this unfamiliar territory. Although she is troubled by a sense of trepidation, Maenne declares that their mission will begin shortly, and bids you aid them when you are ready.
TEXT_HEAVNZ605_01873_SEQ_00: The languid noblewoman lets out a long, despondent sigh.
TEXT_HEAVNZ605_01873_SEQ_01: The languid noblewoman tells you of her beloved brother, who left home without explanation. He's nowhere to be seen in Ishgard and has no friends outside the Holy See save for Redwald in Falcon's Nest. Travel there and ask Redwald if he can direct you to the woman's brother.
TEXT_HEAVNZ605_01873_SEQ_02: Redwald remembers seeing the noblewoman's brother at the Convictory. See if you can find him there.
TEXT_HEAVNZ605_01873_SEQ_03: You find the noblewoman's brother. He seems to be finding life at the Convictory rather difficult, but hearing that his sister is worrying about him ignites his spirit of youthful rebellion and steels his resolve to not return to Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNZ606_01874_SEQ_00: This Haillenarte knight is in mourning.
TEXT_HEAVNZ606_01874_SEQ_01: A memorial service was recently held to honor Ser Chlodebaimt, third son of House Haillenarte. Though no one expected Camp Cloudtop's Rose Knights to abandon their duties for the ceremony, the Haillenarte knight was surprised to find not a single one in attendance. He would not dare question Lady Laniaitte, but his good friend Rontremont worked closely with Ser Chlodebaimt, and he is certain he would have attended if time allowed. That is why the Haillenarte knight wishes to offer him the battle standard raised during the ceremony as a memento. Deliver the battle standard to Rontremont at Camp Cloudtop.
TEXT_HEAVNZ606_01874_SEQ_02: Upon seeing the battle standard, Rontremont is reminded of the terrible battle at the Steel Vigil shortly after the Calamity. He tells you of how Ser Chlodebaimt gave his life for his men, and that he was an exemplary leader. Despite his close relations with Ser Chlodebaimt, however, he feels there is another more deserving of that tattered memento─Lady Laniaitte, sister to Ser Chlodebaimt.
TEXT_HEAVNZ606_01874_SEQ_03: Lady Laniaitte welcomes you with a warm greeting, but quickly turns sullen at the sight of the battle standard. She recalls that her brother was a great man, well loved by his men, and their readiness to seek vengeance for his passing. But rather than dwell on the pain of the past, she believes it best to live her own life and strive for a better future.
TEXT_HEAVNZ607_01875_SEQ_00: Mogzun is eyeing a rusty sword with a satisfied grin on his face.
TEXT_HEAVNZ607_01875_SEQ_01: Mogzun has given you the exciting news that a moogle named Mogoon is giving away weapons that once belonged to the landlords. Visit the area near the Mother of the Sheave statue for more information on this exciting giveaway.
TEXT_HEAVNZ607_01875_SEQ_02: After speaking to Mogoon, you find out that his giveaway was a farce, meant only to get annoying visitors to go away so he can pay his respects in silence. However, moogles are not the only thing proving to be a nuisance. He asks you to slay three of the dragons in the area so that he might have the peace he desires.
TEXT_HEAVNZ607_01875_SEQ_03: You have slain the dragons, and the area becomes noticeably quieter. Return to Mogoon with news of your deed.
TEXT_HEAVNZ607_01875_SEQ_04: Mogoon is pleased that he can finally show his reverence to the Mother of the Sheave in silence. The statue is made in the image of Shiva when she fell in love with the great wyrm Hraesvelgr, so it should be treated with the utmost respect.
TEXT_HEAVNZ608_01876_SEQ_00: Mogoon is concerned about the waters to the east.
TEXT_HEAVNZ608_01876_SEQ_01: Mogoon tells you about a flock of migrating anzu that have taken up in the sacred waters near the Mother of the Sheave statue. Their aggression cannot stand─scare them away or slay them if you must.
TEXT_HEAVNZ608_01876_SEQ_02: You drive away or slay all of the encroaching anzu. Report back to Mogoon with news of your success.
TEXT_HEAVNZ608_01876_SEQ_03: Although Mogoon recognizes the importance of water for migrating birds, he insists that wild creatures cannot be allowed to sully sacred waters.
TEXT_HEAVNZ609_01877_SEQ_00: Mogoon has a worried expression on his face.
TEXT_HEAVNZ609_01877_SEQ_01: Mogoon tells you that the migrating anzu have taken to building nests near the Lost Landlord. Help him to remove the nests before the anzu reproduce and throw the area into noisy chaos.
TEXT_HEAVNZ609_01877_SEQ_02: The nests have been removed. Report back to Mogoon with the good news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ609_01877_SEQ_03: Mogoon is joyed that you have delivered the nests to him. A simple beast like an anzu could never hope to appreciate the beauty and sanctity of the area's sacred statues.
TEXT_HEAVNZ610_01878_SEQ_00: Maenne can't shake the feeling of being watched.
TEXT_HEAVNZ610_01878_SEQ_01: Maenne has felt an unfriendly gaze on her scouting party since the moment of her arrival, and fears that the dragons may be planning an ambush. She bids you investigate the area for any enemies while the dragoons remain at their posts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ610_01878_SEQ_02: You find several dragons lying in wait to catch the dragoons unaware, but you dispatch them quickly. Report back to Maenne so she may plan the next step in the scouting mission.
TEXT_HEAVNZ610_01878_SEQ_03: Maenne seems unsurprised that her suspicions were confirmed, but wonders how the dragons came to be aware of the dragoons' movements. This scouting mission may prove to be more dangerous than initially thought.
TEXT_HEAVNZ611_01879_SEQ_00: Maenne requires your help taking aetheric readings in new locations.
TEXT_HEAVNZ611_01879_SEQ_01: Maenne's scouts have reported several locations that appear to have been host to ancient battles, and have been tasked with obtaining readings of the sites' aetheric levels. However, the scouts scarce have the time to take accurate readings on account of the dragons stalking the area. Maenne asks you to help the scouts and bids you meet the scouting party near Sothton Walls. Speak with the southern scouting party dragoon to see what he requires.
TEXT_HEAVNZ611_01879_SEQ_02: The diresaurs that hulk about the area are proving to be a nuisance, preventing the scouting party from securely setting up their aetherometers. Distract them and slay three of the beasts so the dragoons can set up the aetherometers undistracted.
TEXT_HEAVNZ611_01879_SEQ_03: Your fight against the diresaurs provides much-needed exercise for you, and a much-needed distraction to the beleaguered dragoons. Return to the scouting party dragoon and confirm that they were able to safely set up their aetherometers.
TEXT_HEAVNZ611_01879_SEQ_04: The dragoons were able to set up the aetherometers without incident, and express some regret that they are unable to see you fight for longer.
TEXT_HEAVNZ612_01880_SEQ_00: Maenne's wounds seem to have healed somewhat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ612_01880_SEQ_01: Maenne informs you that she was attacked suddenly while investigating the lower layer of the Rookery by a type of dragon she has never seen before. She worries that leaving the beast be will only result in more injured dragoons, and bids you slay it before any more come to harm. She also asks that you bring something from that battle that might help identify the true nature of such a dragon. Make your way to the lower layer of the Rookery and slay the dragon if you find it.
TEXT_HEAVNZ612_01880_SEQ_02: You encounter the enormous dragon and slay it after a violent struggle, recovering a piece of ancient and rusty armor from its corpse. Give the armor to Maenne to see if she can glean any knowledge from it.
TEXT_HEAVNZ612_01880_SEQ_03: After examining the piece of armor you present to her, Maenne declares that it was forged in Ishgard, and most likely dates back to hundreds of years ago. It seems the dragon you slew was once a heretic, his monstrous form resulting from overindulging in dragon blood. Maenne cannot understand the heretic's motivations, and wonders why anyone would choose to be transformed in such a way.
TEXT_HEAVNZ613_01881_SEQ_00: Maenne needs someone to check on her scouts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ613_01881_SEQ_01: Maenne needs an extra hand to check up on the scouts dispatched to the northeast whilst she takes care of wounded dragoons in a different area of the Rookery. Head towards Easton Eyes and speak to the scouting party dragoon for news of their progress.
TEXT_HEAVNZ613_01881_SEQ_02: It seems that the blood dragons are making it difficult for the scouting party to make any progress at all. Slay three of them so the dragoons can continue their mission unscathed.
TEXT_HEAVNZ613_01881_SEQ_03: Thanks to your wealth of experience in the field of dragonslaying, you make quick work of the blood dragons. Report back to the scouting party dragoon to see if he made good on his promise to kill as many dragons as you.
TEXT_HEAVNZ613_01881_SEQ_04: The scouting dragoon is amazed that you made such quick work of the dragons, and is grateful that they are finally able to make a foothold in such dangerous territory.
TEXT_HEAVNZ614_01882_SEQ_00: The northeastern scouting party dragoon seems to have lost something.
TEXT_HEAVNZ614_01882_SEQ_01: The dragoon in charge of scouting the northeastern region has lost two priceless aetherometers, essential tools for measuring the aether levels of the Churning Mists. He asks for your help in seeking out the tools, lest the efforts made in scouting the region be in vain.
TEXT_HEAVNZ614_01882_SEQ_02: After braving blood dragon assaults and a harsh climate, you manage to find the two lost aetherometers. Bring them back to the scouting party dragoon to find out what to do with them next.
TEXT_HEAVNZ614_01882_SEQ_03: The scouting party dragoon is grateful for your help, relieved that the measurements remain intact. He has asked you to deliver them to Maenne so that he can remain behind and continue his duties.
TEXT_HEAVNZ614_01882_SEQ_04: Maenne is impressed with the aetheric readings indicated in the aetherometers, and will send them to the Congregation to aid in their research regarding the Churning Mists.
TEXT_HEAVNZ615_01883_SEQ_00: This dragoon is concerned about the scouting party at the battlefield to the north.
TEXT_HEAVNZ615_01883_SEQ_01: The dragoon must wait at his station until the aetheric measurements are complete, so he asks you to check up on the scouting party sent north, who may be experiencing the same troubles as he is. Go north and speak to the scouting party dragoon to see if she is in need of an adventurer's strength.
TEXT_HEAVNZ615_01883_SEQ_02: Although the dragoon was able to complete her aetheric measurements, she was attacked and her expedition report was stolen by one of the vicious diresaurs that wander the area. She is not entirely sure which of the brutes stole the report, so kill them until the kleptomaniac dragon gives it up.
TEXT_HEAVNZ615_01883_SEQ_03: The first diresaur you slay fails to yield the report. Keep your weapon drawn and kill more dragons until the report presents itself.
TEXT_HEAVNZ615_01883_SEQ_04: After practicing your combat moves on several more diresaurs, you finally find the errant report. Return it to the distressed dragoon so her work will not have gone to waste.
TEXT_HEAVNZ615_01883_SEQ_05: You return the report to the troubled dragoon, and she is elated that she will be able to finish it at last. It is unclear what the dragon would have done with the information in the report, but surely it would have had dire consequences.
TEXT_HEAVNZ616_01884_SEQ_00: The dragoon needs someone to collect the aetherometers for her.
TEXT_HEAVNZ616_01884_SEQ_01: The dragoon scout is ready to move on to a more detailed analysis, but she requires the three aetherometers she has set up beforehand. Collect the aetherometers and try not to anger any dragons along the way.
TEXT_HEAVNZ616_01884_SEQ_02: You have collected the aetherometers without incident. Return them to the scout to see if they measured aught that can be of value.
TEXT_HEAVNZ616_01884_SEQ_03: The dragoon seems pleased with the measurements of the aetherometers, and requests that you bring them to Maenne, but not before collecting the remaining aetherometers from the scout to the south. Speak with the dragoon at the southern ruins to see if the aetherometers are available.
TEXT_HEAVNZ616_01884_SEQ_04: It seems that scouting is a full-time duty, and the southern scout asks that you collect his three aetherometers, which should have just finished completing their readings. Search the area for the aetherometers and be on the lookout for any hostile dragons.
TEXT_HEAVNZ616_01884_SEQ_05: Once again, you collect the aetherometers without incident. Show them to the dragoon scout so that he may confirm that the readings were complete.
TEXT_HEAVNZ616_01884_SEQ_06: After inspecting the aetherometers to make sure the readings finished successfully, the dragoon bids you return them to Maenne. Speak with her to see what she intends to do with all the aetherometers.
TEXT_HEAVNZ616_01884_SEQ_07: You arrive to the scouting party's encampment to find Maenne hunched over. Apparently she was attacked by a dragon, but she skips the details of the encounter to ask you about the reports from her scouts. Grateful that none under her charge came to harm, she bids you place the aetherometers in the sealed crate next to her.
TEXT_HEAVNZ616_01884_SEQ_08: The aetherometers fit in the sealed crate as if they were designed to be put in there. Report the successful completion of this important task to Maenne.
TEXT_HEAVNZ616_01884_SEQ_09: Maenne is pleased that the aetheric readings are complete, but she is obviously still shaken from her encounter with the dragon. Once her wounds are healed, mayhap she will be curious as to the nature of the beast that attacked her.
TEXT_HEAVNZ617_01885_SEQ_01: Rumor has reached Ingaret that someone has seen sorbets somewhere in the local area. Verify whether or not these rumors are true by finding the person who sighted these creatures and confirming their story.
TEXT_HEAVNZ617_01885_SEQ_02: You speak with Tourcenet and he assures you that he saw sorbets at Red Rim. They should be dealt with quickly, before they get out of hand. Travel to Red Rim and slay some of the beasts to keep their numbers in check.
TEXT_HEAVNZ617_01885_SEQ_03: You have killed four of the monsters. That should keep them under control for the time being. Return to Ingaret and let her know that the rumors were true.
TEXT_HEAVNZ617_01885_SEQ_04: Ingaret thanks you for both confirming the rumors and slaying several of the sorbets, too. Sorbets do not normally live in this area, and Ingaret is unable to offer any explanation as to why they are there. She does seem to have a hunch─one she chooses not to disclose.
TEXT_HEAVNZ618_01886_SEQ_00: Redwald needs your help with an investigation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ618_01886_SEQ_01: Redwald has requested your help in part of Falcon's Nest's ongoing investigations into the heretics' actions. He asks you to travel to the ruins of Hemlock. The knight stationed there will advise you what to do from there.
TEXT_HEAVNZ618_01886_SEQ_02: There have been reports that there are heretics hiding within the ruins supposedly with a mind to establish a base of operations. There should be four heretics there. Find them and eliminate them.
TEXT_HEAVNZ618_01886_SEQ_03: You have found and killed all four heretics reported as taking refuge within Hemlock. Report back to Redwald that this insidious threat has been dealt with.
TEXT_HEAVNZ618_01886_SEQ_04: Redwald thanks you for your work, but goes on to explain that not all heretics truly believe in the Dravanian Horde's doctrine. Many are simply criminals who have nowhere else to run. Of course, their lack of conviction does not make them any less traitorous in the eyes of Ishgardian law.
TEXT_HEAVNZ619_01887_SEQ_01: The troubled Elezen is worried about his uncle, Emont. The man lives out at Oakum Landing, an area teeming with deadly monsters. He asks you to speak with the man and convince him to leave that hazardous place. Persuade Emont to go to Falcon's Nest and live with his nephew.
TEXT_HEAVNZ619_01887_SEQ_02: Emont explains that Oakum Landing is his home, and that he has no intention of leaving. He suggests that if you are truly concerned that the area is dangerous, you should help by killing off some of the tursuses that wander near the landing.
TEXT_HEAVNZ619_01887_SEQ_03: You vanquish the tursuses plaguing Oakum Landing. See if Emont has changed his mind about moving to Falcon's Nest now.
TEXT_HEAVNZ619_01887_SEQ_04: Emont is grateful to you for making the area safer, but still has not the slightest intention of leaving. The man seems resolute. Relay his message back to his nephew waiting at Falcon's Nest.
TEXT_HEAVNZ619_01887_SEQ_05: The Elezen is disappointed that his uncle is being so stubborn, but he appreciates your efforts, both in attempting to persuade the man and in making the area safer. He yet holds out hope that, with time, the old man might change his mind.
TEXT_HEAVNZ620_01888_SEQ_01: Emont is trying to make something, but he is concerned by the constant harassment by the sleet traps around his home. He would hate for them to destroy something he has worked hard to make. Slay five of these beasts to help put the man's mind at ease.
TEXT_HEAVNZ620_01888_SEQ_02: You rid the area of five beastly sleet traps. Let Emont know that he need no longer live in fear of these ghastly vandals and their destructive behavior.
TEXT_HEAVNZ620_01888_SEQ_03: Emont offers his thanks and explains what he was working on. Before the Calamity froze the waters, Oakum Landing was frequented by countless ships. In those days, Emont would recycle unneeded or damaged rigging and sell it for other ships to use for repairs or reinforcements. Though the ice and cold have stopped the ships from reaching him, he plans to prepare for the day the rivers melt by having plenty of rigging prepared for sale.
TEXT_HEAVNZ621_01889_SEQ_00: Margyt is in the middle of a heated discussion.
TEXT_HEAVNZ621_01889_SEQ_01: You happen upon an unknown man offering Margyt some sort of ultimatum, then leaving. She is part of Dominiac's unit, and the troops know that he is up to something─they have not been sent out after the Dravanian Horde in quite some time now. The only option, as Margyt sees it, is to take action of their own accord. Talk to Ayleth for further details.
TEXT_HEAVNZ621_01889_SEQ_02: A scout from another unit was attacked by a dragon─quite an impressive one, if rumor is to be believed. Killing this beast would help make up for the time wasted waiting for orders from Dominiac. The attack happened at Red Rim, to the south of the Convictory. Rendezvous with Ayleth there.
TEXT_HEAVNZ621_01889_SEQ_03: Some members of the scouting party fell to the dragon's attack. Their bodies should be nearby, as should the dragon. Find a body. The attacker will not be far from it.
TEXT_HEAVNZ621_01889_SEQ_04: You have found a body and slain the dragon that was lurking near it. Inform Ayleth of the situation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ621_01889_SEQ_05: Ayleth congratulates you on an impressive kill and asks you to deliver the fang you recovered from the beast to Margyt.
TEXT_HEAVNZ621_01889_SEQ_06: Margyt, too, congratulates you on your victory. She thanks you for the fang, but comments that it does not seem to have come from the dragon that attacked the scouts. That beast was much larger─or so the survivors claim.
TEXT_HEAVNZ622_01890_SEQ_01: Margyt has been reviewing the report of the scout who survived the recent dragon attack. Judging by the fang you recovered from its body, the dragon you slew does not match the dragon in the report. Furthermore, many of the soldiers that reportedly fell to the dragon are still unaccounted for. Their bodies have likely been eaten by the beasts that inhabit the mountains. Kill the slate yetis near the site of the attack and recover evidence of the troops' demise, such that their families may have closure.
TEXT_HEAVNZ622_01890_SEQ_02: You recover several scraps of chainmail from the yetis at Red Rim. Judging by the state of the armor, it seems unlikely that the owners were alive when it was removed. Deliver it to Ayleth at Falcon's Nest so that it can be delivered to the Holy See.
TEXT_HEAVNZ622_01890_SEQ_03: You find Ayleth at Falcon's Nest. She seems frustrated by being assigned so petty a mission, but she assures you that the soldiers' effects that you found will be delivered to their families. Report back to Margyt at the Convictory.
TEXT_HEAVNZ622_01890_SEQ_04: Margyt thanks you for your work. Once Ayleth returns from Falcon's Nest, Margyt plans to review their tactics and techniques to improve their odds in future attacks on the Dravanian Horde.
TEXT_HEAVNZ623_01891_SEQ_00: Margyt is growing increasingly worried about Ayleth.
TEXT_HEAVNZ623_01891_SEQ_01: Margyt thinks that Ayleth has returned to the site of your previous fight with the dragon, south of the Convictory at Red Rim. She is quite uneasy about the situation and asks you to travel there and check on Ayleth's safety.
TEXT_HEAVNZ623_01891_SEQ_02: You have found Ayleth and slain the dragon that lurked nearby. Talk to her and make sure that she is uninjured.
TEXT_HEAVNZ623_01891_SEQ_03: Ayleth laments her weakness and her inability to bring about any change in what she sees as a corrupt nation. She asks for the fang from the dragon you slew, intending to deliver it to Margyt.
TEXT_HEAVNZ623_01891_SEQ_04: Ayleth takes the fang and leaves for the Convictory. Return there yourself and inform Margyt that Ayleth is unharmed.
TEXT_HEAVNZ623_01891_SEQ_05: Margyt is glad that Ayleth is safe. She explains that the girl's drive to bring about change in Ishgard stems from the murder of her lover by an Ishgardian nobleman. Many lowborn seem to share her sentiments, but are afraid to speak out for fear of being branded heretics.
TEXT_HEAVNZ624_01892_SEQ_00: Margyt wants to know where Ayleth is.
TEXT_HEAVNZ624_01892_SEQ_01: Ayleth never returned to the Convictory after you gave her the dragon fang and Margyt is getting worried. Return to Red Rim, where you last saw her, and see if she is still in the area.
TEXT_HEAVNZ624_01892_SEQ_02: You do not see Ayleth, but there are plenty of dragons, which you dispatch in short order. Continue looking for the missing girl.
TEXT_HEAVNZ624_01892_SEQ_03: There is still no sign of Ayleth at Red Rim. Return to the Convictory and break the news to Margyt.
TEXT_HEAVNZ624_01892_SEQ_04: The news worries Margyt. Where is Ayleth and what does she plan on doing with the dragon fang?
TEXT_HEAVNZ625_01893_SEQ_00: Margyt wants to try a new strategy for finding Ayleth.
TEXT_HEAVNZ625_01893_SEQ_01: With no idea where to look next for Ayleth, Margyt suggests talking to the troops at the Convictory to see if anyone might know where she could be. Ask around and see what you can find out.
TEXT_HEAVNZ625_01893_SEQ_02: Ayleth was spotted at the North Star by one of the scouts on patrol. Travel there and find her.
TEXT_HEAVNZ625_01893_SEQ_03: An unknown nobleman offered Ayleth power and status in exchange for the dragon tooth, but it was a trick. He stole the tooth and left Ayleth with nothing. Margyt assures her that despite not having status or social power, if they work together, they can bring about change in the Ishgardian society. Ayleth agrees to work together with Margyt to this end. Margyt asks you to talk to her back at the Convictory so she can continue the discussion in the safety of the camp.
TEXT_HEAVNZ625_01893_SEQ_04: Though no one soldier at the Convictory holds great power, Margyt explains that, like any cohesive fighting unit, if she and Ayleth combine their strength and work together, they can achieve much more than they ever could alone. With this in mind, they resolve to change Ishgard for the better.
TEXT_HEAVNZ626_01894_SEQ_00: Bonifoix stares a thousand yalms into the distance.
TEXT_HEAVNZ626_01894_SEQ_01: Bonifoix and his unit were out hunting dragons at Red Rim when things turned sour. Bonifoix was the only one to survive. Search for the men's belongings so that he can return them to their parents.
TEXT_HEAVNZ626_01894_SEQ_02: You find the slain men's belongings. Take them back to Bonifoix.
TEXT_HEAVNZ626_01894_SEQ_03: Bonifoix's unit was brave and valiant to the very end. The belongings you recovered might help him convince their parents of this.
TEXT_HEAVNZ627_01895_SEQ_00: Jantellot appears to be plotting something.
TEXT_HEAVNZ627_01895_SEQ_01: Jantellot has come up with an incredible plan, but needs your help in enacting it. He needs you to travel to the Slate Mountains and kill four vindthurs─but has yet to explain why.
TEXT_HEAVNZ627_01895_SEQ_02: You unquestioningly put the vindthurs to slaughter. Jantellot will be pleased to hear of this development...
TEXT_HEAVNZ627_01895_SEQ_03: You return to Jantellot and notify him of your victory over the vindthurs. He reveals to you that he plans to retrieve the frozen Dravanian corpses from the mountain and claim them as his own conquests. You find yourself questioning the soundness of his plan...and his mind.
TEXT_HEAVNZ628_01896_SEQ_00: Luciae is looking for assistance in securing the Convictory's supply lines.
TEXT_HEAVNZ628_01896_SEQ_01: Luciae is waiting for supplies from Ishgard, but a nearby nest of archaeornis is waylaying any caravan that attempts the journey. Thin the brood's numbers by slaying at least three grand archaeornis so that the goods can be transported safely.
TEXT_HEAVNZ628_01896_SEQ_02: You have slain three of the grandest archaeornis that you could find, hopefully reducing their numbers enough for any caravans to pass by unmolested. Report to Luciae with the good news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ628_01896_SEQ_03: You inform Luciae of your success. Glad that the route is no longer at risk of attack, she sets about convincing the Ishgardian merchants of its safety.
TEXT_HEAVNZ629_01897_SEQ_00: Pierriquet has a devilish glint in his eye.
TEXT_HEAVNZ629_01897_SEQ_01: Pierriquet has need of three zoblyn shells and has entreated your help in obtaining them. Slay three of the nearby ice zoblyns and gather their shells for him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ629_01897_SEQ_02: You collect the shells Pierriquet asked for. Take them back to him at the Convictory and find out what he plans to do with them.
TEXT_HEAVNZ629_01897_SEQ_03: Pierriquet is delighted at the gift of the zoblyn shells. He plans to use them to fashion affordable, sustainable ammunition for the old, battered cannons he's repairing down at Camp Riversmeet.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_00: Dominiac wants to talk to you about his plans to attract dragons.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_01: The corpse of the wyvern you slew has been stolen. Margyt is heading the investigation into this worrying theft. Speak with her for more details.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_02: Margyt knows who stole the wyvern corpse: the very same nobleman that stole the dragon tooth from Ayleth. After an attempt at a diplomatic solution, the man has rendered his demands: he wants to lead the operation to attract and slay a dragon using the dead wyvern.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_03: Much though Dominiac is loath to rob his unit of the glory of slaying the dragon, his duty to the people of Ishgard takes priority. He decides to submit to the thief's ultimatum. Saintrelmaux is still searching for the dragon and was last seen near the Dreaming Dragon. Find him and inform him of the change of leadership.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_04: Saintrelmaux was approached by a nobleman carrying the wyvern corpse claiming leadership of the operation. A disagreement broke out but was interrupted by an ajattara attack. Both the wyvern corpse and several lives, including the nobleman's, were lost in the attack. Assist Ayleth with the cleanup effort.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_05: Ayleth wants nothing more than to chase the ajattara down and kill it. She asks you to search the area for something─anything that might attract the beast.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_06: Among the wreckage of the ajattara's attack, you find a wyvern bone. Ayleth is hopeful that this will be enough to draw out the ancient Dravanian. Return to Dominiac and apprise him of these serious developments.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_07: Dominiac tells you that word has reached him of an impending Dravanian attack─a vast force sweeping towards the Convictory, led by an ajattara. Dominiac marks a location on your map, near Banepool. He asks you to travel there and use the wyvern bone to draw the Horde's attention long enough for the Convictors to prepare their defenses. Travel to Banepool and distract the attackers, or at least the terrible dragon leading and coordinating the attack.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_08: You place the wyvern bone at the requested location. With any luck, it should attract the ajattara leading the attack on the Convictory. Lie in wait for it and ambush it when it arrives.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_09: You have made short work of the ajattara. This has hopefully bought the Convictors the time they needed to prepare for the Dravanian onslaught. Recover the wyvern bone, lest it attract more dragons.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_10: You have recovered the wyvern bone. Report back to Dominiac.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_11: Your battle with the ajattara bought enough time for the Convictors to mount a successful defense against the now-leaderless Dravanian attack. Dominiac hopes that this victory will draw the Holy See's attention to the importance of what allowed this victory: the strong cooperation between the front lines and their supporting forces. He hopes that this might lead to a change in the way the Convictors fight, going from a group of paupers and outcasts, squabbling for credit and recognition, to an elite, organized fighting unit. He suggests that you find Ayleth and Saintrelmaux. They will be glad to know that your fight went well and that you are unharmed.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_12: Seeing a signet ring Ayleth carries, Saintrelmaux explains how he was born into nobility and that the ring bears his house's crest. Ayleth received the ring from a woman she cared for after the Calamity─Saintrelmaux's mother. The two realize that─despite their different backgrounds─at the Convictory, they are equal. This strengthens their resolve to see Ishgard changed for the better. Relay this uplifting news to Dominiac.
TEXT_HEAVNZ630_01898_SEQ_13: Whether their common ground be coincidence or fate, Dominiac is glad that his troops have come to understand their equal footing. He thanks you again for your assistance in seeing his plan through, and hopes he can find some way to repay you in the future.
TEXT_HEAVNZ631_01899_SEQ_00: Gildon stares off into the distance, his brow furrowed and stomach grumbling.
TEXT_HEAVNZ631_01899_SEQ_01: Your presence recalls Gildon from his fretful pondering, and also brings to mind a request for assistance. The paissas found north of Camp Cloudtop, known for their mischief and antics, have struck a nerve with Gildon by spoiling the cuisine of their resident Rose Knight cook. He asks that you slay three of the paissas to both thin their numbers and make clear the men of Camp Cloudtop will not tolerate their devilment.
TEXT_HEAVNZ631_01899_SEQ_02: You slay three paissas to the north of Camp Cloudtop. Return to Gildon and let him know the deed is done.
TEXT_HEAVNZ631_01899_SEQ_03: Gildon thanks you for your hard work. He tells you the cause for their recent roguery is their search for trees to build a nest. Camp Cloudtop has an adequate number of trees to suit the needs of Gildon and his comrades, and thanks to your help, the paissas will think twice before trying to take them as their own.
TEXT_HEAVNZ632_01900_SEQ_00: Fabrellet's troubled look suggests he needs a helping hand.
TEXT_HEAVNZ632_01900_SEQ_01: Camp Cloudtop's food reserves are running low, and Fabrellet needs your help to keep his men from going hungry. To accomplish this, he plans on using meat from wisents grazing north of the camp until a new shipment of provisions arrives. Slay the wisents north of Camp Cloudtop and obtain four slabs of their meat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ632_01900_SEQ_02: You obtain four slabs of wisent meat. Return to Camp Cloudtop and deliver them to Fabrellet.
TEXT_HEAVNZ632_01900_SEQ_03: You deliver the meat to Fabrellet, who thanks you for your swift work. He is grateful the wisents are present for just such an occasion. As it turns out, they are not indigenous to the islands, but were brought to serve as livestock. He goes on to say they plan to raise sheep as well, but for now they will settle for the less-than-savory meat of wisents.
TEXT_HEAVNZ633_01901_SEQ_00: Lady Laniaitte is waiting anxiously for something.
TEXT_HEAVNZ633_01901_SEQ_01: Lady Laniaitte tells you a small unit was dispatched to survey Ok' Gundu but has yet to report back. Fearing for their safety, she asks that you scour the area and see what has delayed their return.
TEXT_HEAVNZ633_01901_SEQ_02: You come upon three wayward knights among the ruins of an old building, but as you draw closer, you also find the Vanu that assaulted them. Defeat the Vanu and ensure the safety of Lady Laniaitte's men.
TEXT_HEAVNZ633_01901_SEQ_03: You defeat the Vanu, and the knights appear none the worse for wear. Report to Lady Laniaitte of what transpired.
TEXT_HEAVNZ633_01901_SEQ_04: Lady Laniaitte is relieved to know her knights are safe. As she would tell it, the ruins where you discovered her knights were once home to the Gundu tribe until they were subjugated by the Vundu.
TEXT_HEAVNZ634_01902_SEQ_00: Caribault seeks an adventurer who is not afraid to get dirty.
TEXT_HEAVNZ634_01902_SEQ_01: Crops are only as fine as the soil from which they are grown, and Caribault is in need of blackloam to ensure a bountiful harvest. He asks that you bring him five bushels of the rich soil from wisent grazing grounds east of Camp Cloudtop.
TEXT_HEAVNZ634_01902_SEQ_02: You collect five bushels of blackloam. Take them to Caribault so he can prepare the soil for a rich harvest.
TEXT_HEAVNZ634_01902_SEQ_03: Caribault is thrilled to see your bag filled to the brim with rich blackloam. He notes that it is particularly rich, perhaps because it is so fresh. As you leave, he suggests you clean yourself up. You cannot help but wonder if the job was dirtier than he would have you believe.
TEXT_HEAVNZ635_01903_SEQ_00: Fabrellet seems awfully satisfied with himself.
TEXT_HEAVNZ635_01903_SEQ_01: Fabrellet recently discovered several gastornis nests east of the Rosehouse, and was struck with an incredible idea. All he requires to set his plan into motion is a single egg. Make your way east of the Rosehouse, and retrieve an egg from one of the gastornis nests.
TEXT_HEAVNZ635_01903_SEQ_02: You have obtained a gastornis egg. Return to Camp Cloudtop and deliver it to Fabrellet.
TEXT_HEAVNZ635_01903_SEQ_03: You deliver a still-warm egg to Fabrellet who is now giddy with excitement. It seemed as though he intended to make the egg his next meal, but in truth, his plan is to raise a bird of his own for an ever-ready supply of eggs.
TEXT_HEAVNZ636_01904_SEQ_00: Gildon is up to his neck in problems.
TEXT_HEAVNZ636_01904_SEQ_01: Gildon is troubled by the dhalmels that have wandered close to the camp in recent days. Moreover, he claims they are breeding at an alarming rate. He asks that you slay four of them to reduce them to more manageable numbers.
TEXT_HEAVNZ636_01904_SEQ_02: You have slain the dhalmels. Return to Camp Cloudtop and report to Gildon.
TEXT_HEAVNZ636_01904_SEQ_03: Gildon is relieved to hear your report. He suspects the dhalmels have come closer to Camp Cloudtop to satisfy their curiosity. While they mean no harm, they are also blissfully unaware of the damage inflicted upon Gildon and his fellow knights. Though it pains him to do so, he has resolved to putting them down should their numbers grow too large.
TEXT_HEAVNZ701_01905_SEQ_00: Ermiance wants to spread a little cheer in Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNZ701_01905_SEQ_01: Ermiance tires of seeing people moping about, and wants to brighten their spirits with a few cups of soup. She asks that you search about Ishgard for those sad souls in need of cheer, and show them a bowl of her delicious cooking.
TEXT_HEAVNZ701_01905_SEQ_02: Walking about Ishgard, you encounter residents from various walks of life in need of respite. One look at your bowl sends them straight to Ermiance. Return to her and see if her cooking was the cure for what troubles them.
TEXT_HEAVNZ701_01905_SEQ_03: Her pot of soup is not large enough to feed all of Ishgard, but Ermiance takes satisfaction in seeing smiling faces again. She reminds you that, rather than letting the misery of the world consume you, it is sometimes better to forgo the inevitable and enjoy what few pleasures life has to offer.
TEXT_HEAVNZ702_01906_SEQ_00: The bleak nights of Ishgard have never felt colder for Brictt.
TEXT_HEAVNZ702_01906_SEQ_01: Brictt regretfully informs you that Osaulie, the young thief you encountered in the Brume, recently passed away. But something about this whole affair doesn't sit right with him. What he finds most troubling about this is how such a resourceful girl could not afford to guard herself against the chilly nights of Ishgard. Brictt asks that you speak with patrons at the Forgotten Knight and find her belongings for clues.
TEXT_HEAVNZ702_01906_SEQ_02: You speak with a drunken knight in the tavern and find Osaulie's belongings in the Brume. The knight tells you she listened intently to his stories of Camp Cloudtop, a quiet, dragon-free settlement in the Sea of Clouds. Amongst her belongings are flyers for this encampment and a large sum of gil. Return to Brictt and tell him of what you learned.
TEXT_HEAVNZ702_01906_SEQ_03: You tell Brictt of the conversation in the Forgotten Knight, and when he sees the gil and flyers in her bag, all the pieces fall into place. Osaulie was orphaned years ago after an attack by dragons, and he suspects she longed to escape Ishgard. In the end, her desire to save every last coin of her money cost her life. Brictt is saddened that a child with such determination could be denied her dream. As a small gesture of respect, he asks you take her belongings to Camp Cloudtop and erect a small memorial in her honor.
TEXT_HEAVNZ702_01906_SEQ_04: You travel to Camp Cloudtop. You place her belongings down in the shade of a large flower when a sound reminiscent of laughter briefly catches your attention. Return to Brictt and tell him the deed has been done.
TEXT_HEAVNZ702_01906_SEQ_05: Brictt thanks you for taking time to pay tribute to Osaulie's efforts. The end of the Dragonsong War is not yet in sight, but he believes someday the realm will escape the bloody grasp of conflict.
TEXT_HEAVNZ703_01907_SEQ_00: Conu Vanu needs help feeding the hatchlings.
TEXT_HEAVNZ703_01907_SEQ_01: It seems that the winds of fortune have brought you to Ok' Zundu to help Conu Vanu feed Ok' Zundu's hungry hatchlings. Slay five Window wamouracampae and bring Conu Vanu their skinned carcasses.
TEXT_HEAVNZ703_01907_SEQ_02: You have slain the wamouracampae and collected their skinned carcasses, although judging by the smell you fail to see the appeal. Deliver the meat to Conu Vanu so the hatchlings will cry out in hunger no more.
TEXT_HEAVNZ703_01907_SEQ_03: You deliver the meat to Conu Vanu, and he explains that the meat of the wamouracampa is considered a delicacy among the Vanu Vanu. He invites you to partake the next time he prepares the wormy-looking animal.
TEXT_HEAVNZ704_01908_SEQ_00: Hinu Vali's knives have seen better days.
TEXT_HEAVNZ704_01908_SEQ_01: Hinu Vali has a mountain of meat she must prepare for the upcoming feast in Ok' Zundu, and a new set of knives would make her work go significantly faster. Claws from the endymions flying near Ok' Zundu should serve her needs. Slay four and deliver their claws to Hinu Vali.
TEXT_HEAVNZ704_01908_SEQ_02: The endymions fall swiftly, and you pull their claws from their slain corpses. Bring them to Hinu Vali so she may continue with her preparations.
TEXT_HEAVNZ704_01908_SEQ_03: The endymions' claws cut through the meat with little resistance. With any luck, Hinu Vali will have the meat ready in time for Zundu's feast.
TEXT_HEAVNZ705_01909_SEQ_00: Ganu Vali is looking around nervously with bloodshot eyes.
TEXT_HEAVNZ705_01909_SEQ_01: Ganu Vali has not been able to sleep a wink for all the buzzing bugs around Ok' Zundu. He has asked you to gather three tufts of gurglegrass to help manage the bug population and hopefully provide him with the rest he so sorely needs.
TEXT_HEAVNZ705_01909_SEQ_02: You have gathered the gurglegrass, which looks quite eager to gobble up as many bugs as it can. Deliver the grass to Ganu Vali before he collapses from exhaustion.
TEXT_HEAVNZ705_01909_SEQ_03: You have delivered the carnivorous plants to Ganu Vali and his sanity seems to have recovered. The Zundu tribe stresses harmony with nature in all things, and providing the gurglegrass with food kills two birds with one stone.
TEXT_HEAVNZ706_01910_SEQ_00: Guna Vanu wishes that he could choose his family.
TEXT_HEAVNZ706_01910_SEQ_01: Guna Vanu tells you the tragic tale of his brother Gunu Vanu, who is on his way to being the only member of the Zundu to fail his rite of passage eight times. Another failure would ensure their family's place as a laughingstock in the tribe's history, and Guna Vanu begs you to help his brother pass his rite─but first you have to find him. Find out where he could be by asking the Vanu of Ok' Zundu for his whereabouts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ706_01910_SEQ_02: You have asked about Gunu Vanu's whereabouts and it seems that he enjoys lazing about and shirking responsibility more than the average Vanu Vanu. He spends most of his time napping under a shade or in a warm sunbeam. Once you find him, with the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase that includes the words “Wake up!” to rouse Gunu Vanu.
TEXT_HEAVNZ706_01910_SEQ_03: Gunu Vanu wakes up in a panic─it was as entertaining as promised. He expresses joy and agreement at your offer to help him with the initiation rite, although it is still doubtful how much work he will actually do.
TEXT_HEAVNZ707_01911_SEQ_00: Gunu Vanu seeks a helping hand for his rite of passage.
TEXT_HEAVNZ707_01911_SEQ_01: For Zundu nestlings to complete their rite of passage, they must offer the elder something of value to the tribe. Gunu Vanu's plan is to take the beak of a tsanahale, as his father once did, and prove himself a mighty warrior. Meet him deep within the Blue Window.
TEXT_HEAVNZ707_01911_SEQ_02: In the Blue Window, Gunu Vanu states that he will keep watch while you see to the tsanahale. Lure out one of the beasts by whistling loudly and dispatch it in the usual fashion.
TEXT_HEAVNZ707_01911_SEQ_03: The tsanahale is no more, and its beak is yours. Give it to Gunu Vanu so he may finally complete his rite of passage.
TEXT_HEAVNZ707_01911_SEQ_04: Gunu Vanu is overjoyed to receive the tsanahale's beak and is eager to present it to the elder shaman. Accompany Gunu Vanu to the shaman's roost in Ok' Zundu.
TEXT_HEAVNZ707_01911_SEQ_05: Though glad to receive Gunu Vanu's offering at first, the elder shaman grows skeptical that the nestling could slay a tsanahale by himself. Gunu Vanu subsequently admits to being helped by you, and the shaman commands him to redo the rite of passage─this time without attempting to exploit a loophole in the rules.
TEXT_HEAVNZ708_01912_SEQ_00: Hinu Vali has decided to have someone embark on a dangerous mission.
TEXT_HEAVNZ708_01912_SEQ_01: Hinu Vali has asked you to steal supplies from the Vundu tribe. She assures you that the success of this request will affect all the Vanu of Ok' Zundu. Go to Ok' Vundu and steal three Zundu offerings.
TEXT_HEAVNZ708_01912_SEQ_02: You have gathered up the supplies from Ok' Vundu territory, though you cannot at the moment reconcile why they seem to be of Zundu origin. Take them back to Hinu Vali to see what she has to say.
