TEXT_HEAVNZ708_01912_SEQ_03: You have delivered the offerings to Hinu Vali, and she explains to you that they were traditionally given to the Vundu tribe to ensure safety for the Zundu. However, the Vundu sometimes do not acknowledge these offerings and attack anyway. Given that the offerings are essentially meaningless, they would be most useful if they were returned to the stores of Ok' Zundu.
TEXT_HEAVNZ709_01913_SEQ_00: Ganu Vali is looking to the skies with a smoldering gaze.
TEXT_HEAVNZ709_01913_SEQ_01: Ganu Vali tells you of the troublesome Vundu nestlings that are bullying young Zundu tribe members. Take away the Vundu bullies' wings by slaying three of their sanuwa Vundu.
TEXT_HEAVNZ709_01913_SEQ_02: You have laid low the sanuwa Vundu, and have hopefully given the Vundu bullies something to think about. Return now to Ganu Vali and tell him the good news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ709_01913_SEQ_03: You have reported your victory to Ganu Vali. It appears as though the Vundu nestlings are not happy that you have taken away their options for mobility.
TEXT_HEAVNZ710_01914_SEQ_00: Gunu Vanu has a mischievous glint in his eyes.
TEXT_HEAVNZ710_01914_SEQ_01: Gunu Vanu has hatched a plan to make an offering that would surpass even his own mother's. He will present the elder shaman with Ok' Zundu's freshest, juiciest vegetables, but first he needs you to dance for the elder shaman for as-yet-unknown reasons. Go to Aanu Vanu and show him your finest /dance.
TEXT_HEAVNZ710_01914_SEQ_02: Aanu Vanu seems unexpectedly impressed at your twirling, a nostalgic glow overcoming him. Show him the /dance of your people once again.
TEXT_HEAVNZ710_01914_SEQ_03: Once again you have danced for the elder shaman, and he becomes more affable than ever before. He begins to regale you with a story of his youth before he points out that Gunu Vanu is nowhere to be seen. Most likely he is waiting somewhere with the fruits of his plan. Find him and see what he was plotting.
TEXT_HEAVNZ710_01914_SEQ_04: Gunu Vanu's master plan was to borrow the elder shaman's vegetables, which were being grown in secret for Aanu Vanu's own pleasure. Gunu Vanu leaves to present them to the elder. Follow him there and see if his plan works.
TEXT_HEAVNZ710_01914_SEQ_05: The wise and respected Aanu Vanu is able to see through Gunu Vanu's deception and rejects his offering. However, he agrees to let Gunu Vanu try again on one condition: that none tell Aanu Vanu's wife about the secret supply of vegetables. As the saying in Ok' Zundu goes, “One talon washes the other.”
TEXT_HEAVNZ711_01915_SEQ_00: Gunu Vanu is running out of ideas to borrow for his rite of passage.
TEXT_HEAVNZ711_01915_SEQ_01: Gunu Vanu has only one more family member to copy for his rite of passage─his brother, whose offering was to display his skill at riding the traditional Vanu mount, a sanuwa. Gunu Vanu, as always, has a shortcut in mind for this trial. Meet him at the Blue Window to hear his plans.
TEXT_HEAVNZ711_01915_SEQ_02: Gunu Vanu presents you with some leather reins that he claims will make any tame sanuwa obey your every order. He points out one such sanuwa positioned conveniently nearby. It may not be the ideal choice of prey however, since its owner stands nearby and will likely not give up the steed without a fight. Nonetheless, since no alternative target presents itself, use the leather reins on the battle-trained sanuwa and hope for the best.
TEXT_HEAVNZ711_01915_SEQ_03: After using the reins on the sanuwa, its current owner rightly attacks you, leaving you with no choice but to defend yourself. Retrieve the borrowed sanuwa.
TEXT_HEAVNZ711_01915_SEQ_04: You have retrieved the sanuwa. Return to Gunu Vanu and tell him of the noble deed you have performed.
TEXT_HEAVNZ711_01915_SEQ_05: Gunu Vanu once again shows his courage by answering the sudden and conveniently timed summons of the elder shaman. Although you did not hear the call, Gunu Vanu is already yalms ahead of you. Catch up with him to see what he has planned.
TEXT_HEAVNZ711_01915_SEQ_06: The elder rejects Gunu Vanu's suggestion that teaching you the art of sanuwa catching is a proper offering. Of course, Gunu Vanu cannot be blamed for not knowing the intricacies of his own culture, and the elder offers to give him one last chance.
TEXT_HEAVNZ712_01916_SEQ_00: Gunu Vanu is all out of ideas─and second chances.
TEXT_HEAVNZ712_01916_SEQ_01: Try as he might, Gunu Vanu can come up with no ideas for his final chance at the rite of passage. As he is wont to do, Gunu Vanu decides to turn to his family for help. Talk to Guna Vanu and listen to any suggestions he has.
TEXT_HEAVNZ712_01916_SEQ_02: Guna Vanu remarks that the only thing his brother has proven to be skilled at is sneaking and stealing, and suggests that Gunu Vanu creeps into the Garlean─or “Garloon”─outpost to steal one of the many shiny objects that lie strewn about. Gunu Vanu musters up as much courage as he can and heads in the direction of the outpost. Follow him and give what aid he requires.
TEXT_HEAVNZ712_01916_SEQ_03: Recalling the time you distracted the elder shaman with your dancing, Gunu Vanu asks you to throw the Garlean ranks into chaos to aid him in his sneaking. Slay three imperial soldiers to create a diversion.
TEXT_HEAVNZ712_01916_SEQ_04: The troops are staggering from your sudden and brutal assault. Report to Gunu Vanu, who is cowering in the distance.
TEXT_HEAVNZ712_01916_SEQ_05: Gunu Vanu sees no clear path to the imperial supplies, and asks you thin the ranks of the soldiers even further. Slay three more imperial troops.
TEXT_HEAVNZ712_01916_SEQ_06: The encampment has been thrown into confusion after your relentless attacks. Report to Gunu Vanu and see if he has managed to steal anything.
TEXT_HEAVNZ712_01916_SEQ_07: Although you did exactly what Gunu Vanu asked, he was still unable to sneak into the camp and steal anything. He has asked you to slay even more imperial troops. Before long there will be none left in the whole camp.
TEXT_HEAVNZ712_01916_SEQ_08: You have provided the distraction that Gunu Vanu asked for─again─but are not sure if he was fast enough to sneak into the camp undetected. Speak with him and see if your slaughter provided a satisfactory distraction.
TEXT_HEAVNZ712_01916_SEQ_09: Gunu Vanu has managed to steal an object from the Garleans, but it is unclear exactly what it is yet. Whether or not it has any value is up to the judgment of the elder shaman. Speak to Aanu Vanu in Ok' Zundu.
TEXT_HEAVNZ712_01916_SEQ_10: Gunu Vanu presents his shiny metal object to Aanu Vanu, and you see that it is a massive metal claw from the Garlean encampment. Aanu Vanu says it must be a fallen feather from a massive skyborne beast from Zundu legend, and judges that Gunu Vanu's rite of passage is complete. He bestows upon him the title of “Gunu Vanu, Bringer of Shade” for offering such an important piece of Zundu lore. Gunu Vanu wells with pride at his new title, but is eager to rest after his long and tiring journey, and leaves to find shade. Aanu Vanu asks you to find Guna Vanu and tell him of his brother's success.
TEXT_HEAVNZ712_01916_SEQ_11: Guna Vanu is overjoyed that his brother has succeeded in the trial, relieved that his brother has finally grown up in the eyes of the tribe. Guna Vanu hopes that with time, his brother's actions will come to resemble that of a functional member of Ok' Zundu society.
TEXT_HEAVNZ713_01917_SEQ_00: Aanu Vanu is gesturing desperately towards the sky in supplication.
TEXT_HEAVNZ713_01917_SEQ_01: Aanu Vanu tells you of cursed totem poles that lie in the Cromlech. Destroy four of them before the darkness they portend falls upon the Vanu Vanu of Ok' Zundu.
TEXT_HEAVNZ713_01917_SEQ_02: The cursed totem poles are nothing but pieces of splintered wood after facing your wrath. Report back to Aanu Vanu to tell him that the deed has been done.
TEXT_HEAVNZ713_01917_SEQ_03: After telling Aanu Vanu of your successful carnage, he goes on to explain that the totem poles in question were used in dark incantations, sullying the memories of the Vanu Vanu ancestors they were meant to memorialize. Allowing such actions to go unpunished would bring ill fortune to the tribe of Zundu.
TEXT_HEAVNZ714_01918_SEQ_00: Sonu Vanu stares off into the distance, eyes fixed on unseen troubles.
TEXT_HEAVNZ714_01918_SEQ_01: Sonu Vanu has received word that three knights were captured by the Vundu tribe. Unable to intervene directly with the Vundu's plans, he implores that you find them before they come to harm.
TEXT_HEAVNZ714_01918_SEQ_02: You find the captured knights, and they appear to be none the worse for wear. Seek out Lady Laniaitte at the Rosehouse and report to her of their condition.
TEXT_HEAVNZ714_01918_SEQ_03: Lady Laniaitte is shocked and dismayed that her knights have been captured, cursing the Vundu for their audacious act. She plans to deploy a rescue team posthaste, but is overcome with a sense of foreboding. The once-quiet camp is slowly becoming the war zone they were thought to be removed from. Thanks to the Zundu's fellowship and your selfless heroism, her knights will live to fight another day.
TEXT_HEAVNZ715_01919_SEQ_00: This Zundu youth needs someone to set him free.
TEXT_HEAVNZ715_01919_SEQ_01: A poor Ok' Zundu Vanu has been captured by hostile Garlean forces. He says that one of the nearby troops may be carrying the key to his manacles. Slay the troops until you find the required key.
TEXT_HEAVNZ715_01919_SEQ_02: After a series of fierce battles, none of the troops have the key you require. Continue engaging the troops until you find the one that carries the key to the troubled Vanu Vanu's freedom.
TEXT_HEAVNZ715_01919_SEQ_03: Finally one of the imperial troops gives up the key to the captured Vanu Vanu's manacles. Use the feather key on the captured Zundu youth to free him from his imprisonment.
TEXT_HEAVNZ715_01919_SEQ_04: The captured Zundu youth is grateful for your rescue, but hastily returns to his home, lest he get captured again. Return to Ok' Zundu and speak with the now-rescued Zundu youth to make sure he has recovered from his ordeal.
TEXT_HEAVNZ715_01919_SEQ_05: The Zundu youth once again thanks you for your courageous rescue, and informs you that the Zundu chieftain has requested that you go speak with him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ716_01920_SEQ_00: The Zundu intelligencer has need of a sneaky adventurer.
TEXT_HEAVNZ716_01920_SEQ_01: The Zundu intelligencer would have you find his three strategically placed spies and gather their reports, and then give the information to Zundu's chieftain, Sonu Vanu. Find the cleverly hidden spies and hear what they have to say about the Vundu tribe.
TEXT_HEAVNZ716_01920_SEQ_02: The spies tell you, among other things, that the Vundu have been keeping prisoners of people from the surface. Relay this information to Sonu Vanu.
TEXT_HEAVNZ716_01920_SEQ_03: Sonu Vanu seems to react gravely to the news of Vundu prisoners. He assures you that the Zundu tribe will react, but not until the time is right. Return to him when he is ready to share more information with you.
TEXT_HEAVNZ717_01921_SEQ_00: This Vanu Vanu is in an embarrassing situation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ717_01921_SEQ_01: In the Cromlech you come across a Vanu Vanu who is about to become a sacrifice for the Vundu tribe. A malicious poison prevents him from moving, but with your help he may be able to escape. Go to Aanu Vanu in Ok' Zundu for an antidote to the paralytic poison.
TEXT_HEAVNZ717_01921_SEQ_02: Aanu Vanu gives you the antidote, bidding you make your way back to the would-be sacrifice as soon as possible.
TEXT_HEAVNZ717_01921_SEQ_03: The desperate Vanu Vanu eagerly drinks the antidote, but his motor functions are not restored immediately. The unlucky Vanu will hide while you return to Aanu Vanu and ask him to send a sanuwa to the Cromlech.
TEXT_HEAVNZ717_01921_SEQ_04: Aanu Vanu agrees to send a sanuwa towards the Cromlech immediately. With any luck the poor Zundu Vanu will return unscathed.
TEXT_HEAVNZ718_01922_SEQ_00: Hervoix is eager for someone to help him shirk his duties.
TEXT_HEAVNZ718_01922_SEQ_01: Hervoix, a freshly arrived hunter to the bustling Tailfeather, has received the unenviable task of having to kill one of the many beasts that prey on the forest's chocobos. Claiming that hunters have no business slaying bothersome pests, he instead plans to bestow a purse of gil to any adventurer willing to do his work for him─and you eagerly accept the offer. Head to the highlands near the southeast camp and rid the forest of three chocobo legtraps.
TEXT_HEAVNZ718_01922_SEQ_02: The chocobo legtraps will no longer be bothering any chocobos, or lazy and irresponsible chocobo hunters. Bring Hervoix the good news that he will no longer have to worry about doing his assigned duties.
TEXT_HEAVNZ718_01922_SEQ_03: After reporting to Hervoix, it becomes apparent that he intends to take all the credit for your slaughter of the chocobo legtraps. He promises to reward you after giving the report to his chief. Just to make sure, follow him and speak to O'bhen Tia to hear Hervoix's clever retelling of the truth.
TEXT_HEAVNZ718_01922_SEQ_04: You come upon Hervoix while he is in the midst of giving his report, and he quickly tries to gloss over your request for a reward. His chief decides to give him the benefit of the doubt, assigning him a series of new tasks that include everything besides hunting. Hervoix reluctantly accepts this new work and sulks back to his post at Tailfeather. Now that he is out of earshot from his chief, try asking him once again for your promised reward.
TEXT_HEAVNZ718_01922_SEQ_05: Hervoix complains about his tasks loudly, but seems resigned to his fate. At last, he gives you your reward, but it seems he still has more gil to give away, and more jobs to be done...
TEXT_HEAVNZ719_01923_SEQ_00: Hervoix is loath to start his new assignments.
TEXT_HEAVNZ719_01923_SEQ_01: Hervoix has been worrying over the list of tasks given to him by O'bhen Tia, unsure of which one to procrastinate on doing first. Eventually he decides to take care of the beasts that have been stalking the forest to the east. Or rather, he decides to have you take care of them. Head to the eastern camp and speak with Guenaret for any information regarding your targets' whereabouts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ719_01923_SEQ_02: After speaking to Guenaret about the oversized arachnids, you learn that O'bhen Tia himself demanded that Guenaret wait until someone was sent to settle the problem. Although you were not actually the one meant to do the job, Guenaret seems eager to be rid of the menace. Go north and search for any signs of the beasts, which are said to resemble giant spiders.
TEXT_HEAVNZ719_01923_SEQ_03: The monsters will no longer pose a danger to the forest's chocobos or hunters. Report your success to Hervoix at Tailfeather to receive your reward, hopefully this time in a timely manner.
TEXT_HEAVNZ719_01923_SEQ_04: You relay the story of your errand to Hervoix, and he seems to be slighted by the fact that O'bhen Tia would dare entrust him with such dangerous work. With his chief's intentions still a mystery, he gives you your reward and begrudgingly returns to his list of tasks.
TEXT_HEAVNZ720_01924_SEQ_00: Hervoix is looking at his list of tasks in disgust.
TEXT_HEAVNZ720_01924_SEQ_01: Next on Hervoix's list of tasks is the removal of iron leg traps that have been set up around a camp to the north. He ignores the obvious connection between chocobo traps and hunting, and insists that this should not be among a hunter's duties. Eager to push his work onto the nearest adventurer in need of coin, Hervoix enlists your aid. Head to the northern chocobo camp and ask any nearby hunters if they know aught of the reported traps.
TEXT_HEAVNZ720_01924_SEQ_02: At the camp you come across a hunter who explains that O'bhen Tia forcefully stopped him from removing the traps. It seems the chief was insistent upon letting his “apprentice” disable the traps himself. He says the traps were likely set by a band of outlaw hunters, as such traps are liable to injure the most profitable part of a chocobo: its legs. Go east of the camp and search for the traps, and be on guard for any hostile hunters along the way.
TEXT_HEAVNZ720_01924_SEQ_03: You are attacked by one of the outlaw hunters while you attempt to disable the traps, but you manage to complete your task relatively unscathed. Report to Hervoix, who is surely eager to be able to check off another job from his rather short list.
TEXT_HEAVNZ720_01924_SEQ_04: Hervoix, apparently unaware of the inherent danger of his occupation, is absolutely shocked that O'bhen Tia would ask him to perform any task that entails a degree of risk. Skeptical of his chief's aims, Hervoix returns to consider the next job he─or someone else─will undertake.
TEXT_HEAVNZ721_01925_SEQ_00: Hervoix doesn't dare get his hands dirty with this next job.
TEXT_HEAVNZ721_01925_SEQ_01: Hervoix shudders visibly as he reads his next task; he is to pick up garbage littered around the northeastern camp. Luckily, in this dark hour, a kindly adventurer happens to be nearby, willing to lend Hervoix a helping hand. Travel to the northeastern camp and speak with Aimebert, who likely has knowledge about the supposed garbage buildup.
TEXT_HEAVNZ721_01925_SEQ_02: Aimebert informs you that while some of the garbage is from the other hunters going through the camp, the large majority of it comes from the brazen outlaws that infest the area. Search the area around the northeast camp for any signs of suspicious characters, and if you find any, make sure they follow the rules of Tailfeather. If by chance you are attacked, defend yourself as best you can.
TEXT_HEAVNZ721_01925_SEQ_03: You find a suspicious-looking hunter standing in front of dozens of empty bottles. Before you have a chance to shed light on his identity, he calls on his henchmen to attack, but they fall before you in short order. Speak with the remaining hunter to find out why he was so hasty in his attack.
TEXT_HEAVNZ721_01925_SEQ_04: After the very convincing argument you had with his henchmen, the remaining outlaw thankfully agrees to be more diligent with his waste management duties. Tell Hervoix that the Chocobo Forest will no longer have to deal with environmentally insensitive miscreants.
TEXT_HEAVNZ721_01925_SEQ_05: Hervoix is disappointed that all you managed to find on your trip were garbage and outlaws, even though there was little reason to expect otherwise. He remains skeptical of the purpose of O'bhen Tia's orders, but prepares for his next task nonetheless.
TEXT_HEAVNZ722_01926_SEQ_00: Hervoix has a bone to pick with O'bhen Tia.
TEXT_HEAVNZ722_01926_SEQ_01: With his tasks finally complete, Hervoix decides he will no longer tolerate this treatment from O'bhen Tia, and rushes off to finally say his piece. Follow him and speak with O'bhen Tia to hear what is sure to be a profanity-laced tirade.
TEXT_HEAVNZ722_01926_SEQ_02: Hervoix finally builds up the courage to vent his frustrations to O'bhen Tia, but the chief interrupts the poor hunter and runs off in pursuit of reported outlaws. Nonetheless, Hervoix is determined to get his word in and follows after O'bhen Tia, throwing caution to the wind. Go after Hervoix and make sure he does not fall prey to the cunning outlaws.
TEXT_HEAVNZ722_01926_SEQ_03: You come upon Hervoix as he is being beset on by a renegade hunter. You fell your adversary after a brief skirmish, and Hervoix thanks you for your rescue. Unsurprisingly, you find out this incident was the first time Hervoix had ever been in a fight. Hervoix proceeds deeper into the forest in pursuit of O'bhen Tia─follow him and make sure he is not attacked again.
TEXT_HEAVNZ722_01926_SEQ_04: After following Hervoix's trail, you come upon O'bhen Tia and several other hunters among the remnants of a recently abandoned outlaw camp. Hervoix expresses confusion as to why these hunters have earned the ire of Tailfeather, and in response O'bhen Tia finally elucidates the purpose of the tasks he sent Hervoix out to do. The chocobo hunters of Tailfeather respect the natural balance of the Chocobo Forest, while acknowledging the fact that without the birds, their livelihoods would disappear. As such, they are loath to tolerate hunters that disrupt the delicate order to make easy coin. The tasks assigned by O'bhen Tia were meant to give Hervoix a deeper understanding of the Tailfeather philosophy. Hervoix, surprised at the deep consideration displayed by his chief, accidentally lets slip that it was actually you who performed the tasks O'bhen Tia had requested. However, with any luck, and a large heaping of punishment, Hervoix will be able to use this newfound knowledge to further his growth as a hunter, and possibly find the motivation to complete even the most menial of tasks with his own two hands.
TEXT_HEAVNZ723_01927_SEQ_00: Hervoix is awaiting his punishment for neglecting his duties.
TEXT_HEAVNZ723_01927_SEQ_01: Before Hervoix gets his dose of punishment from O'bhen Tia, a cry rings out through the forest, seemingly coming from the northeast. O'bhen Tia, suspecting that it may be the outlaws, hurries off in the voice's direction, and Hervoix follows at his heels. Go after the rest of the group to find out who let out the distressed scream.
TEXT_HEAVNZ723_01927_SEQ_02: Northwest of Tailfeather, you find an upset Q'yantaa standing next to a wounded Hudde. It appears the veteran hunter took an arrow in his protégé's stead─an arrow loosed by none other than the exiled Bauricoin. O'bhen Tia will help Hudde return to Tailfeather to be treated. Make your own way back and speak with the others regarding this troubling turn of events.
TEXT_HEAVNZ723_01927_SEQ_03: Upon returning to Tailfeather, you find your old acquaintance Gysol waiting, and he brings disturbing news: Bauricoin waylaid him on his way to Tailfeather, stealing his chocobo hatchling and promising revenge on Q'yantaa and Loupard. Q'yantaa, hot-headed as ever, hastens to Bauricoin's alleged location without considering the possibility of a trap. Both Hervoix and O'bhen Tia follow after her out of fear for her safety. Speak with Loupard to see what the best course of action could be.
TEXT_HEAVNZ723_01927_SEQ_04: Loupard bids you also follow the group in case Bauricoin's trap proves to be overwhelming. Meet up with the hunters to the north of Tailfeather.
TEXT_HEAVNZ723_01927_SEQ_05: Once you catch up to them, you find O'bhen Tia hunched over, apparently a victim of Bauricoin's trap. As you attempt to speak with the wounded O'bhen Tia, you are attacked by two outlaw hunters. Q'yantaa and Hervoix flee from the ambush in pursuit of Bauricoin. Defeat the hunters and save O'bhen Tia.
TEXT_HEAVNZ723_01927_SEQ_06: O'bhen Tia seems more concerned about the two novice hunters than his own wounds, and bids you follow them before they come to harm at Bauricoin's hands. Hurry to the northwest camp.
TEXT_HEAVNZ723_01927_SEQ_07: You arrive at the camp to find that Q'yantaa and Hervoix have somehow managed to subdue and restrain Bauricoin. Q'yantaa demands to know the whereabouts of Gysol's chocobo hatchling, and Bauricoin coldly explains that he cooked the poor bird, justifying his cruel misdeeds by stating that his actions are no different than any of the other hunters in Tailfeather. Q'yantaa hesitates, finally deciding to partake of the chocobo meat prepared by Bauricoin, stating that she is doing it out of respect for the hatchling's sacrifice. She further goes on to explain that the hunters of Tailfeather work to maintain the natural order, while outlaws like Bauricoin only threaten to destroy it. Hervoix seems to finally understand the significance of his chief's philosophy. Q'yantaa will return to Tailfeather to break the tragic news to Gysol, and Hervoix will take Bauricoin to Tailfeather in shackles. Return to Tailfeather and tell Loupard about what happened at the camp.
TEXT_HEAVNZ723_01927_SEQ_08: You return to Tailfeather and rejoin Loupard, Hudde, and O'bhen Tia. Loupard is grateful for your help in getting through this ordeal, and assures you that Bauricoin will not be troubling chocobos any longer. The other hunters reflect upon the incident, and hope that their partners both take away the fact that hunting─and life─does not always have an ideal outcome. Optimistic that everyone will come out of this tragedy a stronger person in the end, Hudde and O'bhen Tia leave to continue their hunting. Loupard thanks you once again, excited about the future growth of the two hunting teams.
TEXT_HEAVNZ724_01928_SEQ_00: Marcechamp is stewing in his chair.
TEXT_HEAVNZ724_01928_SEQ_01: A wild beast has been making off with Marcechamp's precious chocobos before he can gather them from the traps, and he has asked you to lure it out and slay it. Use the chocobo thigh he gave you to lure out the beast from the designated location in the Chocobo Forest.
TEXT_HEAVNZ724_01928_SEQ_02: You have placed the chocobo meat. Lie in wait and slay the beast when it appears.
TEXT_HEAVNZ724_01928_SEQ_03: You have slain the bear, ensuring that no more of Marcechamp's chocobos will come to harm. Report your success to the beleaguered chocobo hunter.
TEXT_HEAVNZ724_01928_SEQ_04: Marcechamp is grateful for your aid, and for all the help you have given him since arriving at Tailfeather.
TEXT_HEAVNZ725_01929_SEQ_00: Gullinkambi utters a growl, but not from her mouth.
TEXT_HEAVNZ725_01929_SEQ_01: Gullinkambi spends countless moons atop the tower of Anyx Trine guarding her eggs. For lack of time to hunt, she has grown hungry and craves bandersnatch for her next meal. Travel to the cave near the Iron Feast and slay three bandersnatches for their meat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ725_01929_SEQ_02: You slay three bandersnatches and obtain their meat. Deliver the meat to Gullinkambi, that she may satisfy her cravings.
TEXT_HEAVNZ725_01929_SEQ_03: You return to Anyx Trine where Gullinkambi is salivating from the mere scent of the bandersnatch meat. She consumes it hungrily, thanking you in between bites. With a quieted belly, she can continue guarding her eggs with peace of mind.
TEXT_HEAVNZ726_01930_SEQ_00: The Vath fleetfoot is looking at you expectantly.
TEXT_HEAVNZ726_01930_SEQ_01: The Vath fleetfoot is worried by news of an impending Gnath assault on Loth ast Vath. The Vath are ill prepared to deal with a direct, all-out offensive from the much larger Gnath hive. Their only option is a preemptive assault, weakening the enemy before it can finish mobilizing.
TEXT_HEAVNZ726_01930_SEQ_02: You slay the Gnath as instructed, hopefully stymieing their plans of an attack on the Vath. Report back to the Vath fleetfoot with news of the completion of your mission.
TEXT_HEAVNZ726_01930_SEQ_03: The fleetfoot congratulates you on a successful mission. He goes on to explain how he had knowledge of the planned attack: While the Vath of the Nonmind cannot hear the thoughts of the Gnath Onemind, this is not due to a complete severing of the mental connection; the link is merely massively weakened. Some Vath can, from time to time, perceive the Onemind's thoughts. It does not seem that the Gnath are aware of this vestigial connection or the knowledge it provides the Vath with.
TEXT_HEAVNZ801_01931_SEQ_00: Woolnix is eyeing you with obvious interest.
TEXT_HEAVNZ801_01931_SEQ_01: Woolnix is fretting about the great swarm of tarantula hawks in the Collectors' Quarter. He does not feel safe guarding the gate whilst they are so near. Thus, he bids you slay three, in hopes that they will no more encroach upon his position.
TEXT_HEAVNZ801_01931_SEQ_02: You have struck down three tarantula hawks. Deliver tidings of your victory to Woolnix near the Cenotaph.
TEXT_HEAVNZ801_01931_SEQ_03: Woolnix reveals to you that he was stung by a tarantula hawk, and, driven mad by the pain, left his post. Now that there are a few less hovering about nearby, however, he believes he can do his duty in safety.
TEXT_HEAVNZ802_01932_SEQ_00: Midnight Dew wishes to learn more of you.
TEXT_HEAVNZ802_01932_SEQ_01: Midnight Dew wants to see how you fit into Idyllshire's burgeoning community. To that end, she bids you work together with a young adventurer currently tasked with moving foodstuffs into Idyllshire's storerooms. Go to him now, and see what you can do.
TEXT_HEAVNZ802_01932_SEQ_02: You find the green adventurer in a slight tizzy. He informs you that the last of the vessels he carried across the settlement had a hole in it, and subsequently he has lost five crabapples. Find these for him now, whilst he repairs the broken urn.
TEXT_HEAVNZ802_01932_SEQ_03: After looking all over, you find the five missing crabapples. Return these slightly dusty fruits now to the young adventurer.
TEXT_HEAVNZ802_01932_SEQ_04: The adventure-dreaming youth takes the crabapples back, and gives you his thanks. Now, report back to Midnight Dew.
TEXT_HEAVNZ802_01932_SEQ_05: Midnight Dew is happy to learn that you aided the inhabitants of Idyllshire, even in a small way. She tells you that all this was a test of sorts, to learn what manner of person you are. However, you have allayed any doubts she may have had, and earned yourself a modicum of respect within the settlement.
TEXT_HEAVNZ803_01933_SEQ_01: Feltsmox has not been able to catch anything while fishing lately. She seems to think that wildebeest eyes, from the nearby wildebeests, might solve the problem. Help this discouraged and disheartened goblin by gathering three eyes from the wildebeests.
TEXT_HEAVNZ803_01933_SEQ_02: You have gathered the mysterious, red orbs from the wildebeests you slew. Deliver them to Feltsmox and find out what she plans to do with them.
TEXT_HEAVNZ803_01933_SEQ_03: Through the tinted lenses in her mask, you see Feltsmox's eyes light up as you produce the wildebeest eyes. She explains that it makes exceptional bait for fishing, before eagerly rushing away to make use of it.
TEXT_HEAVNZ804_01934_SEQ_00: Feltsmox is staring frustratedly into the river.
TEXT_HEAVNZ804_01934_SEQ_01: Feltsmox is still having no success in her fishing endeavors. The wildebeest eyes you procured for her are great bait and should be attracting fish from malms around, but she hasn't had a single bite. It seems that the fish that normally inhabit the river are being scared away by the damselflies that roam its edge. Slay five of these beasts so that the fish think it is safe enough to return.
TEXT_HEAVNZ804_01934_SEQ_02: Having slain a number of damselflies, the constant buzzing of their wings no longer fills the air. Hopefully this quiet and blissful serenity attracts fish looking to escape the bustle and noise of wherever they are now. Return to Feltsmox and let her know that she is no longer fishing in empty waters.
TEXT_HEAVNZ804_01934_SEQ_03: Though she appreciates your efforts, even with the damselflies having been dealt with, Feltsmox is still unable to catch any fish. Not to be outdone, she resolves to rethink her fishing strategy altogether.
TEXT_HEAVNZ805_01935_SEQ_00: Slowfix needs your help in solving a problem.
TEXT_HEAVNZ805_01935_SEQ_01: Idyllshire is to be a new, free nation─a utopia for goblins and any who wish to join them. But founding a nation is not without monetary costs. Slowfix explains that, since taxing the citizens of their hard-earned gil would fly in the face of all that this fledgling nation stands for, funds are raised through rental of vital tools and equipment. Unfortunately, a goblin has borrowed a pickaxe and left Idyllshire without returning it. Find this ungracious goblin and retrieve the pickaxe.
TEXT_HEAVNZ805_01935_SEQ_02: You find the goblin, but she is under attack by tarantula hawks! Slay these beasts and rescue the defenseless goblin such that you may ascertain the whereabouts of the missing pickaxe.
TEXT_HEAVNZ805_01935_SEQ_03: The beleaguered goblin thanks you before explaining that she forgot about the rental pickaxe she borrowed before leaving on her journey. While she can't return to Idyllshire herself to return the pickaxe, she entrusts it to you, requesting that you return it to its rightful owner in her stead. Go back to Idyllshire and give the pickaxe back to Drydox.
TEXT_HEAVNZ805_01935_SEQ_04: Drydox is ecstatic that you have found the pickaxe─she had given it up for lost. Report to Slowfix that the missing rental equipment is now accounted for.
TEXT_HEAVNZ805_01935_SEQ_05: Slowfix is glad to see the missing equipment returned. He pays you what he considers to be a fair market price for your work.
TEXT_HEAVNZ806_01936_SEQ_01: Tapklix accuses you of being a thief sent by the Illuminati. Uninterested in your words, he insists that you let your actions attest to your innocence by finding and eliminating an Illuminati patrol.
TEXT_HEAVNZ806_01936_SEQ_02: You stop the patrol in its tracks and leave no survivors. However, you sense there are yet more Illuminati lurking nearby. Find them and eliminate them.
TEXT_HEAVNZ806_01936_SEQ_03: The last of the Illuminati have been dealt with. Return to Tapklix now that your allegiance is clear.
TEXT_HEAVNZ806_01936_SEQ_04: Tapklix is glad to have seen your battle against the Illuminati. Using the age-old logic that the enemy of his enemy is his friend, he concludes that you are a true friend to the goblins of Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNZ807_01937_SEQ_00: Tapklix has lost his patience with the goblins who are supposed to be guarding the settlement.
TEXT_HEAVNZ807_01937_SEQ_01: Tapklix is furious that none of the goblins who are guarding Bigwest Shortstop have returned to the camp. The Illuminati have been spotted dangerously close to the camp, but no guards have regrouped to defend it. Find the guards and tell them to return to Bigwest Shortstop. Their posts are at the Makers' Quarter and the Collectors' Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNZ807_01937_SEQ_02: You find the guards and convince them to return to Bigwest Shortstop. Return there yourself and make sure all of the goblins have made it back safely.
TEXT_HEAVNZ807_01937_SEQ_03: Although the guards have all made it back to Bigwest Shortstop successfully, it seems there is a fundamental problem. None of the goblins can agree on the correct procedure for when they should regroup to defend the camp. But the entire patrol force itself is pointless if they are unable to mount an organized defense. For now, Tapklix will lead the goblins in driving off the Illuminati attack, but he asks you to go to Slowfix and advise him of this worrying situation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ807_01937_SEQ_04: Slowfix is not surprised to learn that the goblin guards are unable to agree on the correct rules, because Idyllshire has no rules! Idyllshire is intended as a “free nation for free people.” Rules, procedures, and laws─anything that robs the goblins of their rights and freedom─would run counter to this ideal.
TEXT_HEAVNZ808_01938_SEQ_00: Holepix is ready to let slip the dogs of war.
TEXT_HEAVNZ808_01938_SEQ_01: Holepix believes his kin will not taste true peace until Idyllshire impresses their strength upon the Illuminati. To that end, he bids you go to the Arkhitekton and slay any six Illuminati goblins─be they brandishers, tinkerers, sharpshooters, or gliders.
TEXT_HEAVNZ808_01938_SEQ_02: You slay six members of the Illuminati. Return now to Holepix, and see if this sates his bloodlust.
TEXT_HEAVNZ808_01938_SEQ_03: Holepix is happy with the message of dominance you have sent the Illuminati. However, he fears that the enemies of Idyllshire will yet rally, and attack again from the shadows. Hence, he vows to increase the guard, to keep his kith and kin safe.
TEXT_HEAVNZ809_01939_SEQ_00: Drydox seems to be down in the dumps.
TEXT_HEAVNZ809_01939_SEQ_01: Drydox has lost four bags, each stuffed with her most precious of possessions, and she believes the Illuminati have stolen them. Venture into the Makers' Quarter in the Dravanian hinterlands, and see if you can find Drydox's lost sacks.
TEXT_HEAVNZ809_01939_SEQ_02: After combing through the Makers' Quarter, you find Drydox's cumbersome sacks. When you look inside, however, all you see is junk. Return these so-called treasures to the goblin in Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNZ809_01939_SEQ_03: Drydox is very happy to have her sacks back. It transpires that they are filled with artifacts left by the Sharlayans before their exodus, items that can find new use in Idyllshire. It seems thus that you have done your good deed for the day, and contributed to the small settlement's future.
TEXT_HEAVNZ810_01940_SEQ_00: Halfsix seems to be giggling to himself.
TEXT_HEAVNZ810_01940_SEQ_01: Halfsix has seemingly crafted devices able to interrupt Illuminati communications. Now, he wishes you to plant these contraptions around the Makers' Quarter, so as to vex the mortal enemies of Idyllshire. Make your way to the Dravanian hinterlands, and set up the three jamming devices now.
TEXT_HEAVNZ810_01940_SEQ_02: You plant all three jamming devices in a crescent pattern around the Arkhitekton. Report back to Halfsix, and tell him the great “joke” you two have played on Illuminati.
TEXT_HEAVNZ810_01940_SEQ_03: Upon hearing that the deed is done, Halfsix must stifle his own laughter when imagining exactly how frustrating it will be for the Illuminati to lose their ability to communicate. Though he does not thank you in so many words, you sense you have won the goblin's trust.
TEXT_HEAVNZ811_01941_SEQ_00: Loudjox has run out of wares to sell.
TEXT_HEAVNZ811_01941_SEQ_01: While Loudjox mistakes you for a customer, she realizes that she can part with some gil in exchange for the leaves of narbroois. Make your way to the Makers' Quarter, and slay the sweetly smelling monsters for six of their fragrant fronds.
TEXT_HEAVNZ811_01941_SEQ_02: You strike down a number of narbroois, and tear the leaves from their still bodies. Find your way back to Loudjox with the aromatic prizes.
TEXT_HEAVNZ811_01941_SEQ_03: Loudjox delivers your payment for the leaves, explaining that they are part of a mixture that goblins place in their masks to avoid bad smells. Given your own experiences with goblin aromas, you decline her offer to take a sniff, and instead take your reward for helping the realm smell just a little better.
TEXT_HEAVNZ812_01942_SEQ_00: Slowfix is concerned about the state of Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNZ812_01942_SEQ_01: Slowfix is worried by the increasing number of organizational and administrative problems surfacing in Idyllshire. He needs the advice of a goblin with more of a head for these sorts of things─Dripwix. Unfortunately, Dripwix is nowhere to be seen. Slowfix asks you to track down Dripwix for him. Start by asking Midnight Dew. She should know where he is.
TEXT_HEAVNZ812_01942_SEQ_02: Midnight Dew tells you that Dripwix should be headed towards the Arkhitekton, in the Dravanian hinterlands. Hopefully you will be able to find him before the Illuminati do.
TEXT_HEAVNZ812_01942_SEQ_03: You find Dripwix just as a group of Illuminati goblins descend upon him. Save him by slaying his assailants.
TEXT_HEAVNZ812_01942_SEQ_04: Dripwix thanks you for saving him from the Illuminati's attack.
TEXT_HEAVNZ813_01943_SEQ_00: Midnight Dew is too busy to fill all her orders on her own.
TEXT_HEAVNZ813_01943_SEQ_01: Midnight Dew has received an order for a bag of squigglywogs, but she's simply too busy to deliver it. She asks you to take it to Feltsmox, who should be fishing, as usual, at the Thaliak River.
TEXT_HEAVNZ813_01943_SEQ_02: Feltsmox thanks you for the squigglywogs. She has been having terrible luck fishing lately, but these wriggly little tadpoles make such exceptional bait that her luck should start to turn immediately. She gives you a bag of coins in payment─take it back to Midnight Dew.
TEXT_HEAVNZ813_01943_SEQ_03: You return Feltsmox's payment to Midnight Dew. She explains that fishing is a popular pastime amongst goblins, and the resulting demand for squigglywogs is helping her turn a tidy profit. While the goblins plan to settle a town in Idyllshire, Midnight Dew suspects that many goblins are just natural-born wanderers. She doubts it will be long before Feltsmox feels the need to leave the city and travel the realm.
TEXT_HEAVNZ814_01944_SEQ_00: Dripwix wants to know why you came looking for him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ814_01944_SEQ_01: Dripwix has been keeping a log of the various problems he has observed in the goblins' newly founded settlement. This would be an invaluable tool in helping address the problems Slowfix has been experiencing, but unfortunately the logbook somehow fell into the hands of the Illuminati. One of the espertype magitek vangobs G-III that patrol the area has it, but Dripwix does not know which one. If you destroy enough of the things, the logbook is bound to turn up.
TEXT_HEAVNZ814_01944_SEQ_02: You have destroyed several magitek vangobs, but are yet to find Dripwix's logbook. He seems quite certain that it was taken by an espertype magitek vangob G-III. Keep destroying them until you find the logbook.
TEXT_HEAVNZ814_01944_SEQ_03: You have finally found Dripwix's logbook. Take it back to the eagerly waiting goblin.
TEXT_HEAVNZ814_01944_SEQ_04: With his logbook safely recovered, Dripwix can now return to Idyllshire and assist Slowfix as requested. Meet up with him at Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNZ814_01944_SEQ_05: In order to address the increasing abundance of problems Idyllshire is experiencing, Dripwix suggests implementing rules to govern the settlement's inhabitants. Slowfix is strongly opposed to the idea, believing that rules would run counter to the principles of freedom and liberty that the settlement was founded on. Eventually he relents when the problems being caused by the settlement's complete lack of laws and procedures are pointed out to him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ815_01945_SEQ_01: It seems the Idyllshire aetheryte may be growing unstable, and is in need of a proper inspection. However, Halfsix lacks the necessary aetherflow distributors to make his analysis. As with many things in the burgeoning settlement, it appears these, too, are located somewhere within the Arkhitekton. Thus, Halfsix bids that you make your way there and search the Illuminati pots for three of these tools.
TEXT_HEAVNZ815_01945_SEQ_02: You obtain three aetherflow distributors, and dispatch a number of Illuminati as well. Return with them to Halfsix in Idyllshire now.
TEXT_HEAVNZ815_01945_SEQ_03: Halfsix expresses his gratitude for your service. The aetheryte will no doubt continue to spin in Idyllshire for many years to come, thanks to your efforts.
TEXT_HEAVNZ816_01946_SEQ_00: Holepix is fretting about the Illuminati.
TEXT_HEAVNZ816_01946_SEQ_01: Holepix has learned that the Illuminati have made new machines of war, great mechanical men that he fears can bring Idyllshire to heel. To prevent this terrible eventuality, he asks that you launch a preemptive strike by destroying three findertype magitek vangobs G-III near the Arkhitekton in the Dravanian hinterlands.
TEXT_HEAVNZ816_01946_SEQ_02: You find and destroy three findertype magitek vangobs G-III, one after the other. Now that the last of these whirring horrors has fallen, return to Holepix in Idyllshire and give him the good tidings.
TEXT_HEAVNZ816_01946_SEQ_03: Holepix thanks you for your service to Idyllshire, and tells you how the vangobs came to be. The Illuminati laid hands on old Garlean magitek weapons, disassembled and rebuilt them into something even stronger. Though Holepix is impressed by the ingenuity involved, he also knows they will not hesitate to enslave their fellow goblins, and hopes your efforts will forestall the Illuminati.
TEXT_HEAVNZ817_01947_SEQ_00: Tapklix is muttering to himself and rubbing his rump.
TEXT_HEAVNZ817_01947_SEQ_01: After being attacked by wild beastkin, Tapklix is out for blood. Deliver vengeance vicariously by putting three ratels to death in the Makers' Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNZ817_01947_SEQ_02: You slay the meanest-looking ratels you can find, and leave their carcasses as a message to the remaining pack. Return to Tapklix at Bigwest Shortstop and inform him the deed is done.
TEXT_HEAVNZ817_01947_SEQ_03: Tapklix is relieved to learn that the hurt dealt his rear─and the injury to his pride─have been avenged. He tells you that monsters came trickling down from the mountains after the Sharlayans left the area, and that he means to see them purged so good folk can live free from fear of attack.
TEXT_HEAVNZ818_01948_SEQ_00: Dripwix is overflowing with ideas for new rules and regulations.
TEXT_HEAVNZ818_01948_SEQ_01: Dripwix has been hard at work formulating new rules and regulations to govern the people of Idyllshire. The first such rule is that meticulous records be kept of all tool rentals. He has prepared a large and comprehensive ledger for recording countless details of each and every tool rental.  While Dripwix concocts yet more rules, take the ledger to Drydox to use for all future tool rentals.
TEXT_HEAVNZ818_01948_SEQ_02: Drydox is less than pleased by these latest bureaucratic developments. She seems to view these complex new rules as a nightmarish, confusing inconvenience. Return to Dripwix and see what new rules the enterprising goblin has come up with.
TEXT_HEAVNZ818_01948_SEQ_03: To address the organizational problems being experienced by the Idyllshire patrol force, Dripwix has drafted an amended map of the area, including formalized boundaries and borders for the area claimed by the goblins. Take this map to Tapklix, such that his troops may know where to patrol and how close the Illuminati may stray before a counteroffensive should be launched.
TEXT_HEAVNZ818_01948_SEQ_04: Tapklix is greatly concerned by the map you deliver to him. He finds its intricacies bafflingly complex and has severe doubts that the goblins he commands will be able to memorize the details of it. Leave him to his worries and let Dripwix know that you have delivered the map as requested.
TEXT_HEAVNZ818_01948_SEQ_05: Dripwix seems satisfied for now that his new rules will address at least some of the more obvious problems that Idyllshire has been experiencing. He expresses his intent to continue looking for problems at the settlement and drafting rules to address them.
TEXT_HEAVNZ819_01949_SEQ_00: Slowfix is eager to know about the effect of Idyllshire's new rules.
TEXT_HEAVNZ819_01949_SEQ_01: Slowfix wants to know what sort of effect Dripwix's new rules are having in Idyllshire. Ask the inhabitants of Idyllshire and Bigwest Shortstop for their opinions on these new laws and regulations.
TEXT_HEAVNZ819_01949_SEQ_02: After speaking with several residents of Idyllshire, you learn that people are generally dissatisfied with the new rules that Dripwix introduced. They are unnecessarily complex and restrictive and they cause more problems than they solve. Relay this disappointing─if not unsurprising─news to Slowfix.
TEXT_HEAVNZ819_01949_SEQ_03: Upon hearing that his rules were a complete failure, Dripwix becomes upset and leaves, muttering something about redrawing Idyllshire's borders. Concerned about his friend, Slowfix asks you to find Dripwix and pass on a message to the distraught goblin, telling him to meet with Slowfix. If he is redrawing the settlement's borders, he is likely to be near the ill-defined borders with the Illuminati's settlement at the Arkhitekton.
TEXT_HEAVNZ819_01949_SEQ_04: You find Dripwix under attack by the Illuminati. Slay the attackers and aid Dripwix.
TEXT_HEAVNZ819_01949_SEQ_05: You assist Dripwix and relay Slowfix's message. Concerned that the meeting will result in conflict, Dripwix asks you to join him, as a mediator. The meeting will be on the road from the Arkhitekton to the Collectors' Quarter. Rendezvous with him there.
TEXT_HEAVNZ819_01949_SEQ_06: Slowfix reminds Dripwix what prompted them to found the settlement at Idyllshire─the desire for a free and beautiful home for any and all who would choose to live there. As Dripwix begins to realize that his rules are getting in the way of this goal, it is revealed that Slowfix's disregard for the new goblin lending laws has led to a fishing rod going missing. An enraged Dripwix chases his careless friend all the way back to Idyllshire. Meet with them there.
TEXT_HEAVNZ819_01949_SEQ_07: Slowfix explains that his conversation with Dripwix led to the creation of a new, fundamental law for Idyllshire: always respect friends. Though this one rule alone will not solve the settlement's administrative issues, it encapsulates the spirit in which Idyllshire was founded and will form the basis upon which further rules are established.
TEXT_HEAVNZ820_01950_SEQ_00: Midnight Dew seems concerned about two of the new refugees at Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNZ820_01950_SEQ_01: Midnight Dew is concerned about a pair of new refugees in Idyllshire. Notched Bone and Dedean recently arrived in the settlement, but seem to be having difficulty fitting in. She asks you to spend some time with them and make sure they don't cause any problems. She seems to think that, with a little guidance from you, these two refugees will come to enjoy life in Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNZ820_01950_SEQ_02: Notched Bone seems to really dislike living in Idyllshire─so much so that he and Dedean plan to leave and found a new settlement of their own. Since they can't found a new city on their own, they hope to rally other adventurers at Idyllshire to their cause and have prepared flyers which they ask you to help distribute. Find adventurers in Idyllshire and the Answering Quarter and hand out the flyers to them.
TEXT_HEAVNZ820_01950_SEQ_03: You find several adventurers in and around the settlement, but none of them are at all interested in the idea of leaving Idyllshire and its goblins to found a new city. Relay the disappointing news to Notched Bone.
TEXT_HEAVNZ820_01950_SEQ_04: Notched Bone and Dedean are both shocked to discover that none of the other adventurers are interested in leaving Idyllshire. The pair clearly dislike the local goblins and somehow manage to convince themselves that the adventurers have been brainwashed by the goblins.
TEXT_HEAVNZ821_01951_SEQ_00: Notched Bone seems convinced that the goblins have brainwashed the citizens of Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNZ821_01951_SEQ_01: Notched Bone is still convinced that the goblins have brainwashed the citizens of Idyllshire, and you are unable to convince him otherwise. He hopes to cure the citizens of this brainwashing by exposing what he thinks is a grand, nefarious scheme by the goblins. He saw a goblin armed and heading out towards the Collectors' Quarter and he is sure she was up to no good. Perhaps if you find out what this goblin is really up to, you can convince Notched Bone that they can be trusted.
TEXT_HEAVNZ821_01951_SEQ_02: You speak with the goblin and learn that she is exterminating the damselflies in the area. Apparently there are egg-bearing damselflies nearby which must be eliminated before they can lay their eggs. If they do, the young that hatch will quickly get out of hand. Help the goblin by slaying three of the damselflies.
TEXT_HEAVNZ821_01951_SEQ_03: With the damselflies slain, the risk of them breeding out of control has been negated. Let the goblin know that there is no more work to be done here.
TEXT_HEAVNZ821_01951_SEQ_04: The goblin happily thanks you for helping her finish her work so quickly. The area should now be much safer for the inhabitants of Idyllshire. Return to Notched Bone with this proof that the goblins are kind-hearted and trying only to help.
TEXT_HEAVNZ821_01951_SEQ_05: You explain to Notched Bone that the goblin he saw was simply keeping the surrounds of Idyllshire clear of dangerous monsters, but he remains unconvinced. He somehow still thinks that the goblins are up to no good─despite all evidence to the contrary.
TEXT_HEAVNZ822_01952_SEQ_00: Dedean thinks the goblins are brainwashing people and wants to know how they are doing it.
TEXT_HEAVNZ822_01952_SEQ_01: Dedean still seems to think that the goblins of Idyllshire are somehow brainwashing the immigrants that arrive in the settlement. He saw a goblin leading a group of adventurers─who had just arrived in Idyllshire─out towards Saint Mocianne's Arboretum. He has convinced himself that they are being taken there to be brainwashed and is not interested in anything you have to say to the contrary. Maybe if you find out what the goblin and his party of adventurers are doing, you can explain it to this Lalafell and disabuse him of his delusions.
TEXT_HEAVNZ822_01952_SEQ_02: You speak with the adventurers accompanying the goblin and learn that he is simply giving them a thorough and educational guided tour of the area surrounding Idyllshire. Speak next with the goblin himself and confirm that there is nothing even slightly suspicious going on.
TEXT_HEAVNZ822_01952_SEQ_03: The goblin guide does not even know what brainwashing is, much less how to go about doing it. Just as expected, he is simply showing the new arrivals to Idyllshire what they should be aware of as citizens of the settlement. Hopefully this will be enough to assuage Dedean's suspicions.
TEXT_HEAVNZ822_01952_SEQ_04: Dedean still seems unwilling to believe that the goblins are truly kind and friendly. It seems he has had some bad experiences during his time in Ul'dah that led to these unfortunate prejudices.
TEXT_HEAVNZ823_01953_SEQ_00: Notched Bone and Dedean seem to be on the brink of starvation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ823_01953_SEQ_01: It seems that Notched Bone and Dedean have not eaten in quite some time and they are understandably very hungry. What is less understandable is their refusal to eat the food they have been provisioned with by the goblins. They are under the impression that it is poisoned and are completely unreceptive to suggestions to the contrary. Notched Bone asks you to slay a crawler and harvest its flesh such that he and Dedean may eat. Raw crawler flesh is inedible, but it should be fine if cooked thoroughly. Notched Bone asks that after harvesting the crawler meat, you roast it at the goblin bonfire in the Answering Quarter. Feed these stubborn two now, and deal with their prejudices later.
TEXT_HEAVNZ823_01953_SEQ_02: You slay a crawler and gather a good, large slice of its flesh. Even someone on the brink of starvation would not eat this meat raw. Roast the slice of crawler flesh at the bonfire in the Answering Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNZ823_01953_SEQ_03: You find the bonfire Notched Bone described and slowly roast the crawler flesh, thoroughly cooking it all the way through. Deliver the roasted crawler flesh to Notched Bone and Dedean back at Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNZ823_01953_SEQ_04: You deliver the crawler meat to Notched Bone and Dedean. Now that they have something to sate their empty stomachs, they hand you the jerked water buffalo meat that the goblins supplied them with. They ask you to return it to the goblin who gave it to them─the coalshifter goblin near the bonfire over which you cooked the crawler flesh.
TEXT_HEAVNZ823_01953_SEQ_05: You return the jerked water buffalo to the coalshifter goblin, explaining that the two refugees have secured an alternate source of sustenance in the crawlers that roam the hinterlands. Upon hearing this, the goblin becomes very concerned. No matter how it is prepared, crawler flesh is inedible and can cause severe stomach pains in goblins. He doubts that Lalafell or Roegadyn will fare any better from eating it. He provides you with some gobbietea, which should help to alleviate any stomach problems the two refugees might suffer, and requests that you return to the two and check on their well-being.
TEXT_HEAVNZ823_01953_SEQ_06: It seems that the coalshifter goblin's concerns were well founded. You find Notched Bone and Dedean racked with terrible stomach pains. Administer the gobbietea. It should ameliorate the symptoms they are suffering.
TEXT_HEAVNZ823_01953_SEQ_07: The gobbietea starts to take effect immediately. Though they are still in pain, Notched Bone's and Dedean's conditions seem to be improving rapidly. Speak with Notched Bone and explain that the medicine that cured him was provided by the same goblin that gave him the jerked water buffalo meat that he refused to eat.
TEXT_HEAVNZ823_01953_SEQ_08: Notched Bone is shocked to learn that the medicine came from a goblin. He is still somewhat skeptical about the goblins' motivations, explaining that in all their time as refugees, he and Dedean have only ever experienced kindness as part of a plan to cheat them. It was just such a ploy that led them to be tricked into debt in Ul'dah, forcing them to leave the nation and find a new home.
TEXT_HEAVNZ824_01954_SEQ_00: Notched Bone is convinced he saw a goblin about to get up to no good.
TEXT_HEAVNZ824_01954_SEQ_01: Notched Bone is finally back on his feet after eating the inedible crawler flesh. While incapacitated, he saw a goblin he thought looked extremely suspicious. Since he has not yet fully recovered, he has requested your help in following this goblin. He asks you to meet him and Dedean outside of Idyllshire, in the Answering Quarter. Accompany them on their investigation and make sure they don't cause any problems.
TEXT_HEAVNZ824_01954_SEQ_02: You find Notched Bone and Dedean just outside the city, in the Answering Quarter. They've lost sight of the goblin, but intend to continue southward in the hopes of catching him in some evil act.
TEXT_HEAVNZ824_01954_SEQ_03: In the Answering Quarter, you happen upon a man in no small amount of pain. Notched Bone is sure that the goblins are responsible, but the man insists he was not attacked by them. Notched Bone abandons the man, running back to Idyllshire to plan his next move. Fortunately, the man does not seem to be worried about his own condition, instead expressing concern at Notched Bone's apparent misunderstanding of the situation. Return to Idyllshire and find out what Notched Bone is intending to do next.
TEXT_HEAVNZ824_01954_SEQ_04: Notched Bone has spoken with Dedean and the two both agree that they must abandon their plan of founding a new settlement. They cannot bring themselves to abandon the citizens of Idyllshire, who they see as being under the malevolent influence of the goblins.
TEXT_HEAVNZ825_01955_SEQ_00: Notched Bone still wants to follow the suspicious goblin.
TEXT_HEAVNZ825_01955_SEQ_01: Notched Bone has once again seen the same suspicious goblin as before and is still convinced that this goblin is up to no good. He asks you to once again help him follow this goblin, with the aim of catching him in the middle of some heinous act. It seems this Roegadyn won't be convinced of the goblin's innocence until he witnesses it with his own eyes. Meet him in the Answering Quarter and help him see for himself the goblin's true nature.
TEXT_HEAVNZ825_01955_SEQ_02: Notched Bone tells you that the suspicious goblin he saw is traveling down the road southward. Catch up with the Roegadyn further down the road as he stalks his suspect.
TEXT_HEAVNZ825_01955_SEQ_03: Notched Bone tells you that one of the more suspicious items he saw the goblin packing during his preparations back at Idyllshire was a length of rope. He seems quite worried that this goblin may be planning a kidnapping of some sort. Follow Notched Bone further along the road and speak with him again.
TEXT_HEAVNZ825_01955_SEQ_04: The goblin you are following appears to be looking for someone. Seeing the goblin searching for someone in so secluded an area has Notched Bone increasingly convinced that this goblin is up to no good. He still seems to be traveling down the road. Meet with Notched Bone again near the intersection.
TEXT_HEAVNZ825_01955_SEQ_05: You happen upon a number of monsters─slain, apparently, without difficulty. Dedean is worried about the risks of confronting someone capable of dispatching so many beasts with such ease. Notched Bone, however, steels his resolve, concerned for the well-being of the citizens of Idyllshire. The goblin must be headed towards the ruined bridge. Go there and speak again with Notched Bone.
TEXT_HEAVNZ825_01955_SEQ_06: You find the goblin and another man, Edred, and soon get to the bottom of Notched Bone's misunderstanding. In exchange for massages from the goblin, Edred has been slaying Orn kites for their meat. The goblin ties these downed birds into braces with a rope, before performing the effective─but excruciatingly painful─traditional goblin massage techniques on him. Inspired by their cooperation and ashamed of doubting the innocent goblin, Notched Bone affirms his desire to be a citizen of Idyllshire. Confused but ever generous, the goblin eagerly welcomes him with an excruciatingly painful goblin massage.
TEXT_HEAVNZ825_01955_SEQ_07: It is unclear if Notched Bone is in a state of relaxation following the goblin's massage, or in shock from the pain of it. Whichever the case, he is taking some time to rest beneath the bridge. He intends to return to Idyllshire shortly and asks you to meet with him there.
TEXT_HEAVNZ825_01955_SEQ_08: Having finally come to realize how mistaken they have been, Notched Bone and Dedean resolve to become active members of the Idyllshire society. They plan to work hard and repay their debt to the goblins for all the kindness the goblins offered but which they rudely refused. They thank you, especially, for helping them come to this realization about the true nature of the goblins and their generosity.
TEXT_HEAVNZ826_01956_SEQ_00: Notched Bone wants to become an official citizen of Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNZ826_01956_SEQ_01: Notched Bone has decided that, along with Dedean, he wants to become a citizen of Idyllshire. He's not comfortable approaching their leadership after how poorly he has treated the goblins previously, and asks you to speak to Slowfix on his behalf.
TEXT_HEAVNZ826_01956_SEQ_02: You speak with Slowfix, who is more than happy to welcome more citizens into Idyllshire. He also mentions that a letter has arrived for Notched Bone and asks you to deliver it to him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ826_01956_SEQ_03: You deliver the letter to Notched Bone who, curious at who might have sent it, opens it immediately. It is from a moneylender who has tracked him down to Idyllshire. Not wanting to cause problems for the goblins who have been so kind to him, he decides to sneak out of Idyllshire before the moneylender can find him. To this end, he asks you to check the settlement's exit and make sure the man isn't waiting for him there.
TEXT_HEAVNZ826_01956_SEQ_04: The moneylender has already arrived in Idyllshire. Return to Notched Bone and break the bad news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ826_01956_SEQ_05: Notched Bone is still intent on fleeing the city. Dedean, however, wants to ask the people of Idyllshire for help in driving the moneylender away from the settlement. Meet with this force outside in the Collectors' Quarter and see to it that this malicious crook doesn't get his hands on his prey.
TEXT_HEAVNZ826_01956_SEQ_06: Faced with the prospect of having to engage both yourself and the apparently notorious Edred in combat, the moneylender beats a hasty retreat. Before returning to Idyllshire, Slowfix reveals that he has a request he would like to make of you. Return to the settlement and speak with him for more information.
TEXT_HEAVNZ826_01956_SEQ_07: Slowfix hands you a large sealed envelope which he says contains documents pertaining to Notched Bone and Dedean. He needs these papers taken to Dripwix to be signed, but is too busy to do this himself. He asks you to help him by delivering the papers to Dripwix, who is currently on patrol at the Arkhitekton.
TEXT_HEAVNZ826_01956_SEQ_08: Dripwix happily signs the paperwork and returns it to you, asking you to deliver it to Notched Bone back at Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNZ826_01956_SEQ_09: Notched Bone quickly opens the envelope to find signed citizenship papers for both himself and Dedean. Overcome with the joy of finally having found a place to call home after years of being mistreated, he and Dedean vow to repay the goblins for their unrelenting kindness by doing all they can to help Idyllshire grow into a great and bustling metropolis.
TEXT_HEAVNZ827_01957_SEQ_00: Drydox's capital relocation plan has run into some early difficulties.
TEXT_HEAVNZ827_01957_SEQ_01: Drydox tells you of plans afoot to move the capital of the new goblin republic from Idyllshire to the abandoned buildings of the Answering Quarter. However, the goblin she has sent to survey the site, a novice by the name of Boomshox, has yet to return. She bids you to head into the Dravanian hinterlands and check on Boomshox's safety.
TEXT_HEAVNZ827_01957_SEQ_02: You find Boomshox alive and well, yet distinctly disgruntled. She is keen to conclude her survey as quickly as possible, but the local wildlife insist on interfering with her work. She asks you to slay five crawlers in the vicinity of the Answering Quarter, so that she might finish her fieldwork in peace.
TEXT_HEAVNZ827_01957_SEQ_03: You slay the crawlers, making the local area safer for mapmaking goblins. Return to Boomshox to report your success.
TEXT_HEAVNZ827_01957_SEQ_04: Boomshox is pleased to hear of your victory over the crawlers and pledges to resume her fieldwork with renewed vigor. There is still much and more to be surveyed, but the sooner she completes her work, the sooner she can return home to Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNZ828_01958_SEQ_00: Boomshox looks as if she is about to dripeyes.
TEXT_HEAVNZ828_01958_SEQ_01: Boomshox's fieldwork has run into difficulties again. Her survey of the northern Answering Quarter complete, she has moved on to studying the area around Saint Mocianne's Arboretum. However, the great morbols occupying the lake in front of the Arboretum doors have brought her work to a halt. She asks you to destroy three of these slimyvines to allow her to resume her studies.
TEXT_HEAVNZ828_01958_SEQ_02: You successfully destroy three great morbols. Return to Boomshox in the north of the Answering Quarter to tell her the good news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ828_01958_SEQ_03: Boomshox thanks you for clearing the way for her continued surveyance of the Answering Quarter. Thanks to your selfless assistance, she will soon be able to finish her fieldwork and return to the town she knows and loves.
TEXT_HEAVNZ829_01959_SEQ_00: Boomshox is keen to finish her fieldwork and return to town.
TEXT_HEAVNZ829_01959_SEQ_01: Boomshox has nearly finished the fieldwork assigned to her by Drydox, but the last item on the list eludes her─she has been instructed to pluck three feathers from the Orn kites that live in the hills behind Saint Mocianne's Arboretum. However, the birds are less keen to part with their feathers than the goblin first imagined. Boomshox begs you to dispatch three of the creatures and pluck their feathers, so that she might finally return to the comfort and safety of Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNZ829_01959_SEQ_02: You dispatch the Orn kites and pluck their feathers, carefully selecting the finest plume from each bird. Boomshox awaits your return to the north of the Answering Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNZ829_01959_SEQ_03: You deliver the Orn kite feathers to Boomshox, completing her allocation of fieldwork. While she puts her results in order, she asks that you return to Idyllshire ahead of her and inform Drydox of her success.
TEXT_HEAVNZ829_01959_SEQ_04: You report to Drydox, who is amazed that a novice like Boomshox has completed what she believed to be an impossible task. As Boomshox has proven herself to be eminently suited to surveyance, Drydox resolves to entrust all such fieldwork to the novice in future. Just how Boomshox will react to this vote of confidence remains to be seen...
TEXT_HEAVNZ830_01960_SEQ_00: Feltsmox is still fishing, same as always...
TEXT_HEAVNZ830_01960_SEQ_01: Feltsmox is still trying to catch a fish and is still having no luck. This time, she suspects the nearby sun bears are the cause of her troubles. She claims they have been coming down into the river, eating some of the fish and scaring the rest away. She asks you to slay four of these bothersome beasts and collect their meat for her.
TEXT_HEAVNZ830_01960_SEQ_02: You put the sun bears down and gather thick slices of bear meat from them. Hopefully any of them that are left learn their lesson and stay away from the river. Deliver the meat to Feltsmox.
TEXT_HEAVNZ830_01960_SEQ_03: Feltsmox thanks you for slaying the bears that have been keeping the fish away. Eager though she is to confirm that the fish have returned─by catching a big fat fish to eat─she is too hungry to wait for a bite, and leaves to eat the sun bear meat you gathered for her.
TEXT_HEAVNZ831_01961_SEQ_00: The salvaging goblin is at a complete loss as to how to handle the great morbols.
TEXT_HEAVNZ831_01961_SEQ_01: A salvaging goblin has asked for your help in dealing with the great morbols that interfere with his work. Preventing them from breeding seems to be the best idea, so he asks you to slay three great morbol seedlings. Unfortunately, these slippery little creatures rarely come out of hiding. However, they love fish, and can be lured from hiding by using fish as bait. Feltsmox also loves fish─she is always fishing. Perhaps she can provide some to use as bait. Find her and ask her.
TEXT_HEAVNZ831_01961_SEQ_02: You find Feltsmox and she agrees to cooperate. Unfortunately, she still has had no luck in catching any fish whatsoever. But hope is not lost. She assures you that morbol seedlings are not discerning eaters. They can be just as easily lured from hiding with fishing bait as they can with the fish themselves. Meet with her at Saint Mocianne's Arboretum and put her plan to the test.
TEXT_HEAVNZ831_01961_SEQ_03: Just as Feltsmox promised, the great morbol seedlings are quick to emerge when she throws a handful of fishing bait into the water. You make quick work of the seedlings, slaying three of them as requested by the salvaging goblin. Thank Feltsmox for her assistance.
TEXT_HEAVNZ831_01961_SEQ_04: Feltsmox is happy to be of help, but has mixed feelings about how well her plan worked. After all the trouble she has had in trying to catch fish, she is unsure what to make of the ease with which she caught the morbol seedlings. In any case, the plan was a success. Report back to the salvaging goblin with the good news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ831_01961_SEQ_05: The salvaging goblin is glad that the great morbol seedlings have been thoroughly dealt with. He thanks you for your help, and sets off to thank Feltsmox, too.
TEXT_HEAVNZ832_01962_SEQ_01: It transpires that Woolnix's friend is taking longer to gather junk in the Answering Quarter than anticipated. Woolnix himself has grown more worried with every passing bell, and, given that you are there to help, bids that you seek out his comrade.
TEXT_HEAVNZ832_01962_SEQ_02: You speak to the startled goblin, and learn that he was set upon by some mysterious fiend whilst hunting for junk. See what attacked him, and defeat them if necessary.
TEXT_HEAVNZ832_01962_SEQ_03: You walk up the steps, and are greeted by the sight of two Sharlayan mammets, presumably left behind to deter intruders. Though they attack, you repel them with ease, and ensure they will no more trouble travelers. Return to Woolnix's friend, and give him the news.
TEXT_HEAVNZ832_01962_SEQ_04: The goblin is much relieved to learn he will no longer fall under attack from the mammets. He says he will finish his junk hunting, and then return to the Cenotaph. Make your way back there, and give your full report to Woolnix.
TEXT_HEAVNZ832_01962_SEQ_05: Woolnix breathes a sigh of relief upon hearing your tidings, and thanks you for aiding him and his friend.
TEXT_HEAVNZ833_01963_SEQ_00: Steam appears to be rising from Midnight Dew's beautifully bedecked ears.
TEXT_HEAVNZ833_01963_SEQ_01: Midnight Dew's entire stock has been stolen by a band of thieves, who have been seen escaping into the Sharlayan ruins. She asks you to assist her in tracking the bandits down, and bids you meet with her in the Answering Quarter to begin the hunt.
TEXT_HEAVNZ833_01963_SEQ_02: You meet with Midnight Dew in the Answering Quarter and she briefs you on her plan to catch the robbers. As the stock they stole is too heavy to be transported on foot, she predicts that the bandits hope to escape by boat. While she contacts her comrades to have them stake out the riverbank, she asks that you investigate the Answering Quarter ruins to see if any sign of the bandits or their ill-gotten booty yet remains.
TEXT_HEAVNZ833_01963_SEQ_03: You chance upon a trio of bandits guarding a chest and they immediately attack. Lay the thugs low and retrieve the stolen goods.
TEXT_HEAVNZ833_01963_SEQ_04: You collect the chest the thugs were guarding, a heavy casket of oak and gold marked with the initials “M” and “D.” Return the stolen goods to Midnight Dew to the north of the Answering Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNZ833_01963_SEQ_05: You present the chest to Midnight Dew, who immediately recognizes it as her own. She thanks you for its recovery, and asks that you continue to lend her your expert assistance in retrieving the remainder of her inventory.
TEXT_HEAVNZ834_01964_SEQ_00: Midnight Dew appears to be chewing her perfectly painted lips.
TEXT_HEAVNZ834_01964_SEQ_01: Midnight Dew's comrades have sighted an empty skiff moored along the cliffs to the south, and believe it to be the getaway craft of the thieves who stole her stock. She plans to head south of Saint Mocianne's Arboretum to cut off the bandits from their means of escape, and asks you to meet with her there to help her hunt them down.
TEXT_HEAVNZ834_01964_SEQ_02: You rendezvous with Midnight Dew amid the ruins of the Answering Quarter. With the skiff still empty and no sign of the bandits in the vicinity, she concludes that they must be holed up in the hills. She proposes that you head up into the hills to flush the thieves out while she stands guard against their escape.
TEXT_HEAVNZ834_01964_SEQ_03: You head up into the hills to find the bandits, but the bandits find you first. A pair of burgling blackguards attempt to ambush you in a narrow pass and you are forced to cut them down. Return to Midnight Dew south of Saint Mocianne's Arboretum to inform her of all that befell.
TEXT_HEAVNZ834_01964_SEQ_04: Midnight Dew is pleased to hear that you have brought another two bandits to justice, and relieved that it was an able adventurer like you that fell into their trap, and not one of her goblin comrades. With several bandits still on the loose and half her property still in their hands, she asks that you continue to lend her your invaluable assistance to track down the last of the thieves.
TEXT_HEAVNZ835_01965_SEQ_00: Midnight Dew's goblin comrades are in urgent need of assistance.
TEXT_HEAVNZ835_01965_SEQ_01: Midnight Dew hurriedly informs you that the goblin comrades she dispatched to search for the thieves have spotted their quarry. Unfortunately, their quarry has spotted them in return, leaving them beaten and bruised down by the broken bridge. She bids you meet with her there before the bandits finish the job.
TEXT_HEAVNZ835_01965_SEQ_02: You rendezvous with Midnight Dew and the injured goblins, locked in a stalemate with the leader of the bandits. While she protects her frazzled friends from the outlaw's accomplices, she bids you challenge the head wastrel himself and bring him to justice.
TEXT_HEAVNZ835_01965_SEQ_03: The head wastrel summons his cronies to keep you at bay, but you swiftly cut them down. Confront the bandit leader at the base of the broken bridge and secure his surrender.
TEXT_HEAVNZ835_01965_SEQ_04: The head wastrel, finding himself cornered and his gang defeated, surrenders himself to you on condition that you spare his life. Return to Midnight Dew to inform her of the bandit's capitulation.
TEXT_HEAVNZ835_01965_SEQ_05: Midnight Dew thanks you for apprehending the wastrel and retrieving her stock. After she has attended to the bandit's punishment and the goblins' treatment, she will return to Idyllshire. Meet with her there and she will grant you your reward.
TEXT_HEAVNZ835_01965_SEQ_06: You speak with Midnight Dew in Idyllshire. She tells you that it is not unusual to see bandits in the hinterlands─after all, the Sharlayan ruins make perfect hideouts for outlaws on the run from the city-states of Eorzea. However, this is the first time their criminal avarice has posed an existential threat to Idyllshire itself. Midnight Dew thanks you for your assistance in capturing the criminals─now that her stock is returned, trade with the goblins can continue and the survival of Idyllshire is secured.
TEXT_HEAVNZ901_01966_SEQ_00: Saro Roggo is a picture of nervous energy.
TEXT_HEAVNZ901_01966_SEQ_01: One of Matoya's servants, the poroggo Saro Roggo, has tasked you with eliminating the bugs that are threatening to destroy his mistress's herbs. Examine the medicinal herbs outside Matoya's Cave and dispatch the bugs that appear.
TEXT_HEAVNZ901_01966_SEQ_02: The bugs will bother Matoya's herbs no more. Return to her cave and report your success to Saro Roggo.
TEXT_HEAVNZ901_01966_SEQ_03: Saro Roggo is elated to hear that the herb garden is once again safe from pests. However, his troubles are far from over. As a self-confessed failed creation, he fears that it is only a matter of time before his mistress casts him aside. As such, he wishes to prove himself useful to her, and to this end he bids you speak with the brooms in the cave, that you might learn Matoya's desires.
TEXT_HEAVNZ902_01967_SEQ_00: The straightforward broom will share with you his knowledge in exchange for a straightforward task.
TEXT_HEAVNZ902_01967_SEQ_01: The straightforward broom offers to share with you his knowledge, but you must first bring him the object he desires: a signpost for aetherial travel, which he describes as sparkly, glowy, and angularly. Such signposts used to be commonplace in Sharlayan. Search for the mystery object in the ruins of the city.
TEXT_HEAVNZ902_01967_SEQ_02: You have acquired a disused aetheryte shard, which is most certainly what the straightforward broom desires. Make your way back to Matoya's Cave and present your discovery to him.
TEXT_HEAVNZ902_01967_SEQ_03: The straightforward broom accepts the aetheryte shard with glee. As promised, he shares with you his knowledge─the fruits of Matoya's research into aether. Unfortunately, he does not seem to know what his mistress desires...
TEXT_HEAVNZ903_01968_SEQ_00: The statuesque broom has pure intentions for you.
TEXT_HEAVNZ903_01968_SEQ_01: A self-proclaimed pursuer of purity, the statuesque broom desires that you bring him pure, untainted water. If you do him this favor, he promises to impart to you his knowledge. Draw water from the spring situated west of the Answering Quarter, and deliver it to the statuesque broom.
TEXT_HEAVNZ903_01968_SEQ_02: You have drawn cool spring water from the specified source. Deliver it to the statuesque broom in Matoya's Cave.
TEXT_HEAVNZ903_01968_SEQ_03: Though initially tickled by its transparency, the statuesque broom is underwhelmed by the spring water. He goes on to speak of a legendary water of unsurpassed beauty, that is unattainable to brooms but is found within all men. What could this water be, that is saltier than the Bloodbrine Sea yet clearer than the Thaliak River? Ascertain the identity of this water, and show it to the statuesque broom.
TEXT_HEAVNZ903_01968_SEQ_04: You cry for the statuesque broom, and your tears prove to be the legendary water of which he spoke. As promised, he shares with you his knowledge─the history of Sharlayan. Unfortunately, he does not seem to know what his mistress desires...
TEXT_HEAVNZ904_01969_SEQ_00: The self-possessed broom needs your help to satisfy his fetish for bridges.
