TEXT_STMBDZ414_02737_SEQ_01: Fukudo thanks you for deciding to remain in Namai and help Kurobana. He has come to the conclusion that the Lupin boy might be suited to work which requires strength, but is not of an aggressive nature─specifically, transporting sacks of rice. Fukudo says he shall go inform his friend who monitors the rice storehouse of his idea and bids you talk to Kurobana.
TEXT_STMBDZ414_02737_SEQ_02: Kurobana is initially caught off guard by Fukudo's suggestion, but he eventually agrees to transport rice if it will help the village as a whole. You follow Kurobana as he heads off to talk with Shirojishi, Fukudo's friend.
TEXT_STMBDZ414_02737_SEQ_03: You are greeted by a jovial Shirojishi who wastes no time assigning Kurobana his first task. Kurobana remarks that while he is no fighter, he is certainly strong enough to carry the rice as far as the village storehouse. After watching Kurobana set off, rice sack in hand, Shirojishi bids you monitor his progress and encourage him if he tires on his way to his destination.
TEXT_STMBDZ414_02737_SEQ_04: When you catch up to Kurobana, it is evident that he is struggling under the weight of the local produce. You do your best to lift his spirits, hoping it will give him the strength for one final push. Kurobana seems to regain some of his lost stamina and embarks on the last stretch of his journey to the storehouse.
TEXT_STMBDZ414_02737_SEQ_05: Kurobana triumphantly drops his rice sack thinking his work for the day is done. When Hachiboku lets him know that there are still three more sacks to be transported, the Lupin boy decides enough is enough. You prepare to go and inform Fukudo of yet another failure.
TEXT_STMBDZ414_02737_SEQ_06: You find that Fukudo has already gotten a hold of Kurobana and remonstrated with the boy. The young Lupin is forced to promise that he shall not give up the next time he is faced with another challenge. Fukudo muses that Kurobana might be better suited to a job that requires little strength.
TEXT_STMBDZ415_02738_SEQ_00: Fukudo has thought long and hard about this.
TEXT_STMBDZ415_02738_SEQ_01: Fukudo states that he thinks Kurobana might be suited to plucking weeds from paddy fields. He also explains that “Namai” is actually a local term for the arrowhead: an aquatic plant often found in paddies. You accompany Kurobana to go and talk with Hayabusa, a friend of Fukudo's, and ask if he will let you clear his paddy fields of weeds.
TEXT_STMBDZ415_02738_SEQ_02: Hayabusa is delighted by the offer of help and quickly assigns you and Kurobana areas to work on. While the original plan was for only Kurobana to tend the paddies, you are convinced to join him as it is a good chance to experience the local culture. Dusting off your hands, you prepare to rip out some weeds.
TEXT_STMBDZ415_02738_SEQ_03: Hayabusa praises both you and Kurobana for a job well done. However, just as Kurobana is starting to believe he may have finally found a way to contribute to Namai, he mentions that Hayabusa's paddies smelled somewhat odd. The rice farmer takes great offense at this remark, making it clear that he would like Kurobana to leave immediately.
TEXT_STMBDZ415_02738_SEQ_04: Fukudo will likely be disappointed once he learns that Kurobana has failed to succeed, despite being able to handle the work itself.
TEXT_STMBDZ415_02738_SEQ_05: Kurobana reiterates that he meant no harm and that Hayabusa's paddies genuinely gave off a strange smell. Fukudo accepts that Kurobana bore no ill will and says he will apologize on the boy's behalf.
TEXT_STMBDZ416_02739_SEQ_00: Kurobana does not forget smells so easily.
TEXT_STMBDZ416_02739_SEQ_01: The stench given off by Hayabusa's paddies is still fresh in Kurobana's nostrils. The Lupin lad theorizes that the heightened sense of smell possessed by his race is why only he has noticed the oddity. You agree to accompany Kurobana on a trip to compare the smell of other paddies in the village with Hayabusa's.
TEXT_STMBDZ416_02739_SEQ_02: As expected, the other paddy fields smell perfectly normal. You decide to revisit Hayabusa's terraces to check if they still exude the same odor.
TEXT_STMBDZ416_02739_SEQ_03: Kurobana wonders if the water in the paddies is to blame for the foul stench. However, his chain of thought is soon interrupted by a loud noise coming from the nearby reservoir. The two of you rush up the slope in search of the noise's origin.
TEXT_STMBDZ416_02739_SEQ_04: You encounter a monster that seems to have made itself quite comfy. Kurobana asks you to dispatch it, lest the contamination worsen.
TEXT_STMBDZ416_02739_SEQ_05: Just as you slay the beast it unleashes a pungent odor, strong enough that even you can detect it.
TEXT_STMBDZ416_02739_SEQ_06: Kurobana notes that the smell that came from the beast was the very same stench given off by Hayabusa's paddies. It is, however, unclear just how the creature found its way to the reservoir, Kurobana theorizing that it lost sight of its pack and came here in search of sustenance. You head to tell Fukudo of these recent developments.
TEXT_STMBDZ416_02739_SEQ_07: Fukudo has just finished apologizing to Hayabusa when you return to speak with him. This, along with your slaying of the beast by the reservoir, significantly changes the rice farmer's opinion of Kurobana. Kurobana is asked if he would be willing to check the condition of Hayabusa's paddies on a more frequent basis, which delights the young Lupin. Ageta also requests the same of him and Kurobana begins to feel like he belongs in Namai at last.
TEXT_STMBDZ417_02740_SEQ_00: Kurobana requires your help once more.
TEXT_STMBDZ417_02740_SEQ_01: Kurobana has steadily been gaining the villagers' trust by continuing to pluck weeds and examine the local paddies. However, he is concerned that Namai would be defenseless should another creature attack. You tell Kurobana that Gyorin has been trying to sell some imperial weapons of late and agree to introduce him to the Namazu merchant.
TEXT_STMBDZ417_02740_SEQ_02: Kurobana is impressed by Gyorin's wares and makes it clear he would like to buy them. Unfortunately, the Namazu merchant believes the guns to be worth quite a lot─enough gil to live comfortably for a decade being his valuation. Shirojishi then appears claiming the village is under attack. While Kurobana has said he cannot afford to pay Gyorin's prices, Hayabusa asks if they can borrow the guns to protect Namai. You convince Gyorin to let the villagers take the guns and negotiate some form of payment later.
TEXT_STMBDZ417_02740_SEQ_03: Gyorin, unsure as to whether he can trust the villagers, asks you to go with him to Namai. He wishes to collect his payment as soon as they have slain the creatures threatening their paddies.
TEXT_STMBDZ417_02740_SEQ_04: Hayabusa cannot stop enthusing about how skillfully Kurobana slayed the two penghou with an imperial firearm. Gyorin then arrives on the scene, keen to get down to business.
TEXT_STMBDZ417_02740_SEQ_05: Just as it is starting to look like the deal is not going to happen, a pile of nearby persimmons catches Gyorin's eye. He is all too eager to create a dye with them which he would use to make his own unique apron. Kurobana is somewhat confused by the merchant's thought process, but agrees to trade him one hundred persimmons in exchange for the imperial weaponry.
TEXT_STMBDZ418_02741_SEQ_00: Gyoku of Yuzuka Manor has a task to ask of a willing adventurer.
TEXT_STMBDZ419_02742_SEQ_00: Gyoen of Yuzuka Manor seeks someone capable of seeing the deed he asks done.
TEXT_STMBDZ420_02743_SEQ_00: Gyoboku of Yuzuka Manor is looking for an able adventurer to aid in an errand.
TEXT_STMBDZ421_02744_SEQ_00: A hard-whiskered Namazu at Yuzuka Manor is looking for a strong-armed adventurer to help him.
TEXT_STMBDZ422_02745_SEQ_00: Gyoei of Yuzuka Manor is looking for an adventurer with the constitution to see his deed done.
TEXT_STMBDZ423_02746_SEQ_00: An old Namazu Master at Yuzuka Manor seeks someone for an enlightening endeavor.
TEXT_STMBDZ424_02747_SEQ_00: Gyoshu of Yuzuka Manor has a message for one who walks in the world of man.
TEXT_STMBDZ425_02748_SEQ_00: Gyorin of Yuzuka Manor is casting a perplexed look in your direction.
TEXT_STMBDZ425_02748_SEQ_01: Gyorin wishes to enlist your aid in his struggle to become a successful and influential merchant. Speak with him at the storehouse in the Glittering Basin where he hoards his wares.
TEXT_STMBDZ425_02748_SEQ_02: Gyorin shows you his proud store of treasures and trinkets, which to the discerning eye is unequivocally a midden of unsellable garbage and refuse. Accepting of your harsh appraisal, he resolves to take up fishing to source his mercantile endeavors. Speak with Gyorin at the Glittering Basin once more.
TEXT_STMBDZ425_02748_SEQ_03: At the outset of his new life of fishing, Gyorin managed to drop his precious and prized pole. Search the Glittering Basin for Gyorin's fishing rod.
TEXT_STMBDZ425_02748_SEQ_04: You have found Gyorin's fishing rod. Return it to him at the Glittering Basin.
TEXT_STMBDZ425_02748_SEQ_05: You have returned Gyorin's fishing rod to him. He confides in you that since dropping the pole, he has been considering the pursuit of other means to make his way as a merchant. Travel to the Glittering Basin and speak with him once again.
TEXT_STMBDZ425_02748_SEQ_06: After turning to the sagacious teachings written in his emakimono, Gyorin decides to engage in the prospecting and mining of mineral wealth.
TEXT_STMBDZ426_02749_SEQ_00: At the Glittering Basin, Gyorin eagerly awaits the next opportunity for you to aid him in his ascension to mercantile greatness.
TEXT_STMBDZ426_02749_SEQ_01: Gyorin has set out to prospect choice mining spots. Travel to the Glittering Basin and speak with him.
TEXT_STMBDZ426_02749_SEQ_02: Gyorin boasts to you of the Namazu heightened sense of detection gained by way of the glorious barbels about their head and face. He claims to be using this gift to find precious ores for mining. Travel to the Glittering Basin and speak with Gyorin once more.
TEXT_STMBDZ426_02749_SEQ_03: Gyorin informs you he has found a choice mining location, but that he is unable to reach it due to a host of monsters in the way. Clear his path of two ruffled hornbills at the Glittering Basin.
TEXT_STMBDZ426_02749_SEQ_04: You have slain all the ruffled hornbills that obstructed Gyorin. Speak with him once more at the Glittering Basin.
TEXT_STMBDZ426_02749_SEQ_05: Gyorin asks that you head back to his manor while he mines the ores he has found. Travel to the destination and await his return.
TEXT_STMBDZ426_02749_SEQ_06: Gyorin has returned home and shown his fresh haul to an expert in mineral appraisals named Gyofu. According to Gyofu's trained eye, none of the ores Gyorin brought back from the Glittering Basin are of any value. Gyorin leaves in low spirits. Travel to the Glittering Basin and speak with him.
TEXT_STMBDZ426_02749_SEQ_07: Gyorin reaches the conclusion that perhaps his barbels are not made for detecting valuable minerals. He tells you he will once again seek another way to make his name as a merchant.
TEXT_STMBDZ427_02750_SEQ_00: At the Glittering Basin, Gyorin is visibly depressed.
TEXT_STMBDZ427_02750_SEQ_01: Gyorin strikes upon the idea of trapping monsters in the wild to collect their wings, scales, and anything else he can turn for a profit. To aid him in this, he asks you to help prepare the bait for his traps. Travel to the Glittering Basin and defeat three water serpents.
TEXT_STMBDZ427_02750_SEQ_02: You defeated three water serpents. Deliver the fresh water serpent flesh you stripped from their carcasses to Gyorin in the Glittering Basin.
TEXT_STMBDZ427_02750_SEQ_03: You deliver the fresh water serpent flesh to Gyorin, who promptly departs to set his traps. Travel to the Glittering Basin and await Gyorin's return at the designated location.
TEXT_STMBDZ427_02750_SEQ_04: You patiently await Gyorin at the designated location, but he has not returned. Return to the Glittering Basin and make sure he has not come to harm.
TEXT_STMBDZ427_02750_SEQ_05: Gyorin somehow manages to fall victim to one of his own traps while traveling the Glittering Basin and setting them up. Given to despair once more, he dejectedly returns to his warehouse. Travel to the Glittering Basin and speak with him again.
TEXT_STMBDZ427_02750_SEQ_06: Though despondent over his continued failures, Gyorin is grateful that your quick assistance prevented his death and dismemberment.
TEXT_STMBDZ428_02751_SEQ_00: At the Glittering Basin, Gyorin is making it all too obvious he wants you to talk to him.
TEXT_STMBDZ428_02751_SEQ_01: Gyorin decides to seek the counsel of Gyofu in his unrelenting pursuit of mercantile greatness. Travel to Yuzuka Manor and speak with Gyorin once more.
TEXT_STMBDZ428_02751_SEQ_02: Gyofu tells Gyorin that there are treasures still buried within the ruins of a Garlean stronghold to the east. Gyorin ignores Gyofu's warnings and departs for the ruins immediately. Follow Gyorin, and speak to him at the Glittering Basin.
TEXT_STMBDZ428_02751_SEQ_03: Gyorin continues in the direction of the Garlean stronghold ruins. Follow him once more, and speak to him in Castrum Fluminis.
TEXT_STMBDZ428_02751_SEQ_04: Gyorin discovers a band of Lupin, and asks you to create a diversion. Defeat Lupin looters in Castrum Fluminis.
TEXT_STMBDZ428_02751_SEQ_05: You defeated the Lupin looters. Speak with Gyorin in Castrum Fluminis.
TEXT_STMBDZ428_02751_SEQ_06: Gyorin tells you that he was able to find something valuable while you were distracting the Lupin. Return to Yuzuka Manor and speak with Gyorin once more.
TEXT_STMBDZ428_02751_SEQ_07: Gyofu appraises Gyorin's haul, and determines that all of the weapons can be sold after some minor repairs. Upon hearing the good news, Gyorin resolves to open his own shop, which he will name The New Rich, and continue on the path to greatness.
TEXT_STMBDZ501_02752_SEQ_00: This Oroniri youth is most grateful to the Qestir.
TEXT_STMBDZ502_02753_SEQ_00: Khaishan is so worried he is on the verge of saying something.
TEXT_STMBDZ503_02754_SEQ_00: Tamachag wants to investigate some unsavory dealings.
TEXT_STMBDZ504_02755_SEQ_00: Baidur is not very good at his job.
TEXT_STMBDZ505_02756_SEQ_00: Chambui is in need of meat.
TEXT_STMBDZ506_02757_SEQ_00: Uto would like to attract more custom.
TEXT_STMBDZ507_02758_SEQ_00: This Adarkim warrior has his eyes on a particular kind of flower.
TEXT_STMBDZ508_02759_SEQ_00: Togene has a soft spot for children.
TEXT_STMBDZ509_02760_SEQ_00: Tamachag is not in the best of spirits.
TEXT_STMBDZ509_02760_SEQ_01: Tamachag asks you to aid some local Qestiri merchants that are being troubled by a foreign merchant. He explains that the Qestiri way is to show one's thoughts with actions in lieu of words─something the merchant is painfully unaware of. You head for the Qestiri khan's tent in search of the trader known as Gascot.
TEXT_STMBDZ509_02760_SEQ_02: You come across Gascot in the midst of annoying a Qestiri girl that seems to be in charge of the marketplace. Once Gascot realizes you are not a competitor, he agrees to listen as you explain the local customs. Finally convinced talking will get him nowhere, Gascot agrees to leave the locals in peace and talk with you outside.
TEXT_STMBDZ509_02760_SEQ_03: Gascot remarks that this is his first time talking with a fellow traveler in a long while. He goes on to explain that he has come to Reunion in the hope of starting a trading relationship with the Au Ra there. Admitting the faults with his initial approach, Gascot asks if you would be willing to help him learn more of the area's customs.
TEXT_STMBDZ510_02761_SEQ_00: Gascot is raring to get started with his studies.
TEXT_STMBDZ510_02761_SEQ_01: Gascot enlists your aid to find out more about how Qestir communicate with each other. Rather surprisingly, he is actually aware of his less-than-favorable reputation amongst the locals and feels your help is vital. You agree to lend him a hand and question the Au Ra in Reunion on his behalf.
TEXT_STMBDZ510_02761_SEQ_02: Some of the locals are not especially keen to help when it becomes apparent you are assisting Gascot. However, you are still able to learn a few facts concerning Qestiri customs. Namely, that Reunion is a place where all Xaela put their tribal rivalries to one side to interact peacefully, and that the Qestir really do not ever speak.
TEXT_STMBDZ510_02761_SEQ_03: Gascot listens to you intently as you share what you have learned. Taking to heart the idea that actions speak louder than words, Gascot resolves to greet everyone in the village, and asks that you meet with Cotota to earn her trust.
TEXT_STMBDZ510_02761_SEQ_04: As instructed by Gascot, you approach Cotota in the hopes of gaining her trust. She initially seems confused by your approach, and just as you feel you are on the verge of a breakthrough, you are interrupted by none other than the blundering merchant himself. Gascot unleashes his interpretation of the Bomb Dance on his unsuspecting victims inside the khan's tent. Their response to this disturbance of the peace is unsurprisingly rather negative. Gascot bids you leave the area and regroup to consider just what went wrong.
TEXT_STMBDZ510_02761_SEQ_05: While Gascot is aware his dance did not go down well, he is perplexed as to why. Supposedly he received a very favorable reception when he performed it in front of several Qestiri onlookers earlier. Regardless, he notes that the experience has at least taught him something about the local culture and he shall continue his endeavor to find a way of effectively expressing himself.
TEXT_STMBDZ511_02762_SEQ_00: Poor Gascot just wants some Qestiri friends.
TEXT_STMBDZ511_02762_SEQ_01: In light of Gascot's dance failing to capture the locals' hearts and minds, he suggests you try a different approach: improving his reputation with the other tribes first. Gascot believes advertising his wares in Reunion to a range of tribes will increase the demand for his goods, putting pressure on the Qestir to allow him to trade. You agree to help promote his goods to the Au Ra that have only recently come to Reunion.
TEXT_STMBDZ511_02762_SEQ_02: A Gesi by the name of Jebei shows he is quite interested in trading with Gascot. He explains that his tribe values hunting above all else and would have use for Gascot's foreign weapons. You are also told that the Qestir are in constant need of oil to keep the lamps of Reunion alight. In light of this, Jebei encourages you to retrieve a lump of fat from a steppe gedan and present it to Cotota as a gesture of goodwill.
TEXT_STMBDZ511_02762_SEQ_03: Having slain the beast mentioned by Jebei and collected its fat, you make your way back to Reunion to present the spoils to Gascot.
TEXT_STMBDZ511_02762_SEQ_04: Gascot is pleased to see your venture was a success. He states that Jebei gave him some choice advice while you were away and that he is quite keen to follow it. You are bid to go and hand over the beast fat to Cotota on Gascot's behalf.
TEXT_STMBDZ511_02762_SEQ_05: Cotota seems puzzled to see you again. You hand her the fat and explain the reason for your visit. However, her reaction is far from positive, and you cannot help but wonder if Jebei's advice to Gascot is somehow to blame.
TEXT_STMBDZ512_02763_SEQ_01: Cotota returns the animal fat to you and bids you go and speak with the khan, Iturgen. You elect to present the fat to him and explain your current situation.
TEXT_STMBDZ512_02763_SEQ_02: After you have finished explaining everything to Iturgen, he bids you head to the northeast. You are unsure as to why he would have you travel in said direction, but it seems he is quite keen that you do. Upon finding what seems to be the area he wished for you to visit, you decide to wait and see if anyone, or anything, else appears.
TEXT_STMBDZ512_02763_SEQ_03: After waiting a short time you see Gascot meeting a group of Gesi that includes Jebei. They demand that Gascot furnish them with bombs which they plan to use to destroy Reunion. When Gascot declares he has no intention of supplying them with any weapons, the atmosphere turns sour and the Gesi move to attack the merchant.
TEXT_STMBDZ512_02763_SEQ_04: You intervene in the nick of time, just barely saving Gascot from the Gesi assault. After you have dealt with the attackers, you go to see if your merchant friend is unharmed.
TEXT_STMBDZ512_02763_SEQ_05: Tamachag joins you to put an end to Jebei's scheme once and for all. Cotota then hands you a vellum and infers she would like you to present it to Gascot. You leave in search of him as you realize he left the area while you were otherwise occupied.
TEXT_STMBDZ512_02763_SEQ_06: When you eventually locate Gascot, he remarks that he has just finished saying his good-byes to the Au Ra that were so transfixed by his Bomb Dance. You hand him the vellum given to you by Cotota which Gascot immediately recognizes as a sign that he has been granted permission to trade in Reunion. Filled with enthusiasm anew, Gascot declares he will return to his office in Kugane and bring back with him wares that will enrich the marketplace. He bids you farewell and says he looks forward to the day when the two of you are reunited once more in Reunion.
TEXT_STMBDZ513_02764_SEQ_00: This clumsy Mol maiden has broken something fairly important.
TEXT_STMBDZ514_02765_SEQ_00: Buqatai has his eye on some well-guarded bones.
TEXT_STMBDZ515_02766_SEQ_00: Nigen's brother should have returned from his errand by now.
TEXT_STMBDZ516_02767_SEQ_00: Cotan has awoken to the true potential of cheese.
TEXT_STMBDZ517_02768_SEQ_00: Nigen is worried about yet another family member.
TEXT_STMBDZ518_02769_SEQ_00: Caur needs the help of a strong .
TEXT_STMBDZ519_02770_SEQ_00: Ujin needs help if she is to do what the gods ask of her.
TEXT_STMBDZ520_02771_SEQ_00: Sukegei has been abandoned by his favorite sheep.
TEXT_STMBDZ521_02772_SEQ_00: Nigen is worried for her husband.
TEXT_STMBDZ522_02773_SEQ_00: This Mol maiden cannot wait to go shopping in Reunion.
TEXT_STMBDZ523_02774_SEQ_00: Abaka looks at you with an incredulous glint in his eye.
TEXT_STMBDZ524_02775_SEQ_00: Ogodei has a favor to ask of you.
TEXT_STMBDZ525_02776_SEQ_00: Charakha stares at you with admiration.
TEXT_STMBDZ526_02777_SEQ_00: The Budugan warrior squints at you.
TEXT_STMBDZ527_02778_SEQ_00: Guyug is closely observing your movements.
TEXT_STMBDZ601_02779_SEQ_00: Sorocan gazes into the distance, a concerned frown upon her face.
TEXT_STMBDZ602_02780_SEQ_00: Yabuqa watches the flames of the fire, a wistful expression upon his face.
TEXT_STMBDZ603_02781_SEQ_00: An Oroniri hunter would like to study your combat style.
TEXT_STMBDZ604_02782_SEQ_00: Esugen hums quietly to himself as he works.
TEXT_STMBDZ604_02782_SEQ_01: Esugen, the Dawn Throne culinarian, is in quite the predicament. Halfway through preparing food to feed the hungry Oroniri warriors, he realizes he has forgotten to obtain a key ingredient─sheep's milk. Were he to go and fetch this himself, he would fall behind schedule and find himself at the mercy of fifty hot-blooded, hungry men. To prevent any delays in serving the food, he asks that you go and bring back the milk of three sheep for him. He then directs you to speak with Sorocan to do just that.
TEXT_STMBDZ604_02782_SEQ_02: Sorocan is appalled to learn that Esugen sent you to milk sheep in his stead and is convinced that he is attempting to shirk his responsibilities. Nevertheless, she allows you to proceed to the pen and collect sheep milk.
TEXT_STMBDZ604_02782_SEQ_03: You approach three sheep and manage to fill all three of the pails full of milk, just as Esugen requested. Deliver them to the Oroniri culinarian.
TEXT_STMBDZ604_02782_SEQ_04: Shortly after delivering the pails of milk to Esugen, the two of you are joined by a young man named Kuzuku, who seems to have come solely to taunt the local culinarian. Once he leaves, Esugen turns to you and reveals that as the weakest man in the village, he occupies the bottom rung in the Oroniri hierarchy. He, however, intends to become strong enough to rise from his lowly position, and asks that you help him with his cooking on occasion that he might find the time to train.
TEXT_STMBDZ605_02783_SEQ_00: Esugen gives you a pleading look you know altogether too well.
TEXT_STMBDZ605_02783_SEQ_01: The Oroniri warriors have invited their Budugan allies to dine with them and Esugen has been ordered to prepare a large banquet. He, however, lacks mammoth meat─the Budugan's favored meat. Due to his standing within his tribe he is unable to ask the warriors to procure some for him, thus he turns to you with pleading eyes and requests that you bring back two mammoth carcasses. Once you are done slaying the beasts, he would like for you to come find him at the Bridge of the High Rule Warriors, where he will be training.
TEXT_STMBDZ605_02783_SEQ_02: You travel to the northeast and make quick work of two mammoths. This should more than suffice for the banquet. Take their carcasses to Esugen, who awaits your arrival at the Bridge of the High Rule Warriors.
TEXT_STMBDZ605_02783_SEQ_03: You come upon Esugen, who is trying in vain to defend himself against a swarm of angry vilekin. Stepping in, you quickly dispatch of them. Despite the fact that the threat is now gone, Esugen is still trembling. Lend him a steadying hand.
TEXT_STMBDZ605_02783_SEQ_04: You aid Esugen, who thanks you for your help. He then reveals to you that he is of delicate constitution and even performing what seem like mundane tasks often leaves him short of breath. While disappointed in the results of today, he is not yet ready to give up. He then bids you to meet him at the Dawn Throne and bring the two mammoth carcasses with you.
TEXT_STMBDZ605_02783_SEQ_05: You deliver the carcasses to Esugen and, in doing so, have saved the banquet being held in honor of the Buduga. While he is disappointed by his own inability to conquer the swarm of vilekin that attacked him earlier, he intends to drown out his sorrows through cooking. He seems to have also come to the conclusion that instead of pursuing becoming strong it would be to the benefit of everyone for him to continue doing what he does best─providing good food.
TEXT_STMBDZ606_02784_SEQ_00: Esugen has finished all his tasks for today.
TEXT_STMBDZ606_02784_SEQ_01: Jelme, a young Oroniri boy informs Esugen and you of an upcoming tournament to be held among the brothers of the tribe. While reluctant to do so, the culinarian is required to participate and hastens off to train. As soon as your friend leaves, Jelme turns to you with a request on the tip of his tongue.
TEXT_STMBDZ606_02784_SEQ_02: As Esugen continuously places last in all strength-based tournaments, in the days leading up to the match he often becomes depressed. Jelme, wanting to help lift his spirits, has written a letter of encouragement. He feels too embarrassed to deliver it himself, however, and requests that you take it to the culinarian in his stead.
TEXT_STMBDZ606_02784_SEQ_03: Esugen is visibly moved by the touching words penned upon the letter. He would like to thank the young boy in person for the kind gesture and begins making his way back to the Dawn Throne with you in tow.
TEXT_STMBDZ606_02784_SEQ_04: Esugen's joy is short-lived for not soon after you return to where Jelme is, you are joined by his brother, Kuzuku. After directing a few scathing remarks at the culinarian, he warns the young boy against associating with Esugen then leaves. More than Kuzuku's harsh words, however, Jelme is upset by Esugen's passive attitude. Begging him to learn to stand up for himself, the orphan storms off, leaving you and the stunned culinarian in his wake.
TEXT_STMBDZ606_02784_SEQ_05: Seeing how upset Jelme was by Kuzuku's comments and his passive reaction to them, Esugen vows to no longer let people to walk all over him. He has steeled his resolve and intends to do his very best in the upcoming tournament.
TEXT_STMBDZ607_02785_SEQ_00: Esugen wants to smooth things over with Jelme.
TEXT_STMBDZ607_02785_SEQ_01: Esugen asks you to deliver boortsog─a delicious fried sweet─to Jelme as an apology for what occurred earlier. While he intends to also later seek the boy's forgiveness in person, he must first see to preparations for the main banquet, which is to take place after the tournament.
TEXT_STMBDZ607_02785_SEQ_02: Jelme accepts the gift and tells you that he has long forgiven Esugen. At the moment he has a far more pressing matter on his mind: Kuzuku has fallen ill. The tournament is just around the corner and he worries for his brother's health and status. Asking that you thank Esugen on his behalf, he then scurries off to tend to Kuzuku.
TEXT_STMBDZ607_02785_SEQ_03: Esugen learns from you that Kuzuku, who is to be his first opponent in the upcoming tournament, has taken ill. While initially tempted to take advantage of the situation, the elderly culinarian eventually decides against it for fear of hurting Jelme. Instead, he vows to help speed along Kuzuku's recovery by making him a medicinal stew. Promising this will be the last thing he asks of you, he hands you a sheep bone for bait and requests that you procure some circling bi fang breast meat.
TEXT_STMBDZ607_02785_SEQ_04: As per Esugen's instructions, you place the sheep bone upon a boulder to the east of the Dawn Throne. Now all that is left for you to do is lie in wait and pounce upon the circling bi fang that appears.
TEXT_STMBDZ607_02785_SEQ_05: You successfully slay the bi fang that swooped in from the skies. Esugen will no doubt be pleased by the beautiful cuts of breast meat you have obtained.
TEXT_STMBDZ607_02785_SEQ_06: Upon receiving the meat, Esugen immediately sets to work and soon a pungent smell fills the air. Handing the potent herbal stew off to Jelme, he tells the young boy to go and feed it to Kuzuku while it is still hot. The young boy thanks the culinarian and rushes off to do just that.
TEXT_STMBDZ607_02785_SEQ_07: Esugen tells you that even though he knows he will place last in the upcoming tournament, he is happy he decided to help Kuzuku. He goes on to say that your and Jelme's friendships mean a great deal to him and is what allowed him to realize his talents and revive his passion for cooking. Handing you some food he made specially for you, he sends you off with a smile.
TEXT_STMBDZ608_02786_SEQ_00: This unbloodied Dotharl needs help with a delivery.
TEXT_STMBDZ609_02787_SEQ_00: Dagasi fears for the local livestock.
TEXT_STMBDZ610_02788_SEQ_00: The Dotharli warrior wants to see just how capable you are.
TEXT_STMBDZ610_02788_SEQ_02: Head for the Dusk Throne without straying from the designated path.
TEXT_STMBDZ610_02788_SEQ_04: Present the small leather sack to the Dotharli warrior.
TEXT_STMBDZ611_02789_SEQ_00: Agujam is worried by what lurks beneath the sands.
TEXT_STMBDZ612_02790_SEQ_00: The Dotharli youth is looking for someone to protect her.
TEXT_STMBDZ613_02791_SEQ_00: Mauci is haunted by his past.
TEXT_STMBDZ613_02791_SEQ_01: A young Dotharl named Mauci approaches you regarding his past. Despite being constantly told he is Mauci of the Seven and Seven Swords reincarnate, he cannot shake the feeling that he has no connection to the master swordsman. You agree to help him by asking the residents of Dotharl Khaa if Mauci is truly who everyone says he is.
TEXT_STMBDZ613_02791_SEQ_02: You question a few of the locals and are told time and time again that Mauci most certainly is the reincarnation of his namesake. No other Dotharl were born the year the previous Mauci passed, and his poor swordsmanship is not enough to convince anyone that they could be wrong.
TEXT_STMBDZ613_02791_SEQ_03: Mauci still seems unconvinced that he has been accurately named, but resolves to continue his sword training regardless. You agree to lend him your aid in the hope that it will lead to him improving as a swordsman.
TEXT_STMBDZ614_02792_SEQ_00: Mauci is keen to study your technique.
TEXT_STMBDZ614_02792_SEQ_01: Mauci has decided the best way to improve his own abilities is to study how you fight. He gathers some fatty meat from the village in the hopes of attracting a few Nhaama analas for you to slay. It does not take long for the creatures to approach and you promptly ready yourself for combat.
TEXT_STMBDZ614_02792_SEQ_02: You make short work of the Nhaama analas, clearly impressing Mauci.
TEXT_STMBDZ614_02792_SEQ_03: The young Dotharl learned plenty from watching you fight. He mentions that the village is hosting a practice tourney and that he will attempt to make use of what he has seen in it. You make your way back to Dotharl Khaa to monitor the boy's progress.
TEXT_STMBDZ614_02792_SEQ_04: Sadly Mauci is defeated rather easily by his opponent. He hopes this will go some way to convincing the villagers that he is not and never will be skilled with a blade, but everyone remains steadfast in their belief that he is of the Seven and Seven Swords. Another young Dotharl named Khulan decides she has had enough of the crowd's comments, admonishing them on Mauci's behalf. Khulan introduces herself as an old friend of Mauci's, asking if you would be willing to help her improve Mauci's current situation.
TEXT_STMBDZ615_02793_SEQ_00: Khulan is worried about her friend.
TEXT_STMBDZ615_02793_SEQ_01: Khulan explains to you that the Dotharl khatun is in charge of identifying who newborns were in their past lives. However, even the khatun is not infallible, and Khulan is convinced she incorrectly identified Mauci as the reincarnation of Mauci of the Seven and Seven Swords. Mauci is frustrated by the continuing speculation regarding his identity and asks you accompany him to an area just outside Dotharl Khaa.
TEXT_STMBDZ615_02793_SEQ_02: Mauci explains there is a hill to the north of the village that he likes to sit upon when he needs to reorganize his thoughts. As he is unarmed, you agree to make the trip with him and keep him safe from harm.
TEXT_STMBDZ615_02793_SEQ_03:
You resolve to ensure that Mauci reaches his destination safe and sound, and to there lend the Dotharl boy an ear.

※You must be accompanied by Mauci to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_STMBDZ615_02793_SEQ_04: Mauci remarks that while he is grateful for Khulan's attention, he cannot help but be jealous of his friend and how comparatively simple her life has been. The village's expectations of Mauci have clearly taken their toll on the young Dotharl. He states that he no longer cares if he is able to wield a sword, he just desires the strength required to feel he belongs to his tribe.
TEXT_STMBDZ615_02793_SEQ_05: As you prepare to return to Dotharl Khaa, you are set upon by a manzasiri. The beast is downed in the blink of an eye by none other than Mauci himself. The young Dotharl is not quite sure how he did it, but it seems he defeated the manzasiri with his bare fists.
TEXT_STMBDZ615_02793_SEQ_06: Mauci has started to think he may be a much better fighter with his fists than he ever will be with a sword. He mentions that he would like to confirm something and bids you head back to Dotharl Khaa to tell Khulan of his newfound strength. Khulan is initially shocked to see you returned without Mauci, but calms down when she hears of recent developments. Now that it is clear Mauci is skilled in hand-to-hand combat, Khulan is positive that her friend is not who the khatun judged him to be. She asks you to continue to lend her your help, that you might discover the truth behind Mauci's identity.
TEXT_STMBDZ616_02794_SEQ_00: Khulan has a point to prove.
TEXT_STMBDZ616_02794_SEQ_01: Khulan declares that the time has come to prove once and for all that Mauci is not, and never was, a master swordsman. She bids you head to a cave to the west known as the Hundred-and-one Revelations to meet an Uyagiri udgan. While you make your way there, Khulan says she shall find Mauci and bring him along shortly.
TEXT_STMBDZ616_02794_SEQ_02: You come face-to-face with the udgan known as Ibakha. She instantly realizes that it is not you with whom she has business, beckoning Mauci to join you in the cave. Ibakha is ultimately unable to tell Mauci anything of his past life, but advises him to accept the present for only it, and not history, will lead to his future.
TEXT_STMBDZ616_02794_SEQ_03: Mauci, even more convinced his name is an ill fit, decides to tell the villagers that he is going to abandon training with a sword in favor of honing his hand-to-hand combat skills. Khulan suggests that Mauci slay a Matanga and bring back some of its fangs as proof of his newfound strength. You head with Mauci to the north in search of the creature.
TEXT_STMBDZ616_02794_SEQ_04: Mauci asks you to keep any other creatures that appear at bay while he dispatches the Matanga. You keep watch for beasts while Mauci goes to lock horns with the creature.
TEXT_STMBDZ616_02794_SEQ_05: There are initially no signs of any other beasts, but you choose to continue to keep watch just in case.
TEXT_STMBDZ616_02794_SEQ_06: As expected, several beasts eventually appear and you make short work of them. Noticing that Mauci has successfully vanquished his foe as well, you head over to speak with him.
TEXT_STMBDZ616_02794_SEQ_07: Mauci bids you return to the village without him as he still needs to collect a few of his foe's fangs. He also asks that you inform Khulan of his success, lest his friend be left worrying.
TEXT_STMBDZ616_02794_SEQ_08: Khulan requests that the villagers all gather to listen to a message Mauci wishes to deliver to them. The troubled Dotharli boy declares to the crowd that he is not Mauci of the Seven and Seven Swords and will never again take up a blade. However, Mergen laughs this off, stating that not all the previous Maucis were skilled swordsmen. This leaves Mauci somewhat deflated as he realizes all his turmoil up until now had been for naught.
TEXT_STMBDZ616_02794_SEQ_09: Mauci wishes he had been told sooner of his various past selves, but is relieved that his struggle is over at last. He thanks both you and Khulan for your help, Khulan remarking that she is glad her friend can remain in Dotharl Khaa.
TEXT_STMBDZ617_02795_SEQ_01: Kishiligh mentions that Mauci has been looking for you. It seems he wishes to discuss something he heard from the Uyagir. You set off in search of the young Dotharl.
TEXT_STMBDZ617_02795_SEQ_02: Mauci has recently heard stories of a master culinarian that works at the Dawn Throne. Word has it his cooking is so good it can both cure illnesses and boost warriors' strength. You theorize he may be speaking of Esugen and go to meet with the Oronir on Mauci's behalf.
TEXT_STMBDZ617_02795_SEQ_03: Speaking with Esugen, you learn that Kuzuku had been telling people of how the cook's soup had nursed him back to health. It seems this story made its way to the Uyagir, eventually reaching Mauci's ears as well. After explaining Mauci's situation to Esugen, he asks that you bring him baras meat. You go to meet with Mauci below the Azim Steppe.
TEXT_STMBDZ617_02795_SEQ_04: Mauci gladly agrees to help you hunt several baras, noting that he is relieved to learn there is at least one Oronir willing to help their tribe's rivals.
TEXT_STMBDZ617_02795_SEQ_05: After slaying three baras and obtaining their meat you go to rendezvous with Mauci by Azim Khaat.
TEXT_STMBDZ617_02795_SEQ_06: Mauci was a bit overzealous and wound up slaying a grand total of five baras. However, he says that task has made him feel more convinced than ever that he was correct to abandon his sword for his fists. You gather up both your hauls of meat and take them to Esugen.
TEXT_STMBDZ617_02795_SEQ_07: Esugen is impressed by the sheer volume of baras meat you bring to him, remarking that Mauci must have quite an appetite. He tells you to wait for him with Mauci as he will bring the food directly to you once he is done preparing it.
TEXT_STMBDZ617_02795_SEQ_08: Esugen and Mauci get along very well despite their tribal rivalry. After exchanging a few compliments, Mauci asks if Esugen would be interested in accompanying him hunting sometime. Esugen is enthusiastic about the idea and you are thanked by the young Dotharl for all you have done to improve his life.
TEXT_STMBDZ618_02796_SEQ_00: Bujir knew you would be coming.
TEXT_STMBDZ619_02797_SEQ_00: Caalun has a tradition she would like to pass on to her son.
TEXT_STMBDZ620_02798_SEQ_00: Ibakha is busy preparing a feast fit for a tribe free of greed.
TEXT_STMBDZ621_02799_SEQ_00: This Uyagiri youth needs your help collecting something.
TEXT_STMBDZ622_02800_SEQ_00: This mild-mannered Mol needs the aid of a warrior.
TEXT_STMBDZ623_02801_SEQ_00: Bujeg is busy preparing to make an offering.
TEXT_STMBDZ625_02803_SEQ_00: Maqali's son should have returned by now.
TEXT_STMBDZ701_02804_SEQ_00: An Auri samurai is in need of an extra pair of eyes.
TEXT_STMBDZ702_02805_SEQ_00: Yagoro needs hard-to-find supplies from hard-to-reach places.
TEXT_STMBDZ703_02806_SEQ_00: Haname wishes to show her gratitude to a staunch supporter of the Front.
TEXT_STMBDZ704_02807_SEQ_00: The spineless soldier needs someone to fight his fight for him.
TEXT_STMBDZ705_02808_SEQ_00: The stalwart soldier would request your company on a brief outing.
TEXT_STMBDZ706_02809_SEQ_00: The slight soldier has need of a hero's keen eyes.
TEXT_STMBDZ707_02810_SEQ_00: Motojiro has the look of a man with a heavy heart.
TEXT_STMBDZ708_02811_SEQ_00: The sharp-eyed samurai has an eye for the sky.
TEXT_STMBDZ709_02812_SEQ_00: An ijin merchant in Kugane seeks help in his search for a certain enchanting someone.
TEXT_STMBDZ710_02813_SEQ_00: Keisetsu of Kugane has a task fit for an adventurer from abroad.
TEXT_STMBDZ711_02814_SEQ_00: The face of an injured Sekiseigumi blade is twisted in pain.
TEXT_STMBDZ712_02815_SEQ_00: A puissant porter in Kugane has grievously injured his shoulder.
TEXT_STMBDZ713_02816_SEQ_00: Prapti is concerned someone is encroaching on Vira territory.
TEXT_STMBDZ714_02817_SEQ_00: Garima is in need of an adventurer who won't drag their feet.
TEXT_STMBDZ715_02818_SEQ_00: Jayanti seems to have reservations about her next outing.
TEXT_STMBDZ716_02819_SEQ_00: This Vira bowmaid is desperately looking for something.
TEXT_STMBDZ717_02820_SEQ_00: M'linhbo finds herself between a rock and a hard place.
TEXT_STMBDZ718_02821_SEQ_00: M'zimzizi is fretting over the tribe's lack of food.
TEXT_STMBDZ719_02822_SEQ_00: M'septha has the look of a woman with questions that beg for answers.
TEXT_STMBDZ720_02823_SEQ_00: M'gizzoh is itching to go hunting.
TEXT_STMBDZ721_02824_SEQ_00: M'rahz Nunh is in need of a skilled warrior.
TEXT_STMBDZ721_02824_SEQ_01: An unruly young Seeker of the Sun has been challenging M'rahz Nunh to combat without cease, each attempt more futile than the last. While most would find these duels to be an annoyance, M'rahz Nunh sees this persistence as admirable. That is why he asks you to train this would-be warrior. He says your new student can be found idling about Virdjala.
TEXT_STMBDZ721_02824_SEQ_02: The young Miqo'te scoffs at the idea of you instructing him, and a fight between the two of you quickly ensues. When you defeat him with a single blow, however, he concedes to your offer, introducing himself as M'zhet. Before you begin training him, he wishes to observe your fighting form, suggesting you pit yourself against a gazelle. To that end, he sets off in search of your prey.
TEXT_STMBDZ721_02824_SEQ_03: You find a gazelle and promptly defeat it with a display of skill befitting your reputation. M'zhet has no doubt been enlightened after watching you fight.
TEXT_STMBDZ721_02824_SEQ_04: Bearing witness to your battle against the gazelle has left M'zhet duly inspired. So much so, he is confident he can defeat M'rahz Nunh at this very moment. But first, he would ponder his plan of attack.
TEXT_STMBDZ722_02825_SEQ_00: M'zhet Tia looks ready to fight.
TEXT_STMBDZ722_02825_SEQ_01: Inspired by your display of skill against the gazelle, M'zhet Tia rushes off to go and defeat M'rahz Nunh. Not wanting to miss the battle, you follow him back to the Peering Stones.
TEXT_STMBDZ722_02825_SEQ_02: You arrive to find M'zhet Tia on the ground, writhing in pain. As he finds the strength to stand and take his leave, M'rahz Nunh stops him to ask why he is so insistent on becoming nunh. M'zhet Tia accuses him of stealing the title from his father, after which they were forced to leave the tribe when he was a child. He goes on to say his father abandoned him, and believes it would not have happened if not for M'rahz Nunh. The M tribe leader is shocked to hear all of this, as he had not seen M'zhet Tia or his father since they left the tribe all those years ago. He claims M'zhet Tia's father relinquished the title willingly, but is bewildered as to why he would abandon his son. He asks to take M'zhet Tia with you and investigate M'aht Nunh's disappearance.
TEXT_STMBDZ722_02825_SEQ_03: Recounting the shame of his past has reaffirmed M'zhet Tia's resolve to defeat M'rahz Nunh and become leader of the M tribe. He pleads with you to continue his training that he might challenge the M tribe leader once more.
TEXT_STMBDZ723_02826_SEQ_00: M'zhet Tia is ready to get into shape.
TEXT_STMBDZ723_02826_SEQ_01: M'zhet Tia is determined to defeat M'rahz Nunh. Believing he has found the means to harden himself for battle, he bids you follow him to where he has been keeping to a safe location for training.
TEXT_STMBDZ723_02826_SEQ_02: You arrive at your destination and notice a case that looks strangely familiar. M'zhet Tia tells you it contains grenades which he intends to use for training. Shocking though it may seem, he asks you to hurl the explosives at him. He braces himself as you take a grenade from the container.
TEXT_STMBDZ723_02826_SEQ_03: You lob a grenade at M'zhet Tia. Much to your surprise─and perhaps his as well─he survives the blast. He suspects there may still be too much explosive powder in the grenades. Nevertheless, he bids you take another from the crate.
TEXT_STMBDZ723_02826_SEQ_04: You notice M'zhet Tia tense up as you throw another grenade, and rightly so. He staggers from the impact, but again remains standing. He begins to doubt if he emptied out the grenades at all. Unwilling to back down, he asks you to hit him one more time.
TEXT_STMBDZ723_02826_SEQ_05: The third grenade is too much for M'zhet Tia as he drops to his knees in pain. He is absolutely certain now he forgot to empty out the grenades' explosive powder.
TEXT_STMBDZ723_02826_SEQ_06: M'zhet Tia is battered and bruised, but not beaten. Despite his appearance, he claims he is stronger than ever. Perhaps even strong enough to defeat M'rahz Nunh. After a short rest, that is.
TEXT_STMBDZ724_02827_SEQ_00: M'zhet Tia is ready to reclaim what is rightfully his.
TEXT_STMBDZ724_02827_SEQ_01: Believing he has sufficiently recovered from his rigorous training session, M'zhet Tia prepares to go to the Peering Stones to confront M'rahz Nunh. He asks that you accompany him to bear witness to his victory.
TEXT_STMBDZ724_02827_SEQ_02: M'rahz Nunh agrees to duel. However, he insists on moving the battle to a ravine southeast of the Peering Stones. M'zhet consents and takes his leave of the camp. Follow him to the ravine and wait for the fight to begin.
TEXT_STMBDZ724_02827_SEQ_03: It seems M'rahz Nunh has come not to fight, but to talk. As he tells it, M'zhet Tia's father left the village of his own volition, staying close by to keep watch over his former tribe. When a herd of ravenous monsters came stampeding toward the Peering Stones, he sacrificed himself to stop the herd, leaving his son in the Ananta's care. The weight of this revelation has left M'zhet Tia bereft of the resolve to fight. What will he do now?
TEXT_STMBDZ724_02827_SEQ_04: Knowing of his father's selfless sacrifice has inspired M'zhet Tia. He soon makes for the Peering Stones to speak with M'rahz Nunh.
TEXT_STMBDZ724_02827_SEQ_05: M'zhet Tia wishes to rejoin the M tribe to someday carry on in his father's footsteps. Should he become nunh someday, he plans to once again challenge the friend and mentor who helped to reunite him with his people.
TEXT_STMBDZ725_02828_SEQ_00: M'rahz Nunh's furrowed brow suggests there may be trouble afoot.
TEXT_STMBDZ725_02828_SEQ_01: M'rahz Nunh spoke again with the Vira regarding the death of M'aht. They have reason to believe the Qalyana were behind the stampede that claimed the former M tribe leader's life. In light of this news, their strange behavior in recent days has left M'rahz Nunh concerned. He asks that you travel to East End and see if the Qalyana are up to no good.
TEXT_STMBDZ725_02828_SEQ_02: While surveying East End you happen upon a group of Qalyana assaulting what appears to be a Grand Company officer. You make short work of them and are surprised to see their prey was none other than Lieutenant Molkoh. Hopefully she is not seriously wounded.
TEXT_STMBDZ725_02828_SEQ_03: Lieutenant Molkoh is no worse for wear, relieved that you arrived when you did. She was examining the great tree known as the Percipient One when the Qalyana assaulted her. To have ventured so far from their homes, she believes some clue to their plans must be nearby.
TEXT_STMBDZ725_02828_SEQ_04: You and Lieutenant Molkoh are examining the inside of the Percipient One when a loud thud draws your attention outside. An Ananta of the Qalyana was trying to catch you unawares, but was thwarted by M'zhet Tia. He comes bearing more ill news from the Vira. As he explains it, the Qalyana were using a strange fruit found in East End to drive the wildlife into a frenzy to drive the M tribe from their village. Having recently discovered another container of Black Rose, Lieutenant Molkoh surmises the chemicals within have leaked into the soil, contaminating the tree and the fruit that grows from its branches. M'zhet decides to take the Ananta back to the Peering Stones for questioning, while Lieutenant Molkoh means to call in soldiers to dispose of the contaminated container. M'rahz Nunh will certainly wish to know of what transpired here.
TEXT_STMBDZ725_02828_SEQ_05: M'rahz Nunh is shocked to hear the Vira's claims of the reclusive Qalyana tribe are true. He promises to deal with the Qalyana you detained earlier, but not before extracting from her any pertinent information that may ensure the M tribe's safety. With his people safe, and M'zhet Tia following in his father's footsteps, M'rahz Nunh is certain the future of the M tribe has never been brighter.

TEXT_STMBDZ807_02835_SEQ_00: Hele is tired of soldiers slacking on the job.
TEXT_STMBDZ808_02836_SEQ_00: This Resistance fighter could use some help bringing people together.
TEXT_STMBDZ809_02837_SEQ_00: Zuzudesu needs an adventurer to do what they do best.
TEXT_STMBDZ811_02839_SEQ_00: Emory is preparing for a new business venture.
TEXT_STMBDZ812_02840_SEQ_00: J'nairoh would like to thank you for your help.
TEXT_STMBDZ813_02841_SEQ_00: This well-meaning mother has spread herself a little too thin.
TEXT_STMBDZ814_02842_SEQ_00: Brazen Brook needs help with a rather delicate situation.
TEXT_STMBDZ814_02842_SEQ_01: As Brazen Brook tells it, a single man is responsible for the Alliance's effortless reclaiming of Ala Ghiri. The problem, however, is they are unable to bring this man in for inquiry. Afraid to speak more on the matter out in the open, he insists you speak with Baut, the person in question.
TEXT_STMBDZ814_02842_SEQ_02: Baut is startled by your presence, but is soon relieved when you explain Brazen Brook sent you to help. The reason for his initial panic is made clear when he reveals that he is, in fact, a centurion of the Garlean forces. He ordered his men to retreat in lieu of a crushing defeat at the hands of the Alliance, but ran into an unexpected problem when attempting to turn himself in. To better explain his predicament, he insists you speak with the people of Ala Ghiri and hear what they have to say of him.
TEXT_STMBDZ814_02842_SEQ_03: You speak with the people of Ala Ghiri, and their responses are not what one would expect. Baut appears to be well-liked, with some townsfolk being surprisingly protective of him. As the pieces of the puzzle slowly fall into place, you return to speak with him and confirm your findings.
TEXT_STMBDZ814_02842_SEQ_04: Baut has found himself in a precarious position. Resigned to being a prisoner of war, the Alliance has yet to take him into custody for fear of a revolt from the villagers who have, for reasons unknown, grown to care for him like one of their own. Not wishing for them to come to harm, Baut asks for your help in persuading the villagers to allow for his peaceful surrender.
TEXT_STMBDZ815_02843_SEQ_00: Baut is ready to get to the root of his problem.
TEXT_STMBDZ815_02843_SEQ_01: Before trying to convince the townsfolk of anything, Baut would first learn why they choose to defend him so fiercely. To that end, he suggests the two of you split up and learn what you can about why they adore him so.
TEXT_STMBDZ815_02843_SEQ_02: The people you speak with tell you of Baut's kindness and willingness to defend them from his fellow Garlean soldiers. One man, preoccupied with carrying cargo, suggests you speak with J'dyalani to learn more.
TEXT_STMBDZ815_02843_SEQ_03: J'dyalani agrees to tell you about Baut under one condition: you must accompany her outside of town to exterminate spinners that have built a nest close by. With no other options, you concede and follow her out into the barren lands of Wightrock.
TEXT_STMBDZ815_02843_SEQ_04: It is not long before you arrive at your destination. As you approach, she directs your attention to the spinner's nest, taking care to remain at a safe distance. You ready your blade and prepare to flush the beasts out of hiding.
TEXT_STMBDZ815_02843_SEQ_05: Despite their numbers, the spinners are no match for you. Perhaps now you can finally learn why the villagers are so protective of Baut.
TEXT_STMBDZ815_02843_SEQ_06: J'dyalani explains to you the hopeless situation the people of Ala Ghiri found themselves in, and how their living conditions quickly improved when Baut assumed command there. You wonder how he will react, knowing his actions are the source of their adoration.
TEXT_STMBDZ815_02843_SEQ_07: When you explain to Baut the villagers' reasons for defending him, he begins by asserting he merely grew tired of his men abusing them. As his explanation continues, it becomes clear the real reason for his compassion: their suffering reminded him of his deceased wife and children who he had been fighting to rescue from life under Garlean rule. Putting his recollections aside, Baut is ready to move on to the next step of his plan─convincing the townsfolk that he is not worth protecting.
TEXT_STMBDZ816_02844_SEQ_00: Baut has a plan to smear his reputation.
TEXT_STMBDZ816_02844_SEQ_01: Baut intends to ruin the villagers' perception of him through a rumor of his own creation. Taking his ring in hand, he plans for you to go about town claiming he is the man responsible for the death of one of the village's holy men shortly after his arrival. Before setting the rumor to spinning, however, he suggests gauging the reaction of a single individual. The victim he has chosen is J'dyalani.
TEXT_STMBDZ816_02844_SEQ_02: You show J'dyalani the ring and relay to her Baut's rumor. Her feigned shock is short-lived as she is certain you would never do anything to damage his reputation. She asks you to remind Baut that, regardless of any crimes he has committed in the past, the people of Ala Ghiri are only concerned with the kind-hearted man he has shown himself to be since arriving there.
TEXT_STMBDZ816_02844_SEQ_03: Baut is disappointed to hear J'dyalani was able to see through his lie so easily. He asks you to speak with her once more, hoping she will help you convince the villagers with the truth rather than falsehoods. In the meantime, he will continue deliberating on his next course of action.
TEXT_STMBDZ816_02844_SEQ_04: In light of Baut's situation, J'dyalani concedes that speaking with a member of the Alliance could potentially solve their problems. You mention that he has been working with Brazen Brook to arrange his surrender, and she grows concerned that his arrest─and execution─are imminent. She insists on speaking with Brazen Brook at once, hoping to convince him to spare Baut's life.
TEXT_STMBDZ816_02844_SEQ_05: J'dyalani pleads for Baut's life, going so far as to offer herself in his stead. Brazen Brook can only answer her with confusion. He soon makes clear that they have no intentions of executing Baut. Rather, they need to question him regarding documents left behind by the Garleans after they fled Ala Ghiri. J'dyalani is pleased to hear this, and leaves to go share the good news.
TEXT_STMBDZ816_02844_SEQ_06: You return to speak with Baut, but find only a note in his place. J'dyalani's eyes grow wide with horror as you read aloud the note's contents. Still haunted by the past, Baut means to end his own life, and asks that you deliver his head to the Allied forces. You must move quickly if you are to save him.
TEXT_STMBDZ817_02845_SEQ_00: J'dyalani is not yet ready to give up on Baut.
TEXT_STMBDZ817_02845_SEQ_01: Not wishing to waste time, J'dyalani rushes off to the location described in Baut's note─northwest on the path to the Fringes.
TEXT_STMBDZ817_02845_SEQ_02: A pantera was preparing to rend the life from its willing victim just as you arrived. Your battle with the beast quickly ensues, and after a furious clash of claws and steel, it is at last brought low. With a sigh of relief you help Baut to his feet.
TEXT_STMBDZ817_02845_SEQ_03: Baut is less than pleased that you intervened, and your bringing J'dyalani does little to ease his frustration. When you explain that the Alliance had no intentions of executing him, he scoffs at their offer of clemency, claiming he would find another way to end his life. J'dyalani pleads with him to reconsider, reminding him that the people of Ala Ghiri care a great deal about him. As he continues to lament that he has nothing left to live for, she surprises him with what sounds oddly like a profession of love. Baut is so taken aback he can only laugh in response. The mood now lightened, he concedes to your requests and agrees to speak with the Alliance, granted J'dyalani helps him explain to the villagers he will not be put to death. As you all return to Ala Ghiri, you decide to pay a visit to Brazen Brook to share with him the good news.
TEXT_STMBDZ817_02845_SEQ_04: Brazen Brook is equal parts relieved and ecstatic to see that Baut has agreed to turn himself in. Moreover, the people of Ala Ghiri have not taken arms against the Allied forces in protest. He suspects there is still lingering mistrust of the Resistance and Eorzean Alliance, but he believes that, given time, Ala Ghiri will prosper as it once did so many years ago.
TEXT_STMBDZ818_02846_SEQ_00: Rahu is staring intently into the distance for signs of movement.
TEXT_STMBDZ819_02847_SEQ_00: Guntmar could really use a pick-me-up.
TEXT_STMBDZ820_02848_SEQ_00: Guntmar is wide awake, and wants to make use of his leftover broth.
TEXT_STMBDZ821_02849_SEQ_00: Garrulous Gall wishes to lay the groundwork for a new business.
TEXT_STMBDZ822_02850_SEQ_00: Godafre appears in need of some tight-lipped assistance.
TEXT_STMBDZ823_02851_SEQ_00: The ponderous porter appears to have a request for you.
TEXT_STMBDZ824_02852_SEQ_00: Mawt is whispering to herself in sinister tones.
TEXT_STMBDZ825_02853_SEQ_00: Dob needs a  who knows  explosive ordnance.
TEXT_STMBDZ826_02854_SEQ_00: Godafre has a tall favor to ask of you.
TEXT_STMBDZ827_02855_SEQ_00: Oggery needs a strong hand to save the trees.
TEXT_STMBDZ828_02856_SEQ_00: Hruodiger seeks a partner for his money-making scheme.
TEXT_STMBDZ901_02857_SEQ_00: Something has been bugging Raganher for a while now.
TEXT_STMBDZ902_02858_SEQ_00: Papin wants to surprise his family with something nice.
TEXT_STMBDZ903_02859_SEQ_00: Rawkin is in need of an adventurer with a strong pair of legs.
TEXT_STMBDZ904_02860_SEQ_00: An important individual has yet to visit Coldhearth, and Sagar is growing concerned.
TEXT_STMBDZ905_02861_SEQ_00: Sagar is concerned for a friend.
TEXT_STMBDZ905_02861_SEQ_01: Sagar tells you of Berehta, a kind and caring woman of Coldhearth who seems oddly troubled of late. She refuses to speak with anyone, but she has always been fond of travelers. He asks you to speak with her in the hopes of getting her to open up.
TEXT_STMBDZ905_02861_SEQ_02: Berehta has been thinking about her son, Erart, a young man of twenty summers who fled the village to avoid conscription by the Garleans. With the threat of the imperials gone, however, she is hoping he will someday return. Daunted by the dangers of the world outside Coldhearth, she asks you to inquire after him in her stead. She suggests stopping in Radiata, where he likely passed through on his escape to freedom.
TEXT_STMBDZ905_02861_SEQ_03: You speak with the people of Radiata, and while most cannot recall meeting a man named Erart, the trail is not yet cold. One villager is fairly certain a man by the name Godafre will know who you are looking for.
TEXT_STMBDZ905_02861_SEQ_04: Godafre indeed knows Erart. In fact, he helped hide him from the soldiers who came to Radiata in pursuit of him. Godafre goes on to say he and an acquaintance smuggled him north past Specula Imperatoris, but he knows not what happened next. With no other information to be had, you return to Coldhearth to let Berehta know her son seems to have fled to safety.
TEXT_STMBDZ905_02861_SEQ_05: Relief is clear on Berehta's face when you relay to her what you learned of Erart. Though she is gladdened to hear he is safe, she cannot deny that she misses him.
TEXT_STMBDZ906_02862_SEQ_00: Berehta cannot stop thinking about her son.
TEXT_STMBDZ906_02862_SEQ_01: Knowing her son is safe is simply not enough for Berehta. She asks that you continue your search, suggesting you begin in Ala Ghiri, where he likely went to rest and gather supplies.
TEXT_STMBDZ906_02862_SEQ_02: Speaking with the people of Ala Ghiri, it would seem the Allied forces may know something of Erart. Perhaps one of the Grand Company officers stationed there can offer more information as to his whereabouts.
TEXT_STMBDZ906_02862_SEQ_03: You speak with a flame captain who confirms a man from Coldhearth fitting Erart's description is a part of his unit. Unfortunately, he has already been dispatched to Specula Imperatoris to dispense with the potential threat of Garlean drones. You set your sights north in hopes of meeting with him before he leaves elsewhere.
TEXT_STMBDZ906_02862_SEQ_04: You arrive to find a golden-locked lieutenant who you are confident is the man you are looking for. Before he will take time to speak with you, however, he insists on completing the task set before him. To that end, you assist him in searching for any drones that may be hiding in the abandoned Garlean base.
TEXT_STMBDZ906_02862_SEQ_05: After searching several locations as instructed by the lieutenant, you locate and destroy a number of malfunctioning drones. Perhaps now you can finally get answers.
TEXT_STMBDZ906_02862_SEQ_06: The lieutenant is, in fact, from Coldhearth, but he is sadly not the man you were expecting. That said, he is certain the Resistance will know where Erart has escaped to.
TEXT_STMBDZ907_02863_SEQ_00: This golden-locked lieutenant seems to have something else to share with you.
TEXT_STMBDZ907_02863_SEQ_01: While the lieutenant has no other information to offer you about Erart, he knows someone who can─Guntmar of the Resistance, who is quite knowledgeable of any and all happenings in the Peaks.
TEXT_STMBDZ907_02863_SEQ_02: For a blessing, Guntmar not only knows Erart, but also the unit to which he has been assigned. He goes on to tell you that, at this very moment, they are making their way to Ala Mhigo. He suggests you make haste to Castrum Abania if you wish to catch up with them.
TEXT_STMBDZ907_02863_SEQ_03: You finally track down the captain of Erart's unit. When you mention his name, the captain dithers about what to say next. You sincerely /doubt he has any reason to hesitate.
TEXT_STMBDZ907_02863_SEQ_04: The captain eventually relents and tells you all. Erart assumed the identity of a wealthy Ala Mhigan merchant's son in order to infiltrate the Garleans' army. After a recent clash with the Allied forces, however, they lost contact with him. Assuming the worst, the captain was prepared to deliver a letter to his mother, penned by Erart in the event of his death. Having come so far for answers, the captain feels it appropriate that you take the letter to Berehta.
TEXT_STMBDZ907_02863_SEQ_05: You deliver the letter to Berehta, explaining to her what became of Erart. Too overwhelmed by grief to even open the letter, she begs you a moment to regain her composure.
TEXT_STMBDZ908_02864_SEQ_00: Berehta is ready to read her son's parting words.
TEXT_STMBDZ908_02864_SEQ_01: Berehta confesses she is too distraught to read Erart's letter, handing it to you to read in her stead. According to the missive, Erart left a gift for his mother with J'dyalani of Ala Ghiri. She has been instructed to hand over the package upon telling her it is time to “rekindle the flames of hope.” Unfit to make the journey herself, Berehta asks you to retrieve her son's parting gift.
TEXT_STMBDZ908_02864_SEQ_02: You relay the secret message to J'dyalani as described in the letter, and she presents you with a small pouch. Berehta will be excited to see what is inside.
TEXT_STMBDZ908_02864_SEQ_03: Berehta opens the pouch to reveal seeds and an accompanying note. It says they are date seeds from Garlemald, and will grow even in the most barren soil. As she leaves to inform the others of what she received, a mysterious figure steps in from the shadows, and reveals himself to be the allegedly deceased Erart. He believes his countrymen will not forgive his actions, even if they were for the sake of the Resistance, and so he faked his own death. He has resigned himself to traveling abroad to continue the fight against Garlemald in a distant land. To that end, he takes his leave, knowing Coldhearth rests in good hands.
TEXT_STMBDZ908_02864_SEQ_04: You find Berehta in good spirits, ready to begin planting seeds. She invites you to return to Coldhearth when the date palms have grown, to partake of the fruit born from Erart's sacrifice.
TEXT_STMBDZ909_02865_SEQ_00: Sagar still seems to be worried about Berehta.
TEXT_STMBDZ909_02865_SEQ_01: Despite her earlier enthusiasm, Berehta seems to be troubled once again. Sagar asks you to speak with her in the hopes of resolving whatever new problem has presented itself.
TEXT_STMBDZ909_02865_SEQ_02: Berehta wishes to thank J'dyalani for keeping the date seeds safe all this time. Having never ventured far from Coldhearth, she says she would feel safer accompanied by an adventurer accustomed to braving the wilds of Gyr Abania. And so, the two of you set out together toward Ala Ghiri.
TEXT_STMBDZ909_02865_SEQ_03: While passing through Mount Yorn, you and Berehta are assaulted by a group of chapulis. You promptly trounce them and check to see if Berehta is unharmed.
TEXT_STMBDZ909_02865_SEQ_04: Berehta remains without injury, but is duly unsettled seeing such creatures firsthand. After regaining her composure, she presses onward.
TEXT_STMBDZ909_02865_SEQ_05: Berehta stops for a moment to take in the sight of Specula Imperatoris before continuing onward. Hopefully there are no soldiers lingering in the shadows.
TEXT_STMBDZ909_02865_SEQ_06: You walk through the abandoned base with Berehta, who is on pins and needles all the while. Knowing she is halfway to Ala Ghiri motivates her to continue.
TEXT_STMBDZ909_02865_SEQ_07: Just when Ala Ghiri is within sight, you are attacked by wild griffins. You make quick work of them then check on your travel companion.
TEXT_STMBDZ909_02865_SEQ_08: You are glad to see that Berehta is fine, albeit somewhat shaken. But the danger is over. Together you walk through the gates of Ala Ghiri.
TEXT_STMBDZ909_02865_SEQ_09: You introduce Berehta to J'dyalani and the two soon find themselves lost in conversation like old friends. Baut happens to be passing by, taking the opportunity to seek your advice. Weidheri is in dire need of dates to produce arak, a type of spirit unique to the Gyr Abanian region. This problem is soon rectified when Baut suggests the people of Ala Ghiri and Coldhearth work together in cultivating the seeds Berehta recently received. He then escorts Berehta back to Coldhearth that he can better assess how much work there is to be done.
TEXT_STMBDZ909_02865_SEQ_10: J'dyalani finds it miraculous how you bring people together. With this potential new source of dates for Ala Ghiri's trademark drink, the future has never looked brighter.
TEXT_STMBDZ910_02866_SEQ_00: The dainty damsel would have you pick flowers.
TEXT_STMBDZ911_02867_SEQ_00: Able Ant seems distraught at the absence of a friend.
TEXT_STMBDZ912_02868_SEQ_00: Ranulf wants to help the Barber.

TEXT_STMBDZ914_02870_SEQ_00: This Ananta battlemaid wants to cheer up a friend's father.
TEXT_STMBDZ915_02871_SEQ_00: Kakalai needs your help with a matter of the heart.
TEXT_STMBDZ916_02872_SEQ_00: Serpent Marshal Brookstone finds himself once again in need of a good soldier.
TEXT_STMBDZ917_02873_SEQ_00: This somber sibling is looking to leave Castrum Oriens.
TEXT_STMBDZ918_02874_SEQ_00: Gerbert longs for the days when statues of Rhalgr dotted the Peaks.
TEXT_STMBDZ920_02876_SEQ_00: This hungry Hyur has been working hard to improve his smoke bombs.
TEXT_STMBDZ921_02877_SEQ_00: Munifrid seeks a seasoned adventurer for an important task.
TEXT_STMBDZ922_02878_SEQ_00: Serpent Captain Dantounuel needs an adventurer of particular experience.
TEXT_STMBDZ923_02879_SEQ_00: Supriya appears enchanted by the idea of pheasant feathers.
TEXT_STMBDZ924_02880_SEQ_00: Betha seeks aid in quieting the dead.
TEXT_STMBDZ925_02881_SEQ_00: Lieutenant Dorothe needs a soldier who knows how to swim.
TEXT_STMBDZ926_02882_SEQ_00: Pamisolaux seeks aid in restocking his medical supplies.
TEXT_STMBDZ927_02883_SEQ_00: J'zula Tia has a troublesome task for an adventurer.
TEXT_STMBDZ928_02884_SEQ_00: Topher seeks a redoubtable soldier for an urgent mission.
TEXT_STMBDZ991_02885_SEQ_00: Wichard has a suggestion for his uncle.
TEXT_STMBDZ991_02885_SEQ_01: Speaking with Wichard you learn that he is Gundobald's nephew. The passionate Ala Mhigan lad wishes to contact his uncle and ask for his help in rebuilding their once-great nation. However, as he is too busy to make the journey himself, he asks you to deliver a letter to Gundobald in his place.
TEXT_STMBDZ991_02885_SEQ_02: Gundobald is surprised to learn you have brought tidings from his estranged nephew. While he appreciates Wichard's invitation, he explains he has no choice but to decline it and look after those who are unable to leave Little Ala Mhigo. You are asked instead to check if Wichard would be willing to accept those from Little Ala Mhigo that wish to return to their homeland.
TEXT_STMBDZ991_02885_SEQ_03: Wichard is saddened to hear he has been refused by his uncle, but enthusiastically agrees to accept anyone that wishes to leave Little Ala Mhigo and join him. He sets about preparing for the group's arrival and bids you tell Gundobald the good news.
TEXT_STMBDZ991_02885_SEQ_04: Gundobald is glad to hear his request has been accepted. While some in Little Ala Mhigo are yet to make up their minds, there is a group that is already prepared to make the move to their homeland. Gundobald asks that you speak with him once more should you be willing to aid this group during their travels.
TEXT_STMBDZ992_02886_SEQ_00: Gundobald wishes to honor the memory of a brave warrior.
TEXT_STMBDZ992_02886_SEQ_01: Gundobald would like to commemorate the life of Wilred, who died fighting for the Crystal Braves. He hands you the warrior's old sword and bids you present it to Bertliana, Wilred's childhood friend.
TEXT_STMBDZ992_02886_SEQ_02: Bertliana recovers from the initial shock of seeing her friend's sword to introduce herself to you. She goes on to explain that it has long been her dream to someday take one of Wilred's belongings with her to Ala Mhigo, if it was liberated during her lifetime. Bertliana sets about packing the blade up and asks you to inform Gundobald that she will soon be ready to depart.
TEXT_STMBDZ992_02886_SEQ_03: Gundobald clearly thinks highly of Bertliana─noting that she has done incredibly well to overcome all the hardships she has had to endure. You are given a list containing the names of the first group that has decided to make the journey to their homeland and asked to see if they still harbor any doubts about the move.
TEXT_STMBDZ992_02886_SEQ_04: Everyone you speak with has their own worries, but you are able to reassure them that everything will be fine. You head back to Gundobald to relay that the group is now ready to make tracks.
TEXT_STMBDZ992_02886_SEQ_05: Gundobald informs you that Bertliana will be in charge of leading the group back to Ala Mhigo. He bids you let her know that she is free to give the order to leave whenever she is ready.
TEXT_STMBDZ993_02887_SEQ_00: Bertliana is ready to head home.
TEXT_STMBDZ993_02887_SEQ_01: Eager to depart for Ala Mhigo, Bertliana gathers everyone so that they can bid farewell to Gundobald. He wishes you all safe travels and Bertliana asks you to rendezvous with the party at Castrum Oriens.
TEXT_STMBDZ993_02887_SEQ_02: The group had no problems making it through the Black Shroud to Castrum Oriens thanks to the protection of the Wood Wailers. Bertliana explains that the plan is to continue heading eastwards and cross the Velodyna River. You follow the group through Virdjala to make sure they remain unharmed.
TEXT_STMBDZ993_02887_SEQ_03: The party is set upon by beasts, but you are able to slay them in a timely fashion. You go to speak with Bertliana and make sure everyone is safe and sound.
TEXT_STMBDZ993_02887_SEQ_04: Bertliana states it is time they resumed their journey. It is agreed that you will rendezvous with her in Radiata, a small settlement in the Peaks.
TEXT_STMBDZ993_02887_SEQ_05: You meet up with the group once more and immediately notice they are looking a bit worse for wear. While they were not attacked on their way to Radiata, the long journey has clearly taken its toll. Bertliana decides it is time for a well-earned rest before embarking on the second part of the trip.
TEXT_STMBDZ994_02888_SEQ_00: Bertliana is well rested and raring to go.
TEXT_STMBDZ994_02888_SEQ_01: Eager to reach Ala Mhigo, Bertliana bids the group resume their march towards the city-state. You agree to rendezvous with them in the Lochs.
TEXT_STMBDZ994_02888_SEQ_02: The group's march is halted by Janyn, who states that she has received word there are imperial informants trying to flee to Ala Mhigo disguised as refugees. However, all misunderstandings are cleared when she recognizes you, the hero of the revolution. You continue your advance in the direction of the High Bank.
TEXT_STMBDZ994_02888_SEQ_03: The party are set upon by minotaurs, who prove little match for your might.
TEXT_STMBDZ994_02888_SEQ_04: Bertliana rallies her compatriots and they head for the Ala Mhigan Quarter hoping to find Wichard.
TEXT_STMBDZ994_02888_SEQ_05: Wichard welcomes you all to the city-state and promises the group will enjoy their new lives in Ala Mhigo. He hopes that as time passes, they will be able to begin trading with other nations, using Little Ala Mhigo as a go-between. Bertliana agrees that Wichard's idea is worth pursuing and thanks you for all your help.
TEXT_STMBDZ995_02889_SEQ_00: Bertliana is ready to honor a fallen comrade.
TEXT_STMBDZ995_02889_SEQ_01: Now that the group has arrived in Ala Mhigo, Bertliana would like to commemorate Wilred's memory. Wichard tells you there is a cenotaph known as the Tomb of the Errant Sword to the north of the city. Bertliana asks you to speak with her once you are ready to depart.
TEXT_STMBDZ995_02889_SEQ_02: Bertliana bids you meet her in front of the Tomb of the Errant Sword.
TEXT_STMBDZ995_02889_SEQ_03: Bertliana says a heartfelt farewell to her fallen comrade, struggling to accept that he is not here to take in their ancestors' homeland. She promises to someday visit Wilred and tell him all about Ala Mhigo and how she helped rebuild the city-state. You are thanked one final time and Bertliana says she hopes to see you again sometime in the future.
TEXT_STMBDY104_02922_SEQ_00: Your body odor has caught Sumitsubo's attention.
TEXT_STMBDY105_02936_SEQ_00: Estrild of the Shiokaze Hostelry is keeping a close, enlisting eye on passersby.
TEXT_STMBDY106_02937_SEQ_00: Estrild of the Shiokaze Hostelry continues to keep a close, enlisting eye on passersby.
TEXT_STMBDY107_02938_SEQ_00: Estrild of the Shiokaze Hostelry persists in keeping a close, enlisting eye on passersby.
TEXT_STMBDY108_02939_SEQ_00: Estrild of the Shiokaze Hostelry remains unwavering in keeping a close, enlisting eye on passersby.
TEXT_STMBDY109_02940_SEQ_00: Your reputation precedes you, if the wide-eyed look the stranger is favoring you with is any indication.
TEXT_STMBDY109_02940_SEQ_01: In Rhalgr's Reach you are approached by a starry-eyed Ala Mhigan who thanks you for your service to the Resistance and states that he wishes to share with you an opportunity. Perhaps believing it to be more dramatic, he refrains from telling you what the opportunity actually is, and instead bids you speak with a mysterious veteran who waits for you outside Rhalgr's Reach.
TEXT_STMBDY109_02940_SEQ_02: The veteran tells you of a place called the Circles of Answering, where the monks of the Fist of Rhalgr used to hone body and mind. By the grace of his Doman patron, this training ground has been reborn as Stone, Sky, Sea...in spirit, if not in name. There you may challenge striking dummies tailored to the strengths of various beings fantastic and otherworldly. Should you triumph in the allotted time, you will know you are ready to face them in battle...though whether or not you will survive the actual encounter is an altogether different question. Dummies, after all, do not hit back...
TEXT_SUBCTS610_03005_SEQ_00: Galiena is on the lookout for an enterprising adventurer.
TEXT_SUBCTS611_03006_SEQ_00: M'naago is ready to depart when you are.

Softknox has told you about Rival Wings, a new type of war game incorporating goblin-made machina. If the thought of such fighty-play gives you heartthumps, you can learn more from Softknox...or dive straight into the action.
