To wit: he would see completion of the reconstruction effort celebrated─and pay tribute to Lord Francel's selfless contributions─by holding a surprise commemorative concert. He has already recruited Marcelloix to the cause, and the enterprising provisioner has already prepared a host of instruments. Finally, they suggest one final step to make the occasion truly special─they intend for you and Francel to take the stage together and perform a duet. That said, they are unsure as to what instrument the young lord most fancies. At their request, you offer to inquire with Foncrineau, that you might glean the information necessary.
TEXT_LUCKHA302_04000_SEQ_02: Foncrineau is overjoyed at your offer to hold a concert in Lord Francel's honor. Quick to offer his aid with anything you might need, he suddenly hits upon an idea, and bids you wait while he summons a certain personage who might be especially suited to lend support to your efforts.
TEXT_LUCKHA302_04000_SEQ_03: Minutes later, none other than Lord Artoirel appears on the scene. The renowned collector of orchestrion rolls─and accomplished composer in his own right─proffers one of his own pieces for the occasion: a piano duet he penned in honor of the Firmament's rebirth. More certain than ever that the event will be one to remember, you set off for Saint Roalle's Dais to practice for your own role in the festivities.
TEXT_LUCKHA302_04000_SEQ_04: You plink and plonk about at the piano for a spell of time, but find the complexities of Artoirel's composition beyond your fingers' ability to articulate. You are, however, confident that you will be able to perform the piece to your satisfaction with more practice. Take a seat at the piano again and see what fruits your efforts might bear.
TEXT_LUCKHA302_04000_SEQ_05: After what feels like hours of practice, you at long last feel confident in your ability to do Artoirel's masterwork justice. Seek out Mariorie, who has been charged with overseeing the festivities, and inform her that you are ready to take the stage.
TEXT_LUCKHA302_04000_SEQ_06: Mariorie beams at hearing that you are ready for the concert, and cheerfully informs you that the other performers have all but assembled as well. It is nigh time to raise the curtain on the Firmament's crowning hour.
TEXT_LUCKHA303_04001_SEQ_00: Mariorie is making the final preparations for the forthcoming concert.
TEXT_LUCKHA303_04001_SEQ_01: Mariorie welcomes your arrival, gleefully informing you that the performers have assembled, the instruments have been tuned, and the stage is set for the most magnificent concert the Firmament has seen. After your acquaintances Handeloup and Emmanellain express their eagerness to take part in the event, none other than Lord Francel arrives. Genuinely surprised and deeply touched by the gesture, he states that it would be an honor to perform with you. Make whatever final preparations you must, then join your friends atop the stage.
TEXT_LUCKHA303_04001_SEQ_02: Thanks to the impressive musical talents of your friends, as well as your diligence in practicing for this moment, the concert proves even more impressive than you could have expected, delighting the guest of honor, your friends, the audience, and all in the Firmament whose ears take in the melodies that now soar through the sky. Satisfied at all you have accomplished today, you return to Mariorie to thank her for her own efforts in making this day possible.
TEXT_LUCKHA303_04001_SEQ_03: Unsurprisingly, Mariorie is beside herself with joy at seeing the concert prove to be such an unqualified success. She thanks you for all you have done to bring the magic of music to the Firmament, and expresses her hope that you would not be averse to gracing local residents with an encore.
TEXT_LUCKHA304_04002_SEQ_00: Francel closes his eyes deeply, seemingly lost in reverie.
TEXT_LUCKHA304_04002_SEQ_01: Never ashamed to wear his feelings on his sleeve, Lord Francel appears more emotional than ever as he thanks you profusely for taking the stage with him today. Your moment of shared reverie, however, is interrupted by Thomelin, who announces the arrival of an unexpected and assumedly important visitor. Join Francel at the Mendicant's Court to see what development might await you.
TEXT_LUCKHA304_04002_SEQ_02: You arrive at the Mendicant's Court to discover that your unexpected guest is none other than Ser Aymeric, who, in his own words, has been waiting for the ideal opportunity to express his thanks to Lord Francel for his selfless efforts in rebuilding and revitalizing the Firmament. The young lord, for his part, seems rightly intimidated by the sudden and unexpected praise. Speak with him and pray reassure him that this can only be a positive development.
TEXT_LUCKHA304_04002_SEQ_03: Though remaining halfway in a state of shock at Ser Aymeric's sudden arrival, Lord Francel is nevertheless deeply satisfied and pleased to see his vision of the Firmament finally realized. With confidence that the current generation of Ishgard's luminaries─not to mention the people who form the living, breathing heart of the nation itself─are prepared to usher the Holy See into a new age of prosperity, you offer your most sincere thanks to your companion for his unwavering foresight and devotion to the cause, and promise that you will return in the future to further see his visions become reality.
TEXT_LUCKHZ006_04004_SEQ_00: The blissful bather is dying to talk to anyone who will listen to him.
TEXT_LUCKHZ007_04005_SEQ_00: Edilaude looks as if she's ready to take on the world.
TEXT_LUCKHZ008_04006_SEQ_00: A lonely sack rests on the streets of the Risensong Quarter, seemingly bereft of its owner.
TEXT_LUCKSA201_04025_SEQ_00: The look in Marsak's eyes tell you the fight for Bozja is far from over.
TEXT_LUCKSA201_04025_SEQ_01: Operation Eagle's Nest has failed, and the IVth Imperial Legion once again has the Resistance on the back foot. Bajsaljen is not one to be discouraged, however, and has already begun considering counter-strategies. Believing your counsel essential, he has requested an audience with you.
TEXT_LUCKSA201_04025_SEQ_02: A report from Bwagi reveals the imperial legion's strength is not what it seems. In fact, they are now starved for resources, which has prompted allied forces from Dalmasca and Nagxia to launch an assault and thus slow the arrival of reinforcements to Bozja. The meeting is soon interrupted when a fatigued soldier enters, warning of yet another sighting of Queen Gunnhildr. For reasons as yet unknown, this prompts Mikoto to run off, likely to the southern front.
TEXT_LUCKSA201_04025_SEQ_03: What Mikoto expects to find on the battlefield remains to be seen, but the others bid you go and find her, fearful she may discover more than she hopes for.
TEXT_LUCKSA201_04025_SEQ_04: You find Mikoto unharmed, spying on Misija and a group of imperials. Once again, the vision of Queen Gunnhildr appears, though her power is noticeably diminished from your previous encounter. As you turn to leave, Mikoto's gift of the Echo offers an insight into the future─she sees the Resistance cornering Misija, who is unable to wield the power of Save the Queen. Mikoto would waste no time in relaying this news to the Resistance.
TEXT_LUCKSA201_04025_SEQ_05: Mikoto is convinced the apparition Misija has used to drive back Resistance forces is born of the memories of the late Queen Gunnhildr. She goes on to explain the fabled blade Save the Queen was likely designed to function in a similar fashion to the auracite you encountered in Rabanastre. Assuming this is true, Misija's plans cannot come to fruition without a substantial cache of crystals, meaning there may yet be time for the Resistance to strike back.
TEXT_LUCKSA202_04026_SEQ_00: Bajsaljen would waste no time in dealing with Misija.
TEXT_LUCKSA202_04026_SEQ_01: Mikoto is convinced that Misija has exhausted the power of Save the Queen, and her vision of the near future suggests both Misija and Save the Queen can be taken into custody without bloodshed. Marsak readies their soldiers and sets out for ruins on the eastern edge of the southern front in the hopes of catching Misija unawares.
TEXT_LUCKSA202_04026_SEQ_02: Events play out exactly as Mikoto foresaw. The Resistance manages to corner Misija who is unable to summon Queen Gunnhildr to battle. What Mikoto failed to see, however, is that this was all according to Misija's plan, for she too can now peer into the future. Imperial enforcements soon arrive, and a terrible battle ensues there in the ruins.
TEXT_LUCKSA202_04026_SEQ_03: No sooner do you bring low Misija's imperial soldiers than more arrive to take their place. But your battle was only meant to stall for time, as they manage to open a door leading deeper into the ruins, prompting Misija and Gunnhildr's Blades to escape into the shadows. You follow her into the heart of Delubrum Reginae, where you hope to put an end to her schemes and retrieve Save the Queen.
TEXT_LUCKSA202_04026_SEQ_04: Deep within the heart of the ruins, Misija at last finds what she was searching for─a massive crystal rife with the aether needed to summon the full might of Save the Queen. Yet for all its power, the ancient blade proves no match for you. With the day won at last, you take the now-dormant Bozjan relic and an unconscious Misija back to Gangos.
TEXT_LUCKSA202_04026_SEQ_05: Misija has been placed in solitary confinement awaiting trial, and Bajsaljen believes it best if Save the Queen remain in Mikoto's care for the time being. But there will be no reprieve to study its inner workings, for an imperial warship can be seen approaching in the distance. Bajsaljen orders everyone to withdraw to Gangos and prepare to make a stand.
TEXT_LUCKSA202_04026_SEQ_06: When the Resistance next steps onto the battlefield, they will be joined by their allies from the Far East. Considering all that is at stake, there is no question that your strength will be needed when that day comes.
TEXT_LUCKSA212_04028_SEQ_00: Annes seeks relics of a particular sort, and she suspects you may know where to find them.
TEXT_LUCKSA213_04029_SEQ_00: Kriv believes he knows a way to increase your arsenal of lost actions.
TEXT_LUCKSA250_04037_SEQ_00: Recent events on the southern front have Gerolt feeling inspired.
TEXT_LUCKSA250_04037_SEQ_01: The Resistance has graciously allowed Gerolt to examine Save the Queen. Impressed by its craftsmanship and capacity for memories, he has been inspired to incorporate what he learned from the holy blade into the Resistance weapons. The process will require a great deal more memories, however, and for that he would ask you to consult with Zlatan.
TEXT_LUCKSA250_04037_SEQ_02: Zlatan would discuss the matter of gathering more memories after you are duly prepared. Though he has yet to elaborate on what manner of memories may be required, you suspect a trying experience yet awaits you.
TEXT_LUCKSA251_04038_SEQ_00:
Zlatan is ready to see you on your way.
※Changing classes or jobs will prevent progress during this quest.
TEXT_LUCKSA251_04038_SEQ_01:
You consult Zlatan about what manner of memory would be ideal to further enhance your Resistance weapon, and he suggests those that come from battles of great peril, such as one might expect in a large-scale assault. He is confident fifteen such memories will suffice. Where they should be collected, however, he leaves to your judgment.

※You may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
※Loathsome memories of the dying can be obtained by participating in critical engagements on the southern front, or by completing Crystal Tower alliance raids.
TEXT_LUCKSA251_04038_SEQ_02: Gerolt has readied his forge for your return, and he is quick to begin working when you hand him the memories. With his customary flourishes of clanging and banging, your Resistance weapon is given new form, the energies emanating from it nearly palpable. Though he is quite satisfied with his work, he believes there is yet room for improvement. It is his hope inspiration will strike again before you next call on his services.
TEXT_LUCKSA252_04039_SEQ_00: Judging by his furrowed brow, Gerolt's plans to further improve your Resistance weapon may at last be taking shape.
TEXT_LUCKSA252_04039_SEQ_01:
On the surface, Gerolt's plan is seemingly simple─a more selective use of crystallized memories to better align with your preferred style of combat. However, the means to analyze the aetherial properties of these memories yet eludes him. Enter Regana, accompanied by an Allagan node commissioned from Garlond Ironworks designed to do precisely that. Though daunted by the potential ramifications of accepting further help─financial or otherwise─Zlatan can see no other way to proceed with Gerolt's plan. As Regana explains, the node will use gathered memories to create a registry with which you can modify the Resistance weapon as you see fit. Hoping for an adequate sample size, Gerolt suggests searching for two types of memories, eighteen of each.

※Memories of the dying can be found from certain FATEs and alliance raids.
※Haunting memories of the dying can be found from FATEs in the Gyr Abania region, or the Shadow of Mhach alliance raids.
※Vexatious memories of the dying can be found from FATEs in the Far East region, or the Return to Ivalice alliance raids.
TEXT_LUCKSA252_04039_SEQ_02: You return to Gangos with an ample supply of memories for the node, which wastes no time in analyzing and allocating them. When you offer up your Resistance weapon, however, it warns of aetheric instability, and the near-certain corruption of your weapon should you proceed. Zlatan believes the solution to this problem lies in the crystal foci, which used a sealant of heated aetherial siltstone to ensure its stability. Regana notes there was a time when pottery made from this stone could be found in all corners of the realm, suggesting the ruins of Bozja may not be the only place where they can be found. Of course, there is only one among you capable of scouring such dark depths.
TEXT_LUCKSA253_04040_SEQ_00:
Zlatan is ready to see you on your way once more.
※Changing classes or jobs will prevent progress during this quest.
TEXT_LUCKSA253_04040_SEQ_01:
While relieved to know the Bozjan ruins are not the only place where antiquities made of aetherial siltstone may be found, Zlatan is no less discomfited knowing the arduous task of procuring them must fall to you. Gerolt is confident that fifteen relics should suffice for your plans, and so you set out in search of dark, perilous ruins, hoping his guess is on the mark.

※You may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
※Timeworn artifacts can be obtained by completing the raid Delubrum Reginae, or the deep dungeon Palace of the Dead.
TEXT_LUCKSA253_04040_SEQ_02: You return to Gangos with a hard-earned assortment of artifacts. Loaded into the Allagan node, along with the Resistance weapon, the refinement process thereafter is surprisingly painless. Almost suspiciously so. Zlatan and Gerolt then discuss the feasibility of repeating the refinement process, prompting an equally suspicious recording from the Allagan node, extolling wares from the House of Splendors that would save you the trouble of finding more artifacts, albeit at a price. Zlatan would not forbid you from purchasing from the House of Splendors, but he is understandably keen to avoid any unnecessary dealings with the notoriously unscrupulous Rowena.
TEXT_SUBCTS827_04057_SEQ_00: The warmachina fanatic appears to burn with unsatisfied curiosity.
TEXT_SUBCTS827_04057_SEQ_01: You learn from an Ironworks engineer of the existence of an incredible mechanical dragon. Assuming his hastily attached signal emitter is functioning correctly, the “wyrm-machina” can be found somewhere on the floating mass of Azys Lla.
TEXT_SUBCTS827_04057_SEQ_02: Your search of Azys Lla is interrupted by the familiar figure of the wandering minstrel. In typical extravagant fashion, he regales you with a tale told to him by a fellow traveler─of the legend of Landerwaffe, an ancient masterpiece of Allag which has hunted down through the ages for a suitable master. In light of your command of a multitude of gwibers, the minstrel seems convinced that the mechanical dragon will heed your call. With the instrument of its summoning in hand, you have only to blow a single shrill call from the deck of the Flagship.
TEXT_SUBCTS827_04057_SEQ_03: True to the lore, the call of your flute has indeed been answered by the wondrous and lustrous Landerwaffe. The wandering minstrel is so moved by the sight that he composes a verse on the spot, immortalizing the moment in which machina and master stand poised to begin a whole new chapter of grand adventure. Even fate itself must bend before the mighty partnership of the Shadowmaker and the Dragon Made!
TEXT_SUBCTS660_04079_SEQ_00: Francel is delighted to see two familiar faces in quick succession.
TEXT_SUBCTS661_04080_SEQ_00: Maurilette wishes to teach Charlemend and Maelie the particulars of patient rehabilitation.
TEXT_SUBGSC109_04081_SEQ_00: The Gold Saucer attendant's eyes light up at the sight of you.
TEXT_SUBGSC109_04081_SEQ_01: According to the Gold Saucer attendant, the proprietor of the amusement park wishes to have words with you, and you are instructed to wait for him by the entrance to Card Square.
TEXT_SUBGSC109_04081_SEQ_02: In recognition of the love you bear for Triple Triad as demonstrated in your magnificent card collection, Godbert Manderville awards you a special prize: the magicked card. Thus rewarded for your efforts, you look forward to many more rounds of card-battling fun to come.
TEXT_LUCKSA301_04084_SEQ_00: Marsak has new intelligence on the imperials' whereabouts.
TEXT_LUCKSA301_04084_SEQ_01: Resistance scouts have confirmed the IVth Legion has abandoned Castrum Lacus Litore, and are now consolidating their forces at Zadnor. Despite the presence of the imperial fleet, Bajsaljen intends to confront the enemy, with Camp Vrdelnis as the staging ground.
TEXT_LUCKSA301_04084_SEQ_02: As per Marsak's instructions, you speak with Sjeros, who is to act as your escort to Zadnor.
TEXT_LUCKSA301_04084_SEQ_03: Thanks to the Ironworks' ingenuity and contributions from the Dalmascan resistance, Cid was able to erect a barrier to protect Camp Vrdelnis from aerial assaults. Bajsaljen has a mind to push the front line forward, however, and any outposts established hereafter will also require similar protection. Thankfully, the Ironworks already has a plan of action, which Lilja is eager to explain.
TEXT_LUCKSA301_04084_SEQ_04: The Resistance seeks to secure new outposts closer to the imperials' base of operations, but to do so will require further barriers and a sufficient source of energy to power them. To that end, Cid and Lilja ask you to place devices in the field to redirect the flow of aether towards the proposed outposts.
TEXT_LUCKSA301_04084_SEQ_05: Using the Ironworks' latest creation, the Resistance should be able to obtain all the power they need to maintain a barrier surrounding each outpost, assuming, of course, the devices actually work. You steel yourself for yet another foray into the battlefield, that you may carve the first foothold in enemy territory.
TEXT_LUCKSA302_04085_SEQ_00: The knowing look in Mikoto's eyes suggests it may be time to get to work.
TEXT_LUCKSA303_04086_SEQ_00: Mikoto is ready to send you back out into the field.
TEXT_LUCKSA304_04087_SEQ_00: Bajsaljen's furrowed brow suggests the tide of battle may be turning for the worse.
TEXT_LUCKSA305_04088_SEQ_00: The look of steely resolve in Bajsaljen's eyes suggests the hour of battle draws nigh.
TEXT_LUCKSA305_04088_SEQ_01: The Resistance stands ready to march against the IVth Legion in the hopes of distracting them long enough for Cid to carry out his plan. If all goes well, the Dalriada will be disabled, perhaps giving Bajsaljen and his troops the edge needed to rout the imperials once and for all.
TEXT_LUCKSA305_04088_SEQ_02: Lilja has finished work on the D.A.M., and has even found the ideal location at which to set it. However, a number of final adjustments have to be made on-site, meaning that she must accompany you out onto the battlefield.
TEXT_LUCKSA305_04088_SEQ_03: While seeking a suitable spot to set the D.A.M., you are assaulted by a small unit of IVth Legion soldiers. They prove no match for your martial prowess, and it is not long before you and Lilja resume preparing the D.A.M.
TEXT_LUCKSA305_04088_SEQ_04: With the D.A.M. in place, the Resistance is ready to set their plan in motion. What they were not expecting, however, was for the Dalriada to roar to life. Undeterred by the not-so-small setback of the imperial warship entering the fray, Cid succeeds in activating the aetherwave amplifier, and the Dalriada is forced to make an emergency landing. The sight of this emboldens the Resistance, and so they prepare to press forward.
TEXT_LUCKSA305_04088_SEQ_05:
The Dalriada has been rendered inoperable, but it remains to be seen what armaments yet remain within. Even so, there may never come a finer opportunity for the Resistance to strike, and Bajsaljen intends to seize it. He asks that you accompany his troops into the warship, and at last put an end to the IVth Legion's schemes to control Bozja.

※Players may enter the Dalriada via the associated critical engagement.
TEXT_LUCKSA305_04088_SEQ_06: With Lyon and Menenius defeated, the IVth Legion's plans appear to have fallen to ruin. There is no time to revel in your victory, however, for the Allagan weapon, which lay dormant in the ship, breaks free from its confines. It takes to the sky and begins amassing energy to release in an attack of cataclysmic proportions. Before delivering its fatal blow to the people of Bozja, however, Queen Gunnhildr appears, her holy blade in hand. The two entities clash overhead, the ensuing explosion claiming both the Allagan weapon and the queen.
TEXT_LUCKSA305_04088_SEQ_07: The threat of the IVth Legion and their Allagan weapon is no more. You thought to speak with Bajsaljen, but Marsak informs you he has already returned to Gangos. After your many travails together, the Resistance leader would no doubt welcome you to reflect on this historic victory.
TEXT_LUCKSA305_04088_SEQ_08: You expect to find Bajsaljen in the midst of merrymaking, but instead he is already hard at work setting the foundation for a new Bozja. The myriad factions that comprised the Resistance originally came together out of necessity, but if all goes to plan, the dream of a united Bozja may very well soon become a reality.
TEXT_LUCKSA305_04088_SEQ_09: The fight for freedom is won, and now work to rebuild may begin in earnest. Only time will tell what manner of nation Bozja will become, but you have every confidence it will prove a beacon of peace and prosperity to which others will aspire.
TEXT_LUCKSA311_04092_SEQ_00: Dmitar has glad tidings to share from the battlefield.
TEXT_LUCKSA312_04093_SEQ_00: The Resistance has secured yet another outpost, and Dmitar would guide you there.
TEXT_LUCKSA322_04095_SEQ_00: Merlzirn is in need of an adventurer not afraid to go digging behind enemy lines.
TEXT_LUCKSA350_04096_SEQ_00: Gerolt would test his forge in ways the ancient Bozjans only dreamed of.
TEXT_LUCKSA350_04096_SEQ_01: According to Zlatan, one of the surviving members of Gunnhildr's Blades recently discovered on the battlefield a new variety of crystal that contains not memories, but raw emotions. Gerolt suspects that, with a little effort, these fascinating specimens can be used to reforge the Resistance weapons into the pinnacle of martial perfection.
TEXT_LUCKSA350_04096_SEQ_02: Regana has agreed to call upon her colleagues in the House of Splendors, and will be instructing them to deliver the necessary materials to Gangos. As one would expect of dealings with the much-maligned organization, this service will come at a cost, however, and it falls to you to procure the goods they request as payment─whatever they may be.
TEXT_LUCKSA351_04097_SEQ_00: Zlatan has learned what the House of Splendors seeks in exchange for a reagent.
TEXT_LUCKSA351_04097_SEQ_01:
As Zlatan explains, the House of Splendors has reached an agreement with goblin metalworkers in Idyllshire to supply the Resistance with the reagent needed to refine your weapon. In exchange, you have been asked to provide two varieties of mechanical parts─compact axles and springs, thirty of each.

※Mechanical parts can be obtained by participating in skirmishes and critical engagements in Zadnor, as well as any of the normal Alexander 8-man raids. The Unrestricted Party option cannot be enabled when clearing the aforementioned duties.
TEXT_LUCKSA351_04097_SEQ_02: You return with an assortment of mechanical parts, and after verifying everything is accounted for, Regana's colleague, Seika, hands over the reagent. With the transaction concluded, she takes her leave, but not before proposing an extended contract for additional shipments of reagent. Gerolt promptly refuses, but Seika appears unperturbed by the rejection. This reaction leaves Zlatan wondering if there was more to her proposal than meets the eye.
TEXT_LUCKSA352_04098_SEQ_00: The House of Splendors is prepared to deliver a shipment of metal alloy, provided that you fulfill your side of the bargain.
TEXT_LUCKSA352_04098_SEQ_01:
In exchange for the metal alloy, the House of Splendors has asked for two sets of freshly penned memoirs. They went on to say these tales of heated battle should be based on encounters in Bozja or, failing that, those of an otherworldly nature. There is a pained look in Zlatan's eyes as he tells you they have asked for thirty volumes of each. And so he bids you safe travels as you set off to the battlefield in search of inspiration for your writings.

※Memoirs can be obtained by participating in skirmishes and critical engagements in Zadnor, as well as any of the normal Omega 8-man raids. The Unrestricted Party option cannot be enabled when clearing the aforementioned duties.
TEXT_LUCKSA352_04098_SEQ_02: You return with the requested memoirs, an arduous labor of blood, sweat, and ink. Regana's associates are thrilled to have completed the transaction, but apparently more so to meet Gerolt. They shower him with compliments, followed by a proposal for a wholesale contract for additional shipments of metal alloy. You quickly interject before he has the chance to accept, prompting the attendants to take their leave. Though no new contracts were signed, you are one step closer to a more powerful Resistance weapon.
TEXT_LUCKSA353_04099_SEQ_00: The House of Splendors has devised a way to bind the power of emotion to weapons, which it is willing to share for a price.
TEXT_LUCKSA353_04099_SEQ_01:
Based on the techniques used to create materia, the House of Splendors has devised an incantation that can commit the energies of emotion to the Resistance weapon. For ease of use─or perhaps ease of profit─the spell has been penned to magicked scrolls, and the House has asked you supply them with memories of the dying in exchange. Zlatan forgoes explanations of the crystallized memories and tells you only that two varieties of memory are required, thirty of each.

※Memories of the dying can be obtained by participating in skirmishes and critical engagements in Zadnor, as well as any of the normal Eden 8-man raids. The Unrestricted Party option cannot be enabled when clearing the aforementioned duties.
TEXT_LUCKSA353_04099_SEQ_02: You return to Gangos, memories of the dying in hand. The transaction is carried out as arranged, but before Regana's associate leaves, she takes a moment to offer Gerolt an additional contract for larger shipments of magicked scrolls. Much to Zlatan's surprise, the attendant is strangely composed when the offer is rejected. As she turns to leave, you find yourself another step closer to refining your Resistance weapon.
TEXT_LUCKSA354_04100_SEQ_00: With Regana's attendants gone, Gerolt is excited to finally fire up the forge.
TEXT_LUCKSA354_04100_SEQ_01: Gerolt can hardly contain himself now that your dealings with the House of Splendors are complete. Meanwhile, Regana continues to act suspiciously as she leaves to handle heretofore unknown business. Zlatan intends to find out what she is up to while you see to the final step in Gerolt's plan.
TEXT_LUCKSA354_04100_SEQ_02: The final and most vital ingredient needed to refine your Resistance weapon is the aetherial energy of raw emotions. With sightings of crystals bearing this energy on the battlefield, Zlatan asks that you make ready to go out and search for them.
TEXT_LUCKSA355_04101_SEQ_00:
Before the finishing touches can be added to the Resistance weapon, Zlatan has one last task for you.
※Changing classes or jobs will prevent progress during this quest.
TEXT_LUCKSA355_04101_SEQ_01:
As Zlatan explains it, the raw emotions you seek were first discovered at the site of intense battles where emotions ran high. He asks that you seek out equally fierce confrontations to find fifteen crystals of raw emotion.

※You may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.
※Raw emotions can be obtained by completing the raids Delubrum Reginae or the Dalriada in Zadnor, any level 70 dungeon, or the deep dungeon Heaven-on-High.
TEXT_LUCKSA355_04101_SEQ_02:
You return to Gangos with the required raw emotions, and it is not long before the familiar clangor of Gerolt's hammer and the whirring of the Allagan node fills the air. Before long, the work is completed, and you find yourself the proud owner of a weapon the ancient Bozjans could only dream of, possessed of a strength that may very well rival that of Save the Queen. Zlatan wastes no time relaying the good news to Bajsaljen.

Interrupting the jubilant mood, Regana brings up the matter of their contract, claiming Rowena has doubled the asking price for the materials used in the forging of such weapons. To everyone's surprise, Rowena herself appears unexpectedly to refute those selfsame claims and thereby uncover Regana's extortion scheme. Her plans exposed, Regana fully expects her employment to be terminated, but Zlatan insists she stays on to fulfill the contract between the Resistance and the House of Splendors. Rowena consents to his request, and all present, save perhaps Gerolt, are pleased to see that their work will be allowed to continue.

Your work to perfect the Resistance weapon has enheartened Bajsaljen, for now the people of Bozja will at last have a shining beacon of hope under which they might rally.
TEXT_AKTKYX101_04167_SEQ_00: This panic-stricken Loporrit is desperate for the aid of an able-bodied adventurer.
TEXT_AKTKYX101_04167_SEQ_01: There is an emergency on the moon, and despite lacking any specific details of the situation, the panic-stricken Loporrit is beside himself. He only knows that Buildingway is searching for you, and asks that you head to Mare Lamentorum posthaste.
TEXT_AKTKYX101_04167_SEQ_02:
According to Buildingway, their automated construction machine─the Big Cheese─has gone out of control, burrowing into the moon causing untold havoc. The survey team sent to investigate has yet to return, and now Buildingway would ask you to force your way inside and assess the situation. You need only make your way to Smileton, and he will see to it you have clearance to enter.

※Smileton can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_AKTKYX101_04167_SEQ_03: The path through Smileton is treacherous, thanks in no small part to the Loporrits' security system. Nevertheless you press on, and at the center of it all you find the Big Cheese. After a thunderous battle, the great machine falls silent. Buildingway will be heartened to know the threat is over.
TEXT_AKTKYX101_04167_SEQ_04: You report back to Buildingway and the look of relief on his face speaks volumes. He is disappointed to see his plans go awry, but without the threat of the Final Days and impending doom, he has time to begin anew. This time, he affirms, he will take his time, and make certain to avoid any more abrupt changes of heart.
TEXT_AKTKYX201_04168_SEQ_00: Jammingway is in need of your brains and brawn─mostly the latter.
TEXT_AKTKYX201_04168_SEQ_01: Relieved to see a peerless adventurer such as yourself, Jammingway explains that the reconnaissance automaton they dispatched to Ultima Thule has recently sent a most troubling distress signal. He bids you join him at Thaumazein that, together, you might investigate the matter further.
TEXT_AKTKYX201_04168_SEQ_02: Your Loporrit companion explains that─for reasons somewhat difficult to wrap the mind around─the Ragnarok is capable of transporting you to Ultima Thule even without your fueling the aetherburner. A parting gift from Venat, mayhap, or Meteion.
TEXT_AKTKYX201_04168_SEQ_03: Due to─or perhaps in spite of─your ship existing in two places at once, you instantly travel to Ultima Thule without becoming a fine particle mist. The also-intact Jammingway explains that their automaton sent its last transmission from Base Omicron, and requests you follow them there.
TEXT_AKTKYX201_04168_SEQ_04: At Base Omicron, you meet the military information and operations Omicron N-7000. It relays a troubling series of events that have led to the reawakening of Stigma-4, a militaristic matrix that now threatens to annihilate your planet. As destroying Stigma-4 would have catastrophic consequences for the Omicrons of Ultima Thule, you settle on an alternate solution─adding the distinct impression of defeat to the war cache in Stigma-4's memory banks so that the matrix might reconsider its optimal course of action.
TEXT_AKTKYX201_04168_SEQ_05:
N-7000 has opened an access pathway to Stigma-4's memory systems in the form of a virtual environment. Enter the matrix's subconscious and do what you must to defy its aggressive protocols.

※The Stigma Dreamscape can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_AKTKYX201_04168_SEQ_06: Your mission appears to have been a resounding success, as you have “destroyed” Stigma-4's virtual core. N-7000 should be able to discern whether this was indeed enough to force the matrix onto a more peaceful path.
TEXT_AKTKYX201_04168_SEQ_07: Convinced that its attempt at conquest would end in failure, Stigma-4 ceases its military campaign and is put to work on diplomatic holograms instead. N-7000, however, finds itself without purpose now that peace is here to stay. To prevent it entering eternal sleep mode, Jammingway proposes opening a café as a way to find meaning in life and help others do the same.
TEXT_AKTKYX201_04168_SEQ_08: You visit the nekropolis, where an old venue stands ready to become the new café. Here, as Jammingway tells it, they and N-7000 will endeavor to pass on the knowledge of lost civilizations, and inspire hope in those that have fallen to despair. What future awaits them and the countless travelers that will doubtless visit in the years to come?
TEXT_AKTKYR103_04172_SEQ_00: Gondelimbaud appears to be waiting for you.
TEXT_AKTKYR103_04172_SEQ_01: Gondelimbaud informs you that a residential district has been established in Ishgard, and that Thomelin will guide you there from the Brume.

TEXT_AKTKZJ012_04348_SEQ_01:
Sehth Toskh asks that you speak with several dragons who regret to this day that they were not able to join Midgardsormr in his escape, that they might take some comfort in your tales of faraway places.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZJ012_04348_SEQ_02: You speak with two wyrms in Reah Tahra, though the solace they find in your words is somewhat limited by their abiding doldrums. Sehth Toskh has indicated that one more dragon that would benefit from your insight awaits to the southeast...
TEXT_AKTKZJ012_04348_SEQ_03: You journey toward the vitrified fort only to discover a similarly vitrified dragon, who Sehth Toskh introduces as an old friend who once wished to join Midgardsormr in his journey to a new star. Beleaguered by conquerors from the Alphatron Star as they were, none who would have followed the great wyrm were able to do so, and the life of the dragon before you was tragically cut short─however, Sehth Toskh clearly believes that there is some comfort to be found in the knowledge that their faith was well placed.
TEXT_AKTKZJ012_04348_SEQ_04: Having returned to the marginally less depressing Reah Tahra, Sehth Toskh thanks you for the bit of peace you have brought him by sharing your tidings of Midgardsormr. However grim the history of those in Ultima Thule remains, you too can take comfort in knowing that you have raised at least one dragon's sunken spirits this day.
TEXT_AKTKZJ013_04349_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
The old wyrm is displeased at the state of the spring.
TEXT_AKTKZJ013_04349_SEQ_01:
The old wyrm tells you of his wish to restore the spring at the center of Reah Tahra to its former potable glory. As the dragons apparently have a rather unusual means of cleansing their water supplies, you are summarily tasked with finding a dragon who yet retains a loud voice to roar at it.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZJ013_04349_SEQ_02:
Some small distance from Reah Tahra, you find a bloodthirsty dragon, who you manage to goad into accompanying you back to the spring. As the dragon is unwilling to wait for your tiny legs to carry you there, however, you must take the risk of approaching...

※Speak to the bloodthirsty dragon in Ostrakon Deka-okto to mount.
TEXT_AKTKZJ013_04349_SEQ_03:
The dragon roars by the spring to little apparent effect, but is willing to make one more attempt in the name of impressing upon you how fruitless your efforts are.

※Speak to the bloodthirsty dragon in Ostrakon Deka-okto to mount.
TEXT_AKTKZJ013_04349_SEQ_04: Though there is no perceivable difference in the spring's appearance upon exposure to a second roar, the old wyrm remarks that it tastes slightly better than it did. TEXT_AKTKZA204_04492_SEQ_03: You follow the young pickpocket to his clandestine meeting with a full-grown criminal associate. Your sudden appearance startles them into sudden flight to the west, in the very direction where Ogul should be lying in wait...
TEXT_AKTKZA204_04492_SEQ_04: You arrive at the scene of the ambush, only to find that Ogul has already rendered the Arkasodara man unconscious. Ogul asks that you return to Yedlihmad and convey your success to Kancana while she delivers the lowlife to the Radiant Host.
TEXT_AKTKZA204_04492_SEQ_05: Ogul walks in as you complete your report, and assures Kancana that her stolen belongings will soon be returned. Having allowed the remorseful pickpocket to keep her money, however, the generous Au Ra's coinpurse is empty once more─a fact which seems to bother her little. Thanks to your support, Ogul claims to have conquered her fear of the Arkasodara, and feels no great urgency to leave Thavnair while there are still so many wonders to explore...
TEXT_AKTKZF101_04493_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Yezahn is mumbling to himself indistinctly.
TEXT_AKTKZF101_04493_SEQ_01:
You catch the attention of a distracted man who introduces himself as Yezahn, and he quickly recognizes you as the one who saved Mehvan and Qerasaf's daughter. He informs you that her recovery is proceeding apace, but worries about where she will go after fully healed. The alchemist has taken it upon himself to find a potential parent, and enlists your aid in questioning the people of Palaka's Stand to see if any have room for one more in their heart.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZF101_04493_SEQ_02: You have spoken to the locals and gathered a variety of opinions on the matter of the child's future caregiver. Yezahn is doubtless eager to hear what you have learned.
TEXT_AKTKZF101_04493_SEQ_03: While quick to dismiss himself as a potential candidate, Yezahn gives a moment's consideration upon the mention of Pasareen. Although he seems hesitant to ask her to take on such an enormous responsibility, he admits she is the best option at present. He resolves to at least speak with her, asking you to be a reassuring presence by his side.
TEXT_AKTKZF101_04493_SEQ_04: You find Pasareen doting over her own child, and she greets Yezahn with a smile. The smile soon vanishes, however, after Yezahn makes his request. She gives a vague denial, but Yezahn does not press further. He takes his leave of Pasareen, asking you to meet him at his workshop to discuss this development further.
TEXT_AKTKZF101_04493_SEQ_05: Yezahn seems troubled by Pasareen's words and decides that he cannot stand idly by while his friend is in distress. In the meantime, he will also ponder the question of who will raise the child. He asks that you help him once more, both for the child's sake and the sake of a distraught mother.
TEXT_AKTKZF102_04494_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Yezahn requires a capable green thumb to assist him.
TEXT_AKTKZF102_04494_SEQ_01:
Yezahn is ready to put you to work right away, enlisting your aid to gather herbs for the treatment of both the wounded villagers and the sick child. He informs you that they grow to the northeast, and bids you follow him to their location. 

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZF102_04494_SEQ_02: After a thorough search and an encounter with the local fauna, you manage to find some sprigs of soma. Find Yezahn to see if he has had similar success.
TEXT_AKTKZF102_04494_SEQ_03: It seems Yezahn was not so lucky as you were, although he was spared from having to fight for his life. Satisfied with his supply for now, he returns to the settlement, and asks you to follow him.
TEXT_AKTKZF102_04494_SEQ_04: In excited tones, Yezahn explains that he returned to his workshop to find a sack full of herbs. The alchemist guesses that it was the work of an Arkasodara named Sula, who was not-so-discreetly eavesdropping on your previous conversation with Pasareen. Yezahn asks you to speak with the steward, both to offer your thanks and to find out what she may know.
TEXT_AKTKZF102_04494_SEQ_05: Sula feigns ignorance until you mention Pasareen, after which she suggests that you all speak together about the matter. She asks you to return to Yezahn, where she will join you after gathering her thoughts.
TEXT_AKTKZF102_04494_SEQ_06: Sula arrives at Yezahn's quarters soon after you, clearly anxious. The Arkasodara reveals that Pasareen's beloved husband was killed by her own sister, Chapa, after he had transformed into a beast and attacked the village. Sula then blamed Pasareen for the incident─an action which she has since come to regret deeply. While Sula seems eager to mend their friendship, she requires a moment to gather her courage. Several moments, in fact.
TEXT_AKTKZF103_04495_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Sula looks eager to leave Palaka's Stand, but to where is not clear.
TEXT_AKTKZF103_04495_SEQ_01:
Sula's mood has lightened somewhat, but it appears she still needs some time to steel her resolve. She asks you to accompany her on a patrol of the temples dotting the region, a task which she hopes will help calm her. With a little bit of urging from Yezahn, you agree to accompany the guardian to Purusa.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZF103_04495_SEQ_02: You make the long trek to Purusa and Sula gives you a brief history of the place before quickly moving her mind to her duty. While this area seems to be in good repair, Sula will not be satisfied until a thorough search is conducted.
TEXT_AKTKZF103_04495_SEQ_03: Sula appears to be concerned by the scratches and other damage in this area of the temple. She suggests splitting up and searching for further signs of disrepair.
TEXT_AKTKZF103_04495_SEQ_04: You have searched the temple and found several spots that beg for maintenance. Return to Sula and report your findings.
TEXT_AKTKZF103_04495_SEQ_05: Although your words trouble Sula at first, she seems to be reinvigorated by the work. Her spirits properly steeled, she resolves to make her apology. However, she not-so-subtly hints that having you by her side would be preferable to speaking with Pasareen alone.
TEXT_AKTKZF103_04495_SEQ_06: Sula musters her courage and finally apologizes to Pasareen, but it seems the woman has already forgiven the Arkasodara, instead blaming herself for her husband's transformation and Chapa's death. Pasareen asks for more time to cope with recent events and takes her leave. Now that Sula has said her apology, she is determined to help her friend during their time of need.
TEXT_AKTKZF104_04496_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Yezahn has one final request to make of you.
TEXT_AKTKZF104_04496_SEQ_01:
Sula is determined to do what she can to see the burden of guilt lifted from Pasareen's shoulders. To that end, she proposes looking for a memento to remind Pasareen of Dazahl and help her accept his loss. Sula suggests retracing the path the villagers fled down while searching for anything that might have been left behind.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZF104_04496_SEQ_02: After searching the woods thoroughly, you chance upon a jewel that looks as if it was once set in something. This may be what you were searching for, and Sula may know more about it.
TEXT_AKTKZF104_04496_SEQ_03: Sula has found an ornate necklace into which the jewel you found fits perfectly. However, there are still some repairs required before you can return it to Pasareen. Sula suggests asking Yezahn for help before turning back toward the village.
TEXT_AKTKZF104_04496_SEQ_04: Yezahn informs you that Sula has left to find materials to polish the necklace. Yezahn will craft some adhesive to affix the jewel to its rightful position, and the alchemist asks you to find Pasareen and instruct her to await their arrival.
TEXT_AKTKZF104_04496_SEQ_05: No sooner do you greet Pasareen than does Yezahn and Sula arrive, bearing a necklace gleaming as brightly as the day it was forged. Pasareen is moved by the gesture, and proposes that Yezahn take in the child of Mehvan. She will offer her assistance, first as a wet nurse and then as anything else as the child grows. Yezahn agrees, and Sula adds that she will hunt and bring the hardiest animals as food. With everyone at a happy agreement, they each go their separate ways, and Yezahn asks you to visit him at his quarters when you can.
TEXT_AKTKZF104_04496_SEQ_06: While Yezahn knows that there is hard work in his future, he is glad that the people around him are beginning to heal. He resolves to do his level best for their sake, and hopes that together all in Palaka's Stand can arrive at the other side of this tragedy stronger than they were before.
TEXT_AKTKZF201_04497_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Yezahn has yet another favor to ask of the only adventurer he knows.
TEXT_AKTKZF201_04497_SEQ_01:
The troubles facing Palaka's Stand continue to mount, the most pressing of them being the lack of supplies and able bodies. Yezahn asks you if you know anyone who could help, and you mention Kancana and Ogul, who reside in Yedlihmad. Yezahn seems eager to make their acquaintance, and leaves it to you to enlist their aid.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZF201_04497_SEQ_02: Kancana listens with growling concern as you explain the purpose of your visit. She agrees to help Palaka's Stand without question, and promises to have a shipment of supplies ready posthaste. Ogul offers to protect the shipment, and rushes off to the gates of Yedlihmad with Racashir hot on her heels.
TEXT_AKTKZF201_04497_SEQ_03: Ogul and Racashir are ready to depart, with the former carrying the supplies on her back. Keep an eye out for hungry monsters and daring bandits as you make the long journey to Palaka's Stand.
TEXT_AKTKZF201_04497_SEQ_04: You rescue Ogul and Racashir from the maws of a hungry beast. They do not appear to be unharmed, but Racashir is staring at you with an awed expression.
TEXT_AKTKZF201_04497_SEQ_05: Racashir is impressed with your display, and while Ogul is thankful for your help, she is eager to commence the adventure. She rushes off with a boisterous challenge, leaving the supplies behind. Luckily, Racashir remains to pick up the slack.
TEXT_AKTKZF201_04497_SEQ_06: You arrive to find a monster slain, with Ogul and Sula standing over it triumphantly. Sula is pleased to see you, and it seems that in Ogul she has found a fierce fighting companion. She offers to escort you to Palaka's Stand, where it seems Yezahn is awaiting your arrival.
TEXT_AKTKZF201_04497_SEQ_07: Yezahn is grateful for the arrival of supplies and protection both, and Ogul seems to have found her next adventure. She presents Yezahn with a journal she found during the journey, which the alchemist reveals belonged to Mehvan and Qerasaf. This unexpected discovery is welcomed, and it seems that there is hope for Palaka's Stand at last.
TEXT_AKTKZF201_04497_SEQ_08: Ogul resolves to help the people of Palaka's Stand rebuild, and is eager to resume Racashir's instruction in the fine art of adventuring. The sun shines bright on Palaka's Stand, and the tenseness in Yezahn's shoulders seems to have dissipated entirely.
TEXT_AKTKZF201_04497_SEQ_09: With the pressing crisis facing Palaka's Stand solved, Yezahn basks in the first moments of comfort he has had in some time. The reverie is short-lived, however, as he quickly turns to what must be done in the days ahead. With his help, and the help of the settlement's new arrivals, wounds will heal and the citizens of Palaka's Stand will come to know peace once more.
TEXT_AKTKZC101_04498_SEQ_00:

Rimelnaud would like your opinion on something.
TEXT_AKTKZC101_04498_SEQ_01:
You are approached by Rimelnaud, who wants you to accompany him when he goes to negotiate with an engineer from Tapper's Den. The man in question─Appius─is keen to restart Juturna Platform G, but Rimelnaud doubts his motives on account of his Garlean heritage.

Thus, the Garlean engineer suggests he inspect some of the camp's ceruleum engines that may be in need of repair to prove he can be trusted. At his urging, you agree to accompany him to make sure that he doesn't get up to any antics.
TEXT_AKTKZC101_04498_SEQ_03:
Upon further discussion with Appius, it is agreed that you will be the one to actually inspect the ceruleum engines, lest something break and he be blamed for it. Regardless of how you feel about taking the blame in his stead should that occur, you must concede that it would be better should a Garlean not incur the ire of the contingent by accident.

TEXT_AKTKZC101_04498_SEQ_04: With Appius's guidance, you inspect three ceruleum engines. Rimelnaud will doubtless be curious as to how it went.
TEXT_AKTKZC101_04498_SEQ_05: Appius explains that the engines are no longer running efficiently, to the degree that they will inevitably break down. At this, Rimelnaud relents and agrees to allow the engineer to repair the engines. Continue to lend a helping hand if you wish to improve life in the camp.
TEXT_AKTKZC102_04499_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Rimelnaud perhaps requires some thawing.
TEXT_AKTKZC102_04499_SEQ_01:
Upon significant prompting from Rimelnaud, Appius mentions that a replacement carburetor will be required to fix one of the camp's ceruleum engines. You agree to head to Monitoring Station G in order to extract one from an engine there.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZC102_04499_SEQ_02: You search ceruleum engine innards as instructed, and come up with what is, as far as you can tell, an intact carburetor.
TEXT_AKTKZC102_04499_SEQ_03: Appius wastes no time in repairing the ceruleum engines, and it soon transpires that he is originally from the area currently occupied by the camp. He explains that his motivation for reactivating the platform is to make returning to the area a viable proposition for those who once inhabited it, and is naturally delighted when Rimelnaud promises to broach the topic with his superior.
TEXT_AKTKZC103_04500_SEQ_00:

Rimelnaud is now surprisingly keen to get the platform up and running.

Rimelnaud bids you join him in going to tell Esdelot, the quartermaster, about the plan to reactivate Juturna Platform G. You agree in the hope of finally realizing Appius's goal to restore some warmth to his homeland.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZC103_04500_SEQ_02: Esdelot indicates that the contingent will only aid in the restoration of the platform if you first confirm that to do so is possible under the current conditions. TEXT_AKTKZC104_04501_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync

TEXT_AKTKZC104_04501_SEQ_01:
Rimelnaud proposes that to circumvent the issue of needing an identification key, he and Appius reconfigure the rig's control mechanisms to operate without one. Meanwhile, you are tasked with slaying any particularly fearsome creatures in the vicinity, that the engineers not be accosted.

TEXT_AKTKZC104_04501_SEQ_04: With the rig now confirmed operational, Rimelnaud suggests the three of you head back to camp to inform Esdelot of your roaring success.
TEXT_AKTKZC104_04501_SEQ_05: Esdelot is delighted to hear of your achievements, and extends his gratitude for all you have done, as do the others. TEXT_AKTKZD101_04502_SEQ_00:

Volusus will not be moved.

TEXT_AKTKZD102_04503_SEQ_05: Volusus is thrilled to discover there is a good chance his mother Vipsania is still alive. Though this is a step in the right direction, there is much to be done before the family is reunited.

TEXT_AKTKZD104_04505_SEQ_05: Volusus and Vipsania are at long last reunited, bringing a rare moment of joy to the imperial encampment. Inspired by these jubilant scenes, Galla is reminded of why she first dedicated her life to helping the commonfolk. She urges Vipsania to rest in Tertium until suitably recovered to travel to Camp Broken Glass, a far safer environment for the mother and her young son.
TEXT_AKTKZD201_04506_SEQ_00:

Vipsania is worried for her beloved.
TEXT_AKTKZD201_04506_SEQ_01:
Having successfully reunited Volusus with his mother, you turn your attention to locating his missing father. According to Vipsania, he is none other than the chief of Juturna Platform G, and colleague of Appius the engineer. TEXT_AKTKZD201_04506_SEQ_03: After arriving at the Enceladeum, Galla asks you to search within the perimeter walls for Frontinus, while she and Rimelnaud try the nearby buildings. With deadly magitek patrolling the vicinity, you would do well to avoid detection.
TEXT_AKTKZD201_04506_SEQ_04: During your search, you hear a scream in the distance. Fearing the worst, you race off in the direction of the commotion, prepared to take down any drones that might bar your way.
TEXT_AKTKZD201_04506_SEQ_05: You discover the injured Frontinus facing down an enormous magitek monstrosity, which you dispatch with little difficulty. The silver-haired Garlean, however, is gravely wounded, and you rush to his aid.
TEXT_AKTKZD201_04506_SEQ_06: Frontinus catches his breath and thanks you for sparing him an untimely demise. Galla and Rimelnaud bid you go on ahead to deliver the good news, while they help Frontinus make the long journey to Camp Broken Glass.
TEXT_AKTKZD201_04506_SEQ_07: After what must seem an eternity, Frontinus is reunited with his wife and son. TEXT_AKTKZG101_04507_SEQ_05: Convinced that you are some manner of advanced familiar, both Sokles and Charmion seem intrigued by your impressions of their workplace. They ask that you stay for a while, and continue to share your thoughts and observations...

Sokles continues to regard you with a fiery curiosity.

Charmion begins explaining how the observers of Anagnorisis approach rest and recuperation, when she realizes that she hasn't inquired about your nutritional requirements. TEXT_AKTKZG103_04509_SEQ_03: You deliver the blooms to Overseer Sokles, who combines them with Charmion's handpicked fruits to create a tasty looking juice medley. He hands you the aether-rich beverage, and urges you to drink it on the spot.
TEXT_AKTKZG103_04509_SEQ_04: You drink down the proffered juice, marveling at the complexity of its fruity and floral flavors. Charmion hovers nearby, obviously in need of reassurance that you won't suddenly fade into nothingness...
TEXT_AKTKZG103_04509_SEQ_05: Satisfied that your corporeal form is no longer in danger of imminent dissipation, Charmion continues her lecture on the importance of proper nourishment and the evils of overindulgence. It seems your educational exchange with the passionate observers of Anagnorisis is set to continue...
TEXT_AKTKZG104_04510_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Charmion has one last question to ask you.
TEXT_AKTKZG104_04510_SEQ_01:
Charmion, it seems, has saved her most philosophical question for last: how do you feel about your place in the grand scheme of things? To help you better understand her own calling in life, the inquisitive observer bids you follow her northwest to the Anagnorisis archives.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZG104_04510_SEQ_02: The archives in question contain rows of what appear to be administrative records. Charmion has given you leave to browse these documents at your leisure...
TEXT_AKTKZG104_04510_SEQ_03: Upon perusing the documentation, you discover a staggering number of observation logs─many of them written in Overseer Sokles's hand. Charmion waits nearby, eager to hear your thoughts.
TEXT_AKTKZG104_04510_SEQ_04: Now that you have some inkling of the sheer volume of the overseer's work, Charmion admits to some trepidation at being chosen as Sokles's successor. For his part, however, Sokles has full confidence in her knowledge and ability, and credits you for helping prepare the way for his “return to the star”...
TEXT_AKTKZH101_04511_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Maira appears to be mildly perturbed.
TEXT_AKTKZH101_04511_SEQ_01:
Upon learning that you are not, in fact, a messenger from an expected visitor, Maira enlists you to track said visitor down. As for where you are to search for this “Kleon,” as the guest is known, Maira gestures vaguely in the direction of southerly Zephyrneus.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZH101_04511_SEQ_02: You come to the rescue of a man who you assume is Maira's expected visitor, Kleon. He stands at the spot where you found him, a look of surprised gratitude on his face...
TEXT_AKTKZH101_04511_SEQ_03: You speak with the man and confirm that he is, indeed, the “Kleon” you were searching for. Return with him to the waiting Maira.
TEXT_AKTKZH101_04511_SEQ_04: Maira is at last united with Kleon, and they discuss the reason for his visit: it seems the guest from Amaurot is concerned with the suitability of his registered concepts when it comes to releasing them into the wild. Impressed by your display of battle prowess during his rescue, Kleon insists that you join them in evaluating the state of his “children.”
TEXT_AKTKZH102_04512_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Kleon looks at you expectantly.
TEXT_AKTKZH102_04512_SEQ_01:
Kleon explains that he is concerned for the fate of his creations─namely, a concept he has named the “batrachoi.” It seems you are to follow the Amaurotine visitor to Rumination's Ramble, where Maira's brother, Alkaios, is tending to the observational subject in question.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZH102_04512_SEQ_02: You find Alkaios with the batrachoi, but he is pessimistic about the creature's final evaluation. To demonstrate why, he asks that you give the batrachoi a solid poke.
TEXT_AKTKZH102_04512_SEQ_03: Although designed to act as a guardian of waterways, the lack of response to your deliberate provocation has revealed the batrachoi's extreme docility. Kleon is devastated at the thought of having to abandon his beloved concept, but your suggestion to impart an aggressive attack to the creature may just have saved it from being retired altogether.
TEXT_AKTKZH102_04512_SEQ_04: Kleon thanks you enthusiastically for your assistance, and hopes you will stay around to help him with another of his creations. Meanwhile, you try not to linger on the fact that you may have helped inflict the ancestor of the gigantoad upon the world...
TEXT_AKTKZH103_04513_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Kleon hopes to retain your company a while longer.
TEXT_AKTKZH103_04513_SEQ_01:
Kleon tells you of another concept due for evaluation, and asks that you remain at his side during the process. Follow after Alkaios to the place where the io roams.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZH103_04513_SEQ_02: You join Alkaios at the spot where the io is usually found, but the creature is nowhere to be seen. At Maira's suggestion, you split up to track down the missing concept, a “shaggy, four-legged beast with rather majestic horns.”
TEXT_AKTKZH103_04513_SEQ_03: You eventually find the io, and Kleon shares his plans for the creature's place in the world. Unfortunately, however, Alkaios is forced to point out that although the beast is indeed physically powerful, it lacks the traits necessary to become a dominant hunter. Noting the io's tendency towards nutritional deficiency, the observer requests that you administer its scheduled aetherial supplement.
TEXT_AKTKZH103_04513_SEQ_04: The aetherial supplement appears to have been successfully absorbed by the io. You turn to see Kleon looking upon his creation, his face filled with bittersweet adoration...
TEXT_AKTKZH103_04513_SEQ_05: Facing yet another recommendation to adjust his original concept, Kleon seems unwilling to abandon his dream of turning the io into an apex predator. A sudden hope lights up his features, and he looks to you─the worldly familiar─in search of inspiration...
TEXT_AKTKZH104_04514_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Kleon once more fixes you with an expectant gaze.
TEXT_AKTKZH104_04514_SEQ_01:
Disappointed that his favored creation seems fated to become cattle, Kleon asks you to look over the io for any changes he might make. Surely it wouldn't take much to transform this hulking beast into an apex predator...

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZH104_04514_SEQ_02: You carefully inspect the io, noting its flaws and possible improvements before making your report to its anxious creator. Apparently inspired by your advice, Kleon rushes off to make adjustments, and you are left to wait alongside Alkaios and Maira for his return.
TEXT_AKTKZH104_04514_SEQ_03: Kleon eventually appears with his new and improved io─a beast which now greatly resembles the monster you know as a “behemoth.” Satisfied that his creation now qualifies as a dominant form of wildlife, Kleon leaves you in the company of Alkaios and Maira as he departs for Amaurot to begin work on his next concept.
TEXT_AKTKZH104_04514_SEQ_04: Both Alkaios and Maira thank you for your help with their visitor. It seems your intervention was instrumental in salvaging Kleon's promising-yet-flawed creations. You wonder, however, what good will come of unleashing a behemoth-like beast upon the world...
TEXT_AKTKZH201_04515_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Maira and her brother Alkaios look set to leave on an errand of some kind.
TEXT_AKTKZH201_04515_SEQ_01:
After asking if you've been to Anagnorisis, Maira suggests that you accompany her and Alkaios to meet with your acquaintance, Overseer Sokles. It seems the overseer has summoned the siblings to assist with what promises to be an intriguing duty...

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZH201_04515_SEQ_02: Overseer Sokles explains that several creatures have fallen victim to rampaging lykaones. Alkaios, it seems, is often called upon to accelerate the decay of the remains with time magicks, and you have been invited to attend this somewhat solemn service in the southwest of Philomythes Notos.
TEXT_AKTKZH201_04515_SEQ_03: At the site of the fallen creations, the conversation turns to the subject of mourning and you share with the gathered ancients the traditions with which you are accustomed. Fascinated by the idea of leaving a physical reminder, Maira bids you follow her to a spot where she might prepare an offering of flowers for the deceased.
TEXT_AKTKZH201_04515_SEQ_04: Maira has manipulated the aether in the soil to produce a number of beautiful blooms. She bids you join her in picking a small bouquet for the service.
TEXT_AKTKZH201_04515_SEQ_05: Having gathered a small handful of Maira's conjured “krinoi,” you are ready to head back and deliver the offering to the waiting Sokles.
TEXT_AKTKZH201_04515_SEQ_06: Sokles accepts your offering of flowers and places them with the remains. The simple gesture, alongside Alkaios's solemn words, appears to have stirred the hearts of those present. The Anagnorisis observers express their thanks for your contribution before sending you on your way back to Poieten Oikos.
TEXT_AKTKZH201_04515_SEQ_07: Although perfectly normal to you, your ideas appear to be a source of great interest and inspiration to the long-lived observers. Again, you are forced to wonder if your presence here will affect how the future of the Source unfolds.
TEXT_AKTKZE101_04516_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Knockingway would like you to call upon a friend.
TEXT_AKTKZE101_04516_SEQ_01:
Knockingway explains that their friend, Dreamingway, has not been at his best since awakening from hibernation. As they believe the forlorn Loporrit would be more likely to open up to a representative of Etheirys, you agree to go and ask him what is wrong.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZE101_04516_SEQ_02: Upon introducing yourself to Dreamingway, you learn that his name is the cause of his concern. Inspired by the people of Etheirys, he aspires to achieve a dream of his own─yet has no idea what he should pursue. Perhaps, as he hopes, the other Loporrits will be able to point you in the right direction.
TEXT_AKTKZE101_04516_SEQ_03: You speak with Dreamingway's acquaintances, and though they have only praise for their fellow Loporrit, none can say what he might be particularly suited to. Though he will doubtless be disappointed, Dreamingway would want to know that you must pursue other avenues.
TEXT_AKTKZE101_04516_SEQ_04: Dreamingway is disheartened, though unsurprised, by his fellow Loporrits' responses. You are loath to let him give up hope so soon, however, and encourage him to continue searching. With your help, he might yet find meaning in his name.
TEXT_AKTKZE102_04517_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Dreamingway would show you how he spends his day.
TEXT_AKTKZE102_04517_SEQ_01:
Dreamingway decides to show you one of the jobs that occupies his time on any given day─gathering resources. Before setting out on this most essential of tasks, however, he bids you join him in speaking with Thinkingway to learn what materials want for gathering.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZE102_04517_SEQ_02: According to Thinkingway, Buildingway is in need of crystals, a requirement Dreamingway seems especially familiar with. Dreamingway asks you to meet him in Vallis Vulneris, rushing ahead to find a suitable deposit of crystals to mine.
TEXT_AKTKZE102_04517_SEQ_03: By the time you arrive, Dreamingway has already finished mining all the crystals he requires. But as luck would have it, he recalls something else Buildingway recently asked for─grey sand. How fortuitous that the surrounding area is filled with it.
TEXT_AKTKZE102_04517_SEQ_04: The sand is coarse, rough, and irritating, and it made its way everywhere. Nevertheless, you gathered an ample store. Dreamingway is certain to be pleased with your contribution.
TEXT_AKTKZE102_04517_SEQ_05: As it transpires, Dreamingway is indeed more excited to receive a pile of sand than anyone should be. Perhaps you should be thankful that he didn't ask for more.
TEXT_AKTKZE102_04517_SEQ_06: When you make your delivery, Thinkingway shows themself to be somewhat perplexed as to how Dreamingway knew that Buildingway needed sand, but thanks you both for your hard work regardless. This brief stint in the life of Dreamingway failed to offer ideas for a dream to pursue, but your Loporrit companion is not deterred. He has more to show you, and is confident inspiration is forthcoming.
TEXT_AKTKZE103_04518_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Dreamingway is eager to set about his next task─whatever it may be.
TEXT_AKTKZE103_04518_SEQ_01:
Dreamingway's next assignment is to repair a caretaker, and for that, he requires spare parts from Heimdall's Last Sight. He rushes off without a second thought─leaving you to give chase lest you lose him entirely.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZE103_04518_SEQ_02: You catch up to Dreamingway, who had gotten so far ahead of you that he worried you decided not to come. He has apparently learned absolutely nothing from this experience, as he then dashes off excitedly once more.
TEXT_AKTKZE103_04518_SEQ_03: When at last you reach Heimdall's Last Sight, Dreamingway says that he can salvage the parts from the crashed Allagan vessel on his own. He insists you relax and enjoy the view while he sets about his task.
TEXT_AKTKZE103_04518_SEQ_04: Whilst waiting, you hear a sudden shriek emanate from the area whence Dreamingway proceeded. You decide you had best check on the Loporrit.
TEXT_AKTKZE103_04518_SEQ_05: Your suspicions are confirmed as you find Dreamingway has been set upon by mechanical monstrosities. Steeling yourself, you slay the fiends to rescue your Loporrit companion.
TEXT_AKTKZE103_04518_SEQ_06: It transpires that Dreamingway is somewhat shaken, but otherwise none the worse for wear. What's more, he has managed to procure the parts needed to repair the caretaker.
TEXT_AKTKZE103_04518_SEQ_07: Dreamingway's work on the caretaker is completed in two shakes of a Loporrit's tail. Though he does not feel hopeful that his true calling involves the maintenance of machinery, there is still one job of his you have yet to see─carrot production.
TEXT_AKTKZE104_04519_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Dreamingway has one last demonstration for you.
TEXT_AKTKZE104_04519_SEQ_01:
Still determined to discover a dream worthy of pursuit, Dreamingway wishes to show you how the Loporrits grow carrots─by having you try it yourself. To begin, he asks that you bring a handful of seeds to the carrot creation station nearby.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_AKTKZE104_04519_SEQ_02: You somewhat unceremoniously load the seeds into the carrot creation station, impressing Dreamingway nevertheless. He explains that the next step towards a bountiful harvest requires water crystals, which can be had from the sparkling supply station in the northeast corner of the Carrotorium.
TEXT_AKTKZE104_04519_SEQ_03: You find a large store of crystals exactly where Dreamingway said they would be. With crate in hand, you make your perilous journey over ramp and oversized stairway to arrive at a nearby carrot creation station.
TEXT_AKTKZE104_04519_SEQ_04: Once the crystals are deposited into the machine, all one needs do is wait for the carrots to grow. Fortuitously, after mere moments, Dreamingway hears a sound─undetectable to your ears─that indicates carrots elsewhere in the Carrotorium are ready for picking.
TEXT_AKTKZE104_04519_SEQ_05: You visit the surrounding creation stations and, surely enough, find two carrots practically begging to be plucked. After freeing them with satisfying tugs, you tuck them into your bag that you might present them to Dreamingway.
TEXT_AKTKZE104_04519_SEQ_06: Dreamingway commends you on a job well done, though sadly, your success only reaffirms his belief that he is an unremarkable Loporrit. Mention of his exceptional hearing, however, gives you an idea, and so you ask if he has ever considered musical pursuits. After a brief explanation of what music is, he hums a melody together with his companion Knockingway. Both find it to be a heartwarming experience, and thus is Dreamingway inspired to share the gift of music with anyone and everyone─a dream of his very own.
TEXT_AKTKZE104_04519_SEQ_07: Knockingway thanks you for solving Dreamingway's problem as only a person of Etheirys can. Similarly, the newly motivated Loporrit promises to practice his music often, hopeful that he will have a new tune to play for you when next you meet.
TEXT_SUBCTS670_04523_SEQ_00: The well-dressed attendant has been sneaking glances at you since the moment you entered the Agora.
TEXT_SUBCTS671_04524_SEQ_00: Ameliance is eager to depart for the Studium.
TEXT_SUBCTS672_04525_SEQ_00: Meryld's ever-watchful gaze is upon you, with a smile uncomfortably reminiscent of Tataru writ across her face.
TEXT_CHRHDB811_04542_SEQ_00: The pungent Lalafell can scarcely conceal his excitement.
TEXT_CHRHDB811_04542_SEQ_01: Strolling through the streets of Radz-at-Han, you encounter a strangely familiar Lalafell. He proudly identifies himself as the selfsame youth you met once upon a time in Kugane...who happens to have an unhealthy obsession with Nashu Mhakaracca. It seems the apple of his eye has once again found herself in a pickle, and is greatly distressed by the condition of one Hildibrand─agent of enquiry, inspector extraordinaire. Curious as to what fate has befallen the redoubtable gentleman─you make for the High Crucible to learn more.
TEXT_CHRHDB811_04542_SEQ_02: Following events in the Far East in which Nashu and Hildibrand were sucked into a foreboding portal─along with Gilgamesh, notorious weapon thief, and Jubraca, an unscrupulous Hannish merchant─your associates found themselves wandering the “Interspectorial Rift” for a time. Eventually, with the aid of a recovered Gilgamesh, the other three managed to return to the Source. However, while Nashu was none the worse for wear, Hildibrand emerged in a comatose state for reasons yet unknown. The inspector's plucky assistant has attempted to fashion medicines to revive him, but to no avail. Hoping you might have some insight into his condition, she invites you to join her in Kama at the residence where the inspector is convalescing.
TEXT_CHRHDB811_04542_SEQ_03: Examining the unconscious body of Hildibrand, you conclude that, like the Scions before him, his soul has been summoned to another world─likely the First. Nashu, understandably, is not quite able to grasp the situation, but she is nevertheless heartened that you might be able to bring him back. Entrusting you with her homemade explosives should you have need of them, she bids you a safe journey, and you prepare to depart for the Crystarium. With luck, you will track down the gentleman inspector's wandering spirit.
TEXT_CHRHDB811_04542_SEQ_04: You pay a visit to the Wandering Stairs, where Glynard informs you that one of the veteran bounty hunters mentioned a suspicious individual wont to strike unseemly poses. After listening to the account of said bounty hunter, the dwarf Giott, you are all but convinced that the man in question is none other than Inspector Hildibrand. You are subsequently approached by the former guardsmen Theyler and Vonard, who coincidentally enough are also on the trail of the infamous poser. United by a common goal, you and your comrades depart for Sullen, where the man was last spotted.
TEXT_CHRHDB811_04542_SEQ_05: While the various witnesses in Sullen offer conflicting reports, the picture they paint of the mystery man is one which suggests that, despite his ghastly appearance and disturbing poses, he is a gentlemanly soul at heart. With no doubt remaining that you are on the inspector's trail, you go to share your findings with Theyler and Vonard.
TEXT_CHRHDB811_04542_SEQ_06: Theyler and Vonard are pleased to hear of your success, and somewhat relieved that the poser has proved relatively benign thus far. The three of you resolve to scour the Forest of the Lost Shepherd, where the eyewitnesses claim to have encountered your quarry.
TEXT_CHRHDB811_04542_SEQ_07: Sure enough, you soon come upon a Hildibrand seemingly bereft of his memories and looking a bit pale in the face. Fortunately, a judicious application of Nashu's Delight is enough to make the inspector remember who he is. In that instant, you and your companions are granted a vision by the Echo, which reveals in ludicrous detail how a chance encounter with Giott led Hildibrand to believe he was a Lightwarden extraordinaire. In any event, having been disabused of such notions, Hildibrand strikes his trademark pose and announces his triumphant return to his adoring fans.
TEXT_CHRHDB812_04543_SEQ_00: Hildibrand is back and full of spectral beans.
TEXT_CHRHDB812_04543_SEQ_01:
Inspector's Log:
I am myself again! Or am I? While I have come to realize the Forgiven Gentleman was no more than a figment of my imagination, the fact remains that my burly body and saintly soul have been separated from one another. I am trapped in this world of dazzling purple known as the First, unable to reunite with my physical form. But I have not yet begun to investigate─a solution will surely present itself in due course. You may rest assured, my good friends and beloved family, that Hildibrand Helidor Maximilian Manderville will not rest until he has been made whole!
　　　　　　　　　　　　*　*　*
Looking none the worse for wear despite taking an exploding projectile to the face, a moderately lucid Hildibrand declares his desire to return home to the Source. Though he appears to only tenuously grasp the process you explain this would entail, he is eager to forge ahead, heedless of any potential risks. Said process will require the assistance of Beq Lugg, who Theyler and Vonard assure you will be most happy to help. Course of action decided, you and your companions begin the trek back to the Crystarium and the Cabinet of Curiosity.
TEXT_CHRHDB812_04543_SEQ_02: Hildibrand wastes no time in incurring the esteemed Nu Mou's ire by mistaking them for Moren's pet canine. In spite of this faux pas, Beq Lugg grudgingly agrees to help. Hildibrand's soul proves to be sufficiently resolute, and in short order you find yourself in possession of a spirit vessel bearing his memories and vital essence. After offering thanks and farewells, you prepare for a return journey to the Source.
TEXT_CHRHDB812_04543_SEQ_03: Arriving back at Radz-at-Han, you are greeted by a panicking Nashu and a most distressing state of affairs: the sleeping Hildibrand has been kidnapped! With no clues or evidence as to the perpetrator, you and Nashu head out to the streets of Kama to conduct an investigation and locate the inspector before he comes to harm.
TEXT_CHRHDB812_04543_SEQ_04: Questioning witnesses in Kama, you learn that while none saw anyone carrying the inspector's body, an individual carrying a massive sack was observed not a short while ago. With any luck, this knowledge will help you and Nashu narrow your search and find out whence─and by whom─Hildibrand has been spirited away.
TEXT_CHRHDB812_04543_SEQ_05: In your absence, Nashu has made the acquaintance of one Delion, the editor of an occult periodical, who proffers the far-fetched theory that Inspector Hildibrand has been abducted by aliens.
