Cullaal Ja seeks to introduce an all-new organization to Tural.
TEXT_KINGZB001_05030_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Tsivlu is counting down the days until she can resume trade as normal.
TEXT_KINGZB002_05031_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Povli seems to be dying to discuss something.
TEXT_KINGZB003_05032_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Vugeel Ja gazes at his stall with disinterest.
TEXT_KINGZB004_05033_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
The troubled craftsman is in need of a helping hand.
TEXT_KINGZB005_05034_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Pobli is in need of a tea-tester.
TEXT_KINGZB006_05035_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
The sickly merchant is not only unwell, but visibly unhappy.
TEXT_KINGZB007_05036_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
The hot-blooded storekeeper and her trusty alpaca gaze at you inquisitively.
TEXT_KINGZB008_05037_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Tsabli is perplexed by a coffee conundrum.
TEXT_KINGZB009_05038_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Mivli has a request which involves more than a little danger.
TEXT_KINGZB010_05039_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
The flustered merchant appears desperate for help.
TEXT_KINGZB011_05040_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
You would recognize the rustle of this corn anywhere.
TEXT_KINGZB011_05040_SEQ_01:
Once again you cross paths with the Cornservant. As fortune would have it, they stopped in Wachunpelo upon hearing the rumbling of a stomach in need. Ever wont to see the people of Tural well-fed, they bid you help them offer aid to a peckish young Pelupelu.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZB011_05040_SEQ_02: The peckish Pelupelu has been out of sorts of late. Sleep does little to remedy his fatigue, and despite the protests of his stomach, he cannot eat. The Cornservant suspects the boy suffers from malnourishment as a result of eating corn and only corn. While the cuisines your corny companion can offer are limited, they manage to concoct a nutrient-packed corn soup to help the ailing Pelupelu.
TEXT_KINGZB011_05040_SEQ_03: Once again the power of corn has made the world a little brighter. Even so, there are yet more souls that cry out for satiation. Thus does the Cornservant set out in search of more hungry bellies.
TEXT_KINGZB101_05041_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
The allergic Yok Huy is in need of a dry delivery.
TEXT_KINGZB102_05042_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
The brawny Yok Huy knows how to work smarter, not harder.
TEXT_KINGZB103_05043_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Vyurvarjur has just filled his vials with wardingwater.
TEXT_KINGZB104_05044_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
The injured Yok Huy appears to be languishing in pain.
TEXT_KINGZB105_05045_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Bhurborlor is running dangerously low on medicine for the injured.
TEXT_KINGZB106_05046_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Zarwarkur hopes you are hungry for knowledge.
TEXT_KINGZB107_05047_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Garhorlur is eager to lighten things up around here.
TEXT_KINGZB108_05048_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
The anxious Yok Huy appears to be at her wit's end.
TEXT_KINGZB109_05049_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Dabargar would have you avenge a fallen friend.
TEXT_KINGZB110_05050_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Karporger would ask of you a small-yet-symbolic gesture.
TEXT_KINGZB201_05051_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Nopli is rubbing his hands together.
TEXT_KINGZB201_05051_SEQ_01:
The enthusiastic merchant, Nopli, attempts to sell you what he believes to be rare and otherwise valuable corrupted crystals, only for you to inform him that they are, in fact, neither. He is both shocked by the revelation and dismayed at the untold sums of pel he squandered in their purchase. Though the peddler is naive, he is not one to be deterred, and so he begs your assistance in his pursuit to discover some modicum of worth in the crystals.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZB201_05051_SEQ_02: You agree to lend Nopli your aid, and he quickly tasks you with speaking with a mage of the Boonewa tribe in Wachunpelo, who are said to use crystals in their rituals.
TEXT_KINGZB201_05051_SEQ_03: You manage to locate the mage. Unfortunately, he has no interest in purchasing the crystals.
TEXT_KINGZB201_05051_SEQ_04: You inform Nopli that, much as you expected, there is not a soul in Wachunpelo interested in purchasing corrupted crystals. Initially dismayed by the news, Nopli soon channels his sadness into anger towards the merchant who lied to him, vowing to stop the so-called pernicious peddler from swindling anyone else. To contend with such a cunning adversary, Nopli will undoubtedly need your continued assistance.
TEXT_KINGZB202_05052_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Nopli is eager to put a stop to the pernicious peddler's malevolent schemes.
TEXT_KINGZB202_05052_SEQ_01:
To prevent anyone else from falling victim to the peddler's deception, Nopli asks that you search for them at Icuvlo's Inn, the man in question described as a Lalafell by the name of Gigimolu.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZB202_05052_SEQ_02: You find Gigimolu, but are alarmed to discover that he is in fact the selfsame Dunesfolk merchant you spoke with on your voyage to Tural. You barely exchange a few words before he rushes off to Panaqpelu Retreat. Keeping your assigned task well in mind, you decide to follow him.
TEXT_KINGZB202_05052_SEQ_03: Once more you speak with Gigimolu, who you find bathing in the hot springs of the retreat. Unfortunately, it is not long before he grows suspicious of your sudden interest. Lest he see through the ruse, you decide to speak with his hired help, Cavli, instead.
TEXT_KINGZB202_05052_SEQ_04: Cavli is shocked to learn of Gigimolu's duplicitous actions, which call to mind the treatment of his fellow Pelupelu. He promises to keep a watchful eye on the Lalafellin merchant, and asks that you return to Nopli.
TEXT_KINGZB202_05052_SEQ_05: While he was unable to discover any other victims of Gigimolu's schemes in Wachunpelo, Nopli is certain the merchant is planning to strike again soon. Before that happens, Nopli hopes to enact a plan of his own, and he needs your help to see it through.
TEXT_KINGZB203_05053_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Nopli appears to be in deep thought.
TEXT_KINGZB203_05053_SEQ_01:
To teach Gigimolu the error of his ways, Nopli would give the Ul'dahn merchant a taste of their own deception. To see the deed done, he asks that you speak with people in Wachunpelo, and determine what specialties might garner Gigimolu's interest.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZB203_05053_SEQ_02: After speaking with a number of individuals in the settlement, you narrow down your options to either an uolon bristle hairbrush or a traditional Pelupelu doll. Nopli is certain to be interested in your selections.
TEXT_KINGZB203_05053_SEQ_03: Nopli believes the uolon bristle hairbrush will best serve as bait for his plan. If all goes as it should, Gigimolu will at last come to understand the importance of a fair trade.
TEXT_KINGZB204_05054_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Nopli is of a mind to swindle a swindler.
TEXT_KINGZB204_05054_SEQ_01:
Suspecting that Gigimolu would not give him the time of day, Nopli asks that you speak with the merchant on his behalf and inform him of a trader that deals in rare goods to draw his interest. With this task in mind, you set off for Panaqpelu Retreat once more.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZB204_05054_SEQ_02: Gigimolu is quite easily hooked by the enticing bait you and Nopli have prepared, and asks that you wait for him on the lower level of the retreat while he makes himself presentable.
TEXT_KINGZB204_05054_SEQ_03: You do not wait long before Nopli and a clothed Gigimolu arrive. Initially suspicious of Nopli's intent, and doubtful of his eye for quality, Gigimolu's guard is gradually lowered through your periodic interventions during the negotiation, paving the way for Nopli to introduce the uolon bristle hairbrush. Taking a liking to the product, the Ul'dahn merchant eventually agrees to pay one hundred thousand pel per brush Nopli can offer.
TEXT_KINGZB204_05054_SEQ_04: Nopli is thrilled that his plan went exactly as he hoped. Now it is time to return to Wachunpelo, where the true negotiation will take place.
TEXT_KINGZB204_05054_SEQ_05: Gigimolu is forced to face his own naivety when Nopli reveals the true market value of the hairbrushes, and realizes how shortsighted it was of him to dupe others for profit. Nopli's graciousness seems to have rubbed off on the Dunesfolk merchant, who apologizes for his actions, and pledges to make amends for his wrongdoings. Though they may have started off on the wrong foot, the pair appear to be at the beginning of what you hope will be a long, and mutually beneficial relationship.
TEXT_KINGZB301_05055_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Murfurlur regards you with a mixture of reverence and uncertainty.
TEXT_KINGZB301_05055_SEQ_01:
While Murfurlur has heard of your victory over the Skyruin, he struggles to comprehend how one so small could have triumphed over the legendary vidraal, and so he asks that you favor him with a demonstration of your skill. There have been reports of large monsters threatening all who travel along the road leading to the Shades of Grief, which should prove a suitable challenge. Murfurlur bids you meet him there when you are ready to begin.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZB301_05055_SEQ_02: Prior to your arrival, Murfurlur was attacked by one of the foul beasts, which he defeated easily. There was another, however, which escaped to the southwest, and he tasks you with tracking it down.
TEXT_KINGZB301_05055_SEQ_03: The huallepen was no match for your might. Hopefully Murfurlur found your display of force educational.
TEXT_KINGZB301_05055_SEQ_04: Murfurlur could not be more pleased with your performance, which has helped him to understand how you could accomplish such magnificent feats of strength. Now that the threat is no more, you can return to Worlar's Echo and see if he requires anything more of you.
TEXT_KINGZB301_05055_SEQ_05: It transpires that Murfurlur was a guardian of Karryorzar the Gracious who, following your triumph over Valigarmanda, found himself without purpose, as there was no need for him to stand watch over the temple any longer. He is unsure what new passion he should pursue next, though he is intrigued to learn that you developed your skills over the course of your adventures. You can but hope he will be closer to finding his answer when next you speak.
TEXT_KINGZB302_05056_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Murfurlur is interested to learn more about the adventurer's trade.
TEXT_KINGZB302_05056_SEQ_01:
Murfurlur remains curious about life as an adventurer and wonders if it may suit his skills as a former temple guardian. Upon hearing your description of an adventurer's duties, the Yok Huy recalls a craftsman who might be in need of such services. Yet rather than attempt to approach him on his own, Murfurlur asks that you once again show him how a professional would go about securing a new commission.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZB302_05056_SEQ_02: Luckily for you, the craftsman is very much interested in hiring an adventurer or two to procure Naryor obsidian. The material can be found in Naryor Gorna, but the wildlife there make it a dangerous proposition for those lacking in martial skill. Declaring that this is his trial, Murfurlur asks that you gather three chunks as a demonstration, after which he will see to the remainder.
TEXT_KINGZB302_05056_SEQ_03: With some effort, you find three pieces of obsidian of sufficient quality. Once you show them to Murfurlur, he should have a clear idea of what to look for.
TEXT_KINGZB302_05056_SEQ_04: After examining your chunks of Naryor obsidian, Murfurlur is confident he can gather the rest. You need only return to Worlar's Echo and await his return along with the candid craftsman.
TEXT_KINGZB302_05056_SEQ_05: When the Yok Huy still held ambitions of conquest, obsidian weapons helped them to conquer Tural. These days, however, the material has been largely relegated to decorative trinkets, as the giants eventually recognized the metalworking of other races to be superior. After you receive this history lesson from the craftsman, Murfurlur appears with a bounty of obsidian and is duly compensated. Now that his first commission as an adventurer is complete, he bids you follow him that you might receive your share of the payment.
TEXT_KINGZB302_05056_SEQ_06: While Murfurlur has found this recent experience fulfilling and yearns to help others in a similar fashion, he worries that such opportunities may be lacking in Worlar's Echo. Indeed, his enthusiasm led him to supply the craftsman with so much obsidian that he will likely not require his services for the foreseeable future, and it is unclear who else in the village might be in need of a stout former temple guardian. For now, however, he will consider his next steps, and perhaps seek your wisdom again should you be willing to provide it.
TEXT_KINGZB303_05057_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Murfurlur has been thinking long and hard about how he might best serve others.
TEXT_KINGZB303_05057_SEQ_01:
With your encouragement, Murfurlur has decided to look for work as a bodyguard. He suspects that one of the many traveling Pelupelu merchants would likely have need of protection, but lacks the confidence to approach them in this capacity. And so, to better prepare himself, he asks that you help by training him first. Once you rendezvous with him south of the Shades of Grief, you may proceed with his education.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZB303_05057_SEQ_02:
Murfurlur requests that you act as his bodyguard so that he might learn from your example. To that end, you must keep your eyes peeled and protect him from any perceived threats until you reach the ruins at the Shades of Grief.

※You must be accompanied by Murfurlur to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGZB303_05057_SEQ_03: You manage to fend off all threats on the way to the Shades of Grief. Murfurlur will only require your escort until you reach the peak.
TEXT_KINGZB303_05057_SEQ_04: As before, no ferocious beast is a match for your might. Having reached the zenith of the Shades of Grief, Murfurlur basks in the breathtaking scenery. His gaze, you note, is drawn to the Pelupelu village down below...
TEXT_KINGZB303_05057_SEQ_05: Reflecting on the history between his people and the Pelupelu, Murfurlur expresses guilt and trepidation at the thought of how he might live on in the memories of his neighbors. Though he aspires to be a gentle guardian, he is aware that the Pelupelu elders will not soon forget the dark deeds of the Yok Huy─nor should they. Your training session complete, he heads back to Worlar's Echo and invites you to follow.
TEXT_KINGZB303_05057_SEQ_06: Murfurlur believes that, through his new ambition, he has the power to show the Pelupelu that the Yok Huy of the present are not the same as their ancestors. He hopes that he can continue to rely on you for support as he searches for a new client.
TEXT_KINGZB304_05058_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Murfurlur has finally drummed up the courage to start his new career.
TEXT_KINGZB304_05058_SEQ_01:
The time has come for Murfurlur to seek out a client, and he would like you to bear witness to his efforts. As Pelupelu fishermen sometimes pass through Worlar's Echo on their way to Karvarhur the First, the Yok Huy believes that one might be willing to hire on a bodyguard. You can only hope that his assumption proves correct.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZB304_05058_SEQ_02: As luck would have it, there is indeed a fisher who is glad of the opportunity to employ a Yok Huy protector. Worried that he may fall short in his duties, Murfurlur asks that you join him as he stands watch over his new client on the shore of Karvarhur the First.
TEXT_KINGZB304_05058_SEQ_03: Upon your arrival, you see that Murfurlur has already had to deal with an unusually aggressive creature. For extra reassurance, he would have you trail him and the fisher, keeping watch for potential threats from behind.
TEXT_KINGZB304_05058_SEQ_04: The morbol seedling which catches your eye bodes ill enough on its own, but the bloodcurdling scream you hear a moment later is far more concerning. Given that it sounded like the Pelupelu fisherman and came from Karvarhur the First, it stands to reason that Murfurlur and his client are in trouble...
TEXT_KINGZB304_05058_SEQ_05: For a mercy, you arrive in time to dispatch a morbol before it can harm the fisher. With the immediate danger having passed, you turn your attention to the injured Murfurlur.
TEXT_KINGZB304_05058_SEQ_06: Despite Murfurlur's thoughts to the contrary, the Pelupelu praises him for a job well done. With peace restored─albeit temporarily─the fisher declares it time to settle in and fill his bucket before the opportunity is lost.
TEXT_KINGZB304_05058_SEQ_07: Satisfied with his haul, the Pelupelu fisherman heads back to Worlar's Echo. With no reason to stay, you and Murfurlur follow his lead.
TEXT_KINGZB304_05058_SEQ_08: For as great an honor as it was to guard Karryorzar the Gracious, deep down Murfurlur yearned to protect not a place, but the people. Having completed his first bodyguard commission, Murfurlur reaffirms this passion, naming himself Murfurlur the Defender─a friend to the weak and vulnerable who will do everything in his power to build a stronger relationship with the Pelupelu.
TEXT_KINGZB401_05059_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Murfurlur is in the market for a new client.
TEXT_KINGZB401_05059_SEQ_01:
Though he is heartened by the praise he received for his first commission, Murfurlur is not content to wait for new clients to seek him out. He wishes to take the initiative and travel to Wachunpelo to sell his services, but is still concerned that the villagers there might be frightened by his presence. Once more he seeks to rely on you, this time asking if you happen to know any Pelupelu merchants who might be willing to employ a bodyguard. Fortunately, you might know just the one: Nopli, the merchant who recently came into possession of a cache of corrupted crystals.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZB401_05059_SEQ_02: Talk of Murfurlur and how he protected a fisherman has spread like wildfire among the Pelupelu, and Nopli is eager to hire him. All that remains is to facilitate their meeting.
TEXT_KINGZB401_05059_SEQ_03: Nopli explains that he wants to pay a visit to the Chirwagur and broker a deal for their salt, but has been reluctant to do so owing to their reputation for intimidating buyers into paying outrageous prices. Murfurlur is willing to accompany him, though he is concerned that this may be more difficult than Nopli anticipates, as the Chirwagur truly believe that might makes right. It is clear that he would like you to accompany them in case negotiations go poorly.
TEXT_KINGZB401_05059_SEQ_04: As Murfurlur feared, the Chirwagur bristle at the thought of trading with Nopli, demanding that he surrender his coin and leave empty-handed. However, with your encouragement, the former temple guardian names himself, causing the other giants to back down in respect and giving the merchant an opening to explain why trading salt for corrupted crystals would benefit both parties. Though curious, most of the Chirwagur remain distrustful, but Murfurlur stands firm and vouches for the Pelupelu. Ultimately, the Chirwagur leave, unwilling to believe Nopli's promises...save for a single giant, who agrees to trade salt─a giant whom you previously met along with Vorporlor, and whom Wuk Lamat saved once before. Her deeds─and yours─have earned you a measure of trust, and in time, perhaps the others will change their minds as well.
TEXT_KINGZB401_05059_SEQ_05: Though the outcome fell rather short of his expectations, Nopli is nonetheless content with what little he managed to achieve during this visit. Not wanting to wear out his welcome, he states that you all should return to Worlar's Echo.
TEXT_KINGZB401_05059_SEQ_06: Nopli is nothing if not optimistic about the possibility of peaceful trade relations with the Chirwagur, but he knows it will take considerable time and effort. Fortunately, he knows who to call upon for his next trip to the saltern. Indeed, it seems that this is only the beginning of a fruitful partnership between the Pelupelu merchant and Murfurlur, who thanks you again for your constant support, and states that he will always carry your memory in his heart.

She has managed to ration what little unspoiled food remains thus far, but hunger tempts her to make a reckless choice. The Cornservant believes what she needs is food with longevity, and so they prepare a bounty of dried corn. The hungry Hanuhanu is moved by the generous offering. She thanks you profusely before leaving to share the good news with her family.
TEXT_KINGZC011_05070_SEQ_03: Another day, another stomach delivered from the uncertainty of hunger and sickness. But a corn's duty is never done, and so the Cornservant bids you farewell, shucking off once more to parts unknown.

TEXT_KINGZC201_05081_SEQ_01:
Lanuhanu, one of the Wind's Chosen, has picked you to participate in a customary gifting of feathers to the Landsguard. What this entails is uncertain, but the Hanuhanu asks you to search nearby roads for Nahanshe, a Landsguard soldier who seems to be running late to take part in this sacred custom.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZC201_05081_SEQ_02: After a quick search of the road, you find Nahanshe. The soldier is quite unenthusiastic about this duty, but resigns himself to visit Ok'hanu, where Lanuhanu awaits.
TEXT_KINGZC201_05081_SEQ_03: Enthused to greet this new visitor, Lanuhanu declares that before the feathers are to be passed on, he is obligated to give the Landsguard a tour of Ok'hanu. Follow him to the center of the village and take in all its beauty.
TEXT_KINGZC201_05081_SEQ_04: As you gaze down on Ok'hanu, Lanuhanu explains that the gift of feathers is used to adorn the Landsguard equipment, and that your next task is to dye and oil the feathers. Nahanshe reluctantly agrees to this before leaving. Your Hanuhanu host stops you to explain the true intention behind this work: to temper the rough personalities of new recruits into shining beacons of courage. With this new knowledge in hand, you are to head to the southeastern gate to meet Nahanshe.
TEXT_KINGZC201_05081_SEQ_05: As you arrive at the southeastern gate, Nahanshe greets you with characteristic lassitude. Although his attitude leaves much to be desired, with any luck you and Lanuhanu will polish him into a soldier worthy of the feathers he wears.
TEXT_KINGZC202_05082_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Lanuhanu is ready to start cleaning feathers.
TEXT_KINGZC202_05082_SEQ_01:
While you know not how many steps are required to process feathers before their delivery, your first task is to collect dyes and oils from Ok'bek'be. These two items are essential for making feathers worthy of such a long held tradition.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZC202_05082_SEQ_02: As instructed, the dyes and oils are in a crate at the Ok'bek'be storeroom. The foreman stresses that they must not be dropped before he leaves you to your task.
TEXT_KINGZC202_05082_SEQ_03: You have picked up the crates of dyes and oils. Deliver it to Lanuhanu within the allotted time limit.
TEXT_KINGZC202_05082_SEQ_04: You complete your somewhat stressful journey to Ok'hanu, and see that Nahanshe has arrived before you, although the ordeal seems to have taken everything out of him. Put down your burden and speak with the enthusiastic Lanuhanu.
TEXT_KINGZC202_05082_SEQ_05: With all the supplies at hand, Lanuhanu is ready to begin dyeing and oiling the feathers─one by one. Nahanshe balks at the enormity of this task, but Lanuhanu stresses that everything must be done with the proper care and caution. Finally realizing how much thought goes into the equipment he wears, Nahanshe apologizes for his previous attitude and dives into the work with a newfound vigor. The task goes by surprisingly quickly, and Nahanshe appears eager to bring the finished product back to his superiors.
TEXT_KINGZC202_05082_SEQ_06: It appears that your work is not done yet, as Lanuhanu informs you proper rituals must be observed before Nahanshe can complete his delivery. You know not what is to come, but it is clear Kixaihih is involved somehow.
TEXT_KINGZC203_05083_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Lanuhanu is eager to see his feathers blessed.
TEXT_KINGZC203_05083_SEQ_01:
The feathers cannot be delivered to the Landsguard until they receive the wind's blessing, and luckily Lanuhanu volunteers to deliver the crate to the likeness of Kixaihih in Kozanuakiy. He bids you and Nahanshe to meet a friend of his who awaits you on the road for an unspecified task.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZC203_05083_SEQ_02: It seems your next job is a familiar one─you are to cull beasts near the shallow waters of Uyuypoga and then gather bark from the trees nearby. Kixaihih will accept no less if you are to receive the wind's blessing.
TEXT_KINGZC203_05083_SEQ_03: The creatures prove little trouble, leaving the area free from nasty threats. Gather bark from the nearby trees without fear of surprise attacks.
TEXT_KINGZC203_05083_SEQ_04: The fragrant bark comes off easily enough, and you quickly gather the required quantity. While you know not how Nahanshe fared, you may as well bring the bark to the carefree Hanu.
TEXT_KINGZC203_05083_SEQ_05: The Hanu is pleased with your work, and explains that according to legend, the bark was burned to drive away wicked beasts when the Hanuhanu first settled the forest. Now it is burned before battle for good luck, and as such it is only natural that this blessing should be bestowed upon the equipment of the Landsguard as well. The Hanu instructs you to bring your bounty to Kozanuakiy, and asks you to offer a prayer to the likeness of Kixaihih on the way.
TEXT_KINGZC203_05083_SEQ_06: You arrive at Kozanuakiy with the bark and offer a prayer to Kixaihih, and Nahanshe wonders aloud why the Hanuhanu have such respect for the Landsguard. Just as this thought is uttered, a group of Hanu approach you and one introduces herself as Zulihali. She then harangues Nahanshe for his ignorance of history and for his attitude during this ordeal, refusing to give the feathers and expressing disdain for the Landsguard. When asked why, she reveals that the sacred figure of Kixaihih was once destroyed by the Dawnservant and impresses upon Nahanshe that he must answer for his own conduct, or else. The overblown anger of Zulihali and her cohorts clearly perturbs Nahanshe, and he asks you to allow him some time to think.
TEXT_KINGZC204_05084_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Nahanshe is visibly shaken.
TEXT_KINGZC204_05084_SEQ_01:
Nahanshe is troubled by the accusations of Zulihali and the others, and resolves to learn the truth behind the Dawnservant's past actions. The obvious course of action is to return to Ok'hanu and ask Lanuhanu what he knows.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZC204_05084_SEQ_02: You arrive at Ok'hanu only to find the Wind's Chosen is nowhere in sight. With no other options, Nahanshe suggests asking some of the younger Hanuhanu to see if Zulihali's disdain of the Landsguard is shared.
TEXT_KINGZC204_05084_SEQ_03: From your conversations with the young Hanuhanu, you form an incomplete picture of the Dawnservant's controversial rescue of Ok'hanu. Perhaps Nahanshe has thoughts on what it all means.
TEXT_KINGZC204_05084_SEQ_04: Your conversation with Nahanshe is interrupted by the arrival of a flustered Lanuhanu. He informs you that he was waylaid by Zulihali and the other young Hanu, who then stole the crate of feathers and are now holding them ransom until Nahanshe provides his answer. The unnerved Landsguard asks you and Lanuhanu to stall the group before rushing off to complete an unknown task. Lanuhanu then assures you that this is all part of the process, and bids you go to Zulihali to see the final results.
TEXT_KINGZC204_05084_SEQ_05: Nahanshe comes slightly later than the appointed time, and gives a heartfelt appeal, confessing regret over his past conduct and expressing a new appreciation of his duty. Impressed by this, Zulihali and Lanuhanu reveal that this was all a ruse meant to guide him along this path. While the Landsguard is confused at first, he accepts the lesson learned, and wishes to offer a prayer to Kixaihih before his departure. Lanuhanu asks you to wait at Ok'hanu for him to deliver newly blessed feathers.
TEXT_KINGZC204_05084_SEQ_06: As promised, Lanuhanu arrives with Nahanshe in tow. Both the Hanu and the Landsguard thank you for your role in this rite of passage, and Nahanshe looks forward to seeing the rest of Tural from a bright new perspective.
TEXT_KINGZC301_05085_SEQ_00:

TEXT_KINGZC301_05085_SEQ_01:
Movamuq has received an unusual request from her potsworn: to recruit a stranger to Earthenshire to fulfill some undisclosed task. She bids you speak with Anfroy, the artisan in question, to learn more of his plans.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZC301_05085_SEQ_02: For reasons yet to be made clear, Anfroy tasks you with learning all you can about the tastes of his Moblin caretaker. He suggests speaking with her fellow Moblins, hopeful they can shed light on what it is she holds dear.
TEXT_KINGZC301_05085_SEQ_03: You make your inquiries among the Earthenshire folk, and discover a few tidbits about Movamuq's personal preferences. Chief among these revelations is the fact that she likes Anfroy and his works, and dislikes anything that impedes either.
TEXT_KINGZC301_05085_SEQ_04: You divulge all to Anfroy, who divulges his own truth in turn: that he means to make a gift for Movamuq, to thank her for her long years of loyal service. Among the findings from your fact-finding mission, he believes he has discovered some hint as to what kind of present might please her most. Unable to call upon Movamuq's help in its crafting, he must continue to rely on yours.

Anfroy's interest has been piqued by Tarnotik's mention of the “treasure” that Movamuq carries close to her heart─a gift given to her by Anfroy in his younger years. He asks that you interrogate Tarnotik again to learn more.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZC302_05086_SEQ_02: Tarnotik knows no more about Movamuq's treasure, but he knows how you might learn more about it. He entrusts you with a toolbox that Movamuq requested he procure for her, and bids you deliver it to her─volunteering to help her find the materials he was unable to procure at the same time.
TEXT_KINGZC302_05086_SEQ_03: You speak with Movamuq, who reveals that her treasure is a ruby that Anfroy entrusted to her safekeeping after he scratched it, that none might know of his once shoddy handiwork. She means to make the jewel the centerpiece of a farewell present to Anfroy, and asks for your help in securing the remaining materials. First, she sends you back to Anfroy, to ensure that he is so focused on his own work that he will not learn of Movamuq's maneuvers.
TEXT_KINGZC302_05086_SEQ_04: You inform Anfroy of the identity of Movamuq's treasure, and that she has engaged your services in some secretive task. Inspired by the revelation, he bids you keep Movamuq occupied until his work is complete.
TEXT_KINGZC302_05086_SEQ_05: With Anfroy absorbed in his work, you return to Movamuq that she might begin hers in earnest.

Movamuq informs you that the crafting material she requires to complete Anfroy's leaving gift can be found near Many Fires, to the east of Earthenshire, before running as fast as her legs will carry her to that very place.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZC303_05087_SEQ_02: You meet with Movamuq by the aetheryte of Many Fires. She had ordered a length of leather cord from her usual supplier in Tuliyollal, but its delivery was delayed by the storm, leaving her with little option but to craft it herself. To this end, she asks you to slay one of the tegus that make their home in the Dewspun Bank, and bring her back its hide.
TEXT_KINGZC303_05087_SEQ_03: You slay a tegu and flay its skin. Satisfied with your work, you return to Movamuq who eagerly awaits your return.
TEXT_KINGZC303_05087_SEQ_04: Movamuq studies your tegu hide and declares it perfectly suited for her needs. The gathertask done, you return to Earthenshire to begin the craftytask.
TEXT_KINGZC303_05087_SEQ_05: On returning to Earthenshire, you find Movamuq in a blind panic. Anfroy is missing, and she knows not whither or wherefore he has gone.
TEXT_KINGZC304_05088_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Movamuq fears for the safety of her missing potsworn.
TEXT_KINGZC304_05088_SEQ_01:
Anfroy is missing, but Movamuq knows a means by which he might be found─following the graven arrows he once scratched into the walls of Earthenshire to escape the village unnoticed. It falls to you to seek out these arrows, and by them, Anfroy.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZC304_05088_SEQ_02: You find an arrow on the outer wall of the village. It points towards the northwest, where the next in the sequence is presumably placed.
TEXT_KINGZC304_05088_SEQ_03: You find a second arrow, which directs you out of the village to the west, into the Glostfired Bank. You head out to try to pick up Anfroy's trail.
TEXT_KINGZC304_05088_SEQ_04: You find Anfroy surrounded by hungry beasts, and cut them down moments before their jaws close around the terrified trinketmaker. Hopefully he remains none the worse for wear.
TEXT_KINGZC304_05088_SEQ_05: Anfroy thanks you for saving his life. He reveals that he was making his way to the Cracked Cistern in order to craft Movamuq's present when the fiends waylaid him, and asks that you meet him there.
TEXT_KINGZC304_05088_SEQ_06: In the Cracked Cistern, Anfroy gets to work crafting his farewell gift to Movamuq, though he fears how well she will receive it now that she knows of his unauthorized abscondment. He asks that you return to Earthenshire ahead of him, to put his helphand's concerns to bed.
TEXT_KINGZC304_05088_SEQ_07: Back in Earthenshire, Anfroy and Movamuq exchange their gifts, together with words of both gratitude and vitriol. Though their potpact is approaching its end, they will continue to bear the respect they share for each other in their hearts, and pass these feelings on to those who follow in their footsteps.
TEXT_KINGZC401_05089_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Movamuq is ready to move on.
TEXT_KINGZC401_05089_SEQ_01:
Following Anfroy's retirement, Movamuq finds herself temporarily without an artisan to assist, and so turns her attentions to the fielding of commissions for new pieces. It emerges that the patron patiently awaiting her presence at Many Fires is none other than your friend Nahanshe, so you go together to greet him.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZC401_05089_SEQ_02: Nahanshe explains that he has gathered all the materials needed to revitalize the Landsguard's uniforms, but their chief armorer has succumbed to an untimely injury. Thus has he been tasked with seeking the services of the artisan who originally designed and constructed the uniforms. Movamuq believes that said artisan now resides in the Cracked Cistern, and suggests you all go there to convince him to return from retirement.
TEXT_KINGZC401_05089_SEQ_03: At the Cracked Cistern, Anfroy reveals that you have already met the artisan in question: it is his old friend Rostand, the man who previously lent Anfroy his workshop. Movamuq fears he will refuse if she asks, but perhaps the famed artisan can be persuaded by you and Anfroy.
TEXT_KINGZC401_05089_SEQ_04: Though Rostand is reluctant to make the long journey to Tuliyollal, you convince him to make the shorter one to Ok'hanu, where you are sure your friends among the Hanuhanu will facilitate both the delivery of materials from the capital, and a suitable environment in which to work. You return to Nahanshe to seek his acceptance of this compromise.
TEXT_KINGZC401_05089_SEQ_05: Nahanshe gladly accepts the proposal, and urges you go to Ok'hanu to seek Lanuhanu's approval. So sure is he that it will be granted, Nahanshe makes for Tuliyollal, to arrange the transport of all the necessary materials.
TEXT_KINGZC401_05089_SEQ_06: With a little help from an adventurer's expert eye, Rostand rediscovers his confidence in his craft, and reconstructs the Landsguard's armor down to the minutest detail. In the fires of Rostand's forge are the bonds of friendship forged─between the artisan himself, the Landsguard, the Moblins, and the Hanuhanu. Anfroy stands ready to offer you his congratulations for the role you played in this.
TEXT_KINGZC401_05089_SEQ_07: Anfroy thanks you for your role in bridging the gap between Tuliyollal and the Cracked Cistern, Ok'hanu and Earthenshire. It is to the latter that he must return, to finish packing for his own journey across the many-faceted jewel that is Tural. A jewel that is ever being polished to a more glorious sheen by the efforts of selfless souls such as yourself.

TEXT_KINGZE304_05147_SEQ_01:
Kayamene comes to the realization that by taking the strange, white crystals from the Maw of Sansheya, she has put all Shaaloani in danger. She races to return her stolen stone to the Maw, and bids you follow suit as soon as you are able.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZE304_05147_SEQ_02: You find Kayamene crouched over Wesanpe, who was conducting his own investigation into the Maw when he came under attack from a pack of blue blobs. Though the stone Kayamene was carrying has driven them to the hills, she begs that you give chase and lay them low, lest they should set upon any other unsuspecting soul.
TEXT_KINGZE304_05147_SEQ_03: You find and dispatch the blue blobs with all haste. Your duty done, all that remains is to return to Sheshenewezi Springs to regroup with Kayamene.
TEXT_KINGZE304_05147_SEQ_04: Back in Sheshenewezi Springs, Kayamene recounts Neshtezi's tale to Wesanpe: of the ancient threat of the blue blobs, and of the stones which ward them away from the burning ceruleum they so crave. You vow to journey to Yowekwa Canyon to find more of the same stones, that Shaaloani may be safe from the blue beast and its minions once more.
TEXT_KINGZE401_05148_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Kayamene asks for your continued assistance in finding a way to counter the blue blobs' bane.
TEXT_KINGZE401_05148_SEQ_01:
As Neshtezi told it, the stones her ancestors placed in the Maw of Sansheya to ward away the blue blobs were mined from Yowekwa Canyon. Kayamene asks that you accompany her there to try to find more of the same stone.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZE401_05148_SEQ_02: You join Kayamene in the canyon and split up to search it for similar stones to the ones you found in the Maw.
TEXT_KINGZE401_05148_SEQ_03: On examining what appears to be a bone protruding from the sand, you find that it is in fact a calcified fossil that bears a striking resemblance to the warding stone. Kayamene will no doubt be curious to see what you have found.
TEXT_KINGZE401_05148_SEQ_04: Kayamene examines the fossil and remembers another old legend that provides a possible explanation for its blob-repelling properties. Alas, such fossils are few and far between, and mining them in sufficient quantities to keep her company's operations safe would require a significant outlay─one the overseer is unlikely to be willing to lay out. Zitekkwa, however, may prove more pliable.
TEXT_KINGZE401_05148_SEQ_05: You meet with Zitekkwa in the Hhusatahwi saloon. He is eager to hear more of Kayamene's proposal and heads downstairs to meet with her.
TEXT_KINGZE401_05148_SEQ_06: Feeling that he owes you a debt for your previous assistance, Zitekkwa agrees to finance the mining operation. Kayamene invites you both to Sheshenewezi Springs, that together, you might win over her parsimonious overseer.
TEXT_KINGZE401_05148_SEQ_07: After hearing the testimony of his two employees, the overseer reluctantly agrees that the blue blobs do indeed pose a threat to his company. However, it is Zitekkwa's prediction that they will pose a threat to all Shaaloani if left unchecked, together with his willingness to provide the funds necessary to see the mining operation established, that finally convinces him to agree to Kayamene's plan. While the others head inside to discuss the terms of Zitekkwa's loan, Kayamene remains behind to offer you a word of thanks for supporting her till the end.
TEXT_KINGZE401_05148_SEQ_08: Thanks to you, life in the wilds has become a little more livable. Perhaps one day, it will be a place where people can not merely survive, but thrive.

He would sooner starve himself than take another bite, but the Cornservant has an idea to please his selective palate. Using a generous helping of kernels from their own cob, the Cornservant creates popcorn, and it is love at first bite for the Milalla. Realizing now that foods should not always be taken at face value, the Milalla runs off to apologize to the outskirts' farmers.
TEXT_KINGZF006_05154_SEQ_03: Corn and its seemingly limitless potential has changed another life for the better. But the Cornservant's work is far from finished─not so long as there are more bellies to be fed.

TEXT_KINGZF201_05160_SEQ_01:
Nakente has asked you to look for Shaloaci, the young Shetona in charge of Yyupye's Halo. She was last seen walking alone up the hill to the east of the farm, and Nakente fears she may be in danger.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZF201_05160_SEQ_02: Thanks to you, Shaloaci has escaped a narrow brush with death. She will need further assistance if she is to get back on her feet, however.
TEXT_KINGZF201_05160_SEQ_03: The young Shetona is grateful for your help, but there is another she will need to thank: Nakente, the woman who sent you to find her. As you were planning to report back regardless, the two of you may return to the outskirts together.
TEXT_KINGZF201_05160_SEQ_04: After a thorough scolding from her aunty, Shaloaci explains the motive behind her recklessness: the yields at Yyupye's Halo have been dwindling steadily over the years, and the cause is unclear. Seeking an outsider's perspective, the two women have henceforth requested your cooperation in getting to the bottom of this mystery.
TEXT_KINGZF202_05161_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Shaloaci is ready to dig into the mystery.
TEXT_KINGZF202_05161_SEQ_01:
After a hearty meal, Shaloaci has invited you to Yyupye's Halo to get a closer look at the place─but first, Nakente would like to have a word with you in private.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZF202_05161_SEQ_02: Nakente explains to you her concerns for what unspoken anxieties Shaloaci may be struggling with. As an outsider, you are perhaps uniquely equipped to lend an ear, and so she asks that you try to broach the subject at some point during your investigation. With that agreed upon, she sends you on your way to Yyupye's Halo.
TEXT_KINGZF202_05161_SEQ_03: You rendezvous with Shaloaci just outside the farm. After asking for your honest impression, she decides that perhaps the issue lies in the ground beneath your feet. While she examines the fields to the east, you are to investigate those in the west and report back should you find anything amiss.
TEXT_KINGZF202_05161_SEQ_04: You inform Shaloaci of a strange crackling sound coming from underground, and the two of you set to digging. What you unearth is stranger still: a measurement device as well as a box containing a report from Yyupye, the founder of the farm─addressed to none other than Shaloaci herself! While she reads the rest of the report, your task is to go and inform Nakente of your new lead.
TEXT_KINGZF202_05161_SEQ_05: You apprise Nakente of the latest developments, but she admits she has no recollection of Yyupye, suggesting the founder is no longer among the living. In any case, the investigation will surely continue once Shaloaci has finished reading the report in its entirety.
TEXT_KINGZF203_05162_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Nakente has an idea of where Shaloaci might have gone.
TEXT_KINGZF203_05162_SEQ_01:
With Shaloaci nowhere to be seen, one can only assume she is still reading Yyupye's report. Nakente sends you to find her at the control tower, the young woman's favorite haunt.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZF203_05162_SEQ_02: Fortuitously, Shaloaci has finished reading the report by the time you arrive. It outlines a tentative countermeasure to protect the farmland, but will require the use of a specific device said to be located at Yyasulani Station. Rather than risk another solo venture, Shaloaci has asked you to accompany her there. Once your preparations have been made, you are to rendezvous at Yyupye's Halo.
TEXT_KINGZF203_05162_SEQ_03:
Yyasulani Station is no small hop from the outskirts. Given that Shaloaci has much to discuss along the way, however, the journey should be a breezy one.

※You must be accompanied by Shaloaci to complete this task. Speak with her again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGZF203_05162_SEQ_04: Upon arriving at Yyasulani Station, Shaloaci promptly retrieves the device from its storage location. Along with an overview of its function, she recounts to you the other things she learned from Yyupye's report─namely, that the farm was to be entrusted to the woman's daughter once she came of age. Needless to say, the implication is clear. As for what Shaloaci will do with this newfound knowledge, it seems not even she has the answer yet. For now, the two of you had best head home with your prize.
TEXT_KINGZF203_05162_SEQ_05: With Yyupye's transformer safely in hand, you and Shaloaci make the long journey back to the outskirts. The exorays remain to be dealt with, but for the time being, both of you could surely do with a good, long rest.
TEXT_KINGZF204_05163_SEQ_00:
 Quest Sync
Shaloaci is eager to mitigate the mushroom menace.
TEXT_KINGZF204_05163_SEQ_01:
Now that Nakente has been brought up to speed, an impassioned Shaloaci invites you to reconvene with her at the control tower. For the purposes of this exoray extermination, it seems there is one last thing you will need.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZF204_05163_SEQ_02: Newly outfitted with a communication device, you are now fully equipped to coordinate your efforts with Shaloaci's. Make your way to the fields of Yyupye's Halo and await further instructions.
TEXT_KINGZF204_05163_SEQ_03: Over the communicator, Shaloaci has steeled you for the fungal fight ahead. Once the exorays show themselves, you are to slay every last one of them, then repeat the process at the other side of the field. Hopefully by the time you have run out of mushrooms to crush, Shaloaci will be waiting for you near the bridge.
TEXT_KINGZF204_05163_SEQ_04: With the exorays routed, Nakente makes it clear that Shaloaci has every right to step down from managing Yyupye's Halo. But in finding the last traces of her mother, it seems the young Shetona has also found her confidence. In rising to the challenge of her new post, she has inherited both the farm and her mother's legacy.

TEXT_KINGZG010_05173_SEQ_01:
The power of corn is boundless, as demonstrated by the Conservant's appearance in Solution Nine. It has come in search of bellies needing nourishment, but there appear to be no rumbling stomachs anywhere to be found.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZG010_05173_SEQ_02: While the Cornservant's ear can hear no hungry stomachs in need of sustenance, they're confident that, if you venture about long enough, there is at least one to be found somewhere in Solution Nine.
TEXT_KINGZG010_05173_SEQ_03: You speak with several seemingly disgruntled citizens of Solution Nine, but none of their grievances have anything to do with hunger. The Cornservant is not one to be deterred, however, and so you continue your search.
TEXT_KINGZG010_05173_SEQ_04: After a little more searching, you come across a seemingly dejected woman all by herself. She admits to being hungry, but because she has lost her sense of taste, eating has become a chore she actively avoids. The Cornservant believes such a crisis calls for a special dish. After a brief moment of reflection, they are struck with inspiration and, within moments, conjure a most delectable taco. The woman takes a bite and is gripped by nostalgia that brings her sense of taste rushing back. She thanks both you and the Cornservant before taking her leave, promising to be better about her neglected diet.
TEXT_KINGZG010_05173_SEQ_05: The Cornservant not only helped another hungry soul in need but was at last able to be seen, which surely brought the ardent cob no small amount of joy. Even so, the world is vast, and there will always be more people who hunger for one thing or another. Thus, the Cornservant's journey will continue.

On the streets of Canal Town, you come across a young guide in a rather excitable state. Eager to share his tale, he explains how his last tour came to an abrupt end when his customers vanished from existence. Seemingly unwilling to leave the job unfinished, he invites you to take the tour instead, and bids you rendezvous with him by the Font of Devotion.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZH001_05174_SEQ_02: You find the tenacious tour guide by the fountain, where he delves into the myths surrounding the water feature. Armed with a few tidbits of knowledge, you head to the eastern side of Canal Town to see what else the young man has in store for you.
TEXT_KINGZH001_05174_SEQ_03: In the second half of the tour, you learn about the Font of Devotion─a much-loved location back in the resort's glory days. Pressing an old coin into your palm, the young guide encourages you to make a wish.
TEXT_KINGZH001_05174_SEQ_04: Channeling your wish into the timeworn coin, you cast it into the still pool of the fountain. The tour guide watches on, waiting to speak with you again.
TEXT_KINGZH001_05174_SEQ_05: The young man reveals that despite his many years as a guide before becoming an Endless, he never got the chance to make a wish of his own. Seizing the moment, he throws a coin into the font, where it sinks to rest beside yours. The guide thanks you for indulging him before fading out of existence, having finished his final tour.

You agree to help gather the outstanding medical history texts, and set off for the southern side of Canal Town to begin your search.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZH002_05175_SEQ_02: You successfully relocate the abandoned books, perusing a few paragraphs as you go. Clearly, a great deal of knowledge is contained in these three tomes alone. No doubt the archivist will be delighted to take receipt of the missing monographs.
TEXT_KINGZH002_05175_SEQ_03: With the texts back in her safekeeping, the Daguerreo archivist expounds upon the importance of documenting medical history. ※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZH003_05176_SEQ_02: Having skillfully deduced the girl's initial riddle, you discover the hidden clue next to a stack of crates by the entrance to Yesterland. You attempt to read between the lines as you ponder the next location.
TEXT_KINGZH003_05176_SEQ_03: The second riddle leads you to the starglass─more specifically, to one of the four streetlamps surrounding the plaza. Armed with another clue, you prepare to roam the deserted streets once again in search of the next hiding place.
TEXT_KINGZH003_05176_SEQ_04: After poring over the words of the third riddle, you end up amongst the shrubs behind an empty house. Time to see where the final clue leads.
TEXT_KINGZH003_05176_SEQ_05: You solve the final riddle with aplomb and rendezvous with the lively lass. Once you provide the correct password, she shares her thought process behind setting the clues and devising the game. The girl expresses her gratitude before bidding you a fond farewell─leaving you bereft of a playmate, but with a newfound sense of what Yesterland was to the Endless who called it home.

TEXT_KINGZH004_05177_SEQ_01:
In the now-desolate streets of Yesterland, you encounter a young boy looking for his brother. Perhaps disoriented by the present state of the city, he seems doubtful of his ability to conduct a thorough search alone. He bids you speak with him again should you be willing to assist.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZH004_05177_SEQ_02:
You agree to accompany the clever youngling, and together, make your way to the Bergmähr-Ring.

※You must be accompanied by the clever youngling to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGZH004_05177_SEQ_03: The merry-go-round stands still, and the once-teeming plaza is devoid of life─a stark contrast to the tales of fun and games the child is kind enough to share with you. With no sign of the missing brother, the pair of you head for the esperance wheels to continue the search.
TEXT_KINGZH004_05177_SEQ_04: You arrive at the motionless hulks of the esperance wheels, and yet again fail to find signs of the boy's brother. As your discussions stray from tales of youthful recklessness to ceruleum contraptions, the truth about his circumstances begins to dawn on the clever youngling. The look of consternation on his face prompts you to inquire further.
TEXT_KINGZH004_05177_SEQ_05: Hearing your news of the outside world, the boy seems to age before your very eyes. The news that his beloved brother is likely safe and sound rouses the boy─now an elderly man─prompting him to reflect upon his life inside the dome. Thankful and relieved, the man fades out of existence─his metaphorical search at an end.
TEXT_KINGZH005_05178_SEQ_00:

The restless Milalla is fearing the worst.
TEXT_KINGZH005_05178_SEQ_01:
You are accosted by a restless Milalla, who begs your assistance in rescuing defenseless animals from Matchlock Menagerie's hungry scorpions. Before you can ask any further questions, however, the Milalla darts off towards the menagerie, assuming you will not be far behind.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZH005_05178_SEQ_02: The Milalla is horrified to discover the volcanic scorpions stalking a pair of diminutive creatures. Unable to contain his emotions, he blindly charges towards the scorpions in hopes of deterring them, and you must seek him out before the worst comes to pass.
TEXT_KINGZH005_05178_SEQ_03: Though you swiftly slay the scorpions, the Milalla is frozen in fear, and requires a helping hand to jolt him back to reality.
TEXT_KINGZH005_05178_SEQ_04: As he regains his senses, the Milalla reports his good tidings─the small animals have escaped unharmed. Before he rushes on ahead to fetch them, he proposes the two of you continue your conversation back at the menagerie entrance.
TEXT_KINGZH005_05178_SEQ_05: Upon your return, the Milalla informs you of his previous life as a worker at the menagerie, and reveals that the scorpions were originally introduced as a means of recreating Alexandria's once-famous scorpion vodka. While he regrets what has become of the menagerie ever since, the Milalla finds some comfort in your efforts to rescue the surviving wildlife, and expresses his thanks to you before he departs.

You cross paths with a Milalla engineer who, despite a recent soak in Opal Springs, appears to be anything but relaxed. She begs your assistance in finding her lost blueprints, and hastily orders you to search the Arena of Valor in her stead.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZH006_05179_SEQ_02: At the Arena of Valor, you discover a set of documents describing the ins and outs of the Meso Terminal. You assume them to be the engineer's blueprints, though only her confirmation will prove whether they are the ones she seeks.
TEXT_KINGZH006_05179_SEQ_03: The engineer's eyes light up at the sight of the blueprints, and she confirms they are her prized possessions. She reveals herself as the mind behind the Meso Terminal's design, having once found inspiration in the parallels between Sphene and the Milalla's revered Speaker. She regards the blueprints as a symbol of her life's work, and hopes to spend her final moments basking in the terminal's presence before she fades from existence.

TEXT_KINGZH007_05180_SEQ_01:
While wandering the barren Windspath Gardens, you meet an elderly woman eager for you to join her on a stroll. She strides off ahead, asking you to reconvene by the bridge in Blooms of Discovery.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZH007_05180_SEQ_02: You find the amiable elder gazing out across the forlorn landscape. She starts to quiz you about the nation of Lindblum, but is evidently as fond of light exercise as she is discussing historical matters, and soon sets off again.
TEXT_KINGZH007_05180_SEQ_03: Another change of scenery, another question─this time concerning the weighty concept of nationhood. Having heard your response, the elder strides off, beckoning you to leynode aero.
TEXT_KINGZH007_05180_SEQ_04: In what proves to be the last portion of this roving excursion through the annals, the elder explains her personal ties to Lindblum before asking you to share your thoughts. Happy that her memories of Alexandria's much-maligned neighbor live on, she fades from existence with a contented smile.
TEXT_KINGZH008_05181_SEQ_00:

TEXT_KINGZH008_05181_SEQ_01:
You meet a young botanist still reeling from a frightful encounter with a fiend. The boy reveals that he was chased away while searching for plant specimens in an effort to emulate his hero. He asks you to brave the bushes in his stead, and bring back nepheletta fronds, irenaris leaves, and some banana leaves for his collection.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.
TEXT_KINGZH008_05181_SEQ_02: You manage to gather the requisite leaves. Time to head back to the Cleyra Museum of Nature and deliver the specimens to the youth.
TEXT_KINGZH008_05181_SEQ_03: The budding botanist thanks you profusely for helping him complete his collection. He goes on to share with you a wealth of knowledge gleaned from hours of diligent study, and reveals he once harbored a wish to travel far and wide, before poor health forced him to abandon his plans. Hearing your tales of adventure, however, reignites a flame within the boy, and he renews his vow to explore the world. When he fades from existence, his eyes are gleaming with unmistakable wonder.
TEXT_KINGYR301_05187_SEQ_00: The medicine merchant leers at you, his smile unnaturally wide.
TEXT_KINGYR301_05187_SEQ_01: A medicine merchant of dubious repute offers you coin in exchange for your services as a courier. Before you know it, a phial of precious liquid is in your hands, and the merchant's grin has taken on a hungry, expectant quality. Best to make your delivery and get this over with.
TEXT_KINGYR301_05187_SEQ_02: The Lalafellin gladiator receives you with unadulterated joy, babbling about the alleged transformational wonders of this medicine. He hands you a heavy sack of coin, making clear the reason for the merchant's wolfish grin─as well as the potential repercussions should the payment be found lacking.
TEXT_KINGYR301_05187_SEQ_03: The medicine merchant receives his payment with satisfaction and is readying your reward when he notices a burly Hyuran gladiator waving in your direction. Presumably his potion worked wonders─yet he denies any knowledge of the gladiator or his concoction's efficacy, urging you to try it for yourself instead. The blue phial winks up at you from your palm as you consider the endless possibilities that await...
TEXT_CHRHDB911_05192_SEQ_00: Looking rather lost herself, Nashu Mhakaracca has come west in search of the missing inspector.
TEXT_CHRHDB911_05192_SEQ_01: Following a lead from the pages of The Thavnairian Truth, Nashu Mhakaracca has come west in search of the once more involuntarily displaced inspector. Her tentative plan is to interrogate local residents for sightings of the errant starship in an attempt to divine the missing Manderville man's current location. To that end, she has handed you a visual aid─an illustration of said starship─and enlisted you to expand the range of the investigation. The Landsguard stationed at Brightploom Post may be best equipped to handle any questions regarding unusual airborne vessels.
TEXT_CHRHDB911_05192_SEQ_02: You have gathered some reliable starship sightings from the Landsguard. Nashu will wish to hear of your findings back at the markets.
TEXT_CHRHDB911_05192_SEQ_03: Although Nashu herself discovered little amongst the stalls of Bayside Bevy (aside from a taste for several local delicacies), she is impressed by your successful investigative efforts. Based on the information provided by the city guard, you move your search northwards to the dome-enclosed Heritage Found.
TEXT_CHRHDB911_05192_SEQ_04: Having arrived in the location where the starship supposedly went down, Nashu suggests shifting the focus to tracking down the inspector himself. Surely one of the residents has sighted your gentlemanly quarry?
TEXT_CHRHDB911_05192_SEQ_05: One resident of the outskirts insists that no man of Hildibrand's description would have escaped his notice in such a tight-knit community. Enamored by the suggestion to seek the inspector in “Solution” Nine, Nashu immediately makes her way over to the mechanical sentry at the tower's entrance.
TEXT_CHRHDB911_05192_SEQ_06: The sentry verifies your unlimited access to Everkeep, but sounds the alarm upon detecting materials of an explosive nature upon Nashu's person. Her subsequent nonsensical explanation appears to overload the logic circuits of every nearby unit, allowing you to enter Solution Nine without further challenge.
TEXT_CHRHDB911_05192_SEQ_07: Nashu reasons that the best way to find the inspector is to locate an ongoing case, for that is where a gentlemanly agent of enquiry is most likely to be. You head off to True Vue, the liveliest part of town, to ask after any potential incidents or mysteries.
TEXT_CHRHDB911_05192_SEQ_08: Your inquiries are met with the news of a recent theft which, conveniently for you, occurred not far from where you now stand. This sounds like just the kind of case Nashu was hoping for.
TEXT_CHRHDB911_05192_SEQ_09: Nashu, too, has heard the details of the robbery, and you both head off to the scene of the crime. There you witness the detective work of a man who very much resembles Inspector Hildibrand, though his garb and speech seem that of an entirely different person. Nashu is nevertheless confident that he is the missing inspector, theorizing that the man's ungentlemanly manner is the result of shock from the crash. Although adamant that a healthy dose of her “medicine” will put him to rights, she heeds your call for restraint and settles for following the man in the overcoat from a distance...for now.
TEXT_CHRHDB911_05192_SEQ_10: After foiling Nashu's first attempt to “treat” him, the man in the overcoat denies being any sort of gentleman inspector, instead introducing himself as Detective Hardiboiled. While a second round of treatment (this time disguised as a hard-boiled egg) confirms the characteristic uncanny Manderville indestructibility, his pulpy demeanor nevertheless remains unchanged. This fact, along with the physical resemblance, leads you to suspect he shares a soul with the Hildibrand of the Source. Though confused and a little disappointed, Nashu concedes that you likely have the wrong man. The detective, for his part, is intrigued by your talk of a missing person, and Nashu eagerly accepts his offer to work on the case.
TEXT_CHRHDB911_05192_SEQ_11: Nashu opts to curtail her own investigations for a time, still feeling overwhelmed by the futuristic city of Solution Nine. It seems you are free to return to your usual activities until Detective Hardiboiled makes a break in the case.
TEXT_KINGSF101_05239_SEQ_00: This railroad employee is come to Tuliyollal in search of you.
TEXT_KINGSF102_05240_SEQ_00: Nitowikwe is excited to tell you the good news.
TEXT_KINGSF103_05241_SEQ_00: Wawlika has a message to share with you.
TEXT_KINGWK101_05253_SEQ_00: An oddly dressed Loporrit seeks long-eared leads.
TEXT_KINGWK101_05253_SEQ_01: The crimson-garbed Loporrit, Namingway, explains that when he was sent to study Etheirys over a hundred years ago, his survey pod suffered critical damage, leaving him stranded with no way of contacting Bestways Burrow. Only recently did he arrive in Old Sharlayan, pursuing rumors of Loporrit sightings, and he is elated to discover the recent advent of moon travel. After directing him to the Tower of Babil, you agree to meet him in Mare Lamentorum so that he might be greeted by a familiar face upon arrival.
TEXT_KINGWK101_05253_SEQ_02: After quite some time trudging through frozen fields and past defunct magitek, Namingway arrives to meet you in Mare Lamentorum. Together, you enter Bestways Burrow, where he is promptly spotted─and interrogated─by Searchingway and the other Loporrits. The revelation that Etheirys need no longer be evacuated comes as a massive shock to Namingway, but Searchingway encourages him to repurpose his skills for a different project: the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. Lured by the prospect of uncharted frontiers, both he and you agree to take part.
TEXT_KINGWK101_05253_SEQ_03: Searchingway explains that the Cosmic Exploration Initiative is headquartered some distance away. Fortunately, you may enlist the aid of Drivingway to be shuttled safely to the base.
TEXT_KINGWK101_05253_SEQ_04:
You and Namingway ride the moon rover to the Moongate Hub, where you are welcomed by an eager Searchingway. He has much to tell you about the current state of the project and the assistance he hopes each of you will offer.

※You can now travel to the Moongate Hub by speaking with Drivingway in Bestways Burrow.
TEXT_KINGWK101_05253_SEQ_05: Searchingway shares that the Cosmic Exploration Initiative is run by a diverse crew of volunteers, from Loporrits to Sharlayan academics. Together, the team must construct a vessel for interplanetary travel, the facilities necessary to house and maintain such a vessel, and other machinery required for the exploration of unknown stars. While Namingway is directed to pursue his passion of assigning appellations, Searchingway gives you an exotablet with which to stay apprised of the latest developments and requisitions, and suggests you find missions to participate in as you explore the base.
TEXT_KINGWK102_05254_SEQ_00: Searchingway is pleased with the initiative's stellar progress.
TEXT_KINGWK102_05254_SEQ_01: Having set you loose in the Moongate Hub with your exotablet and an instruction to “Go forth,” Searchingway is understandably curious as to your progress. Moments after you give a brief report on your activities, Namingway arrives, eager to share his newly crafted nomenclature in situ.
TEXT_KINGWK102_05254_SEQ_02:
When you indicate your willingness to hear more, Namingway urges you to accompany him first to the starship launch area, whence you will surely be guided hither and thither across Sinus Ardorum.

※You must be accompanied by Namingway to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGWK102_05254_SEQ_03: You visit the fully constructed Galactic Way with Namingway in tow. Relishing the opportunity to recount the inspiration behind his creative choices, he dives into an explanation of the ship's propulsion system and its aspirational name.
TEXT_KINGWK102_05254_SEQ_04: Your next destination is Gleamslope, so named in hopes that its sparkle will be visible during journeys to other stars. Notably, the tunnel that passes through it was carved without the use of magic, partly due to the magnetic interference in Sinus Ardorum, but also to test the efficacy of such a method on stars with limited aether.
TEXT_KINGWK102_05254_SEQ_05: Last on your tour is Weddingway's Bower, a botanical garden lush with crossbred plants. Naturally, Namingway is prepared to explain the appellation given to each in greater detail, should anything in particular stand out to you.
TEXT_KINGWK102_05254_SEQ_06: As your eyes scan over the hodgepodge garden, Namingway imparts tidbits of interest for each lunar species. From mycophlox to the sabotended, each has been lovingly─if somewhat eclectically─named.
TEXT_KINGWK102_05254_SEQ_07:
Having completed your tour of Sinus Ardorum's sights, you and Namingway report to Searchingway. He offers to guide you to one final vista─one overlooking the entire Moongate Hub. There, he confesses that the resolution of the Final Days left him unmoored from purpose, as it did many other Loporrits, but the scholars of Old Sharlayan inspired him to follow his curious heart. It was this epiphany that gave rise to the Cosmic Exploration Initiative and its headquarters, where a fully functional starship is now in want only of a destination...

The next quest will be available once you have completed 100 stellar missions in Sinus Ardorum. You may undertake missions and other cosmic exploration tasks from your exotablet.
TEXT_CHRHDB921_05295_SEQ_00: Nashu Mhakaracca's expression is equal parts consternation and anticipation.
TEXT_CHRHDB921_05295_SEQ_01: As if awaiting his cue, Hardiboiled appears just as you approach the anxiously awaiting Nashu. The detective's search for the missing Hildibrand has proven unsuccessful, but after encouraging you to retell the tale of your journey thus far, he pounces on the idea of tracking down the starship instead. To that end, you make your way over to the residential sector, hoping to interview older natives of your world who may have witnessed the original crash landing.
TEXT_CHRHDB921_05295_SEQ_02: Nashu produces a copy of the starship illustration─complete with her own hand-drawn portrait of Inspector Hildibrand─to aid in your investigation. As she only has one other copy for herself, she insists that you share yours with Detective Hardiboiled.
TEXT_CHRHDB921_05295_SEQ_03:
The detective is eager to begin questioning the park-goers. He suggests showing Nashu's picture to older Hyune and Hhetsarro that might have originally hailed from outside the dome.

※You must be accompanied by Hardiboiled to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_CHRHDB921_05295_SEQ_04: Despite your best efforts to jog their memories, the elder residents are unable to help you in your search. Hardiboiled is unwilling to give up, however, and directs you towards a Shetona man he spotted heading towards the 9-14 radius.
TEXT_CHRHDB921_05295_SEQ_05: As fortune might have it, the Shetona gentleman recalls the exact moment he saw the flying disc crashing down somewhere in Yuweyawata, to the north. Armed with this new information, you and the detective set off to find Nashu.
TEXT_CHRHDB921_05295_SEQ_06: You realize some method of transportation is required in order to cross the lake and reach Yuweyawata on the other side. Hardiboiled soon solves this problem by contacting a reforger acquaintance at the driftdowns who is willing to lend you the use of her hover cargo.
TEXT_CHRHDB921_05295_SEQ_07:
You board the hover cargo and venture across the lake to Yuweyawata. Hardiboiled stands in the entrance to the research facility, taking in the gloomy interior.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the accommodating reforger at the driftdowns.
TEXT_CHRHDB921_05295_SEQ_08: Satisfied that the place is relatively free of roaming threats, Hardiboiled urges you to take a look around. Somewhere in the mess and debris of the facility may be found a clue as to what became of the starship.
TEXT_CHRHDB921_05295_SEQ_09: A series of confidential records helps you piece together the story of the starship's discovery and the subsequent experiments performed upon its comatose─yet miraculously unharmed─occupant. Believing you have found Inspector Hildibrand's last known location, you set out to find Detective Hardiboiled and share your promising lead.
TEXT_CHRHDB921_05295_SEQ_10:
Verification key in hand, Hardiboiled leads you to the room where the researchers have been preserving Hildibrand in a specimen capsule. Rather than fuss with finding a manual to open this advanced containment unit, however, an explosive egg proffered by Nashu suffices to at last reunite you with the indomitable inspector.

Hildibrand seems none the worse for wear after three decades of hibernation. Hardiboiled marvels at the inspector's still youthful appearance, not to mention his taming of the zombie horde drawn by the commotion, but there appears to be no love lost between the hard-bitten detective and the gentlemanly agent of enquiry. Differences (and similarities) aside, Hardiboiled is nonetheless willing to share the details of the new case he stumbled across within the ominous facility.
TEXT_CHRHDB922_05296_SEQ_00: Detective Hardiboiled's veteran nose has picked up the scent of a new case.
TEXT_CHRHDB922_05296_SEQ_01:
Inspector's Log:
To what far-flung shores have I found myself flung this time? Well, irregardless of inexplicable intergalactic travel (or rather more local jaunts), I, Hildibrand, agent of enquiry, inspector extraordinaire, have made my triumphant return! After emerging from a slumber of thirty some-odd years, I have made the acquaintance of a man purported to be my twin from another world─an assertion I am inclined to push back against, given the man's somewhat surly disposition. However, like yours truly, he appears possessed of a sincere desire to solve mysteries and redress the wrongs of the world, so for now, let us see if a partnership may yet be forged!
　　　　　　　　　　　　*　*　*
Detective Hardiboiled shares the details of the new mystery he stumbled across: an ominous tale of ghoulish experiments and suspiciously empty specimen cages. A researcher who survived the zombification of his peers has continued their work in secret, imbuing monsters with the souls of criminals marked for “rehabilitation.” Hoping to recover more data from the battered storage device he discovered, Hardiboiled invites you to his domicile in the recreation zone of Solution Nine. The Case of the Fiendish Fugitives has begun...
TEXT_CHRHDB922_05296_SEQ_02: Although the device was more damaged than anticipated, Hardiboiled was able to piece together a partial file on one of the criminal subjects. It seems a habitual thief now inhabits the body of an eyeclops and, judging by past tendencies, is likely engaging in acts of larceny primarily to inconvenience and infuriate. The detective reasons that as electrope is Alexandria's most critical resource, then the quarry in Heritage Found would be too tempting a target to ignore. Perhaps someone at Electrope Strike knows something that could help with your investigation.
TEXT_CHRHDB922_05296_SEQ_03: A helpful quarry worker confirms that someone has indeed been stealing raw electrope shipments and happily agrees to provide bait to snare the thief. All appears to be proceeding to plan, but upon spotting you lurking with intent to ambush, the wary eyeclops flees before the trap can be sprung.
TEXT_CHRHDB922_05296_SEQ_04: Despite giving immediate chase, you lose the thief in a field dominated by towering eyeclopes. Eyeclopses. Eyeclopsi...? Detective Hardiboiled─firmly in the “eyeclopes” camp─suggests you split up and approach the brutes, noting that the criminal in question has a cowardly reputation. Find the one that does not attempt to squish you on sight, and you will have surely found your man-in-a-monster.
TEXT_CHRHDB922_05296_SEQ_05: You locate the thief masquerading as a wild eyeclops, but are once again left choking in the dust kicked up by his impressive escape velocity. Did Nashu see which way he went? Only one way to find out.
TEXT_CHRHDB922_05296_SEQ_06: Hardiboiled and Hildibrand corner the eyeclops thief. Following a tense standoff during which the detective and the inspector display their very different approaches to apprehending criminals, the eyeclops is convinced to surrender. He also volunteers what little information he knows of the researcher who not only transferred his soul into his monstrous body, but also coerced him into stealing the electrope. Satisfied that you have learned all there is to learn, Hardiboiled bids you wait for him at his place, then leaves to deliver the thief to the authorities.
TEXT_CHRHDB922_05296_SEQ_07: Back in Solution Nine, Hardiboiled muses over the researcher mastermind's possible motivations and the other monsters undoubtedly in his employ. These fugitive flunkies will be trying to avoid detection, possibly even operating outside the dome's confines. Admitting his unfamiliarity with the outside world, the detective asks for your continued assistance with the case─a request which Hildibrand is only too pleased to answer. Hardiboiled also alludes to a former nemesis known as the “Crime King,” who may very well have been part of the researcher's ersatz rehabilitation program. Eager to return to pulling data from the storage device, the hard-bitten gumshoe bids you drop in the next time you are in the neighborhood...
TEXT_KINGZA101_05307_SEQ_00: This usually chipper cob of corn looks oddly consternated.
TEXT_KINGZA101_05307_SEQ_01: You find the Cornservant in a most unusual predicament. While normally overeager to tend to the hungry bellies of Tuliyollal, they sense a stomach so ravenous, they dare not approach it alone. In your company, however, they have courage to carry out their duty. Not wishing to press you into action, they humbly await your readiness at the pier.
TEXT_KINGZA101_05307_SEQ_02: Together with the Cornservant, you set off for Bayside Bevy. You can only wonder what manner of famished individual could leave your corny companion feeling so daunted.
TEXT_KINGZA101_05307_SEQ_03:
After some concentration, the Cornservant discovers the troubled belly belongs to a seemingly harmless Pelupelu merchant. No sooner do you speak with him, however, than he doubles over, professing a great hunger for blood.
