Namingway cannot help but broach a subject that has gone unaddressed: the matter of the Nagylvi's physical forms, which have yet to be discovered... Or have they? According to the terminal bud, those remaining on Auxesia rooted themselves into the earth and became one with the forest. In their newly immobile forms, however, they were powerless to prevent overgrowth consuming the star's remaining aether, and may well have perished were it not for the timely intervention of the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. As far as major revelations go, this is indisputably one to share with Searchingway.
TEXT_KINGWK402_05484_SEQ_08: Searchingway is all but speechless when he learns that his crew of humble explorers has unwittingly saved the Nagylvi from extinction. The bud, however, insists that the true boon was your determination to learn more of them. It is great comfort─to many present, it would seem─that civilizations, too, may live on in others' hearts and minds. To that end, the initiative shall strive for ever greater understanding of the Nagylvi, and perhaps yet further exploration across the stars...
TEXT_KINGWK403_05485_SEQ_00: Searchingway seems concerned about whatever concerns Namingway. How concerning.
TEXT_KINGWK403_05485_SEQ_01: With the analysis of Grandma Laurel as yet ongoing, Searchingway would make an altogether different request of you. He reveals that Namingway is to embark on some manner of undertaking which would benefit greatly from your assistance. For the exact details, however, you will need to seek out the Loporrit in question.
TEXT_KINGWK403_05485_SEQ_02: That Namingway originally crash-landed upon Etheirys is known to you. That the wreckage of said crash yet remains in the peaks of Gyr Abania, however, is a matter you hadn't much cause to consider until just now, with the loquacious Loporrit's insistence that you recover it. Alas, with the passage of a hundred years, Namingway can no longer recall precisely where his survey pod was abandoned, save that a certain quarrying town was nearby. He bids you join him in the search, and to that end, you must both make the long journey to Ala Gannha.
TEXT_KINGWK403_05485_SEQ_03: Arriving in Ala Gannha, Namingway is surprised to find the town so devoid of people, as his frame of reference is based in the Autumn War of a century past. As he recalls, it was a group of young children who helped him to bury the survey pod, but after so many years, he cannot be sure they yet live. Your only recourse is to ask the locals in the event that someone has stumbled upon the wreckage by chance.
TEXT_KINGWK403_05485_SEQ_04: Speaking with the residents of Ala Gannha, you learn that the erstwhile Garlean occupation is still felt keenly. With large swaths of land wholly uninhabited, anything buried is like to go undiscovered...and even if it were stumbled upon, the fear of magitek would surely compel the locals to leave it well alone. For one man, however, the sight of Namingway brings to mind the traditional Ala Gannha quarrying song─specifically the children's variant, featuring lyrics about a rabbit from the moon.
TEXT_KINGWK403_05485_SEQ_05: Namingway, too, has caught wind of this curious children's song, yet it seems no one here can produce the lyrics. Seeing as a portion of the population relocated to Ala Ghiri over the years, perhaps you shall have to take your inquiry there.
TEXT_KINGWK403_05485_SEQ_06: Arriving in Ala Ghiri, your crimson-garbed companion soon draws the attention of a middle-aged merchant named Sewal. His grandparents used to sing for him a nursery song about “Namingway the Red,” and as your luck would have it, he can recite both verses─with all their pointed clues intact. When Namingway explains his objective, Sewal requests to join in the search, to aid the Loporrit as in generations past.
TEXT_KINGWK403_05485_SEQ_07: As indicated by the second verse, the three of you approach the river to the east of Ala Gannha, where stands a makeshift rock “gate” and, beyond it, distinctly castle-like ruins. If the song's lyrics are to be believed, here is where the search begins in earnest.
TEXT_KINGWK403_05485_SEQ_08: Crossing the river and through the “gate,” the three of you poke at dirt piles until you happen upon a mound through which suspiciously Loporrit-esque metal prongs poke out. After some dedicated digging, sure enough, you uncover Namingway's long-lost survey pod, miraculously undisturbed after a hundred years. With the search thus concluded, Sewal bids you both farewell, leaving you to make arrangements for the retrieval. It can wait until you have returned to Auxesia, however.
TEXT_KINGWK403_05485_SEQ_09: After Searchingway promises to have the wreckage retrieved, Namingway reminisces on all of his accomplishments since returning to Bestways Burrow. Names, he explains, are gifts to be shared, bearing sentiment as well as purpose─and his purpose has been fulfilled through the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. He expects to stay on for some time yet, savoring the reunion with his fellow Loporrits, but hopes that you might be available for a new adventure with him someday.
TEXT_KINGWZ401_05486_SEQ_00: Mumukko seeks idle hands to handle animals.
TEXT_KINGWZ401_05486_SEQ_01: Due to the ongoing analysis of Grandma Laurel taking precedence over all else, the other fields of research are in dire need of support. Seizing upon your free time, Mumukko requests that you assist with the study of interstellar dhalmels.
TEXT_KINGWZ401_05486_SEQ_02: According to the exozoologist, the dhalmels are equipped with biometric scanners in order to monitor how well they adapt to an alien environment. You are tasked with observing the beastkin's behavior, documenting the scanners' output, then reporting back.
TEXT_KINGWZ401_05486_SEQ_03: You take note of three different specimens: one that appears to be ravenously hungry, despite the presence of edible plants; one whose scanner has recorded a bowel movement, yet naught but a foul odor remains; and one who seems perfectly healthy. The latter notwithstanding, it would seem prudent to report back to the researcher.
TEXT_KINGWZ401_05486_SEQ_04: The exozoologist agrees to feed the hungry dhalmel and explains that the foul odor you detected, and indeed the bowel movement recorded on the biometric scanner, was likely little more than misidentified flatulence. However, this proves that the research equipment, no matter how helpful, is not enough to fully monitor the dhalmels. In the interest of furthering an interstellar menagerie, Mumukko must be notified posthaste.
TEXT_KINGWZ401_05486_SEQ_05: You pass along the dhalmel researcher's concerns, and Mumukko agrees to recruit some manner of on-site supervisor. After all, this field of study began during construction of the Ragnarok and will surely contribute to its legacy. Not only that, but Mumukko is mindful of what this research, and all others pursued on Auxesia, will communicate to the Nagylvi. Rest assured she shall be weighing the initiative's next steps carefully.
TEXT_KINGWZ402_05487_SEQ_00: It is time Mumukko took things into her own idle hands.
TEXT_KINGWZ403_05488_SEQ_00: The lively Loporrit fears break time has gone on overlong.
TEXT_KINGWZ404_05489_SEQ_00: Theorizingway is eager to meet more erudite guests.
TEXT_KINGWZ404_05489_SEQ_01: Theorizingway has sent out fresh invitations to Studium members who were regrettably unable to attend the previous field trip. Together, the two of you welcome Rurusha, Jude, and Hinageshi to the Timberlodge, each of them modest contributors to the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. Though theirs is an independent tour, you are nevertheless requested to keep an eye on them and answer questions as they arise.
TEXT_KINGWZ404_05489_SEQ_02: The tour's first destination is the Rooting Towerling. Having studied the ambient aether of a fair few destination candidates during his time assisting with the Phaenna Stellascope, Jude has a strong interest in the confluence the tower serves to generate. Rurusha, too, is impressed─both that the forces of nature were so expertly manipulated to suit a civilization's own ends, and that her contributed technology has gone on to analyze ruins on Auxesia as well as Oizys.
TEXT_KINGWZ404_05489_SEQ_03: The tour heads next to New Growth City, where Hinageshi is keen to examine Auxesia through an anthropological lens. Based on the style of architecture, particularly the resin glass windows evocative of greenhouses, she identifies the region as an erstwhile residential district. Yet though their fields may differ, Rurusha and Jude are no less impassioned to pursue their own angles of investigation. It seems someone must inform Theorizingway that the tour will continue a while longer.
TEXT_KINGWZ404_05489_SEQ_04: Rurusha, Jude, and Hinageshi return to the Timberlodge with full many thoughts regarding Auxesia. It wasn't until she arrived that Rurusha fully grasped the city's magnitude, but as she explains it, the inspired feelings of awe and wonder have made her feel like a fledgling researcher all over again. Hinageshi, too, is grateful to have had this experience, as she suspects there could be many and more civilizations lurking just under the surface of the ruins, and the thought is an energizing one for her future research. As for Jude, he expresses his amazement at setting foot upon a star he personally helped to locate. His mind turns to the possibility of similar stars with slumbering populations, and it is a newfound appreciation for that passion toward the unknown which he shall take home with him. The field of interstellar studies has come a long way, and so Rurusha proposes a meeting with Debroye and Professor T'laqa to discuss the potential of a new faculty at the Studium─one which will surely attract eager academics from every subject under the sun.
TEXT_KINGKW301_05502_SEQ_00: Lydirceil has something to discuss with you.
TEXT_KINGKW301_05502_SEQ_01:
Lydirceil informs you that Gerolt has some concerns regarding your phantom weapon─possibly relating to the weaponsmith's ambitious plans to merge ancient methods with his own homegrown techniques. Curiosity piqued, you prepare to present your weapon to Gerolt for inspection.
※Please note this quest cannot be abandoned via the journal. If you wish to abandon the quest, you may do so at any time by speaking with Lydirceil.
TEXT_KINGKW301_05502_SEQ_02: After a brief examination of your phantom weapon, Gerolt concludes that his worries were, alas, warranted. Taking a moment to remind all present of the enhancement process thus far, he reveals that the island's aether─from which your weapon derives its power─is actually limiting the potential for further improvements due to its volatile, illusory nature. Thankfully, it would seem he has a plan to overcome this flaw. Rather less thankfully, Gerolt insists you /congratulate him on this breakthrough before he shares any further details.
TEXT_KINGKW301_05502_SEQ_03:
Buoyed by your acknowledgement, Gerolt describes how your phantom weapon has been inadvertently bound by a complex illusion, thereby limiting its power. His plan is thus: to remove its glamour-like shroud using the Archive's magical knife, which just so happens to have illusion-dispelling properties. To prepare the blade for the task, you are called upon to procure a variety of essential supplies and deliver them to the weaponsmith when ready.

Monarch whetstone: seek a trader in the markets of Tuliyollal.
Ancestral alloy ingot, ascendant twine, and majestic polish: craft using the relevant recipe or purchase from the market board.

※Should you choose to craft the three items listed above, you will need to have obtained the Master Recipe XII tomes of the Disciples of the Hand.
TEXT_KINGKW301_05502_SEQ_04: As you hand Gerolt the supplies, he declares his wish for a quick tipple to prevent any knife-honing mishaps. Doubts about the efficacy of rum in this context notwithstanding, you resolve to speak with the weaponsmith again.
TEXT_KINGKW301_05502_SEQ_05: With quenched thirst─and surprisingly steady hands─Gerolt soon hones the blade to perfection. With the knife's physical form thus prepared, the next step will be to enhance its dispelling magicks. No doubt much work yet awaits...
TEXT_KINGKW302_05503_SEQ_01:
As the group discuss how to enhance the Archive's knife and its magical properties, Gerolt reveals that the process will require potent catalysts akin to glamour dispellers. Hearing this, Brigid suggests you utilize several different “phantom dispellers”─unique prisms found only at sites of intense battle. Predictably, the arduous task of collecting these mysterious trinkets for Gerolt falls to you.

The three varieties of phantom dispellers required can be obtained from FATEs and critical encounters on the Occult Crescent's North Horn, excluding the Forked Tower: Blood and the Forked Tower: Magic.

Phantom dispellers are also obtainable by completing certain duties via the Duty Roulette:

Phantom dispellers α: High-level Dungeons
Phantom dispellers β: Trials
Phantom dispellers γ: Normal Raids

※Speak to Lydirceil if you wish to abandon this quest.
TEXT_KINGKW302_05503_SEQ_02: Having braved myriad battles, you return to Gerolt with a pack full of phantom dispellers. Though the Archive's knife is swiftly imbued with the strange prisms, the weaponsmith deems it necessary to test the blade before proceeding further. For Lydirceil, this involves being equipped with glamoured, fire-resistant gear, attacked with the “Phantom Philleter”─as Gerolt has dubbed the knife─and set alight with a gout of arcane flame from Brigid's orb. Much to everyone's relief, the blade dispels the illusion, leaving the fire resistance intact and Lydirceil's armor somehow lighter than ever before. With the Phantom Philleter's capabilities indisputably proven, the time has come to turn its scintillating point on your phantom weapon.
TEXT_KINGKW303_05504_SEQ_00:
A surprisingly unsinged Lydirceil is eager to proceed.
※Changing classes or jobs will prevent progress during this quest.
TEXT_KINGKW303_05504_SEQ_01:
Though Lydirceil is keen to see your phantom weapon stripped of its illusory trappings, Gerolt is already having misgivings. Despite the success of the previous test, the weaponsmith divulges that he noticed a slight aetherial imbalance in Lydirceil's armor resulting from the Phantom Philleter. Leery of leaving the issue unaddressed, Gerolt resolves to rebuild the core of your weapon and thus counteract any discrepancies. Sadly, this requires three chunks of ecliptic arcanite, and, presumably, a significant outlay of tomestones. Once you have completed the transaction, Dodokkuli will be waiting to receive the ore for initial processing.

※You may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

※Chunks of ecliptic arcanite can be obtained from Ermina in the phantom village.
TEXT_KINGKW303_05504_SEQ_02: The diminutive metallurgist deftly completes his preparations and hands the processed ore to Gerolt. Brandishing the knife with enthusiasm, the grizzled weaponsmith slices through the illusion wreathing your phantom weapon. Although the weapon's true form has been revealed, Gerolt is determined to “squeeze every last drop o' potential” out of his creation, and bids you channel memories of battle into it to help him achieve his vision. Exactly what he means by this, however, remains to be seen...
TEXT_KINGKW304_05505_SEQ_00:
Lydirceil appears somewhat flummoxed by Gerolt's latest idea.
※Changing classes or jobs will prevent progress during this quest.
TEXT_KINGKW304_05505_SEQ_01:
Puzzled as to what Gerolt means by channeling memories into the phantom weapon, Lydirceil presses the weaponsmith for details. Gerolt's thinking is thus: an armament's true power is unleashed through the process of acclimatization between weapon and wielder, whereby imperfections are overcome and quirks mastered. Your phantom weapon, however, is utterly flawless, which obviates the need for acclimatization, but also precludes the benefits this brings. By utilizing your martial memories, he hopes to reverse engineer this process, allowing your phantom weapon to attain its ultimate potential. According to Brigid, only the most recent of memories will suffice, and thus you find yourself bound for distant battlegrounds once again.

The memories themselves are to be stored in a currently empty knowledge crystal given to you by Dodokkuli. Once it is filled to the brim, Gerolt can begin the long-awaited final phase of enhancement.

You may use the knowledge crystal to gauge your progress and verify which duties and field operations are applicable.

※You may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

※Speak to Lydirceil if you wish to abandon this quest.
TEXT_KINGKW304_05505_SEQ_02:
After generating a multitude of martial memories, you deliver the knowledge crystal to Gerolt, who uses some spare ecliptic arcanite to ensure the memories bind correctly. From here, Brigid takes over, completing the process with aplomb, and adjusting your armament's attributes to your exact specifications. After countless errands, experiments, and life-endangering forays into the wilds near and far, your phantom weapon has finally attained its pinnacle of potency. This unique facet of the isle's arcane environment and your very own recollections will no doubt serve you faithfully in battles to come. Should you wish to further tinker with its properties, Brigid will be glad to oblige.

※To unlock the next quest, you must complete the sidequest “Wisdom's End.”
TEXT_KINGKW305_05506_SEQ_00: Lydirceil is planning a spot of revelry.
TEXT_KINGKW305_05506_SEQ_01: To mark the expedition's conclusion and the completion of your phantom weapon, Lydirceil proposes a modest celebration. As Gerolt relishes the prospect of more reckless rum-drinking, and Dodokkuli envisions a slightly less rambunctious affair, Ermina strolls over, announcing that the House of Splendors will cover all expenses. Leaving you somewhat stunned by this display of generosity, she bids you wait while she makes the necessary preparations.
TEXT_KINGKW305_05506_SEQ_02: With the group gathered around an improvised table laden with food and drink, Ermina congratulates you on your endeavors, going on to reveal some unexpectedly fortuitous news: after all his hard work on the phantom weapon, Gerolt's debts are no more. Freed from his contractual obligations to the House of Splendors, the cantankerous weaponsmith rejoices in the thought of peddling his newly acquired techniques to anyone but Rowena. Alas, Ermina is quick to remind him of the unfortunate truth. Far from being a source of future income, Gerolt's new skills will be rendered useless the moment he leaves the isle─a fact corroborated by the Archive, somewhat worse for wear after a cup of rum too many. In his desperation, Gerolt seizes upon the idea of using the Phantom Philleter on himself, but soon comes to regret this utterance when the Archive turns on him, knife in shaking hand... Though you could happily watch the drunken tonberry chase Gerolt around the phantom village for hours on end, it seems Lydirceil would have a final word with you.
TEXT_KINGKW305_05506_SEQ_03: Lydirceil informs you that despite the Archive's best efforts, his knife was not capable of resolving Gerolt's problem. Unsurprisingly, the weaponsmith is truly crestfallen and plans to linger on the Occult Crescent─unwilling to relinquish his hard-won skills just yet. Reminding you that Dodokkuli and Brigid remain on hand to tend to your phantom weapon needs, Lydirceil presents you with a replica of the Phantom Philleter as a keepsake before bidding you a fond farewell.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SEQ_00: The expedition messenger wishes to speak with you.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SEQ_01: At High Tide Harbor, the expedition messenger shares a summary of your Occult Crescent endeavors thus far. No sooner do you offer your seal of approval than he bids you return to the isle to see how Ketenramm and the crew are faring. Head swimming with imagery from your erstwhile adventures on the South Horn, you prepare for another voyage to those distant shores.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SEQ_02: You find Ketenramm by the fountain, spirits high and enthusiasm for the expedition undiminished. He informs you that a route to the island's northern reaches has been established, and, eager to venture out, requests you speak with Jeffroy before departing.
TEXT_KINGKD101_05511_SEQ_03: As you discuss the path to the North Horn with Jeffroy and the others, a familiar voice cuts through the hubbub. Iris, the tiny faerie you encountered when first arriving on the island, floats forth and announces her wish to accompany you─albeit as a passive observer. Seeing no harm in this arrangement, Ketenramm quickly assents. Party thus augmented, your thoughts turn to the isle's next unexplored frontier...
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_SEQ_00: Ketenramm has much to discuss with you.
TEXT_KINGKD103_05513_SEQ_00: Ketenramm is ready and raring to explore.
TEXT_KINGKD104_05514_SEQ_00: Ketenramm is considering your next steps.
TEXT_KINGKD106_05516_SEQ_00: It seems Iris has more to reveal.
TEXT_KINGKD107_05517_SEQ_00: Ketenramm is eager to return to the field.
TEXT_KINGKD107_05517_SEQ_01: Having heard Iris's tale and learned the true nature of the isle's architect, your goal is clear: find the Tower of Magic and defeat its twisted overseer, the Index. To this end, Ketenramm would first return to the base camp and ascertain the progress of his crew. Hopefully, their investigation into the North Horn's aetherial flows will reveal some clue as to how the tower can be accessed.
TEXT_KINGKD107_05517_SEQ_02:
It appears the North Horn's aetherial abnormalities partially result from the presence of several familiars, each of whom exude such powerful aetheric energies as to disrupt the local confluences. To restore the balance, and thereby gain ingress into the tower, these fiends must be dealt with─a task which inevitably falls to you.

※The relevant critical encounters are “Doubled Trouble,” “Quarried Away,” and “Appalling Behavior.”
TEXT_KINGKD107_05517_SEQ_03: Befitting of creatures capable of disrupting the ambient aether of half the island, your marks prove to be formidable foes. Yet with perseverance, not to mention judicious use of the ancient techniques at your disposal, they eventually succumb. Ketenramm will doubtless wish to hear of your success.
TEXT_KINGKD107_05517_SEQ_04: Learning of your triumphs, the veteran explorer is keen to verify whether the creatures' demise has had its intended effect. You decide to visit the solitary pavilion and examine the nearby confluence afresh.
TEXT_KINGKD107_05517_SEQ_05: On-site, the Archive reveals that while the confluence has stabilized significantly, the tower remains inaccessible. Sensing an opportunity to leverage his past experience roaming the wilds with Gulool Ja Ja, Ketenramm offers to dispatch more familiars in the hopes of further stabilizing the aetherial flows. While he and his crew labor toward a solution, you resolve to accumulate sufficient knowledge for your impending battle with the Index─for as your scholar-turned-tonberry companion is keen to stress, your foe brings the wisdom of an entire era to bear.
TEXT_KINGKD107_05517_SEQ_06: Thanks to Ketenramm and his crew, the aetherial flows have stabilized, and the Tower of Magic is finally accessible─under the right climatic conditions. With your head filled with a lifetime's worth of arcane knowledge and occult wisdom, you watch the skies for telltale signs of an auroral mirage and steel yourself for the fight ahead.
TEXT_KINGKD108_05518_SEQ_00: The Archive senses a change on the isle.
TEXT_KINGKD108_05518_SEQ_01: The Tower of Magic now lies empty, its twisted tenant slain by your hand. Back at the base camp, the Archive receives news of your success with jubilation, positing that the isle's ward is beginning to dissipate. Hoping the ship might now be free to leave, Ketenramm suggests you speak with Ofangeim to check the vessel is still seaworthy.
TEXT_KINGKD108_05518_SEQ_02: Learning of your victory, Ofangeim orders a thorough inspection of the ship, soon concluding that the vessel is ready to sail. Ketenramm is eager to share the good news, and so asks the crew to assemble in the phantom village, extending an invitation to you, Iris, and the Archive as well. You dutifully head for the plaza, ready to hear the veteran explorer address his comrades.
TEXT_KINGKD108_05518_SEQ_03:
Under brilliant blue skies, Ketenramm declares the mystery of Shades' Triangle solved at last and announces the expedition's pending return to Tural. Yet as the crowd whoops and cheers, the old explorer suddenly shifts his tone, asking his faithful crew a favor: that they breathe no word of their exploits upon the isle. Though this precaution is to ensure the knowledge stored within the towers does not fall into the wrong hands, he nevertheless laments the thought of sending his comrades home empty-handed. Despite his worries, however, the crew appear delighted─content at simply having joined the great Ketenramm on his last adventure.

Leaving the crowd to their revelry, you gather round as the Archive chastises himself for his actions, prompting Ketenramm to console the old scholar and remind him that the knowledge he so painstakingly preserved may one day save the world. Spirits lifted, the Archive thanks you once again for your endeavors. It is on this high note that you and Ketenramm resolve to make for High Tide Harbor, where the expedition messenger awaits.
TEXT_KINGKD108_05518_SEQ_04:
After greeting the relieved expedition messenger, Ketenramm announces he will be making his report to the Dawnservants. You wait for his return by the waterside, preparing to be peppered with myriad questions by the messenger.

In due course, Ketenramm returns from the palace and invites you to take a stroll to Morrow's Measure. Stopping in front of one of the great stone plinths that line the way, the venerable explorer informs you that he made his report to the Vow of Reason and mentioned nothing of your discoveries on the Occult Crescent. With the expedition thus officially ending in failure, he begins to muse on the nature of adventure, revealing that thrills and experience, not riches and reward, are what drive him ever onward. Indeed, it appears he is already considering his next steps─despite assurances that this outing would be his last. And so, wondering where Ketenramm's path will lead, you make for High Tide Harbor to speak with the expedition messenger once again.
TEXT_KINGKD108_05518_SEQ_05: Though the messenger has torn up his report at Ketenramm's request, he expresses hope that your discoveries might one day aid the world. For the time being, he thanks you for your contributions and shares that Ketenramm has already departed to oversee his crew's withdrawal from the isle. Though the expedition is at an end, the Occult Crescent remains accessible, should you have unfinished business on those strange, distant shores...
